45rnams yin no/ /mnga' bdag khri chung gis rting la yar lung du byon te/ de'i brgyad dbus kyi btsad po 'od bsrungs brgyad rnams yin te/ de'i sras 'od skyijo 'bar/ de la sras bdun la zhang rsha tsha/ khri lde 'bar/ gtsang pa tsha drug khri lde 'bar la sras drug la/ g.yu thog gi brgyad/ sna mo ba/ 'gying nga ba/ don mkhar ba/ thang khor ba rnams yin no/ dku /bye chung lha sgom gdung chad/ gung lde 'od 'bar spe skyar gdung chad/ zla ba'i brgyad rta shags pa dang / gra sna ba yin no/ /khri thog thag ma ru por gdung ༄chad/ chung ba bzhengs can 'bar gyi brgyad mon mkhar ba/ zhang mda' pa spun bdun thang pa rnams yin no/ /gtsang rā tsha spun drug la/ 'od btsan/ lha btsan/ gung btsan gsum gyi brgyad bying pa'i btsad po rnams yin no/ /lhan po'i brgyad byar na yod/ da༄ ra'i brgyad khru 'brug pa dang / chu mig geg po ba rnazlos yin no/ /'od bsrungs /rgyad do/ /gnya' khri btsan po nas tho tho ri snyan btsan bar la lo drug brgya drursha cu/ tho tho ri snyan btsan nas/ srong btsan sgam po 'khrungs pa yan la lo brgya dang lnga bcu/ de nas me pho khyi lo la byang ji ston pas(268)/ rgyal rabs dpag bsam ljon shing(269)brtsams pa yan chad la lo dgu brgya nyi shu rtsa gsum/ de nas lo drug cu rtsa gcig me pho khyi la rgyal rabs 'di bris pa yar bcad/ gnya' khri btsan po mar bcad la lo stong dang bdun brgya dgu bcu rtsa bzhi song 'dug rga /bod kyi rgyal rabs 'di ni/ phal cher byang ji ston pa shes rab 'bum gyis rgyal rabs mang po bsdus pa/ dpag thog pa rin rdor(260)la dris te bris so/ /

46bcu gnyis pa/ sa skya ba'i gdung rabasamador bsdus/dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung rabs(261)ni/ sngon gyi dus su/ bod yul du lha srin dar che ba'i tshe na/ yar lungs shar gyi g.yang spang skyes dang /si li ma gnyis mjal bar gyur/ srin po khrug med kyang de la chags pas 'khon par gyur cing / de gnyis 'khon pa'i bar du lha sras skyes pa la jo bo 'khon par skyes zhes grags pa/ ma sangs las 'khon gyi brgyud rim par byon zhing / rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi nang blon du gtogs pa/ 'khon rgyal dpal bo che'i sras bzhi ste/ khri mdzes lha legs/ tshe la dbang phyug 'khon klu'i dbang po bsrung ba/ tshe 'dzin/ gsum pa de sad mi mi bdun gyi drug pa yin/ bzhi pa'i sras rdo rje rin chen nas bu brgyud rim pa bzhin/ shes rab yon tan/ yon tan 'byung gnas/ tshul khrims rgyal po/ rdo rje gtsug tor/dge skyabs/ dge mthong / bal po/ shākya blo gros/ de dag thams cad kyang sngags rnying ma'i yon tan dang ldan no/ /༈de la sras gnyis/ gcen shes rab tshul khrims tshangs spyod bsrung(262)ngo / / ༈gcung dkon mchog rgyal po(263)shing pho khyi la 'khrungs/ chu pho byi ba la sa skya btab/ dgung lo drug cu rtsa dgu pa chu pho rta la 'das/ ༈ de'i sras sa chen kun dga' snying pos(264)'jam dbyangs/ khrir wa pa la sogs zhal gzigs/ chos gsan/lus yang por sprul bsgyur nus so/ chu pho spre'u lo la 'khrungs/ bla brang shar

wa bzhu gas dgang lo drug cu rtsa bdan pas so stagala'adas de'iXs ri ri ri bzhi/ gcen kun dga' 'bar/ ༈gnyis pa slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo(265)/ chu pho khyi lo la ska 'khrungs/ bzhi bcu zhe gcig pa chu pho stag la 'das/ spyogasum pa rje brtson grags pa rgyal mtshan(ske 66)/ me mo yos la 'khrungs/ sa skya'i dbu rtse rnying ma mdzad/ dgung lo bdun cu pa me pho byi ba la 'das/ ༈bzhi pa dpal chen 'od po(267)lcags pho rta la 'khrungs/ lnga bcu rtsa bzhi pa chu mo phag la 'das/ de'i sras gnyis/༈ gcen po sa skya paṇḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan(268)dpal bzang po chu pho stag la 'khrungs/ paṇa chen shākya sri la sogs pa mkhas pa rnams sten cing rig pa'i gnas lnga mkhyen/ bla brang shar pa sher 'byung la gtad nas gzhi thog btab/ rgyal bu go dan byang ngos pas gdan 'dren byung zhing / sngar rje btsun pa'i lung bstan la/ dus gyis byang phyogs nas mi skad rigs mi gcig pa/ zhwa khru 'phur ba 'dra ba gyon pa/ lham phag pa'i sna 'dra ba gyon pas gdan 'dren byung ba la byon na bstan pa la phan zhes pa bzhin/ shing pho 'brug drug cu rtsa gsum pa la/ khu dbon gsum byon/ lam du lo gsum 'gor/ rta lo la byang ngos su phebs/ rgyal pos/ go yug rgyal po rgyal sar bton pa'i mjal phrad 'khor ba dang / lug lo la mjal/ gnam mchod pa'i rgan mgo thob/bstan pa rgyas par mdzad/ bla ma de dgung lo bdun cu bzhes pa lcags mo phag la byang ngos su gshegs/ ༈gcung po zangs tsha bsod rgyal(269)/ shing pho 'brug la 'khrungs/ 'dan gyi lcags ri btab/ lnga bcu rtsa drug pa sa mo phag la 'das/ de dang jo bo dkon mchog skyid kyi sras/ ༈gcen po 'gro mgon 0) ma go ta rgya po bu gu yug rgyal po'i nu bo na/

48'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan(270)shing mo lug la 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu pa la khu bo'i phyags phyi la byang ngos su byon/ gyis rgyal po kau pe la(271)lu pa'i shan na bzhugs dus la/ byang ngos pa'i rgyal po mo go du(272)dang /bla ma pa lhan du byon pa mjal bas mnyes nas rgyal bu byang ngos pa la/ hor gyi rta pa brgya skor gcig byin nas/ sa skya pa blangs/ dbang bskur/ de nas yon mchod du sbrel te/ se chen rgyal sar byon phyin chad/ gu shrī(273)ti shrī(274)rim par bskos/ rgyal khams kyi bdag po mdzad/ dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe drug pa lcags pho 'brug gi zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nyer gnyis la sa skyar gshegs so/ ༈/gcung po mnga' bdag phyag na rdo rje(275)sa mo phag la 'khrungs/ dgung lo lnga pa la khu bo'i phyags phyir byon/ rgyal bu go dan gyis hor gyi chas su bcug /dpon mo me 'ga' 'dun gnang / se chen gyis bod spyi'i steng du bskos/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu pa me mo yos la sa skyar grongs/༈de dang ma gcig mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi sras/ bdag nyid chen po dharma pha la radzi ta(276)sa pho 'brug la 'khrungs/ bla ma 'phags pa grongs rting / dgung lo bcu bzhi pa la gong du byon/ rten skya bo yin na'ang bla ma'i gdan sa lta bur bzhugs/ rting la rgyal bu ji 'brag thi mur gyi sras mo dpal ldan gnang /bod la bskos nas yar byon pa/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gcig pa sa pho byi ba la tre maṇḍal(277)du 'das/ ༈de dang jo bo stag 'bum gyi sras slob dpon rarna bha tra chung ngu la 'das/ :zangs tsha'i btsun mo jo mo 'bro la sras mo slob dpon ma mdo sdo/ sras slob dpon rin chen rgyal mtshan(278)sa pho khyi la 'khrungs/ gong du byon/ bla ma dbus gtsang du byon pa'i shul du gdan sa lta bu mdzad/ bzhi bcu zhe lnga pa chu pho rta la shing khun du 'das so/ :zangs tsha'i btsun mo lha gcig mdzes ma'i sras rma slob dpon ma bsod nams 'bum

49dang / slob dpon ma nyi ma 'bum/ ༈btsun mo bzhi pa lha gcig mdzes ma'i nye gnas ma jo bo rdo rje ldan gyi sras/ slob dpon ye shes 'byung gnas(279)sa pho khyi la 'khrungs/ mkhan po shar ma zug par grags/ phyis rgyal bu hu dkar che'i bla mchod la ljang yul du byon/ sum cu so drug pa chu mo bya la der 'das/ :zangs tsha'i btsun mo lnga pa jo lcam hor mo'i sras slob dpon ma rin chen 'byung gnas/ :slob dpon ye shes 'byung gnas dang jo bo rin skyid kyi sras/ bla ma bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal(280)chu pho khyi la 'khrungs/ phyis o ja thu rgyal pos gdung brgyud du mnga' gsol/ gdung brgyud spel du bcug nas lha khang bla brang du lo bco lnga bzhugs/ bu yan du rgyal pos gu shrī gnang nas bzhi thog tu bskos/ lo bcu gnyis gdan sa mdzad nas/ drug cu rtsa gnyis pa chu mo phag la 'das/ ༈de sman rtser bzhugs dus kyi sras slob dpon bsod nams bzang po/ gzhon dus su byang ngos su gu'i gung mdzad/ gi gan rgyal po'i dus su mi skya mdzad/ sras mo mun dha gan gnang / dbang bskos nas btang ba/ mdo khams su 'das/༈dbus gtsang du dpon chen a glen gyi jo mo kun dga' 'bum phul ba'i sras bla ma kun dga' blo gros(281)pa/ rgyal po bu yan du/ ge gan/ ye sun thi mur gsum gyi ring la ti shrī mdzad/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu pa me mo yos lo zla ba gnyis pa la ta'i tur 'das/ ༈ma gcig yon bdag mo'i sras gcen po gcig byung ba 'das/ gnyis pa bla ma kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ ye sun thi mur rgyal po'i dus su/ gu shrī/ ti shrī mdzad/ gsum pa bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan(282)/ ye sun thi mur rgyal po'i dus chang gu'i gung(283)mdzad/ rgyal po 'ja' yan du/ rin chen dpal/ gong ma tho gan thi myur gsum gyi ring la ti shrī mdzad/ ༈ma gcig nam mkha' rgyal mo'i

wa 50 /de sras/ nam mkha' bshes gnyen/ gnyis pa bla ma nam mkha' legs pa gu shrī dang bzhi thog gi gdan sa mdzad/ gsum pa slob dpon chen po nam mkha' rgyal mtshan pa gong du byon/ bzhi pa gcig bu chung la 'das/ ༈ma gcig gzhon nu 'bum gyi sras/ slob dpon chen po kun dga' nyi ma/ gong du ta'i dben gu shrī mdzad/ bla ma don yod rgyal mtshan pa ta dben gu shrī dang / bzhi thog gi chos 'chad mdzad/ gsum pa bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa gu shrī dang /bzhi thog gi gdan sa mdzad/ bzhi pa gcig chung ba la 'das/ ༈ma gcig nyi ma rin chen gyi sras slob dpon nyi ma dpal/ sras mo slob dpon ma bsod nams 'bum/ gcung po slob dpon chen po kun dga' legs pa'i rgyal mtshan/sras mo mun dha gan dang sdebs nas dbang mdzad/ bsod nams bzang po dbang dang / sras mo mun bha gan gyi sras slob dpon rang nas gu shrī mdzad/ bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa dang / ngam rings si tu'i yum gyi sras slob dpon chen po chos kyi rgyal mtshan pas chang gu'i gung mdzad/ :kun spangs pa'i lcam mo'i sras slob dpon chen po blo gros rgyal mtshan pa dbang dang / khang gsar dpon mo'i sras mo slob dpon bsod nams 'bum/ sras slob dpon chen po bsod nams blo gros/ gcung po slob dpon chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan pa/bla ma nam mkha' legs pa/ khang gsar dpon mo'i sras slob dpon chen po kun dga' rin chen pa'o/ ༈/chos rje khu dbon gyi slob ma shan nub gung gsum du grags pa la/ shar pa'i gdung rabs ni/ gdung rus zhang zhung /sngags rnying ma ba jo bum zhes pa'i sras gsum las/ gcen po bla ma shar pa sher 'byung chos rje pa la rab tu byung / dpon chen shākya bzang po la bla brang shar nyos nas bzung / dgung lo drug cu rtsa bzhi thub/ gnyis pa slob dpon rdo rje 'od zer shar gyi gdan sa lo bdun mdzad/ dgung lo drug cu rtsa gnyis

51thub/ gsum pa slob dpon 'od zer 'phan rten dge bsnyen yin/ khong mched kyi lcam mo'i sras/ bla ma ye shes rgyal mtshan/ chos rje pa dang / shar pa shes 'byung gi slob ma yin/ gong du se chen me bha la'i bla mchod byas/ bla ma rdo rje 'od zer gshegs rting / shar gyi gdan sa lo bcu dgu mdzad/ dgung lo drug cu rtsa drug thub/ shar pa chen po rab tu ma byung gong gi sras/ phyug po rje btsun skyabs la 'khrungs pa'i sras gsum ka 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i slob ma yin/ gcen po bla ma dus 'khor ba(284)ye shes rin chen/ bla ma 'phags pa shing kun na bzhugs pa gdan 'dren pa la sa skya pa spyis rdzangs/ phyis rgya yul du byon/ se chen rgyal pos thugs la btags nas ti shrī mdzad/ dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe bdun la rtse lngar(286)gshegs/ gnyis pa bla ma kun dga' seng ge /bla ma'i gsung bzhin du gong du byon/ gong ma dang / rgyal bu a nan ta'i bla mchod mdzad/ dbus gtsang du byon nas shar gyi gdan sa lo nyi shu rtsa dgu mdzad/ dgung lo drug cu rtsa brgyad thub/ gsum pa 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan(286)/ se chen gyi lung gis/ sa skya'i bzhi thog gi bla mchod lo bcu drug mdzad/ phyis gong du/ ol ja du rgyal pos gdan drangs nas ti shrī mdzad/ dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu la gong du 'das/ lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan phun tshogs mnga'/ dpal sa skya'i mnga' thang bla ma 'di'i dus che ba lags/ bla ma shar pa dang ma gcig dpal 'bum gyi sras che ba/slob dpon chen po seng ge dpal dgung lo sum cu la rgya yul du gshegs/sras gnyis pa kun dga' bsod nams rgyal ba pas gdan sa mdzad nas/ me pho khyi lo sum cu so bzhi/ lo drug cu re gnyis pa la gshegs/ ma gcig nam mkha' rgyal mtshan ma'i sras che ba slob dpon rin chen rgyal mtshan/ rta lo/'dis lo lnga bcu bzhes/ gnyis pa slob dpon kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ gsum

52 pa slob dpon nyi ma gzhon nu la 'das/ /nub pa'i thog ma slob dpon 'u yug pa bsod nams seng gis chos rje pa la thug de la slob dpon zangs tshas bzhi thog phog de'i gcung po gcig gi sras bla ma kun smon yang chos rje pa la thusade'i gcung po kun dga' mdzes sku mched gnyis/ phyis dpon chen kun dga' bzang po'i(287)phyogs su chad nas/ bla ma 'phags pa dang thugs ma mthun pas/ se chen gyi lung gis spyags nas/ gcen po sman rtse'i yul du 'das/de'i dbon po yon tan dpa'aca/ gyis dbon po sangs rgyas dpal zer ba gcig gis gdan sa byas/ ༈gung pa chos rje pa'i slob ma skyo ston dri med/ de nas dbon brgyad med par slob mas gdan sa bzung ba/ bla ma dar ye shes/ gung pa dpal rnyil/ gung pa sher rgyal/ gung pa bkra shis bzang po/ :khang gsar pa'i brgyud pa/ sum pa grags pa rgyal gyi sras/ bla ma grags pa 'od zer(288)dang / bla ma shar pa rdo rje 'od zer dang / ye pa'i btsun pa yin/phyis bla ma 'phags pa'i dkon gnyer rgan pa mdzad / slob dpon dharmā pha la'i phyags phyi la gong du byon/ bla ma dus 'khor ba'i rjes la/ se chen gyi dus su ti shrī mdzad nas/ lo lnga bcu rtsa brgyad pa la gong du 'das/ de'i gcung po'i sras/ bla ma sangs rgyas dpal(289)gyi dus na khang gsar bla brang bzung /gong du ol ja du rgyal po dang / gu yug rgyal po dang / bu yan du rgyal po gsum gyi ring la/ ti shrī mdzad nas dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe brgyad pa la gong du 'das/ de'i sras bla ma grags pa rgyal mtshan pa gu shrī mdzad/ kun spangs mdzad pa'i ngang / dgung lo nyi shu rtsa drug pa la grongs/ khang gsar pa'i pha spun ring po'i brgyud/ slob dpon chen po nyi ma rgyal mtshan gong du gu shri mdzad nas grongs/ slob dpon chen po bde legs rgyal mtshan no/ /

——— (5shā bcu gsum/ sa skya ba'i dpon rabs lo rgyus mdor bsdus/sa skya'i dpon chen la snga ba shākya bzang po(290)la/ bla ma chos rje byang ngos la byon dus/ bla ma 'u yug pa dang / bla ma sher 'byung ma gtogs/dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad phyag 'tshal du bcug nas gdan sa lta bur bskos/ bla ma 'phags pa'i dus su/ se chen gyi lung gis/ dbus gtsang gi zam klu gun min dbang ha'i(291)dam kha byin nas dpon chen la bskos/khang gsar chen mo btab/༄lha khang chen mo'i(292)lcags ri phyi nang brtsigs/shing cha drangs nas thog ma phub pa 'das/ nang gnyer byas pa kun dga' bzang pos dpon chen byas nas/ rin chen sgang(293)lha khang bla brang(294)btab/lha khang lcags ri rdzogs par byas/ kun dga' bzang pos las ka gtad nas dpon chen zhang btsun/ phyug po sgang dkar ba/ byang rin rnams bla ma'i zhal tas rim par bskos/ kun dga' bzang po la bla ma ma mnyes nas/ se chen gyi lung gis bsad/ byang rin gyi dus na/ se chen gyi thugs la btags nas/can li si'i(296)dam kha dang / shel gyi sa dam gnang / de nas dpon chen kun gzhon/ dpon chen gzhon dbang / de'i ring la/ phye gsal chen mo(296)dang / dbus gtsang gi khrims kyi zhib cha(297)phal che ba byas/ de nas dpon chen byang rdor/ dpon chen ag glen/ 'dis sa skya'i lcags ri phyi ma dang / dpon po ri'i lcags ri/ khang gsar gling byas/ 'di gsum gyi bar

54la 'bri khung pa dang 'thabs/ de nas dpon chen legs pa dpal/ dpon chen seng ge dpal/ dpon chen 'od zer seng ges zhon cing dben(298)gyi dam kha bzung / dpon chen gan dga' rin chen/ dpon chen don yod dpal/dpon chen yon btsun/ sdung dpon chen 'od zer seng ge dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po/ dpon chen dbang phyug dpal/ dpon chen bsod nams dpal/yang dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po/ dpon chen dbang brtson/ dpon chen nam mkha' brtan pa/ dpon chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ dpon chen dpal 'bum/dpon chen blo chen/ dpon chen grags dbang / sa skya'i nang chen gnyer la/dpon chen kun dga' bzang po/ dpon gzhon nu dpal/ dpon kun gzhon/dpon don grub dpal/ dpon blo gros/ zha lu dpon shes ston pa rin chen dpal/ dpon grub bzang / nye gnas chen po dkon mchog bzang po/ nye gnas 'jam rgyal/ yang ston pa rin chen dpal lung gis bskos/ ston pa ring mo/ jo btsun kun shes/ nye gnas kun dga' 'phel/ dpon yon btsun grags pa dar lung gis bskos/ si tu'i dam kha byung / yang gsar bskos byas/ rin bsam du dben sha lung gis bskos/ nye gnas nam mkha' rgyal mtshan lung gis bskos/ dpon kun rin/ nye gnas 'bum skyabs/ nam mkha' dpal du dben sha/ nye gnas bzang po dpal/ dpon po chos rgyal/dbon seng ge rgyal mtshan shes rab 'od zer du dben sha/ de'i shul du dbon po dkon mchog rin chen dang / nang pa kun dga' 'bum rnams so/ /

56bcu bzhi pa/ bstan pa'i gtad rabs dang mkhan brgyud/ bshad rgyud byung tshul/paṇa chen sdom rgyad ni/ bstan pa'i gtad rabs(299)/ mkhan brgyad(300)/ bsha༄da rgyad(301)/ bod kyi 'dul 'dzin gyi gyes tshul ni/dadro po bstan pa thub pa chersha pos/ 'od srung la gtad/ des kun dga' bo/des sha na'i gos can/ des nyer sbal la/ des nag po la/ des dhir trī ka la/des legs mthong la gtad ces lung phreng tshegs las gsungs/ lang kur gshegs pa'i mdo'i 'grel pa(302)las/ thubaci pas 'od srungs/ des kun dga'o/ des sha na'i gos can la/ des u pa gu pa ta la/ des dhir dhi ka la/des si tsa ka la/ des budha shanti la/ des budha ma ti la/ des slob ma dge slong rtsibs la/ des su na sha ti la/ des rta skad la/ des shab la/ des klu sgrab la/ des ārya de ba la/ des rā ha la la/ des sam snya nan ti la/bas dge slong dgra bcom pa la/ des sngal ga ya sha la/ des ku ma rā la/des sha ya ta la/ des bha su bhanda la/ des a nan ta la/ des nyil lig na ya sha la/ des dge slong seng ge la gtad nas/ de man chad la/ bstan pa gcig gis gcig la gtad pa med zhes so/ /don gnyis pa bod kyi mkhan brgyad ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ sha ri'i bu/ sgra can 'dzin/ rsham ze sgra can 'dzin/ klu sgrub legs ldan byed/ ye shes snying po/ zhi ba 'tsho/ sad mi mi bdun gyi nang nas/ spa

56raṇḍa/ li sangs rgyas ye shes/ ka 'od mchog grags/ g.yo dge 'byung /gtsang rab gsal/ dmar shākya mu ni gsum mo/ /'ga' zhig zhi ba 'tsho'i slob ma ka ma la shrī la/ des g.yor dge 'byung des bla chen/ des kla mes zhes bzhed pa gda'/ 'ga' zhig sba raṇḍas lha lung rab 'byor dbyangs/༄ des bla chen zhes bzhed pa 'ang gda'/ g.yor gyi mkhan bu bla chen po/ des spa gong ye shes g.yung drung / grum a tsa ra ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des dbus gtsang gi mi lnga'am drug gam bcur grags pa rnams rab tu byung / 'a/ga' zhig bla chen gyi ya gong dang 'ol ba gnas brtan grags pa gnyis/de gnyis kyis bsnubs brag dpal gyi dbang phyug dang / cog ro shel 'byung gnas gnyis/ de gnyis kyis ge/ra chung sher grags dang grum gnyis grum gyis dbus gtsang gi mi lngar byed na klu mes shes rab tshul khrims/ sum pa ye shes blo gros 'bring ye shes yon tan/ lo tshong gnyis lngar bzhed/ drug tu byed na sba rag sdon/ bcur byed na klu mes shes rab tshul khrims/ 'bring ye shes yon tan/ glan shes rab 'bar/ sba tshul khrims snying po/ rag shi tshul khrims 'byung gnas te dbus pa lnga/ lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug /tshong khe shes rab seng ga u pa de ka ra/ 'o brgyad spun gnyis ste bcur byed/ /'ga' zhig klu mes/ 'bring sba rag lo tshong ste drug gis bla chen la blangs/ gzhan rnams kyis rting la grum la blangs zhes snga phyir bzhed pa gda'/sum pa ye shes blo gros/ gar mi yon tan g.yung drung / dmar shākya byang chub la sogs pa rting grum gyi mkhan po yin par bzhed/ klu mes kyi rting la grum la 'dul ba nyan/ gzhan tshos sngon la byon pa'i rjes klong thang du zin nas bsdongs yong par bzhed do/ klu mas kyi mkhan bu ni/ zhang sna nam rdo rje

67dbang phyug rngog byang chub 'byung gnas/ glan ye shes shes rab/ gru mer shes rab grags te bu bzhir grags pa dang / gzus la sogs dpag tu med la/ gru mer gyi mkhan bu/ yam shud rgyal ba 'od/ des sto so kor/ des gra pa mngon shes/ des khyung rin chen grags/ des bya 'dul dang / slob dpon phya pa la sogs pa/ byes rtsis pa gzhon nu seng ge des dpal ldan gro de nas brgyad pa rnams lags so/ /༄ yang klu mes/ glan ye shes shes rab/ glan tshul khrims byang / glan bsod gzhon/ glan 'byung gnas 'bar/ shākya pu bha/ ye shes grags/ khams pa 'brog chen/ blo gros grags pa la sogs pa del pa dang / rgya gsar sgang pa rjes 'brang rnams so/ lo ston gyi mkhan bu/ kyi ye shes dbang po/ rma gsal ba shes rab/ de gnyis kyis rgya gnyis mor gyur pa/ sbal ti jo sras/ sbal ti dbon/ zhig po sher seng la sogs pa skyor mo lung pa rjes 'breng dang bcas pa lags so/ 'dul ba stod dar(303)ni/ tta na shrī la 'dzi na mi tra gnyis kyi slob ma/ bal po'i pazlo ta shākya se na/ des dharmā pha la/ des gra byi phu'i klung lo tsa ba/ des mda'i skyog 'dul 'dzin/ des zhang zhung 'dul ba 'dzin/ des zhing mo che byang chub seng ge la sogs pa la sil cher gra pa rjes 'breng dang bcas pa yin te nyung shas las med do/ /'dul ba'i bshad rgyud(304)ni/ sangs rgyas/ nye bar 'khor/kun dga' bo/ sha na'i gos can/ nyer spas/ dhir dhi ku nag po/ legs )thong / blo mi 'beb/ yon tan 'od/ shākya 'od/ chos kyi bshes gnyen gnyis/ de gnyis kyis/ seng ge'i gdong can/ des tta na shi la dang /'dzi na mi tra gnyis la/ des cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan/ des g.yo dge 'byung /

58gtsang rab gsal/ dmar shākya mu ni/ de gsum gyi 'dul ba khur nas hor yul du byon pas skad mi cig pa'i phan pa ma byung nas/ mdo khams dan dig shel gyi dgon par kun gshen gsal 'bar rab tu byung ste/ ming dge ba gsal du btags ste 'dul ba bslabs so/ des grum la sogs la/ grum la klu mes kyis/ de la gzus rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ gzus la gzus kyi bu bzhi ni/rong khar phug gi sne po grags pa rgyal mtshan/ ka chu'i sbo chung tshul khrims ci'abyung gnas/ 'dzim pa shes rab 'od/ rgyal gyi glan tshul khrims byang chub rnams so/ /'dzims pa ma gtogs gsum la rgyas/ gsan khyad par sne po'i slob ma yin/ yang sne po'i slob ma sog pa tshul khrims bla ma/ sba chung gi slob ma nyang 'tshams pa rin chen bla ma/ 'dzims pa'i slob ma ko khyim pa ye shes bla ma la yang rgyas gsan te/ rgya'i bla ma rnam gsum zer ro/ /stod dar ni/ tta na shī la/ 'dzi na mi tra'i slob ma bal po shākya se na des dharmā pha la/ des gra byi'i phu'i rlung lo tsā/ des mda'i skyogs 'dul 'dzin/des gzus zhes bzhed do/ rgyal 'dul gyis slob ma kyi pho tshul 'phags/ tsha rong pa 'dul 'dzin/ rma tsho byang rtor/ bya 'dul/ sha mi smon lam 'od la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab/ ba phyar ba dang / zam tsher ba la sogs pa ni rgya nas brgyud pa'o/ /sha mi ni tsha rong pa'i yang slob ma yin/ bya 'dul rma tsho'i slob ma yin/ bya 'dul nas brgyad pa rtsibs pa gzhon nu seng ge nyang stod mkhar lung nas brgyud pa rnams dang cu/ sangs rgyas gzhung pa dang / ar dog ba/ nag mo dang / ri zan rtog pa dang / bkra shis sgang pa/ jo gdan rdo rje dpal nas brgyud pa la sogs so/ /bya 'dul gyi slob ma dpal chen ye shes g.yu drung / de'i slob ma mkhan po shun pa/ de'i slob ma zhig po sher mas la sogs pa dga' ba gdong pa bya 'dul nas brgyud(305)do/ skyi pho tshul phag

59gi slob ma rtar 'dul ba 'dzin pa/ de'i slob ma stong 'dul ba 'dzin pa la sogs rnal pa rjes 'breng dang bcas pa rnams lags so/ / sha mi'i bu bzhir grags pa ni rgya dur gyi klu dkar 'dul 'dzin/ yang dben gyi jo gdan pa tshul/sbal ti jo sras thag ma rdor gzhon rnams yin la/ thag ma'i slob ma rnal 'byor byang seng nas brgyad pa jog po dgon gsar ba sangs rgyas jo sras/ brag rtsa ba ston nam/ lha stodage 'dun dgongs pa la sogs pa rnams so/ /klub dkar ni rgya dur ba yin la/ sha mi g.yu rtser byung / tsha rong pa tsha rong dang spu gu dor byang ste/ lhag ru la sogs pa yar klung gi 'dul ba 'dzin pa rnams dang /rtsebs dkar ba zangs chen pa/ mtsho sna ba la sogs pa rnams ni tsha rong ba nas brgyad pa'o/ /yang thag ma rdor gzhon/ thag ma ka ba chen po dar ma seng ge'i yang slob ma yin no/ /bco lnga pa/ paṇa chen sdom brgyud byung tshul/paṇa chen sdom brgyud byung tshul ni/ bla ma paṇa chen shākya shrī(306)bod du byon pa'i dus su/ chu shul sprog ma dgon par(307)mi bcu gcig gis bsnyen rdzogs byas pa'i nang nas mkhan po rdo rje dpal dang / byang chub dpal gnyis kyis phyag phyi la 'gro bar zhus pas/ zul phu'i na bza' 'phred gsol la 'dul ba nyon la shog gsungs nas/ 'dul ba bslabs byon pas/ paṇa chen gyi bla mchod jo brtan gtsang so ba'i phyi la bla mchod du bzhag paṇa chen rgya gar la 'byon dus phyags phyi la 'gro zhus pas/ rgya gar du tshad pa mi thub/

60gtsang so ba la rten la 'dul ba shod/ dge slong bzhi sde dang ma bral ba gyis gsung nas/ gtsang so ba bshags(gshegs)pa'i rjes la mkhan po rdo rje dpal gyis mkhan po byas/ byang chub dpal gyis slob dpon byed dus/ logs su 'then bzhed nas/ so sor gyes pas tshogs pa sde gnyis byung / ༈de rting bla ma chos kyi rgyal po'i bsnyen rdzogs gyi mkhan slob gong du gdan 'dren byung bas/ mkhan po gtsang so dbang phyug grags gdan sar bskos nas 'dam du byon pas/ bla ma chen po bsnyen rdzogs mdzad zin pa gsan nas logs su bzhugs pas tshogs pa gnyis byung ngo / /de'i gdan sa mkhan po bde ba dpal gyis mdzad/ de rjes mkhan po bka' bzhi pa grags gzhon gyis mdzad/ de rjes mkhan po bsod nams grags/ de rjes mkhan po bsod nams bzang po/mkhan po gtsang so'i rjes su khong rang gi dbon po gzhon byang pas mdzad/ de rjes khong gi dbon po mkhan po 'dul tshad pa byang chub bzang po/ de rjes mkhan po 'dul tshad pa don grub dpal/ tshogs chen pa(308)mkhan po rdo rje dpal gyi rjes su mkhan po sangs rgyas dpal/ de rjes mkhan po 'od zer dpal/ de rjes mkhan po chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ de rjes mkhan po sangs rin/ de rjes mkhan po bsod nams dpal/ de rjes mkhan po shes rab mgon/de rjes mkhan po seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan po sangs rgyas dpal gyi dus su/gzhu pa mkhan po dkon mchog bzang pos logs su then pas/ bye rdzing pa'i tshogs pa(309)byung / de rjes mkhan po thugs rje dpal/ de rjes mkhan po kun dga' dpal/ de rjes mkhan po tshul khrims dpal/ de rjes mkhan po sangs gzhon/ de rjes mkhan po dar ma bzang po/ de rjes mkhan po tshul khrims mgon po'o/ /

krobacu drug pa/ bka' gdams pa'i brgyud pa byung tshul/bka' gdams pa'i(310)brgyud pa ni/ mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho rab tu bzang po 'khrungs pa'i gdung brgyud/ shar phyogs za hor gyi rgyal po(311)dge ba'i dpal gyi sras gsum gyi 'bring po zla ba'i snying po dge 'dun phal chen(312)sde las rab tu byung pa/ bri ka ma la'i gnas brtan/ jo bo dhi pang ka ra(313)/ de la slob ma rgya gar dang bod du mang du byon kyang / bod du sras kyi thu bo khu rngog 'brom gsum/ de'i nang nas bka' gdams kyi mes po 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas(314)/ stod lungs pa gnams kyi bye ma lung pa/ rten dge bsnyen(316)te/ ra sgreng dgon pa(316)btab/ de'i sras mang du byon kyang / ska mched gsum ni/ phu chung ba gzhon nu rgyal mtshan(317)/ po to ba rirnon chen gsal(318)/ spyan mnga' tshul khrims 'bar (319)te/ kham pa lung pa(320)dang bzhir grags/ phu chung pas slob ma ma bsten no/ /bcu bdun pa/ bka' gdams gzhung pa'i brgyud pa byung tshul/po to ba la slob ma nyis stong brgyad brgya tsam 'dus/ ra sgeng gi gdan

62sa lo gsum mdzad/ thugs kyi sras bu chen brgyad du grags/ gtsang du ram ding ma ba/ snang gre lhas pa gnyis/ gnyal na glang gnyos gnyis su grags te/gnyal pa chos 'bar dang / bun pa lha rje gnyis/ dol nas snye mo bu chung pa dang / rog dmar zhur ba gnyis/ dbur stod nas zhang sha ra ba yon tan rgya mtsho/ glang ri thang pa rdo rje seng ge gnyis la nyi zla zung gcig tu grags/glang ri thang pa'i slob ma sha'o sgang pa nas/ glang thang zhang / dge bshes gnyan/slob dpon sgom pa/ dge bshes mgar/ slob dpon gtsang pa/ de nas glang thang sangs rgyas dbon/ rgya ma ba la phul/ glang thang zhang gi slob ma chos rje phag mo gru pa yang yin/ :zhang sha ra ba la grwa pa sum stong drug brgya kha yar tsam byung pa'i nang nas bka' babs bzhir grags pa'i byang chub sems kyi bka' babs yin/ chad kha ba la rnam thar gyi bka' babs/ nyi mal 'dul 'dzin la longs spyod kyi bka' babs/ rnal 'byor shes rdor/ 'dis gdan sa lo gsum mdzad/ gzhung bshad kyi bka' babs dam pa stabs kha ba dang bzhi/snar thang pa chos lung sku gshegs dang lnga yin/ sngar gyi stabs kha bas/ 'dod 'jo/ ngar dgon/ khru phu/ stabs kha ba dang bzhi btab bo/ / :bya 'chad kha ba'i slob ma se spyil bu ba dang / rnal 'byor byang seng / gan pa dar re la sogs pa rnams yin/ ses spyil bu btab/ de'i slob ma lha rin po che/ des lha 'gro ba'i mgon po/ des lha lung gi dbang phyug /de jo grags kyi khu bo skyo mo dar rgyan gyi bu yin/ des lha zur khang pa/ des jo bo grags rin gyi sras/rnal 'byor byang seng gis gro pa dgon pa btab bo/ /sangs rgyas dar res mkha' ru dgon pa btab bo/ /snar thang pa glang gtum ston blo gros grags kyis snar thang(321)btab ste/ chos lung du sku gshegs pas/ chos lung sku gshegs su grags/ de'i

63gdan sa sding dkar sku gshegs/ shes rab grags kyis snar thang zhes pa'i ming btags/ de'i gdan sa zhang btsun rdo rje 'od/ de rnams kyi slob ma dpal ldan gro bdag nyid du(322)grags/ des sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga dang / rje btsun sgrol ma dang / gnas brtan bcu drug(323)dang / grub thob nyang ri khrod pa(324)rnams kyi zhal gzigs/ sangs rgyas stong gi ya gyal du grags/de'i slob ma zhang ston chos kyi bla ma/ de'i rjes su sangs rgyas sgom pa seng ge skyabs/ des byang chen btab/ 'gro mgon zhang dang dus mtshungs yin/de'i ring la dngha na shi la'i slob ma skyel nag grags seng gis mtshan nyid kyi grwa sa(326)btsugs/ bcom ldan ral gri(326)la sogs byung / de'i gdan sa mkhan po 'chims nam mkha' grags(327)/ bla ma 'phags pa'i bla ma yin/lha khang rnying ma bzhengs/ chu mig chos 'khor chen mo'i(328)gral dpon(329)mdzad/ de'i slob ma skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims/ des snar thang gi gtsug lag khang chen mo dang lcags ri chen mo bzhings/ de'i gdan sa chos rje nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ des tshul khrims stag brgyad bskos/ chos khrims(330)dag ther cher mdzad/ de'i rjes su mkhan po 'dul ba 'dzin pa grags pa brtson 'grus ze'u bse chen dang / sol ja du rgyal po'i dus su gong du bzhuṭa nas bstan pa dang / gdan sa la phan pa mdzad/ de'i slob ma mkhan chen grags pa shes rab/ de'i gdan sa mkhan po 'chims blo bzang grags pa/ sha khrims dang / khams pa mi bsten pa'i khrims mdzad/ de la sogs gzhung 'chad /na byed pa rnams po to ba'i brgyud de bka' gdams gzhung par (331)grags

64bco brgyad pa/ bka' gdams man ngag pa'i brgyud pa byung tshul/spyan snga ba tshul khrims 'bar gyis lo dgon pa btab/ de'i slob ma stod lungs pa rin chen snying pos btsan gro dgon pa btab/ stod lungs pa'i dpon po spyan snga ba'i gsol ja ba gzhon nu 'od kyis bya yul btab ste/ bya yul ba chen por grags/ de'i slob ma chen po bcu bzhir grags pa/ khams su rab kha ba chen po/ ngang tshang pa chen po gnyis/ dgas por shar pa gling pa chen po dang / bo thang pa chen po/ g.ye ru ri mer ba chen po/ rgya ri ba chen po/gtsang du brag dmar ba chen po/ brag nag pa chen po/ bu sman pa chen po/mal gror shul pa chen pos rgyal po stengs btab/ khroms zher chen pos(332)skam skam(333)btab/ smad dum bu ri ba chen po byang chub sems dpa' zla rgyal gyis dum bu ri(334)btab/ skyer sgom pa chen pos rgya ma'i mchod khang rnying ma dang / rin chen sgang btab bo/ /bya yul du snubs mchod gnas/gtsang pa jo sras rin po che glang lung pa/ lor dge bshes gnas brtan/gtsang pa rin chen glang lung pa nas/ bya yul dang gnyis ka bskyangs/ des se rnal 'byor/ des sangs rgyas sgom pa/ des them tshe ring mo ba/ des khams pa lung pa/ des sangs rgyas gtsang ston 'bri khung pas bkrongs/ de'i rjes su slob dpon jo bos lha khang gsos/ des sangs rgyas ston pa/ des slob dpon sgom pa/ des slob dpon rgyal stangs pa/ des slob dpon btsan

65khro ba/ spyan mnga' tshul khrims mgon po/ bya yul ba 'di gdan sa chos pa gang bzang res 'dzin pa min pa/ dpon brgyad kyis 'dzin pa'i srol med/ rgyam ba'i skyer sgom chen pos/ rgya ma rin chen snang dang / rgya ma'i mched bang rnying ma btab pa'i rjes su bya yul ba chen po'i skye ba yin zer/ sangang rgyasadabo ston gyis rgya ma'i lha khang gsar ma btab/ des slob dpon sangs yon/des slob dpon gzhon nu seng ge /des slob dpon skam dgon pa gzhom nu 'bum/ des slob dpon 'od 'byung / des slob dpon gzhon nu 'od/ des slob dpon bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ 'di skyer gyi gdung brgyad kyis 'dzin pa sras yin/ yang jo bo'i slob ma'am bla mchod bzhi las/ ༄rnal 'byor pa phyag khri mchog /rnal 'byor pa shes rab rdo rje/ rnal 'byor pa 'dzeng dbang phyug rgyalamatshan gyis slob ma ma bskyangs/ rnal 'byor pa chen mo lung a mes byang chub/ dpal ldan dgon pa bar grags pa'i slob ma/ zhang ka ma ba/ gnyan sna mo ba/ 'bre ko de lung pa/ tshe kong sne zur ba bzhi la/ dgon gyi bu bzhir grags pa/ kha rag sgom chung dang lnga ste/ de rnams so so'i brgyad dang / khyad par sne zur ba'i brgyad/ gtsang na grang po lung pa dang / stospyi bo lhas pa la sogs pa dang / darshas na rgya ma rin chen sgang pa'ang yin te/ de la sogs pa gdam ngag gtso bor ston pas bka' gdams gdams ngag par grags so/ /bcu dgu pa/ bka' gdams lam rim pa'i brgyud pa byung tshul/yang jo bo'i slob ma nag tsho lo tsā ba/ de'i slob ma rong pa phyag sor

66pa(336)sku tshe hril por sku mtshams la bzhugs/ lan gcig 'khrug zlums(336)la byon pa/ sma tsho byang rdor gyis 'u shang rdor spyan drangs te/ grwa pa lnga brgya dang bcas pas chos zhus pa'i nang nas/ zur chos pa(337)bzhis zin bris so sor byas pas/ bstan rim(338)bzhi byung pas/ rong pa'i bu bzhir grags pa ni/ zul bya 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po/ rog stag can pa/gtsang na zhu ldan pa chen po/ rnam par ba chen po/ 'dis rnam par dang /ram pa lha sdings btab/ gsang phu de'u thog(339)gi gdan ga'ang lo bdun mdzad/ de dag ni rong pa'i bka' brgyad lags/ rong pa phyag sor ba'i dgon pa bcom chung ba'i phu rwa sgreng gi zhu'og na yod pas bka' gdams 'og mar grags te/ rwa sgreng bka' brgyad dang gnyis la bka' gdams gong 'og tu grags so/ / dkunyi shu pa/ gsang phu dgon pa'i gdan rabs/ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo sum stong nyis brgya dang brgyad na/bod kha ba can gyi ljongs/ 'brog mtsho dang nye ba'i phyogs su/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i(340)dge bshes rdo rje gzhon nu(341)zhes pa'i sras lnga'i che shos/rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis/ jo bo rje ( sogs pa'i mkhas grub du ma bsten cing / gsang phu ni'u thog gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs te/ bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad/ ༈de'i gcung po jo sras klu khri/ klu byang / chos skyabs/thub pa dang bzhi'i chung ltag jo sras chos skyabs kyis dpal mo zhes pa khab

68mdzad/ de'i rjes su gnyal pa ri lus lo gnyis/ rnam pa ra bas lo brgyad mdzad do/ ༈/bla ma de gsum gyi slob ma cha pa chos kyi seng ge(350)/ khyung rin chen grags kyi slob ma rgya dmar ba/ stag pa kha che la sogs nyang stod stag tshal/smon gro la sogs su bshad pa mdzad pa'i drung du byon te/ stod lung rgya dmar dang / bla ma zung du bsten te lung rigs kyi sgro 'dogs bcad nas sne'u thog gi gdan sa lo bco brgyadaXkyi bar du mdzad/ mthar yang gro lung pa'i drung du byon nas kyang spros pa bcad(361)/ 'dzam bu'i gling thams cad snyan grags dang bu slob kyis khyab par mdzad pa de'i sras kyi gtso bo seng chen brgyad du grags pa/ gtsang nag pa brtson 'grus seng ge dan 'bag smra ba'i seng ge'abru zha bsod nams seng ge ma bya rtsod pa'i seng gi rtsegs dbang phyag seng ge nyang bran chos kyi seng gi ldan ma dkon mchog seng ge dmyal pa dothan tan seng ge ste/ seng ge brgyad zer/ kha cig gi gtsang pa 'jam seng 'dren pa'ang 'dug 'khon jo sras rtse mo/ rngog jo sras ra mo/ khu jo sras ni tsho/ gnyos jo sras dpal chen bzhi la jo sras bzhi zer/ gzhan yang bzad pa ston skyabs/rdo rje 'od zer la sogs pa sde snad 'dzin pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / kham pa rdo rgyal la sogs pa grub thob du ma/ mdor na mdo stod smad/ dbus gtsang / sto gnyal gyi cho rigs btsun zhing blo gsal ba dpag tu med pa smin par mdzad de bstan pa ches cher gsal bar mdzad do/ /de'i rjes su thugs kyi sras rtsegs dbang phyug seng gis lo lnga/ de gnyis kyi slob ma dad pa bzang pos lo bdun/ 'dzam tsan zhes lo bdun/ bzad pa dar ma 'od/ bzad pa don grub gnyis kyis lo sum cu mdzad do/ /yang 'bre shes rab 'bar gyis nyang 0) so gnyis zer ba'ang 'dug

69stod skyegs gnas rnying du chos bshad cing / khyad par bstan pa'i snying po phar phyin don du gnyer ba la/ 'dus pa'i nang nas la stod dgon mkhar gyis gdan sa mdzad cing / deng sang gi bar du'ang de'i mi brgyad kyis 'dzin/ gtsang pa 'bre skur gyis dga' ba gdong dang bya rog tshang la thegs su bshad pa mdzad/khu sher brtson gyis thang po cher(352)bshad cing grwa pa khri lhag tsam 'dus/ar byang chub ye shes(353)kyis gnam rtsed ldeng(354)dang / gzhu kun dga' ra ba(366)/ gnam ljing kha la sogs su bshad do/ /dkar chung ring mo dang / khu'i slob ma zhang e bas mon 'dra dang / rgya grong / 'or skyo reg /me reg / 'on lcang rdo la sogs su mdo smad tsho bzhi'i grwa pa la chos gsungs shing / mkhas pa bsod rin dang / gnyal pa zhig pa/ rgyal ba so ston la soṭa dpag tu med pa smin par mdzad cing / gral stan za 'og la byed pa dang /das chos re la ja sig chen(356)lnga bcu re tsam skol ba la sogs longs spyod skyong de dus kho na che bar grags/ de'i rjes su mkhan po bsod rin gyis gdan sa byas/ de grub thob la stod dmar po'i sras che shos yin/ las kyi me long(367)la sogs bstan bcos kyang du ma mdzad/ chos blo bshad byed(358)pa'i srol byung / rjes su 'gral sher rgyal gyis gdan sa mdzad/ sku tshe'i smad la shab 'bre sgang du gra sa btsugs/ de'i slob ma ra grags she la sogs pa yin no/ /༈yang zhang e pa dang / dan 'bag gi slob ma gnyal pa zhig pos(359)'on lcang rdo la sogs su bshad pa las bu dgur grags pa byung ste/bzad rings/ phu thang dar dkon/ gtsang drug gsum la snga tshar gsum zer/'u yug pa bsod nams seng ge / bo dong rin po che/ slob dpon jo nam gsum la bar tshar gsum zer/ rgya 'chims ru ba/ chos rje 'jam gsar/skyel nag grags seng gsum la phyi tshar gsum zer bar grags pa las/ dar

70dkon gyis yar lung dang / mtsho smad lha khang la sogs par bshad do/ /gnyan dar ma seng ge dang / ja yul dkar mo la sogs slob ma byung ngo / /gtsang drug gis zha lur bshad gra btsugs so/ /'u yug pa sa skyar byon/ zhang mdo sde dpal la sogs slob ma byung ngo / /stabo dong rin po ches/ brag ram gyi bshad gra btsugs so/ /slob dpon dar lo/ dbu ma ba sher 'bum dang /bu ston grags seng la sogs slob ma byung ngo / /gtsang pa jo nam gyis 'gral gyi slob ma byas nas/ 'gral gyi gdan sa mdzad kyi yod pa la/ de'u thog tu bzad pa don grub kyis gdan sa gtad de/ gnyis ga'i gdan sa mdzad nas chos gzhi rnams dril te lo bco lnga'i bar du gdan sa mdzad cing / rog dang /'od zer mgon po la sogs pa'i slob ma byung / de'i rjes su rog gis zla ba drug mdzad/ de nas slob dpon 'od zer mgon pos lo sum cu so lnga byas shing / slob dpon chen po shag gzhon dang / tshad ma'i skyes bu slob dpon chen po don grub dpal/ kha rag pa byang gzhon/ sma ra ba brtson rnying / lo ro ba dar ma 'od/ tshal pa shag bkras la sogs pa dpag tu med pa smin par mdzad/slob dpon chen po shākya gzhon nus/ tshal gung thang(360)du bshad ga(361)btsugs nas lo drug song ba na/ ni'u thog tu spyon drangs nas gdan sa lo nyi shu rtsa bdunadumadzad cing / blo gros mtshungs med dang / phyogs las rnam rgyal/ g.ye pa rdor gzhon/ rgyal sde ba gzhon nu seng ge /mkhas pa'i skye bo du ma dang / chos rje skar ma ba dang / rtogs ldan grags seng la sogs mkhas grub du ma smin par mdzad do/ /de'i rjes su rgya ma bas lo brgyad gdan sa byas/ de'i rjes su phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis lo brgyad/ yar 'brog pa gzhon 0 lo bcu bdun zer ba'ang 'dug

71rgyal gyis zla ba gcig dang / slob dpon gzhon seng gis lo brgyad/ gtsang dkar gyis lo gsum/ slob dpon blo gros seng ga spre'u lo la slob dpon shākya gzhon nu dang / slob dpon don grub dpal dpon slob kyis gung thang gi bshad grwa btsugs nas lo drug na/ slob dpon shag gzhon nee thog tu byon zhing /gung thang du slob dpon chen po don grub dpal gyis/ stag lo nas rta lo'i bar lo bzhi bcu zhe gcig gi bar du mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum(362)gyis bshad grwa legs par bskyangs te/ slob dpon chen po dkon mchog seng ge dang / 'jog po ba gnyis dang / kun mkhyen shes rab rgyal mtshan dang / mkhas btsun blo grol bzang po dang / slob dpon shes rab 'phel dang / smra ba'i skyes mchog bsod nams dpal la sogs pa nyi zla ltar grags pa rnams dang / slob dpon bka' bzhi pa dang / slob dpon chos mchog la sogs pa gsung rab sde snad kyi don la blo gros rgyas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / mkhas btsun ri khrod pa la sogs pa mkhas grub bsam gyis mi khyab pa smin cing grol bar mdzad/ sras kyi thu bo shes rab rgyal mtshan rta lo la rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur te/ khong gis lo bcu bzhi gdan sa mdzad/ yos lo nas slob dpon blo gros bzang pos lo bcu gcig gi bar du gdan sa mdzad de/ slob dpon bsod nams dpal bskos/ ༈yang 'dzam tse chen po'i dus su gtsang pa 'jam seng gis bshad pa mdzad pas gling stod pa gyes te/ dpon po jo phun zhes pas bdag brkyen byas nas/ 'jam ston/ zhu ston/ blo gros 'bar/ zhes pa gsum gyis rim pas bshad/ de dag gi rjes su/ slob dpon gnyal zhig 'u shang rdor spyan drangs te lo brgyad kyi bar du bshad pa mdzad/ de nas rgyal ba so ston gyis byas/ khong bros pa'i rjes su rgya 'chims ru ba bde ba can nas bos te gdan sa mdzad/de'i slob ma chu mig pa ye shes dpal gyis gdan sa lo bco brgyad mdzad cing /

72ldan ma grags rin/ las stod pa grags rgyal/ las stod pa 'bum mdzes/'chims ru ba sangs rgyas/ lho brag pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ gnyags grags tshul/ yar lungs pa spyan ras gzigs dang / btsan thang pa bsod nams dbang phyug /zhang thugs rje brtson 'grus la sogs pa mang du byon/ ldan ma grags rin gyis lo brgyad mdzad/ de nas sto brag pas snga phyi dril bas lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis mdzad cing / thog ston dang / nyang stod pa dang / btsan dgon pa gzhon nu bsam gtan/ dbon dge ba zhang shes rab ye shes la sogs smin par mdzad/ nyang stod pa ye shes mgon gyis lo bdun bla chos mdzad/ yang lho brag pa rang gis byas/ de'i shul du btsan mgon pas lo nyi shu'i bar du gdan sa byas shing / chos grags gsar ma dang / bla brang dpon po/ lha sa ba/ ru 'tshams pa sher rgyal la sogs pa de'i slob ma yin/ de'i rjes su/ bla brang pa/de nas chos grags gsar ma/ de nas lha sa ba/ ya rtse ba/ lha yul ba/ rin chen grags pa/ yon tan rgya mtsho/ yang rgya 'chings kyi dus su/ bde ba can du gnyags grags tshul gyis bshad cing / la stod pa 'bum mdzes dang / la stod pa grags rgyal/ rgya ston bsod rin/ mdzes rtog pa la sogs pa de'i slob ma yin/ rjes su rgya ston bsod rin gyis bshad pa byas te/ dge brag pa dang /don grub seng ge ral dkar/ dbon dmar ba la sogs pa de'i slob ma yin/rjes su dge brag pas gdan sa byas/ de'i rjes su snye thang pa bkra shis seng ge /༈yang bzad rings kyis khro phur(363)bshad grwa btsugs te/ 'ga' pa dang /stag ston spyil bu ba la sogs slob ma mang po byon/ ldong gis gdan sa byas/de'i rjes su de gnyis kyi slob ma sto pa grub seng gis byas te/ rong pa dang /rigs kyi thigs pa dang / gzhon mdzes dang / zhang lam dang / nyag gcig la sogs slob ma mang du byon/ rigs thigs pa'i slob ma zha lu ba bu ston kha che

73(364)yin/ ༈yang skyel nag gis snar thang du tshad ma bshad pa las/ skyo ston grags 'bum dang / chu mig pa seng ge dpal la sogs byung / skyo ston grags 'bum gyi slob ma bcom ldan ral gri /de'i slob ma mkhan po zi dbon/dbu tshad pa rin bzang / skyo ston shag 'bum/ grags rgyal/ gra rings/ gra thung / rtsed rings/ rtsed thung la sogs pa yin/ rjes su dbon rin 'byang gis bshad/ de'i slob ma ldong ston yin no/ / cunyer gcig pa/ bka' brgyud pa spyi'i byung tshul/thub bstan lnga brgya tha ma la gangs can gyi khrod du theg chen gsang sngags kyi sgrab pa 'dzin skyong spel ba'i bka' brgyud chen mo 'di lta bu byung tshul ni/rgyas ba rdo rje 'chang chen pos dngos su rjes su gzung zhing / slob dpon klu sgrab yab sras/ la ba pa(366)/ nag po spyod pa(366)/ ye shes kyi mkha' zlogro skal pa bzang po rnams las bka' babs bzhi(367)thob ste/ snga ma la pha rgyad(368)dang / phyi ma la ma rgyud(369)kyi'o/ /de lta bu'i grub thob chen po rto lo shes rab bzang po'o(370)/ /de la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes kyis dka' ba bcu gnyis(371)spyod nas dus thabs bsten pas mos gus 'ba' zhig gis sa lam bgrod de/ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub(372)brnyes pa ni jo bo na ro ta pa ye shes dngos grub(373)ste/ dpal na len du'i byang sgo bsrung ba'i bzlo ta chen po'o/ ༈des smin cing grol bar mdzad pa sgra bsgyur rgyal po mar pa lo tsā chos kyi blo gros(374)ni/ mar yul gyi mar she lugs su rtse'i

74byes marapakhri 'jam/ lho phu chus khyer gyi brag steng du byon pa'i sras gsum gyi 'bring po mar ston dbang phyag 'od zer gyi sras lnga'i mtha' ltag tu bya lo la 'khrungs/ 'brog mi shākya rā shes(375)dang / 'gos lo tsā ba(376)la lo tsā bslabs/ rgya gar du lan gsum byon/ rje 'gran gyi do med rnam gnyis bsten pa ni/ gtso bo paṇa chen na ro pa/ de 'og rgyal sras me tri pa(377)/ khyad par du grub thob zhal lnga bsten pa ni/ dpal zhi ba bzang po/ ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa(378)/ ri ri ba(379)/ ka so ri ba(380)/ a ba dhu ti pa'o(381)/ /chos kyi 'brel pa'i bla ma(382)bcu gsum ni/ pham thing gi bal po spyi ther ba/ de'i gcung po dpal 'jigs med grags pa/ spen ta ba/dpal ye shes snying po/ ka na ka shrī/ ma: shrī spyo na/ brnya rakshim ta/ ta sprug ta rakshi ta/ kha che la snam ka ra/ jo bo tse lu ba/ sing ga gling pa rol pa'i rdo rje/ dpal ku su lu pa/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma chu shing gi snye ma can no/de rnams kyis dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs shing bka' bstan bcos lung man ngag du ma thob/ yi dam zhal gzigs shing grub pa brnyes/ te lo pa dngos su gzigs/ des sngon mar pa lung bstan/ sa ra ha chen po la rnal lam du chos thob/ khyad par du'ang bla ma na ro pa lo drug zla bdun du bsten nas/ mthar bod du gdul bya snod ldan yod cing / rigs brgyad nam mkha'i me tog yal kyang / chos brgyud chu bo'i gzhung ltar ring / rsha tsa nyid skye ba 'di'i 'og rol du mchog gi dngos grub thob/ khyod kyi brgyud pa bdun tshun chad du nga rang gis byin gyis rlob cing / mchog gi dngos grub thob ces lung bstan cing /rgyal tshab tu bskos pa ji lta bar/ bod du sgrab brgyud kyi bstan pa nam langs pa la nyi ma shar ba ltar mdzad cing / gnyirā med rnam rgyal(383)gyi brgyud chen po la sogs bka' bstan bcos mang du bsgyur/ sto brag tu sku mkhar

10 dgu thog(384)rtsigs nas 'gro don bskyangs/ dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa brgyad la mkha' spyod du(386)gshegs/ de'i sku'i sras bdun gyi che shos dar ma mdo sde/ sku yon tan phun sum tshogs kyang sku gzhon nu la bar chad byung ste gsheṭa/phug ngon gyi ro la grong 'jug(386)byas nas 'phur te/ rgya gar du bram ze gzhon nu'i ro la grong 'jug byas pas rje ti phu bar gyur pa yin yang zer/de'i gcung dar ma bsam gtan la sogs drug byung / thugs kyi sras(387)ni/byang gi mar pa mgon legs dang / dgyer phu'i dge bshes klog skya jo sras la sogs dang / khyad par du ka chen bzhi zhes pa shar gyi ka chen dol gyi 'tshur ston dbang nge(388)nus mthus thugs zin/ lho'i ka chen gzhung gi rngog ston chos rdor(389)shes rab kyis thugs zin/ nub kyi ka chen gtsang rong gi mes ston tshon pos(390)zhabs tog gis thugs zin/ byang gi ka chen gung thang gi mi la ras pa(391)mos gus kyis thugs zin no/ snga ma gsum ni bshad brgyud gtso/ phyi ma gcig pu sgrab brgyud(392)gtso che'o/ gzhan yang gnyal gyi shud bu sgom dpal rtogs pazlo thugs zin/ skyo ston skya rgyal/ ba rang lnga ba can/zhang bsod nams 'bar/ rngog mdo sde la sogs kyang bla ma dang mjal lo/ /dol gyi 'tshur ston dbang nge ni/ ༈gzhung gi rngog ston chos rdor ni rus chen bzhi las stong gi sde tshan rngog /bod kyi rgyal po'i blon po mang du byang ba'i brgyud/ rngog ban chen zhes pa sngags rnying ma pa'i dge bshes che ba rshacig gi sras su gzhu ri bor sku 'khrungs/ thog mar yab la rnying ma bslabs/ de nas rje mar pa dang 'jal te/ dbang bshad sgrab mtha' dag thob/ 'bul mo che lan gsum la sogs zhabs tog byas/ the rdo rje grags/ bye ma lung pa chos kyi seng ge dang / khams pa shes rab rdo rje rnams la rang rang gis brtsams chos thob/ bshad sgrub mthar phyin nas spen tsha thel du bzhugs dus/ dgung

76lo drug cu rtsa brgyad la ska mngon sum du mkha' spyod du gshegs/ de'i slob ma/ ram rtsa can/ la snya ba can/ tog dad pa can/ rgya ya ma can/ sum pa phod kha can/ sto pa chung ma can/ gnyal pa rdog chung ma/ mi la mthu chen la sogs mang du byon/ :bla ma'i sras ni/ rngog mdo sde/ sku tshe snga ma la stod kyi spug ye shes rgyal mtshan yin/ dgung lo gsum bzhi la mar pa dang mjal nas lung bstan thob pa dang / bo dong pa/ chag lo tsā ba(393)/ ba ri lo tsā ba(394)/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba(395)/ rma lo tsā ba(396)la sogs lo 1 ba brgyad tsam bsten/ chos thos bsam sgom pa mthar phyin/ yab kyi gdan sa mdzad/ bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i zhal gzigs/ nya mo gyur(397)du/ bla ma mar pa'i sras mo gcig la gral dpon zhus nas brgya 'bul byas/ 'chims chen mo/ g.yor ston/ dge bshes cha pa/ mkhon bsod nams rtse mo/ shar pa rdor seng / zhang rin po che sogs dbus gtsang gi dge bshes gdugs thogs lnga brgya bsags nas zla ba phyed dang gnyis chos 'khor mdzad/ sras mo des bzang lan du/ mar pa'i sku gdung phul/ ldam chung btab/ gsang phu de'u thog /gzhung nya mo gyur/ yar lungs bya sa/nya 'phrang po zho ra rnams su chos gzhi mdzad/ dgung lo bdun cu rtsa bdun pa la gshegs/ de'i slob ma rtsegs tta rmā ra tsa/ mgar bkra shis rin chen/'tshe'u dar re/ mal yer pa ba/ te bo mgon po/ ngo rje kun dga' 'od/sher pa rdor seng / mnyam med shākya ye shes/ lhas phyug mkhar ba/ snga tsha chos sku/ dran ston mtha' bral/ sto nag la sogs bu chen mang du byon/ bla ma'i sras jo sras tshul khrims shes rab/ thogs med grags pa/ jo 'od/bsod nams grags/ ston chung dbang mo ste lnga'o/ de thams cad yon tan dang ldan yang sku tshe thungs nas/ bla ma bzhugs ring la snga rim gyis 'das so/ /

77thogs med grags pa'i sras rgyal tsha ra mo dang / rdor seng gnyis/ ra mo ston chung dbang mo'i skye ba yin/ gdan sa lo bcu bdun bskyangs/ mar pa yab sras kyi gdung khang bzhengs nas zhang rin po che la rab gnas zhus/ rdor seng gis gdan sa ma mdzad/ gcen jo tshul gyi sras bla ma kun dga' rdo rje'o/ /des bla ma mdo sde/ rgyal tsha ra mo/ lho nag ra mo'i mtshe'u der/ dpal chen go'o/ /grub thob shol po ba/ mal nag mo rnams bsten/ spre zhing gi gzims khang lho ma btab/ gdan sa mdzad cing / lo bdun cu rtsa bdun pa la 'das so/ /de'i sras slob dpon dge slong / bla ma gzi brjid/ slob dpon rgyal po dga'/ bla ma gzi brjid kyis yab la chos zhus/ bya 'dul gyi slob ma ba phyar ba la bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ lo ras/ ral drug pa/ sgro sgom/ mdo chen pa la sogs bsten/ gzims ba/ nga byang ma dang / gtsug lag khang bzhengs/gdung khang yang der spyan drangs/ gdan sa mdzad nas brgyad cu la gshegs/slob dpon rgyal po dga'i sras seng ge sgra/ bla ma dam pa rin chen bzang po/slob dpon chos rdor/ bla ma ri bo ba rin chen bzang po ni bla ma gzi brjid la chos thob nas dgung lo bcu pa la bshad pa mdzad/ bco brgyad la zul phur dge tshul/ so gsum la bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ mkhan po zul phu ba chos grags dpal/ las slob 'od zer dpal/ gsang ston ye shes dpal/ yab dang /slob dpon rdo rje rin chen/ slob dpon bzang mo ba/ slob dpon rin chen gzhon rnams la chos thob/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bdun pa la bla ma gzi brjid 'das nas/ rjes kyi zhabs tog sgrabs shing gdan sa mdzad/ so lnga pa la khams su byon nas lo gnyis la 'khong/ tshal pa'i yang dgon/ sgom sde dang /dpon brgyud kyi bla mar gyur/ gser gyi bka' 'gyur bzhengs/ lha khang dang gdan sa rgya cher bskyed/ spre zhing dang zul skyor gyis thog drangs dge 'dun

78dpag tu med pa la tshogs sog dang / de'i sku skal/ dbus gtsang gi dgon sde 'brel yod kun la mdzad/ jo bo nā ro ta pa dang mar pa'i sprul par grags shing ska che ba'i yon tan dpag tu med/ 'gro don rgya cher mdzad nas dgung lo bajen cu rtsa bdun la gshegs/ slob dpon seng ge sgra'i sras slob dpon rin chen rgyal mtshan spun gsum/ slob dpon chos rdor gyi sras gsum ste che shos bla ma chos kyi rgyal mtshan gdan sa mdzad pa'o/ /rgyal tsha ra mo'i brgyud pa ldam chung pa rnams so/ ༈/gtsang rong gi mes ston tshon po ni/ gtsang nyang stod stag tshal du 'khrungs/ mtshan bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rje mar pa bsten nas chos mtha' dag thob/ rong ba do'i gnas bzhengs/ der mar pa spyan drangs nas zhabs tog cher mdzad/ gdung brgyud med/ mar pa dang / me ston gnyis ga'i slob ma/ zhang bsod nams mkhar/ de'i sras bde gshegs ye shes snying po/ de'i sras zhang ston kun grags/ de'i sras bla ma rin chen/ de'i sras shākya rgyal po/ de'i sras zhang ston grags 'byor te/ chos kyi lugs brgyad pa'o/ / ༈ gung thang gi mi la ras pa ni/ sngon bla ma nā ro pas mar bee la lung bstan cing / mi la'i bzhed pa mar pas zhus pas/ nā ro pa dgyes shing /bod phyogs su'ang brgyang phyag stong mdzad/ mar pa'i bu chen kun gyi mchog go/'di'i rigs ni khyung po/ yab mi la sher rgyal gyi sras su la stod gung thang smad kyi rtsa ko sgron du 'khrungs/ mtshan rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ pha spun gyis sdod du ma ster nas dbus su byon/ yar lungs su gnyags khrums ston la ser ba zhus/rong du lha rje snabs chung la mthu zhus nas dgra thams cad tshar bcad/ rong ston lha dga' rā rdzogs chen(398)rgyas/ der rje btsun mar pa'i snyan pa gsan nas sto brag tu byon/ khong gi dgra mar pa nag po mthus btul/ mthu ser mdzad pa'i sdig sbyongs don du/ gsas mkhar dgu thog ma res sgor mo/

79res zur gsum/ res zla gam/ res gru bzhir rtsig tu bcug /nam zin la bad bla mas sgyel gyin yang yang brtsigs pas/ sgal pa lan drug rdol ba la/sgal sgor(skur)byas nas brtsigs/ lo re la thog re zin/ gdams ngag re gnang / dbang re bskur nas/ thog lnga pa la rgyad gsung / drug pa la yi dam zhal gzigs/ skabs der rngog chos rdor gyi phya'es phyir byon/ mi la phug tu spab pa mdzad/ khong gi dgra dol yal po ba ser bas btul/ mar pa la yum drodag med mas zhu rogs mdzad cing / zhabs tog dang mos gus kyis mnyes nas chos ma lus pa gnang zhing byin gyis brlabs/ mar pa rgya gar du phyi res byon(399)dus/ rje mi la la stod du byon/ sras kyi thu bor lung bstan cing mnga' gsol nas rdzangs/ ska tshe gcig tu 'jig rten spangs(400)shing rdzong drug(401)dang / la phyi'i sgongs(402)/ chu bar(403)la sogs ri khrod 'ba' zhig 'grims/ dka' spyad drag pos sgrab pa rtse gcig tu mdzad cing /lo dgu'i bar du nyams rtogs ci yang ma byung༄ yang / 'bad pas/ zla ba phyed kyi bar du nyams rtogs dus gcig tu 'bar zhing bar chod re sol ba dang bogs re thon te/ 'chong lung du 'dre dmag dang po'i dus su rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor(404)rdzogs/ la phyi chu bzangs su 'dre dmag bar pa la spros bral(405)rdzoṭa/ chu bar du 'dre dmag gsum pa la ro gcig(406)rdzogs nas/tshe rings ma spun lnga(407)dam la thogs(408)/ sgom med kyi rnal 'byor(409)la mngon du phyogs shing / mngon shes rdzu 'phrul du mas gdul bya mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad btul/ rgya gar dharmā girti dang / dam pa rgya gar(410)la sogs grub thob rnams dang rdzu 'phrul 'gran/ bod du byon pa'i grub thob la grub rtags bzang zhing ngo mtshar che bar grags/ dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa bzhi la mya ngan las 'das pa'i rjes su sku'i bkod pa mang po bstan no/ /

80de'i bu chen(411)dpag tu med kyang / sras kyi thu bo nyams rtogs mthar phyin pa'i slob ma brgyad/ gung thang gi snyan chung ras pa/ snen lung gi ngan rdzong ras pa/ nya ma'i 'bri sgom ras pa/ mdo sgra'i se ban ras pa/ sdi shangs kyi khyi tsha ras pa/ ras pa zhi ba 'od/ bde ba skyong / mnyam med dwags po lha rje(412)rnams so/ /dang por che ba'i sras bzhi/ bar du nye ba'i sras brgyad/tha ma sku bgres khar 'khrungs pa jo bo bka' gdams pa mi gsum yod ces grag go /༈ras chung pa ni/ mtshan rdo rje grags/ bla ma mi la dang thog mar mjal zhing thugs zin/ rgya gar du lan lngaXbyon/ pa la tsan nu la phyag na rdo rje zhus nas sgrabs pas mdze thon/ bla ma pham thing pa dang / thang ju 'ba' ro ti phu gzung sngag kyi sdong po/ a ru la badzra/ a mo ka badzra/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo rnams dang mjal/ lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor dgu(413)dang / tshe dpag med la sogs dbang sems bskyed du ma thob/rgya gar nas nam 'khor du mi la'i drung du bzhugs shing / phyis bla ma la zhus nas dbus su byon/ dbu ru 'brom du bal po skye med la/ chos gsan/ bar skabs su/ yar lungs su bye chung rtsad po'i mdze gsos nas mag pa mdzad/pho brang skyegs ldan du bzhugs pa'i skabs su/ lha gcig ldem bu dam tshig nyams(414)nas bral te/ gnyal lo ro mog pa'i tshe skong dang / byar po nag la sogs su bzhugs/ de la slob ma nye gnas rin chen grags/ gnyags gcer bu ba/ sgom chen smon lam/ mal yel pa ba/ bla ma sgom chos/ 'dral sher snang / bur sgom nag po/ mnga' ris pa gsal mchog /jo mo sge mo/ lo gtsang ra/ sum ston chos dar/ sto pa bya ston/ zangs ri ras pa/ 'brog tshulan bdun yang zer/

82byang chub sems dpa' zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa yin la/ de dang lhan du bstan pa 'dzin par khas blangs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' cistong lnga brgya yang / 'di'i 'khor dang brgyad 'dzin pa rnams yin par mngo sde de nyid las gsal bas/rnam thar bsadro gyis mi khyab mod kyi/ gdul bya'i snang tshul ltar yang rje mi la'i thugs sras kun gyi mchog tu/ mar pa mi la gnyis gas lung bstan pa yin te/'khrungs yul gnyal/ rigs snyi ba/ yab snyi ba lha rje'i sras gsum gyi bar pa mtshan snying po kun dga'/ lha rje mdzad cing dgung lo so gnyis pa/ dge bshes sha ba gling pa la rab tu byung / mtshan bsod nams rin chen du btags/mkhan po sha ba dang / bya 'dul ba la 'dul skor gsan/ mar yul blo ldan la gsang sngags gsan/ dbu ru byang du byon nas dge bshes gnyug rum pa/rgya lcags ri gong ka ba byang chub dpal/ dge bshes bya yul ba gsum bsten nas/ bka' gdams ngag zhus/ zhag bcu gsum tsam du mi 'chor ba'i gnas pa bzang po(419)byung zhing / rtog pa mgo non/ sa bcu non pa'i snga ltas(420)mdo las gsungs pa bzhin rmis/ yab mes kyis rtsigs pa'i ser chu lha khang du bzhugs nas/ nyin gcig sprang po gsum las rje mi la'i snyan pa thos/ de ma thag mos pa skyes/ byin rlabs zhugs nas yid 'phrogs te la stod du byonasprang / po gcig la lam sna bcol bas chong dus nas 'grogs ma nyan/ dwags po ma byon pa'i gong nas rje mi las yang yang lung bstan/mjal ma thag mnyes nas sna len gyi mgur gsungs/ sngar gyi rnams zhus pas bzhad nas/ bye ma tser bas mar nag mi yong / yungs dkar tsir na yong ba yin/ thabs lam(421)sgom gsungs nas/ gdams pa rnams rim gyis gnang ba bsgoms pas zhag bdun nas brtsams te/ bde drod rang 'bar la song /rtags snang dang nyams myong(422)khyad par can skyes nas ring po ma thogs par

sangs rgyas longs sku(423)/ sprul sku(424)rnams dang mjal rdo sa sku myur du mthong bar lung bstan/ byin gyis brlabs shing rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur nas dbus su byon/ rgya lcags ri gong khar byon/ se ba lung du bka' gdams pa'i gseb tu bzhugs pas/ thugs dam cung zhig 'gribs nas la stod du log nas/ mi la bsten pas sor chud ces pa'ang 'dugagang ltar yang 'ol kha nas bud nas/ sgam po zangs lung du bsgoms pas sor chud/ sgam po'i ngo mthong ba'i la khar bla ma'i lung bstan bzhin/ chos sems nyid bden pa mngon du rtogs(426)/ bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi mos gus skyes/ 'o de gung rgyal gyi bu dwags lha skam pos spyin bdag byas nas/ sgam po'i ri khrod btab/ zad par zil gnon gyi ting nge 'dzin(426)mngon du gyur/ rdzu 'phrul la sogs mngon shes lnga thob/ snang sems 'dres(427)shing dbang du 'dus/ nyams rtogs mthar phyin/ dgung lo bdun cu rtsa bdun la mya ngan las 'das/ bla ma des don gnyis kyi gter kha phye nas 'gro don dpag ta med cing / ba chen gdags thogs lnga brgya byang ba'i lnga tshar la/ dgas po ring ring dge ring sgom pa/ rgyal ba khyung tshang pa/ gnyag nag gnyag dmar po/ sgom pa legs mdzes/ nye gnas gsal byang / bar tshar la slob ma khams pa mi gsum ni/'tshur phu'i grub thob dbu se/ phag rgya'i khams pa rdor rgyal/ bsam gdong gi shel sgom byang ye/ zhang sum thog pa/ phyi tshar la/ byang gi 'bab rom pa chen po/ 'ol kha'i rnal 'byor chos g.yung / shangs pa'i rmog cog pa/ mkhan po 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po/ bla ma 'ol kha ba/ lho pa tar sgom/ skye sgom ye shes rdo rje/ rdzi sgom skyes se/ bya sgom rdo rje seng ge/ 'brog dmar yu/ nam pa 'phan ne/ btsad po lha sgom la sogs gnam gyi skar ma tsam byon/ gdul bya dpag tu med do/ /༈dgas po rin po che sku mched gsum(428)gyi

84gcen po gnyis pa lha rje rdor 'bar gyi sras su 'khrungs pa/ dwags po sgom pa ni/ thog ma'i mtshan zla rgyal gling du btags/ dgung ro bcu gcig pa la/a khu chung ba tshul 'bar gyis/ bla ma'i drung du skyal/ chos ma lus pa thob/bcu sum pa la spros bral gyi rtogs pa shar/ bcu drug pa la mkhan po mnga' ris pa shes rab snying po'i dge tshul mdzad/ mtshan tshul khrims snying por mnga' gsol/ bco brgyad pa la sgom ro gcig rtogs/ nyi shu rtsa lnga pa la sngar gyi mkhan po dang / slob dpon zhab rtse yon tan blo gros/ 'brom shes rab ye shes la sogs las bsnyen par rdzogs/ sum cu rtsa lnga pa la bla ma nyid kyis gdan sa rdzog(429)nas gdan sa bskyangs/ lo gnyis na bla ma gshegs nas bkra shis sgo mang(430)bzhengs/ de nas dbus su byon te/ lha lung brag ral la sogs su bzhugs/ jo bo rin po che'i thugs rje dang / srung ma rnams kyis bskul te/ lha sar byon nas gsor nam(431)mdzad/ sba 'bring gi sde 'khrug(432)zlum/ zhang rin po che(433)la gnas kha gnyis(434)gtad nas sgam por byon te/ mkhyen rtogs thugs rje ngo mtshan gyi rnam thar dpag yas mnga' ba ste/ dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa bzhi la/ glang lo dbyu gu zla ba'i nyi shu la 'das so/ /de la slob ma grub thob dbu se/ zhang rin po che/ mkhan po bye dkar ba/ jo btsun rog po/ zhang ston ka lo ka/ dung ston la sogs pa byon no/ /nyer gsum pa/ rkarma bka' brgyud byung tshul/mnyam med dwag po rin po che'i bu chen(435)/ rje dus gsum mkhyen

85pa(436)ni/ mdo khams te shod gangs kyi ra bar 'khrungs/ gdung rus lta sdong dkar po/ yab sgom pa rdo rje mgon po/ yum lha lcam ming 'dren ma/mtshan dge 'phel/ dgung lo bcu gcig la yab la dpal lha mo zhus nas bsgrab pa'i zhal mthong / lu ru'i dgra btul/ bcu drug la ska brag tu mkhan po thimachog bla slob dpon phyag seng ge grags la rab tu byung nas mtshan chos kyi grags pa btags/ dge bshes kra ra ba chen po la dbang gdam pa zhus/ dgung lo bcu dgu pa la dbus gtsang du byon/ nye shu pa la stod lung du slob dpon dge bshes rgya dmar dang / phya pa/ spa tshab lo tsā ba/ ra lcags ston tshul/bla ma brag dkar po ba/ gshen pa rdor seng rnams la chos gsan/ mkhan po dge bshes pa phug pa/ slob dpon ye shes blo gros/ gsang ston gcung po dang gsum la bsnyen rdzogs mdzad stag dur du lo lnga bka' gdams mdzad/ rnal 'byor pa shes rab rdo rje dang mjal/ dge bshes sha pa gling pa'i spyan sngar byon/bla ma dwag po sgom tshul dang mjal/ khong gis zhus sna mdzad nas dgung lo sum cu pa la rje dwag po rin po che dang mjal/ dbang gdam pa mtha' dag rim par zhus nas drod rtags nyams rtogs(437)rim par shar/ sgam por lo gsum dka' thub mdzad/ grwa pa brgyad brgya'i nang nas sgom sran che bar gragagatsang du ldom bu la byon/ mi la'i slob ma 'ga' dang mjal/ don dge tshul spun gnyis/ don mo ri pa/ spen phug pa/ rgyab lo spang khang pa/ gshed pa ral lcags rnams la chos zhus/ 'phan yul bya bzang brag tu rdzu 'phrul brnyes sgam por byon mjal nas mon du byon nas rgyal po'i chos gnas mdzad/ tshur lam ras chung pa la chos zhus/ snye mor bla ma rdzong par bsten/ bla ma be ro dang / grub thob dpal 'dzin(438)dang / dpal rga lo(439)dang / grub thob a seng la chos zhus/ gzhu'i gru gzhi'i dgon par bzhugs/ de nas

86dbas gtsang da lo sam cu la lo bcu bdan thos bsam/ bca gnyis bsgrab pa ring ripa dpa ring dge dge mdzad/ dwag po khu dbon gyis lung bstan nas dgung lo lnga bcu pa la mdo khams su byon/ lnga bcu rtsa lnga la sgam po gnas nang du bzhugs/ ja mdzo lnga bcu dang bcas pa'i 'bul ba dbus gtsang du bskur/ dgung lo bdun cu rtsa bzhi la 'bri klung na yar byon/ rab byung stong re tsam tshogs/ zla smad slo'u ru/dkar ma dgon pa mdzad/ bla ma'i gdan sa rnams su 'bul ba chen po len mang du mdzad/ sto brgyud la lam ston nas dbus su byon/ stod lung mtshur phu'i gdan sa btab nas/ mtshar pa dang sga ra ba'i 'khrugs pa bsdam/ gsang 'dus ma ha ma ya/ dgyes rdor/ bdag med ma/ bde mchog theg mo thugs rje chen po sgrol ma/ mi g.yo ba sogs/ yi dam mang du gzigs/ byams pa la chos gsan/ sa ra ha/ bee tri pa/ rje mi la zhal gzigs/ ngo mtshar gyi rnam thar dpag tu med do/ /gdul bya dpag tu med pa smin grol la bkod/bla ma mi la'i ska tshe tsam zhal gyis bzhes pa bzhin bzhugs nas/ dgung lo dīrgyad cu rtsa drozhi sa glang lo stag gi zla ba'i tshes gsum la mya ngan las 'das rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i zhal slob sto pa ltar sgom/ mnyam med shākya ye shes/ rgyal ba gang pa/ 'gro mgon ras pa/ rin po che spong grag pa/'jam gling skye ba gsum pa/ bla ma bsam yas pa/ dza nee bsgom bzang bla ma lha/ zla stod khang sar ba/ cham bu na ring / gtsang pa tshul sing / gtsang pa ston pa/ bla ma stag do'u pa/ dge bshes dkon cog seng ge sgom pa tshul khrims rgyal po/ dge bshes lha rje gsum pa/ dge bshes shākya/ ming dge jo sras sogs rnams ni so so nas bla ma de nyid yi dam la sogs par mthong tshul rnam thar du yod pa rnams yin la gzhan ni ngo mtshar can gyi bu chen dpag tu

87med do/ /mtshur phu'i gdan sa ni/ rgyal ba gangs pa rang byung sangs rgyas bla ma rgya mtsho ba/ gdan sa rin grags rnams kyis rim par bskyangs te/ rgyal ba gangs pa'i dbon brgyad yin/de nas kurma the (440)byon no/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa de bzhin gshegs nas rgya gar yul du grub thob mi tra dzo gi'i(441)slob ma rnal 'byor pa chos kyi dbang phyug zhes par 'khrungs par bstan/ slar yang dpal ldan kurma pa chen por sku skye ba bzhes te/ sngon/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i lung bstan la/ ma 'ong pa'i dus su/ bod yul lho brag grub pa'i gnas bdun du gdul bya gcig gi don du 'byung / gsungs pa dang 'bri chung ngo mthong cig nas/nged kyi dgongs pa rdzogs par byed gsung ba dang / yon bdag dgon pa ba yang rgyal po cig tu skye/ de 'khor dang bcas pa la ngas phan thogs gsungs pa rnams kyi don dang mthun par 'bri klung dam pa chos phyug yul du btsad po'i bu'i rigs su 'khrungs/ smre 'dor gdong byi la bzhes par/ yab 'tshur tsha rgya dbang / yum sing re za lang skyid nyid kyi mtshan chos 'dzin zhes bya/ dgung lo drug nas yi ge mkhyen/ dgu pa bcu pa nas gsung rab thams cad tshar re gzigs pa tsam gyis tshegs med du mkhyen/ ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rang shar du 'khrungs/ dbus su 'byon bzhed pa'i lam du rin po che spong brag pa dang mjal dus su ngo mtshar gyi ltas mang po byung / de dus gsum mkhyen pas spral pa mkhyen nas/ dbang gdam pa mtha' dag bstan/ byin gyi brlabs/)mas rtogs 'khrungs/ chos skyong gi lung zhus tsam gyis zhal gzigs/ de phyin yi dam zhal gzigs tshul sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar mang po snang / chos skyong gi sa la ri mo bris nas thung rir dgon pa btab/ gsang ba ye shes kyi

88mkha' 'gro ma'i ma ṇi'i dbyangs 'di gyer lugs su bslabs/ de nas dge tshul mdzad/ mtshan dar ma bla ma btags/ phyis rin po che ka thogs pa byams pa 'bum gyis mkhan po mdzad/ rin po che spong brag pas slob dpon mdzad nas bsnyen par rdzogs/ la rgya byas pa/ sgo rig pa'i rdzas pas chos skyong gi bka' chad phab nas btul/ de nas gnas nang du byon nas bzhugs skam po rdo rje dpal rtsegs byung nas/ 'dir sangs rgyas mar me mdzad cig bzhengs dang /bya ba thams cad nged kyi bsgrab cing gnas bsrung / bu slob bskyangs zer nas de bzhin du byas/ de snas gdan sa rkarmar byon/ 'gro don rgya chen po mdzad/ thugs rje chen po byon nas 'dir byams pa'i ska cig bzhengs dang /'phrin las 'byung gsung nas de ltar byas/ der dasal ldan lha mo nags mo 'bum sde dang bcas pa byon nas/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i gdan sa 'jigs la khad/ dbus su myur du byon zer ba yang yang byung pa'i dbus su byon/ da khams su mi phyin/ mnga' ris man chad 'dul dgos snyams tsa na/ thugs rje chen po'i zhal nas gdul bya'i phyed khams na yod/ da rung yong yang shes gsungs/ byang lam la gangs dkar zhol nas 'bri khung la byon/ der rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'khor bcas kyi 'bri khung gling thams cad khyab par gar byed pa byung / lha sar rgyal ba shākya thub pa la 'od zer mang po byon nas thim pa'i bstan pa phan par shes/ garmer gsol dus su/ rta mgrin dbu stong phyag stong yod pa gcig la slob dpon padma dpag tu med pas bskor ba gzigs/ tsa rir phebs dus ma mgon bsu ba la byung / mtshur phur phebs dus dus gsum mkhyen pa'i skus nam mkha' kheng pa byung / bla ma yi dam chos skyong gzigs tshul kun bris ma lang / gtsang phyogs su 'gro don la byon/ 'brong 'u sogs su gzigs snang dang lung bstan mang du byung / mdol chung du gsad gso yi cho

89'phrul bstan/ stod lung mdar mkhar nag byung nas dbus gtsang gi mi nor thams cad khyed la 'bul zer/ g.yor po byang thang la byon dus/ gru gtong ma nyan pas rlung sgom nas chu la mi 'bying bar byon/ lar skye ba bcu drug gi bar tu thugs rje chen po dang rta mgrin gyi sgo nas 'gro don bsam gyis mi khyab pa byas/ ma mgon gnyis skye ba bcu drug lag gi bar gyi chos skyong yin gsungs/mtshur phur nub cig rgyal chen rnam sras 'brug la zhon pa cig byon/ nga'i pho brang du 'gro dgos zer ba de hor yul du 'gro dgos pa'i rtags su 'dugasngon mdo khams su bzhugs dus su rgyal po go pe la dmag la byon pa dang /rong po'i yul gser stod zhes par mjal/ sems bskyed du bcug(442)de dus su byang chub sems dpa' nor bzang dang klu sgrab sogs mang du gzigs/rgyal po go tshob la dang / de dus kyi 'brel pa dang /༄ dus phyis grub thob chen po'i grub rtags dang rnam thar ngo mtshar can gsan te/ gser yig pa gdan 'dren btang byang bas/ 'gro mi 'gro the tshom da yod tsa na/ kla rgyal dang sngags bdag rshas 'gro don yong pa'i 'byon ze( nas 'byon pa'i zhal༄ bzhes mdzad nas byon/ rgya yul du khong gi sar ma phebs bar du yang / sde dgon gogs pa rnams gso ba dang / bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa rgya chen po mdzad/ lam na yod pa'i skye 'gro thams cad rang dbang med par 'dus shing 'bul ba bsam gyis mi khyab/ rgyal po'i bu rdor phebs nas rgyal 'bangs thams cad kyis bkur ti(sti)bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad/ gsang ba'i bdag po'i lta stangs kyis phyir rgol ba(443)tshar bcad/ mu stegs pa btul/ skabs der rgya nag ke jur yod dus/ 'jam dpal chen po zhal bcu gcig pa/ phyag stong /phyag re na lhang bzed re na sangs rgyas re bzhugs pa/ zhabs stong yod pa cig gzigs/ ༄ dus phyis rgya mi nyag la sogs rgya mtsho la thug par khyod kyis 'dul

ba/0'gyur gsungs nas/ phyis mi nyag yul gyi sprul pa'i lha khang na bris yod gsung pa ni chos rje phyi ma gnyis kyi 'gro don gyi ltas su snang / rgyal bu'i sar yun ring du bzhugs na/ yon mchod ma 'phrod par yod pa la/ der bar chad dang / chags sdang mang po 'byung ba'i ltas byung zhing / spyan ras gzigs kyis bskal ma btab/ byang phyogs kyi pho brang du 'byon dgos pa'i bla ma yi dam ma'e' 'gro'i lung bstan yang yang byung ba'i/ rgyal bu'i zhu ba nan can la ma gnang par/ sngon grub thob chen po nyid mi nyag yul du lha legs par bkur ba'i rgyal por skyes pa tshun chad kyi rgyal bu slob rnams da lta yul de nyid du skyes shing 'dul ba'i dus la babs par mkhyen nas mi nyag 'gar byon/ gdul bya thams cad tshim par mdzad ma mgon dang rnam sras kyis bskal nas/ 'phrul snang sprul pa'i lha khang bzhengs pa'i tshe rnam snang kun tu zharla gzigs/ lha khang dang dge 'dun gyi sde mang po btsugs/ ling 'ju(444)dang /ma ju sogs su 'gro don mdzad/ rin po che nyid kyi shing cig btsugs nas/ phyis 'di sdong po chen po gyur tshe nga 'dir 'ong gsung / skabs der gnyan chen thang lha(445)dang bstan ma bcu gnyis kyis gdan drang nas gtsang khar yang nyug cig byon/rgyal po mong gol gan gyis rin po che'i snyan pa gsan nas/ gser yig pa mang po spyan 'dren du btang byung / ye shes pa dang / gnam lha dkar po la sogs 'jig rten pa'i lha mang po'i spyan dang ltas cho 'phrul sna tshogs byung nas hor yul du byon/ gser yig pa tshos mthong par thun mong gis grub rtags(446)mang po bstan/ 'ong ge bya ba'i rgyal sar slebs dus 'das ma 'ong da ltar gyi 'brel pa mang po dran te/ sngon gyi sku tsher/ glang po che'i gzugs can gyi sprul pa mdzad nas/ mu stegs kyi rgyal po chen po zhig 'khor dang bcas pa de btal ba de da ltar rgyal po chen po mong kha gan da 'dag de'i btsan mo sras ri ri mi ri ri

'khor g.yog rnams kyang / dpon mo 'e jigam dang rgyalabu sa ri /1ga sogs dang / blon po rnams su skyes 'dug cing / da lta rjes su ma bzung na sngon mu stegs can gyi bag chags kyis/ er ka 'un gyi chos lugs(447)la zhugs nas/ — rgyal khams thams cad mu stegs can tu 'gro dogs 'dug pas 'dul ba'i dus la babs cing / dpal dus gsum mkhyen pa'i gdul bya gcig gi don du 'byung zhes pa'ang / rgyal po 'di yin te/ 'jig rten du stobs ldan gyi skye bo cig btul na skye 'gro dpag tu med pa dul bar gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /yan ring mi 'dag zhes pa'ang sa phyogs gan ta rgya ba la dgongs so/ /rig ri ri ring ra de ltar mkhyen nas 'dul ba'i don du byon pa'i/ 'brug lo la zi ra 'u hur rdor rgyal brgyud thams cad 'tshogs pa'i sar byon/ der klu bdud dang / ra ha la'i cho 'phrul dang bar chad byung pa'i khro bcu'i(448)ting nge 'dzin gyis zlotul/ spyan ras gzigs kyi lta stangs kyi byin gyis brlabs/ ngo mtshar gyi cho 'phrul mtha' yas bstan pas/ rgyal po 'bangs dang bcas pa thams cad rang dbang med par dad/ phyi rol pa'i lta ba las log nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la btsud/ dgun nyin lam drug tshun chad du kha ba dang lhags pa med par byas/rje 'bangs thams cad zla re la so thar bsnyen gnas dus gsum du bsrung du bcug byang chub tu sems bskyed/ dbang bskur(449)sku bzhi'i ngo sprod kyi khrid btab/ rgyal po la nyams myong bzang po skyes/ ming yongs su grags pa'i skar ma'i/ rgyal po'i spyi gtsugs kyi rgyan du bkur/ lung ci zhus gnang pa'i rgyal khams tsam la zla ba 'byung ngo cog gi dus bzang bzhir(460)su la'ang tsa ra mi byed/ srog mi gcod sha za ba'i khrims bcas/ gnam mchod pa kun la gnod 'tshe med cing rang rang gi chos lugs skyong du bcug gser gyi dam kha dang / dngul bre stong(451)gis mgo byas nor rdzas dpag tu med pa phul

zhi/lha bla mchod kun la bkye/ btson thams cad dong sprug(452)pa lan gsum byas/ ga ra gu rum du gtsug lag khang chen po 'jom bu gling na 'gran zla med pa bzhengs/ mi nyag yul sogs rgyal khams thams cad du lha khang sum stong tsam dang mchod rten zhig pa kun gsor bcug lha khang dang gdan sa mang po btab/ sog po'i yul na yod dus rmi lam du shākya thub pa ska 'dom bcu tsam yod pa zhig byon nas/ khyod kyis bod du sku 'di tsam zhig /zhengs dang /bar chad zhi zhing rgyal khams bde bar 'gyur gsungs nas/ gdan sa mtshur phur gtsug lag khang dang / lha chen po gtso 'khor dgu(453)dang bcas pa bzhengs su btang / rgyal po cig bu btul ba'i thor mi skad rigs mi gcig pa sum brgya drug cu(464)gdul byar gyur cing / 'dzam bu gling thams cad chos dang bde ba la bkod do/ /de nas rgyal po de gnam du song(465)ba'i shul da migs das kyi nyes pas rgyalabargyad mched rnams rgyalas la rtsod pa byangari sku / //// ri sku ri pa sa sde ri su ba'i skabs su/ bar chad chen po byung yang mi tshugs pa'i rmi ltas byung / rgyal po go pe la sngon spyan 'dren mkhan yin yang khong gi sar ma bzhugs pa'i thugs chang dang / rgyal bu mong kha gan ska mched(456)kyi phyogs su 'bul gyi rin po che spro la mtho 'tsham sna tshogs su snyomadzad mer bsregs pa dang / chur bskyur ba dang / mtshon 'debs pa dang / dug sdud pa dang / mgo la lcags gzer btab/ skye bos gsum rim du bsrung nas zhag bdun zas med par 'jog pa la sogs sdigs mo rnam pa sna tshogs byung pa la/ rdo rje phag mo dngos su byon/ye shes mkha' 'gro rigs bzhis dur khrod ha la ha la nas bram ze'i bu mo'i ro 'khyer byon nas tshogs 'khor mdzad/ snang srid thams cad(467)sku bzhis ngo sprod du ro stoms shing rtsal rdzogs pas/ gang gis kyang cung zad gnod pa ma nus shing / g.yo 'gul med la gnas nyer bzhi'i(468)mkha' 'gro dbugs

93phyang shing / byang shar 'tshamasaras dpal lha mo'i dmag bzhi khri bzhi stong dang rshacas pa byung / rlung chen po dang thog ser phab/ nad yam langs/ gshed ma 'ga' re shi/ rgyal po 'khor bcas rnams la cho 'phrul dang mthong snang dpag tu med pa dang / chos skyong gi rtsub 'gyur mang po byung pas/ zhag bdun na slar yang rgyal blon thams cad 'gyod cing bzod pa gsol/ sman gyi bla'i ting nge 'dzin gyis 'od zer spros nas ltas ngan dang nad yam zhi bar byas/rab tu dad de zhabs spyi bor blangs/ bkur snyi dang 'bul ba chen po byas/sman tse'i yul du 'gro dgos gsung pa la/ dus gsum mkhyen pa lung bstan nas bod yul du 'gro bar zhus rgyal pos lung bzang po byin no/ /chu ma khar(459)dang shin kun(460)tu phebs dus cen mkhar nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i mi kun 'dus nas dgon pa thob zer na'ang ma btab/ der rgya yul gyi lha 'dre kun gyis bar chad byas pa la/ rta mgrin gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi zil gyis mnan/ lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du 'dus/ de nas rim gyis bod du gdan phebs/ mtshur phur byon dus/ bka' brgyad bla ma yi dam thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs/da phyin chad gar yang ma 'asgro zhig gsungs nas/ der bzhugs shing bu slob gdul bya dpag tu med pa 'phel/ skabs der 'gro mgon 'phags pa rgyal po'i ti shrī mdzad gong nas bod du byon pa dang / yang mtshur phur mjal bzhugs pa gdan mnyam po mdzad/ sngar nga mong kha rgyal po'i bla mchod byas pa'i dus su/ngas khyed la byang chub sems dpa' mthong na dga' bar btags pa ye ma yin zhes sogs gsung gleng mdzad/ mtshur phur lha khang rten dang bcas pa thams cad legs par grub nas rab gnas mdzad dus mgon po 'khor bcas byon nas/ lha rten 'di rnams dang / khyed kyi bya ba thams cad ngas bsgrub pa yin/da rung ma 'ong pa'i dus su yang khyod bsam bzhin du skye ba len cing khams

ga// khyab par gdul bya'i don byed dus su yang nged kyi bstan pa bsrung zhing bya ba bsgrab pa yin no zer/ rta lo la rgyal ba rgya mtsho 'khor bcas kyis byin gyis brlababs nas thugs rje chen po'i lha khang bzhengs/ ma ṇi'i rgyun dge 'dun dang / spang po la tshul btsugs(461)/ rta lo la mya ngan las 'das pa'i ltas mkhyen nas mi las gangs zhur mo'i 'gram du 'khrungs pa'i lung bstan byung tshul dang / rnam thar ngo mtshar ba rnams gsungs/ lug lo zla ba dang po nas cung zad bsnang / zla ba gsum pa nas zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar rgyan ma chad par sa g.yorā byang / rtog ldan rnal 'byor rang byang rdo rje dang / gnyi ma do na ba ripa zipa ring rgas kyang sang 'char bzhin gdul bya'i lus dang mthun par sprul sku 'byung /zhes gsungs zhing / ltas dang cho 'phrul ngo mtshar ba dang bcas nas/ lug lo zla ba dgu pa'i yar tshes gsum la bde bar gshegs so/ /tshes dgu la gdung sbyangs shing sku 'dab byas/ nyi ma nyis 'gyur gyis ring ba dang / me tog gi char 'ja' dang 'od sogs rnam 'phrul du ma snang / gdung la lha sku ring bsrel sogs rten dpag med byon/ skyirje kurma pa/'i zhal slob ni/ grub thob chen po o rgyan pa/ byang sems rgyal ye/ bla ma o rgyan rin po che/ bla ma mnyan ras/ rin po che gnas nang pa/ bla ma gnam mtsho ba sogs mang po byon/ bsam gtan ldan pa byang chub rin chen sku skye ba snga phyi gnyis la chos thob/ grub thob chen po gshegs dus o rgyan rin po che mtshur phu'i gdan sar bkod/ de nas gnyan ras kyis cung zad mdzad/ de nas bla ma gnas nang pas mdzad do/ gnyan ras ma gtogs pa gnyis kurma pakshi'i dbon brgyud yin/de nas chos rje rin po che rang byung rdo rje(462)byon no/ /grub thob chen po kurma pa de nyid gshegs khar/ nga'i lus 'di zhag bdun ma 'gul bar

06thog cig gsungs nas/ tshang spug nas 'phos te 'ja' tshon lta bu'i sku gyur nas steng lha'i yul du byon/ lha rnams kyis mchod pa rgya chen po byas pa'i zhag brgyad 'das 'dug pa sngar gyi ska la grong 'jug mdzad dgongs nas byon tsa na/sku lus mer sbyangs/ mtshur phul lung pa chong nge gang / 'dul bya thams cad sdag sngal bar gzigs pa'i snying rje ngang du cung zad brgyal/ de nas dran pa byed de/ de la grong 'jug rung ba'i ro btsal ba'i stod lung 'phar tshang na byis pa lo gsum tsam lon pa'i ro skyon med cig rnyed de/ de la grong 'jug mdzad nas mig rig rig byung pa'i/ shi mig gson la mi dga' zer nas ma des mig khab kyis btsags/ gdong la btab/ mig med pa 'gro don mi nus dgongs nas slar don nas lus btsal bas byang gi phyi khang na phug ron 'bus khyer cig las ma rnyed nas thugs phyung nas dga' ldan du 'gro snyams tsa na/ zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro ma nyi shu rtsa lnga byung nas mi lus len par bskul/ mi yul du 'gro don dka' bar lan btab kyang ma lo bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i de rnams kyis bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskar/ bkra shis gsol/ mang yul gung thang gang zhur mo'i 'gram/ 'o ma zhulung mkhan thang gi rtsa phu rlung shod du skye ba bzhes shig ces lung bstan/ 'ja' tshon gyi lam la zhugs nas/ shel gyi khang pa steng dang 'og mun gnag pa cig tu byon rtsa na/'dod chags khrug gi rba rlabs byung zer nas mkhas 'gro thams cad bros gnam gung dgu la skas dgu 'dug pa'i skas cig la 'dzegs pa'i ma thar bar/ las kyi rnam smin thar lam dka' zer ba'i sgra byung nas brgyal/ dran pa mdo long tsam byung / sku khams 'tshub cing 'o brgyal ba byung gsungs pa rnam thar bar do ma na yod do/ de nas sngon gyi lung bstan ltar/ shing pho spre'u yi lo zla ba dang po'i tshes brgyad la sku 'khrungs te/ yab sngags 'chang chos dpal zhes pa sngags

96 wa wa rnying ma'i yon tan dang ldan pa gcig yin/ 'on kyang stoms chung pa'i rdza bdugs(463)byas pa'i 'tsho ba la/ sras 'khrungs nas ngo mtshar gyi ltas mang du byung / snang ba rmi lam sbya mar shar/ sku skye ba dran pa'i gsung mang du byung 'bri klog dang / chos /mas cad mthong ba tsam gyis mkhyen pa'i yul phyogs su'ang grags shing dgung lo gnyis gsum tsa na glang 'khor spyi mchod(464)du byon nas/ dam pa'i sku(466)las 'od byung nas thim zhing byin rlabs zhugs/dam pa'i gdams pa thams cad thugs su chud/ yab la gdams skor zhus/mkhan po gser khang pas dris pas sku tshe snga ma dang bar do'i rnam thar gsungs/skyid grong 'phags pa'i(466)drung du byang sems rlabs po che sad/ grub chen rkarma pa chen po'i ma 'ong pa mkhyen nas/ grub chen o rgyan pa la zhwa nag gcig dang sku gsum ngo sprod gcig gtad nas 'di phyis len pa la nga rang yong gsungs pa yod pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ grub chen o rgyan pa dang mjal bzhed nas/ sbud krar sang 'byon dgongs pa'i do nub grub chen o rgyan pa'i thugs dam gyi snang bar/ grub thob chen po kurma pa byon nas gnas g.yor ba yin gsungs pa byung ba'i/ sang de/ de ring grub chen kurma pa chen po 'byon par yod/ rol mo'i bsu ba gyis/ su byung stos gsungs/ nye gnas tshos ltas pas/ gzhan su yang mi dga'/ rdza gdugs mkhan po/ bza' tsho bu chung khrid pa cig byung zer ba'i/ de ka yin bsus la nang du bos gsungs/ grub chen pa dang g.yas g.yon du bzhugs gdan mnyam por bzhibs/ grub chen pa la spyir yang bsod nams dang ska'i zil dpag tu med cing / gsang ba'i bdag po'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs snas lta stangs kyis zil gyis mnan pas non par tal bar byon/ pha ma tshos phyag 'tshal yang bu chung phyag kyang mi 'tshal/ 'jigs skrag kyang med par mchod khang gi mdun na dril gdang cig 'dug pa dkrol/ grub chen bzhad
