97cing bu chung thu mo cig 'dug snyan grags chen po yong ba'i rten 'brel yong gsungs/ gdan la bzhugs nas khyod su yin gsungs pas/ nga ming yongs su grags pa tham pa yin/ sems la yon tan chos kyi rtsal rdzogs kyang / lus 'byung bzhi'i rtsal ma rdzogs pa'i de yi bar du khyed kyis bskyangs par zhu gsungs/de bzhin yin par 'dug nga la dag pa'i snang ba mang po byung gsungs nas mos gus dang mnyes tshor chen pos spyan gyi 'bras ltar bskyangs/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang / smon 'jug gi thugs bskyed(467)gnang / dbang gdams ngag gnang nas bsgoms pas chos thams cad rgya mtsho'i steng gi chu ltar ma g.yos pa shes pa byung / de nas brtsam ste mgur mang po gsungs/ dgung lo bdun la tsho mkhan po kun ldan shes rab la rab tu byang / mtshan ni rang byang rdo rje zhes pa ska tshe snga zlo'i gsang mtshan yin pa de gzhu btags/ de'i skabarā su/ mtshur ther bla ma gnyan ras la spyan ras gzigs kyi lung bstan byung nas/ gdan sar 'gro don la spyan 'dren btang byung / las stod grod lung byon/ grub chen o rgyan pas dbang bskur mdzad pa'i tshe/ bla ma bde mchog dngos su gzigs/lhan gcig skyes pa'i ye shes(468)brtan par gyur/ nyams snang dag snang la rgod tshang pa dang mjal nas skyes sbyor(469)gnang / de ltar dag snang byung ba rnams bla ma la zhus pas/ bar chad 'byung bas gzhan la ma smra gsungs/ sbyad krar ma mgon byon nas mtshur phur myur du dengs gsungs/ de nas mtshur phur phebs/ mnyan ras dang mjal tshe/ sa ra ha dang mjal/ bar snang bsgrab chu 'thon/ shing skam btsug pa yal ga rgyas/ sngar 'phar 'tshang du spyang la sa 'debs mkhan gyis ma de 'bod du btang nas mdzo mo cig gnang / khyod kyis nga'i mig la ji btsugs byas gsungs pa'i khyab btsug pa med/ sa gcig btab lags zer skad/ rta lo la sa g.yos mang du byung ba'i tshe lus kyi rtsa mdud grol

08(470)zhing ye shes phyogs med du shar/ chos thams cad gdod ma nas thugs su chud cing / ska tshe brjes kyang bsnyel ba mi mnga'/ yon tan thams cad rang chas su rdzogs ༄kyang tha mal pa'i snang tshul dang bstan nas gzhan yang bla ma mkhas grub dam pa bsten te/ dgung lo bco brgyajo/ mngal dang zhol zla rtsis pa'i nyi shu(471)la mkhan po byang chub sems dpa'i gzhon nu byang chub pa dang las kyi slob dpon dge 'dun rin chen gyi spyan sngar bsnyen par rdzogs nas 'dul ba'i skor gsan(472)/ thams cad mkhyen pa shākya gzhon nu la mtshan nyid(473)mtha' dag gsan/ snye mdo pa chen po kun dga' don grub(474)la/ rje dam pa dang grub chen rya rgyan pa'i chos skor kun/ bla ma rtogs ldan gnam mtsho ba la dwag po bka' brgyad sogs gdams khrid dang / nyid kyi sku tshe snga ma gnyis kyi chos skor thams carsha gsan zhing / gzhan yang gshin rje rgya/ rngog pa seng ge sgra/ gsang bdag ngos nag pa/ dbus rtse ba la sogaso dang bcas te/ bla ma de thams cad gang mnga' ba'i dbang byin rlabs/ khrid gdam ngag mdo rgyad bstan bcos kyi lung dang bshad pa mtha' dag gsan nas bla mar bkur zhing bzhabs tog mdzad la/ de thams cad kyis kyang chos rje nyid la chos thams cad zhu zhing sangs rgyas dngos su mos gus mdzad pa'o/dag pa'i snang ba la/ dngos dang mnal lam du/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ sngon gyi paṇa chen grub thob rnams dang mjal zhing chos gsan dbang byin rlabs snyed pa'ang ston pa rgyal ba shākya'i rgyal po/ sangs rgyas mi 'khrug pa/ sangs rgyas 'od dpag med/ sangs rgyas spos kyi glang po sogs sangs rgyas du ma dang byang chung sems dpa' kun tu bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs/ spyan ras gzigs/ gsang ba'i bdag po/ byams mgon/ spos kyi glang po sogs/ grub thob chen po sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ thogs med sku mched/

99chos kyi grags pa/ padma 'byang gnas/ te lo pa/ ka ma la shrī la/ bai ma la mi tra sogs dang / rtog ldarsha gyi rgyal po mi la ras pa/ mnyam med dwags po lha rje/ rgod tshang pa(475)sogs brgyad pa'i bla ma rnams dang mjal zhing chos thob tshul rnam thar du gsal zhing / sdu dam gyi lha(476)bde mchog yab yum/digyes rdor yab yum/ gsang 'dus/ gshin rje gshed/ 'byung po 'dul byed/rdo rje phur pa/ ku ru ku le/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho sogs yi dam chos skyong du ma gzigs/ 'jam dbyangs chen po rin chen rgyal mtshan dang gong du 'byon(477)dus mdo khams su mjal/ chos gsung gleng mdzad pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' du ma dang mjal ba'i dag snang byung / sa skyar byon dus tshogs pa thams cad kyis rang dbang med par chos dang byin rlabs zhus/ mdo khams su byon nas lha steng du phebs dus/ nags la me chen 'bar ba la snying rje chen po'i bden stobs mdzad pas du ba'i nang nas 'brug byung zhing char rgyan chen po bab nas de ma thag me zhi/ sgam po gnas nang du byon dus rdo rje da la rtsegs 'khor bcas kyi bsus/ mi dang mi min kun dbang du bsdas nas shar phyogs ko la ti'i 'khrugs pa zhi bar byas/ mdo khams gnas sgo sdong mtshur phu khyung rdzong du grub chen o rgyan pa dag snang la rim par byon nas sngar gyi gdam ngag lhag ma rnams gsungs shing snyigs dus kyi 'gro don lung bstan/mdo khams nas dbus la byon pa gnyan chen thang lha sogs bod yul gyi gzhi bdag kun gyi bsus/ mtshur phur chos skyong lcam dral gyis bsus lha sar jo po'i dbu thog tu gser gdugs phul ba'i tshe phyogs bcu'i zhing gi sangs rgyas kun la mchod pa'i snang ba shar/ gang dkar du bzhugs pa'i tshe kong po'i rgyal khams su 'gro don 'byung ba'i ltas shar nas 'byon/ sgam po zangs lung / rtswa ri g.yu mtsho sogs la dag snang dpag med shar zhing / kong po thams cad chos dang rgyal

100khrims kyis bde ba la bkod/ mtshur phu'i rkungs kyi ri khrod du nang gi rtsa rlung thig le(478)thams cad gzigs pas phyi'i gza' skar dus sbyor(479)kun mkhyen/ rtsis kyi bstan bcos mdzad pa dang mtshur phur rgya phig dang gzhal med khang mdzad/ gru bzhir snyigs dus su gzhan la phan pa'i ltas byung bde chen gyi ri khrod btab/ bde chen du lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du gzigs nas/phyi nang gzhan gsum dbyer med bkod/ snye mdo ba la dbang zhus dus/ ko 'be can gyi bar chod rtsom gyi 'dug pa/ chos rje nyid chos skyong ber nag can du skad cig gis gyur nas btul ba'i rdzu 'phrul rtog ldan grags seng gis rmi lam bzung nas ltar phyin pa'i mthong / de sogs bstan chos mdzad pa dang / nyams rtog khye ran 'khrung tshul ngo mtshar gyi rnam thar mtha' yas pa ni 'bri yi mi lang /bde chen du bzhugs dwags kong du 'gro don dus la babs pa'i ltas byung pas byon/ nag phu ri khrod btab/ lo gcig gi nang du gnas dang gtsug lag khang mang po tshar/ skog phrang(480)du rdo rje theg pa mtha' dag gi don rtog nas gsang sngags nang don gyi 'grel pa mdzad/ shar phyogs las kyi gshin rje'i gnas(481)tshul ji lta bar gzigs/ rtsa ri'i gnas mdar ngo mtshar gyi ltas mang po skyel bsu ba kun gyis mthong / phrang dam po gcig la 'gro dgos yod par/ sang 'byon pa'i do nub gtsang po'i gzhung la bye ma'i lam cig glo bur du chags nas/ sang de la dpon slob kun byon pas phrang dam por 'byon ma dgos/ 'di 'bri gung sgom pa ye shes dpal gyis kyang mthong 'dug dgas lha sgam por me tog gi char babs/ chos kyi khri stegs g.yos stag lo la dbus su byon/ lha sar ngo mtshar gyi ltas du ma snang zhing / mtshal pa dang / khams pa dang 'khrugs pa 'dum/ de nas mdo khams su byon/ skar ma lha khang gsos shing 'gro don mdzad/ klu sgrub kyi dgongs pa ji lta bar rtogs nas chos

101dbyings bstod pa'i rnam bshad mdzad/ sbral lo zla ba dang po la chos skyong gis bskul nas sog chu(482)la zam pa mdzadami/ spyan ras gzigs kyis bskul nas nags phur dben pa la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ shar rgyal po'i pho brang du lo gsum nas 'byon dgos pa'i lung bstan byung / sbrul lo'i dbyar nyi logs su ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro cig byon nas/ rgyad kyi rgyal po 'bum pa'i gnad zab mo bstan/rtsa rir dben pa bsten nas ting rnge 'dzin 'phel/ g.yeng bar gyur nas 'gro don 'phel bas/ rang don gzhan don la brtags dpyad gyis zer ba'i lung bstan byung ba la sems dpa' chen po'i spyod pa/ bdag pas gzhan gces pas thugs bskyed pas/ rgya yul du 'byon dgos pa'i rten 'brel 'grig nas sku tshe mthar ma phyin par/ 'phrin las lhag ma la kong por skye ba bzhes dgos par mkhyen nas/ de'i bzhugs gnas su lhan grub steng gi ri khrod btab pa'i don rnam thar la legs par dpyad na gsal dror bzhugs/ lung bstan bzhin shar rgyal po thog thi mur(483)gyi spyan 'dren la mgon po tshal ching 'ja' sa dang 'bul ba/ kurma pakshi'i gser gyi tham kha dang bcas pa bskar btang nas lug lo zla ba bdun pa la btegs nas/ dbus su byon/ rtsa rnge snying mar las kyi mkha' 'gro'i rnam 'phrul dang sa g.yos chen po byung / lha sar gung thang du ti shrī kun dga' rgyal mtshan pas gtso mdzad dang 'dzom 'dam du byon pas/rgyal gyi zla ba la 'brug gi sgra chen po byung zhing / nyi ma gzas bzung(484)/kha ba chen po byung pas/ rgyal po chen po'i sku tshe la bar gcod yong / rang res der mi sleb par 'dug gsung nas mtshur phur log spre'u lo zla ba gnyis pa la btegs nas byon/ rgya bod kyi lam du 'gro don chen po mdzad do/ rgyal po gnam du gshegs sa kyin jang har mkhyen nas sgrib sbyangs kyi cho ga(485)mdzad/ rgyal bu rasna sris(436)rtsa ba'i bla mar byas nas kyin ngang hur sde

102btsugs/ de dus 'phrin las bar chad med cing 'phel ba'i ltas shar/ zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bco brgyad la pho brang du phebs te/ rgyal po rin po che dpal blon po dang bcas pa'i bkur sti chen pos mchod/ dbang bskur zhing chos kyi tshim par mdzad/ rgyal po de yang ska tshe thung zhing / ltas mkhyen zhing / bya lo zla ba dang po'i nya la rgyal po chen po༄ tho gan thi mur sman tse'i yul nas ta'i tur gdan phebs pa bsu ba la skye 'gro bye ba phrag du ma tshogs pa'i nang du/ khrom la sus kyang lam mi phyed pa la/ chos rje zhwa nag gsol ma ṇi pad dbyangs mdzad gin byon pa'i khrom thams cad kyi go skabs phye/ sbrel dkar chen po'i mdun du rgyal po nyid byon nas bsu zhing zhabs la btugs/ mos gus dang dbul ba bsam gyis mi khyab/ gong ma'i tha'i ha rgyal brgyud(487)/ em thi mur tha'i shi la sogs mi dpon kun gyis dbangacu zhus/ nye gnas grags btsan tha'i gyi dben gyi tshen dpon la bskos/ mi dpon mang pos mtha'i shri la ngan brtsams nas 'khrugs pa chen po yong par byung ba/ chos rjes zhal ta byon nas bde 'jam la bkod/ chos rje bzhugs ring la rgyal khams bde ba'i khag 'khur mdzad pas thog tu phebs/ zla ba drag pa la shang dor rgyal po rgyal sar bzhugs dus su chos skyong rnams kyis bar chad bsrung zhing byin gyis brlabs pa'i ltas shar/'gro don bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad/ skabs der spyan ras gzigs kyis lung bstan zhing rgyal po'i tshe chu 'don du 'byon par zhus nas/ khyi lo zla ba lnga pa'i nya la btegs/ chos thams cad kyi stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i /mi pa zhes pa'i mtshan gyi 'ja' sa gu shrī dam kha shel gyi spel kha/ gser yig sgor mo phul/bod rtsa ri gsar rnying du gser bre'i gnang sbyin dang / nyid kyi zhal slob mdo khams kyi bla ma ting 'dzin bzang po dang / mtshal dge sbyong chen po la si tu'i tham kha sogs skyes ma'i gnang sbyin phul mtshur phur 'ja' ya du rgyal po'i dus

103mchod dang yin thang(488)btsugs/ mtshur lung pa dar gan du phul yur lam rtse lnga dang mi nyag 'gar byon/ de rnams su ngo mtshar gyi ltas dang 'gro don dpag tu med/ mi nyag yul du sngon gyi lha khang dang gdan rnams gsos/gdan sa bskos/ de nas mi nyag ring mor byon/ mi skya phal pa mi cig gis gos kyi thu ba nas bton nas gser srang nyis brgya tsam phul/ zhabs tog dang 'gro don dpag tu med/ 'khrugs pa thams cad 'dum/ dmar khams nas skar ma la byon zhing / phag lo zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes nyer lnga la 'dam du phebs/ dbus gtsang gi gzhi bdag rnams kyis bsus/ tshes gsum mchod pa cig gi dus su/ da rung shar phyogs su 'gro don yod pa'i ltas byung / zla ba dgu pa la mtshur phur phebs/ lha sa gung thang brgyad nas byon/ de dus gong du mi dpon rnams la bde togs byung ba mkhyen gzeng byon/ dgun bsam yas mchims phur bzhugs/ mkhas grub dang gdul bya dpag tu med pa rjes su bzung / tshal pa la cha rkyen gtad nas gser gyi bstan 'gyur(489)phun sum tshogs pa bzhengs de rnams rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa dngos su thim zhing chos sgra sgrogs par snang /sa phyogs 'ga' zhig du tshe chu brus pa la/ snyigs dus skye bo'i chags sdang dang bar chad byung dogs nas ma thon pa'i tshul du mdzad cing don la bsam yas phu nas thon nas sus kyang ma tshor bar phyag tu bzung / gong nas 'bul ba chen po dang bcas pas gdan 'dren yang yang rim par byung nas/ byi ba lo zla ba brgyad pa la byon nas tshes bco lnga la 'dam nas thegs/ rgyal po'i pho brang bar du 'gro don rgya chen po mdzad yon mchod mjal/ nyin gcig rgyal blon gnyis dang yon mchod gsum po yod sar rgyal po chen po la tshe chu drangs pas ska tshe'i bar chad zhi ste/ sngon se chen rgyal po ma gtogs phyis kyi rgyal po gang yarā rgyal

105chos pa rnams dbang med du bos nas/ 'dir bstan pa'i bya ba mi bsgrub par/bstan pa bsnubs lugs 'di 'dra byed pa ci yin/ nged tsho tshe 'di yi sto gos ma phyid par khyed tsho la zhur yong snyam mam/ sngar gyi se chen rgyal po la sogs gong ma tshos bya ba nas/ da khyed tshos 'chos pa yin nam/ rgyal po'i ska tshe dang rgyal khams spyi'i khag khyod blon po re re tsam gyis theg pa yin na khur/zhunged thams cad bod du 'gro ba yin gsungs pa la sogs bka' skyon mang po byon pas skrag nas/ de ma thag bande gtsang mi gtsang rnams mchod/ ci tsam dar gan la 'don 'ja' sa phyogs thams cad du bsgrags/ re zhig de ltar 'jag gan pas sbyin bdag byas nas ta'i tur kur sde(493)bzhengs/ dkyil khang du rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs/ g.yas g.yon du bka' brgyad bla ma'i sku dang bde mchog lha lnga'i blos bslangs(494)chos skyong dang bcas༄ pa bzhengs/ shing kun tu'ang kur sde btsugs 'bri phag gi rin po che la shel gyi spel kha/ mtshur phur gdan sa ba la dmi pakshi'i gser gyi tham kha gnang / slar yang ha ching sang zer ba nag phyogs kyi blon pos ngan byas nas/ gnam ca/chod pa rnams la gtser pa byung ba'i/ chos rje pa'ang cung zad thugs chad nas/ spyir nyid kyi gsung dang / rgya'i rtsis mkhan mkhas pas rtsis yig la ska tshe ring ba'i ltas yod cing tshe la dbang ba'i gang zag yin pa la thugs 'byung sto dga' ldan du gshegs par bzhed do/ /stag lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes brgyad la/ rgyal blon kun 'dzom sar/ rnal 'byor nga ni nam mkha'i sprin dang 'dra/ gar 'gro mi shes pas/ rang rang gi chos kyi don sgrub par 'dod pa rnams myur du bsgrab shig gsungs yang / sngar bod du 'byon gsung pas 'phro ma gtogs/ ce 'da' ba'i gsung ma go yos lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes lnga'i tho rengs/ mnal ma sad par 'od gsal gyi ngang las rdo rje'i mgur bzhengs pa gsol ja ba shag seng

106sogs kyis thos/ de ma thag tu nam mkha' las chos rje mya ngan las 'das zer ba'i sgra dang sa g.yos chen po byung / lnga pa'i bcu bzhi la ta'i tu nas btegs nas/ chu tshan khar ska khrus mdzad/ khu ba rnams slob ma tshos btung pa'i tshe/sprin nag dang 'od dang rshaja' tshon sna tshogs byang ba ci yin zhus pas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen cig gshegs pa'i gdod pa( yong gsungs/ de nyin nas shang do bar du 'ja' tshon rgyan ma chad/ shang dor gong ma tha'i ha blon por bcas pa thams cad chos kyis tshipa par mdzad nas tshes brgyad nas 1 khams zi/ zla ba drug pa'i bcu'i nyi ma phyed yol la nam mkhar dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pa tshogs 'dug pa'i mchod pa bshoms zhes 'dul 'dzin par gsung byon/ba yan tha'i shis ngus nas/ chos rje sku mi 'da' bar zhu zhus pas/ nga bod du 'gro snyam pa yin te/ khyod rgyal blon la ma grub nga'i bka' las kyang cung zad 'das/ de snga phar song zin/ da 'di tsam du song nas bcos su med pas zhing gzhan du 'gro rgyal blon rnams bstan pa dang khrims chos bzhin skyongs gsungs/ ta'i dben gu shrī dkon mchog rin chen gyis/ chos rje gshegs na bdag cag rnams kyi bstan pa ji ltar bskyang zhus pas/ stag lo zla ba gsum pa la smras pa bzhin mdzad gsungs/ slob ma tshos gsol ba btabs/ zhal ta zhus byas pas/ chos la brtson par gyis/ bod kyi gdul bya kun la'ang sngar phag lo nas/ byi ba lo'i bar kha ta byas tshar/ dpon slob myur du 'phrad par bya'o gyis gsung ba de dus drung 'khor tshos yi ger btab ste/ chos rje sprul sku bzhi pa(496)slar 'byon pa'i zhal bzhes su go'o/ de nas bde mchog gi mchod bstod byed du bcug o rgyan gyi bsnyen bsgrab(496)kyi lus gnad kyis 'pho ba mdzad nas mya ngan las 'das so/ / brtso lnga'i dgongs kha res dpon du'i ran thi mur res mjal ba la 'ong nas pho brang sgo mdun na yod pa'i tshe/

107zla ba shar ba'i dbus na/ chos rje sku yongs su rdzogs pa gser gyi mchod rten dang bcas pa byon pa/ khong ras pa bco brgyad kyis mthong nas phyag 'tshal/gnyis kyis ma mthong / skabs der chu dang 'ja' mor sngar nyid gyis srog bskyabs pa'i sog po dpon g.yog gsum gyis mthong / gar bzhud zhus pas ta'i tu nas bod du 'gro gsungs/ dpon mo ha ha dpon g.yog gis chos rje khri la btegs nas tha'i hu'i sar bzhud pa mthong / gzhan yang bu slob dang mjal ba tshan pa 'ga' byung gnang / nyi shu lnga la pur la bkur sti bsam gyis mi khyab pa byas/ gu shrī rnams dang tha'i gyis mgo byas/ mi dpon kun gyis zhabs thang du pur sgrom bteg nas/ tsaṇḍan dang a ka ru'i mes sbyangs/ ngo mtshar gyis cho 'phrul dpag tu med pas thams cad tshim par byas shing / sku gdung la bde mchog lhan skyes dang / spyan ras gzigs dang / chos 'byang(497)yig 'bur bcas pa sogs rten dang ring srel dpag med byon te/ curgyal po chen pos gtso mdzad kun gyis mchod cing / sku gdung bod yul du spyan drangs te mtshur phur lha khang bzhengs/ gser sku dang ska 'dra chen po bzhengs so/ /chos rje nyid mtshur phur bzhugs dus kyang kurma bsko dbon brgyad rim par bskos te/ bla ma gnas nang pa'i rjes su bla ma bkra shis 'bus/bla ma dbang rin/ de'u thog pa'i yon tan dpal/ bla ma nag po rin chen dpal/ bla ma chos dbyings/ bla ma chos rgyal da lta gdan sa byed do/ /zhal slob ni/ nyid kyi bla ma thams cad kyang tshur chos zhus nas gtsug gi nor bu 'dzin cing / gzhan yang / ni'u thog gling stod smad/ bde ba can dang chos 'khor gling(498)gi gdan sa ba snga phyi sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen dpag tu med cing o rgyan pa chen po'i sprul sku skye ba byon pa dang / bram ze mgon po/ lha bu rmog lcogs pa dang / rmi lam 'od gsal gyi rtsal mnyam pa

108rtogs ldan grags pa seng gi rgyal ba ri khrod pa/ ku su lu'i brtul zhugs(499)mthar phyin cing rig pa'i rtsal rdzogs rtog ldan bsam gtan nus pa mthar phyin pa g.yung ston rdo rje dpal(500)/ phug po che ba lha rje rnam gnyis/ chu sgom/ kho yo dge slong sogs rtog ldan gyi rnal 'byor dpag tu med cing / gu shrī kun dga' rgyal po/ ta'i dbon gu shrī dkon cog rin chen/si tu dge sbyongs chen po'i bla ma ting 'dzin bzang po sogs mdo dbus kong gsum gyi gdan sa skyangs pa'i bla ma rnams sogs smos kyis mi lang ste/sbas pa'i rnal 'byor rnams sus shes par nus/ chos rje sprul sku'i drung du dge sbyong dge ba'i blo gros kyis zhal slob bu chen gyi dkar chag zhur btang ba'i gzhan mi dgos kho rang gi ming bris gsungs zer te/ yon tan gzhan ma mchis kyang /sku tshe gsum bar ma chad par skye ba gnyis kyis bsten pa'i dpon slob yin no//chos rje rin po che sprul ska bzhi pa 'byon pa'i lung bstan pa gong du smos pa rnams dang rkarma pakshi'i rnam thang las/ da ste lo brgya tsam na bram ze chen po thugs kyi sprul pa dus gsum mkhyen pa'i rnam 'phrul cig byon nas/ bstan pa skyong yang zhes gsungs pa dang / chos rje rang byung ba'i gnam mtho tshal chos khri'i rgyab tu shug pa gcig btsugs nas/ 'di chos khri 'di dang mnyam dus rang re 'dir 'ong / zho kha thang du lha khang gcig byed pa'i rab gnas la song zhes pa bla ma lha lung pa rin rgyal gsungs pa dang / snye bor byon dus som shing rtsa ba gcig la rtse mo gnyis pa gcig la sku rgyab gtad nas/ shing rtse 'di gnyis mnyam par song dus rang re 'ong gsung pa sogs dang mthun par sprul sku byon tshul ni rgya yul nas dga' ldan gyi gnas su byon ste/ sngon gyi gsung na yod pa ltar/ lha'i drang srong legs par skyes su 'khrungs nas mi'i lo ngo gsum tsam bar du/ bcom ldan 'das byams pa la chos ga na zhing byang chub sems

109dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa las/ byams mgon gyis/ khyod da dung 'dzam bu'i gling du skyo ba med par sems can gyi don la som zhig ces bka' rtsal zhing / dpal rta mgrin la sogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro du mas dbang bskar/ mnga' gsol nas/ bka' bzhin zhal gyis bzhes te/ 'od sna tshogs 'the ba'i shel gyi khang pa las shel gyi them skas nas bab nas/ 'og gser gyi sa gzhir byon pas snang ba byung gsung pa ltar kong po dang mdo khams kyi bar/ rngod a la rong gi brag rar(501)/ shing pho rta la sku skye ba bzhes gdung rus ska cor du 'khrungs tshe yab sangs rgyas dpal/ yum dge 'dun 'bum gcung po nyayon tan rgya mtsho'o yab yum la ngo mtshar gyi ltas mang po byung zhing / gsung mkhyen ma thag nas sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa'i gsung dang / rnam 'gyur mang du byung yang yab yum tshos bu chung gi 'du shes kyis khrid cing phyogs rnams bskor te/ lan gcig dwags lha sgam po'i mchod khang du byon dus bka' brgyud bla ma'i ska 'dra rnams la dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mang pos skor 'dug pa gzigs nas/ domab la gsung pa dang / lam du dgra 'jigs yod med mkhyen pa dang / brag gsum mtsho chu(502)dang / khung ra sogs chos rje gong ma'i yon bdag rnams ngo mkhyen/sku tshe snga ma la byon pa'i khang pa rnams kyi sgo dang lam sogs mkhyen/ sras po lhan grub la sku tshe snga ma'i zhwa nag yod pa blangs nas gsol ba sogs sngon gyi sem thar ji ltar ba mdzad/ nad pa dang gdon chen sogs la byin rlabs kyis phan/ mngon par mkhyen pa'i gsung mang du byon/ chos zhu ba rnams la thogs med du gsungs pas/ chos rje kurma pa rang byung rdo rje'i sku skye ba yin pa'i graṭa pa dgas kong dang / dbus gtsang mdo khams thams cad khyab nas chos rje gong ma'i bu chen thams cad rim par 'dus/ gsol ja ba shag seng yong nas nye gnas mdzad yon bdag gsar rnying thams cad kyis bkur bsti dang zhabs

110tog byas/ rtog ldan ye rgyal dang rtog ldan mgon rgyal la ska tshe snga rabs kyi chos skor dbang gdams pa mtha' dag zhus/ bla ma rdza shongarā pa la mdo mang sogs lung sna tshogs dang / slob dpon blo gros seng ge la mtshan nyid skor thams cad gsal 'debs zhus/ rtog ldan mgon rgyal sogs kyis dben par zhus pas/ ska tshe snga ma dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa bzhi bzhugs par zhal gyi bzhes pa la lnga bcu rā drug las ma bzhugs pas rgya mtshan sdig spyod rnams la thugs skyo bas dga' ldan du byon pa dang / /shegs dus sku'i bkod pa bstan tshul sogs dga' ldan nas slar mi yul byon tshul rgyas par de dus gsungs/ gzhan yang bu slob rnying pa rnams rim par mjal tshad ma rgyas pa nas mkhyen pa dang /sngon gyi rabs gsungs pa dang / yi dam gzigs pa/ nyams rtog dang dngos grub brnyes pa/ byin brlabs kyis nad gdon zhi ba/ 'phrin las kyis gdul bya btul ba/ dgon pa btab pa/ 'khrug pa 'dum pa/ mgur gsung pa/chos bstan pa'i smin grol la bkod tshul brir ma lang ste rnam thar dang mgur 'bum du lta/ sa pho byi ba'i lo la chos rje sprul sku'i rnam thar tshal pas thos nas zhu yig ja 'dren bskur/ stag lo la mtshur phu nang pa'i gdan 'dren byon/dgung lo bcu gcig la chu pho 'brug lo la dbus su byon/ yar lung nas mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug gis phyag dang bkur bsti zhabs tog du ma mdzad/ de nas tshal gung thang du phyag phebs/ dpon slob gsar rnying mjal nas thugs 'dres shing tshim(503)/ mtshur phur bde chen la phebs dus ngo mtshar gyi ltas mang du snang / snyan grags kyi bod khams khyab/ nam mkha' dpal dbon mas mjal nas gtor dbang zhus bkur bsti chen po byas/ bde chen du rta'i zla ba la ral phud mdzad/ mkhan chen don grub dpal ba dang / slob dpon jo btsun pa la rab du byung / bla ma g.yung ston pa la sngags gsar rnying(504)gi

111 —dbang bskyed rdzogs/ lung man ngag mtha' dag zhus/ sbrul lo la skyor mo lung pa la 'bri nang gi dmag btegs(605)pa zlog pa la skyid shod kyi lha sde spyis chos rje spyan drangs nas lha sa rkyang thang du byon/ mi chen thams cad zil gyi mnan dmag zhi bar mdzad/ chos rje mi dpon thams cad kyis spyi bor bkur/ngam shod(506)dang gtsang phyogs kyi byang brgyab len re 'gro don la byon/ bya lo la bla ma 'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa dang mjal zhing chos kyi gsung gleng 'phel/ phyag rtse sprod(507)mdzad/ snye thang brgya grong du dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su bla ma khu dbon dang chos rje pa bzhugs khri gsum bshibs nas gung la bzhugs/ khrom thams cad dang dad gus kyi 'ur/bla ma'i drung du chos 'brel gsan/ dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po la sogs chen po thams cad dbang du 'dus/ slob dpon chen po bzhi thog pa dang rim par mjal nas phyag rtse sprod mdzad/ mtshur phur gzhal yas khang gsos/ rgyal bu ra: shis rnam thar thos nas 'bul ba chen po byung /rgyal po chen pos kyang sprul ska byon tshul snga gong nas gsan yang the tshom ma chod pa las/ deng chung glang snang gong du sleb dus/ gong mas dris pa'i snyan grags chen po 'dug tshal pa si tu(508)chos rje gong ma'i slob ma dam tshig dang shes rab che bas/ chos rje gong ma yin nges su 'dug zer/ rtog dpyod can thams cad kyis de ltar gtam gin 'dug zhus pas/ gong ma phyag thal mo sbyar/ spyan chab byon nas/gdan 'dren gyi 'ja' sa snyan ngag chen mo bod yig ma/ rten gser bre(509)gcig dngul bre(510)gsum/ gos dar dgu tshan gsum dang bcas pa bskur nas dbon gyis mi dpon ding ju dbon dpon dang / gar sde'i sde dpon dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang / ti shrī'i mi bsod nams shes rab btang byung ba bya lo la phebs/ bya lo'i ston ta'i si tu ba'i rdzong ba mdzad chos zhus/ sa pho

113ba'i ltas dang rnal 'byor mang po byung / zla ba lnga pa'i nyer dgu la rkyang ri rngog nas mgul du phebs/ der skye 'gro mang po la chos gsungs dus 'ja' dang me tog gi char chen po byung / zla ba drug pa'i tshes brgyad la sog zam snar phebs/bco brgyad bar du bzhugs/ der klu nag gdong gis thog mar cho 'phrul chu chen po lud pa slar yang gtor ma byin pas dam la thog shing chu chad/ mdo dbus thams cad 'tshogs pas chos mang po gsungs/ 'bul ba dpag tu med pa byung / me tog gi char babs/ zla ba bdun pa'i tshes brgyad la ga rer phebs nas bcu bar bzhugs/ tshes bcu gsum la gsar ma sgang du phebs/sgom sde ras tshang pa'i bla ma byon nas bsu/ sgam sder gdan drangs/ zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes dgu nas bco brgyad bar spa kha ru 'gro don mdzad/ zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bcu gnyis la cham la khar phebs/ bco brgyad la /rmar phebs nyin 'ja' tshon dang me tog gi char bab/ nyer bdun la skar ma ngan pas gtso byas grwa pa bu slob spyi la 'bul ba byas/ zla ba bcu pa'i tshes gsum la rkarma na bzhugs pa rnams la skyos ma'i 'bul ba rnam bzhag mdzad/ thugs bskyed chen mo gnang / mdo khams kyi che dgu 'dus/ tshogs pa khri phrag re tsam byung / nyin gcig nam mkhar nyi zla'i bar na shel gyi mchod rten dang /chos rje'i sku bzhugs pa ding ju dbon dpon gyis mthong / zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes drug la lha steng(513)du byon brgyad bar bzhugs/ nyin tse re byin brlabs bshad mi zin pa byung / tshes bco lnga la gar ma nas thegs bcu drug la gyim thang du sa skya pa'i nye gnas dpal ldan bzang pos 'bul ba byas/ tshug gnyis bar du sgar sa rnams kyis skyelathung byas/ bco brgyad la sha ha la la byon nas zi dgon du zhag gnyis bzhugs/ nyer gnyis la zi mda' ru rā khros 'bul ba zhabs tog byas/ nyer bdun la la 'or du phebs der dpon chen

114gyis gtsos byas mi dpon kun bsu ba la byung / zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la ldan klong thang(614)du phebs/ 'bri chu(515)la 'byon dus ngo mtshar gyi ltas mang po byung / tshes gsum la dpon chen pas gro dang 'bul ba byas thugs bskyed chen mo gsungs/ tshes brgyad bzhugs/ /mi pa'i dgon lag gnyis su byon/ sku tshe snga ma'i rnam thar mang po gsungs/ mi dpon dang gser yig pa tshos byang lam la 'byon par zhus pas/ nga 'gro don gang che byed gsung nas ma gnang bar kre la byon/ tshes bcu la rag thag tu phebs/ de nas mdo khams dpon chen gyis lha khang chen po bzhengs yod pa'i rab gnas mdzad/tshes bcu bzhi la nyi thag ri bur phebs/ mi sde la gzan gsung nas dpon chen pas gtso mdzad mi dpon rnams de nas slog cha'o da'o zhabs tog la btang /kre phur nye drug la phebs/ bla ma dpal ldan pa'i gtso mdzad kre bo'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshos bsu/ 'ja' 'od mang po byung / nyer brgyad la dpal ldan pa'i dgon du gdan drang 'bul ba byas/ der dad ldan rnams la chos rje rin po che bar snang la bzhugs pa'i snang ba byung / thugs bskyed chen mo gsungs/phag lo zla ba dang po'i tshes gcig la kre man ḍal du phebs/ tshes gsum la sde dgon pas gdan drangs/ tshes bzhi la du dben shas gdan drangs/ thugs bskyed chen mo gsungs/ tshes la thegs/ de ltar mdo khams sgang la gdul bya dang sku bsod chos rje gong ma bas kyang che bar grags pa byang ngo / /'di yan chad shangs pa'i gser yig pa phyag phyir phyin pa des yi sgor btab 'dugayon btsun gyi skad bshad pa la/ khyi lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nyer lnga la rma chu gling khugs su phebs la khad pa la/ rang re rta kha bag tsam thal 'dug sto phyogs pha gi na 'bo gang dkar ze ba yod par sgom gin bsdad na yong bar 'dug ste/ da shing kun bar du 'gro ba'i thabs med gsungs/ de dang ngo log

115gis shang do brgyab pa dang dus mtshungs par 'dug phag lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes drug la rgya gar phebs/ rgyal bu sang gra shri can la rang du bsu ba la byung /gdan 'dren byung nas brgyad la ga chur(516)byon/ rta rma ming dbang gis 'ur rdo so yar zhag gnyis bzhugs/ tsong dbang dkon cog dpal gyis mgo byas rgyal brgyud bcug nying dbon gyi mi dpon rnams la dbang bskar/ srad nya dbang khong tshos dma' phab 'dug pa'i skabs su nang 'grigs kyi snal ta mdzad/dbang bde khrol la btang / dbang hu rnams btson las bkrol/ ga chur zhag brgyad bzhugs nas la bar gyi lha khang du rgyal bu chos dpal gyis mdzad par nye ba'i sgar la bzhugs gong 'khrug 'ja' mo(517)thams cad chad pa'i don gyis gong du lam la thon pa'am byon na bar chad 'byung bar mkhyen nas ma byon par zla drug gi bar du sa cha de rnams su bzhugs/ ska 'khor lnga brgya tsam re bzhugs pa la nying dben pa'i rgyags sprad/ sgo rma tseng cudabang dang / di ju thang chang ma 'chams par dmag tshan༄ cher bsag nas/ zla ba bzhi pa'i bco lnga'i nyin 'thab dus btab pa la zhal ta bskar nas 'khrugs pa bcag rgyal chung lha btsun la/ gong ma yab sras kyi drung rū zhu yig khyad 'phags bkur nas zla ba gsum pa'i nyer gnyis la song ba'i zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu drug la pho brang du sleb/ bco brgyad la mjal/ ja 'dren gong ma yab sras kyi gser yig pa re/gong ma'i gser bre gcig dang / dngul bre gsum/ gos dar cha dgu tha'i tshes dngul bre gsum/ gos dar cha bdun/ gsol chang / bla ma chos rgyal ba'i cha'o bre lnga bcu dang bcas pa bskar nas/ chos rje pa ga'o 'ja'o na bzhugs par zla ba drug pa'i gnam garā la sleb byung / 'u lag zhon pa brgyad cu/shing rta nyi shu la zhon/ ga chu shing kun gyi dmag gis gin cang hu bar/ do'i dmag gis pho brang bar gdan drangs so gsungs pa yod zer/ 'on kyang 'ja'

116mo med rab/ mu ge dang / dus ma bde rabs zhu yin 'dug pas/ 'ja' mo med na rang rta ni mi thon/ dmag nyung dus ni mi thon/ tshan po che khyer ba'i sems can mang po la gnod pas/ 'ja' mo nam tshugs dus 'gro gsungs/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gsum la sa'i char 'bab pa dang ltas ngan pa byung bas/ chos rje gsung gis/ dus ngan pa shar/ gtam ngan chen po cig myur du yong bar 'dug gsungs/ de nyin par ti sri'i gdung ngo log gis rgyab pa(618)dang dus mtshungs pa 'dug zla ba lnga pa'i bcu gnyis la dpon dpal 'bul gyis zhu ba bskur nas/ ti shrī'i gdung chos 'khor 'byon gin yod pas/mdzo lnga bcu'i 'chi med zhu zer ba byung ba'i/ mi nyung bar bzhad nas/ mi rdzun ma 'di tsho mtshar gdung chos 'khor byung na dang dga' ste yong rgyu 'dug pa ma mthong / gdung bcom pa'i da sprug kha cig zhag nas slebs yong / mi la ma bshad cig gsung tsa na zhag lnga na gdung bcom pa'i lhag rnams sleb byung / bla ma 'jam dbyangs pa dang brag ston bsod nams 'bum la sogs la dbang gdam pa mang po gnang / char zhu ba nam byung gi char babs/ shing kun tu ma byon pa'i klu chu stor bcad phag lo la lo nyes klu chu byang bcad lo legs gser yig pa snga rting rnams ga jur song ba'i skabs su/ tsha go ba shes rab dpal zer ba sbyor drug gi 'gro don skyong ba'i bya bral ba chen po de rgyal mo rong nas mjal du byung / sgar du zhag gsum bsdad pa'i skabs su/ des lam sna byas nas/ zla ba bdun pa'i bcu gcig la ga'o ra nas sto phyogs la byon/ yar gleng khug ba glang gnyan tshe dong gong bshal nas tsha 'phrang la byon/ 'dzim gar lcags mos zhabs tog byas/ zhag bcu gnyis bzhugs/ de nas gong du sgor mo 'dab mi btang / rgyal mo rong la byon/ de ltar tshugs bzhi bcu zhe bdun gyis rab sgang du phebs/ mi nyag sa 'dru gnyis/ sgo sding gnyis 'khrugs nas

117dmag sogs bsam gyis mi khyab 'dug pa la/ zhal ta byon gnang sbyin mdzad nas 'khrug pa che chung 'dum nas/ lo skor gnyis mi 'khrug pa'i/ yig 'phrin brgya dang nyi shu rtsa bdun mdzad/ 'khrug 'dum bar la zla ba dgu pa nas/ byi ba lo zla ba gnyis pa'i bar du 'gor/ mdo khams kyi 'khrug chen rnams 'dum pa'i phyogs su phyag rdzas song ba la rta bdun brgya tsam gser srang nyis stong lhag pa/ ja sig lnga brgya/ dngul/ stag gzig mdzo phyugs gos dar sogs shin tu mang ba song / de tshar nas rin chen gling du gsang ba gsum sku mtshams mdzad/ khrid pa brgyad brgya tsam byang / rab sgang stod du seng ge sgang zer ba btab/ rin chen gling nas zla ba /nyis pa la yon btsun bkras rin gyis mtshur phur bya 'dab dang / lha khang mchod rten zhig pa rnams 'chos pa'i/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i sku 'dra'i thog tu rgya sgrig 'gel ba la yong pa zla ba bcu gcig pa la mtshur phur slebs pas skad 'di rnams bshad/ chos rje ba rin gling nas seng ge dgon du rab gnas la byon/ de nas 'bo gang dkar la 'byon pa yod zer khong gis thos 'dug gdan 'dren gyi gser yig pa rnams la/ gong nas bka' skyon yong bar 'dug pa'i skabs su/ sgor mo 'dab mi sleb nas/ khong tshos ma lan pas rgyu mtshan zhus pas khrol/ shing kun gyi mkhar dpon la sogs 'ga' zhig la/ chos rje'i zhabs tog ma byas 'dug gsung nas tsa ra byung 'dug gong ma'i 'ja' sa byi ba lo dpyid zla tha chung tshes bcu bdun la bris pa/ chos rje ba nged la bsam nas byon nas mdo smad la phebs/ mdo smad du phebs 'dug na'ang / gser yig pa dang mi dpon rnams go ma chod pa'i don gyis bod la byon pa yin las che/ byang chub kyi sems kyis sngar gyi smon lam rdzogs par byas pa dang / nged la bsam nas mgyogs por byon byas nas/gdan 'dren la shes rab btang ba yin zhes sogs bsnyen bsngags rgya chen po

118dang / gser bre gcig dngul bre gsum/ gos phyi nang / dgu tshan gnyis dang bcas pa/ 'ja' sa bod yig ma na/ dkon mchog gi byin brlabs la lam dang / 'jam thams cad 'jags yod pas myur bar 'byon par zhu zer ba zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes gcig la bris pa bskur nas shes rab dbon dpon mngaṭa/skabs der/ dar ma rgyal mtshan thang chang la 'dzugs mi byang nas nyes pa thugs la khad pa/ khong la dkar ba'i mi dpon rnams kyis/ ༄khong chos rje ba'i yon bdag rnying pa yin bod gyong song rnams khong min pas mi thub pas/ khong btang na gdan 'dren thub zhus pas/ khong gdan 'dren gyi rgyab gnon la sogs gying dbon dang mdo smad kyi mi dpon dmag dang bcas pa song ba gdan drongs/lam du gegs byed mi byung nas gdan ma 'drongs/ khyod rang rnams ma zlog par gong du zhu ba thong gsung ba byung ba la/ shing kun tu bla ma 'jam dbyangs pas gser yig pa dmag sde'i sems can la gnod 'tshe byang na gdan mi 'drongs/de rnams med kyang / 'ja' sa byon zhing lam bde ston gdan 'drongs pa'i khag nged kyis 'khur zer ba byas nas gdan 'dren gyi 'ja' sa dang thar ma lha sding pas bskos 'ja' bsrung bya rnams khong gis khyer yongs nas chos rje'i drung du phul 'dug chos rje ba byi ba lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bco brgyad la gong du thegs/ gdan 'dren rnams kyis nya rgyal chu kha nas bsu zer ba'i skad dang 'ja' sa'i ngo bshus glang lo zla ba gsum pa la mtshur phur slebs/ rgya'i ngo log gi dpon che ba gcig chos rje ba la ngo ltas nas/ btsun pa byas ding jus mgo gying dben pa sogs kyis gcan ma rang nas bsu/ shing kun tu zhag bdun bzhugs/ zla ba bcu pa'i bcu bzhi la bteg nas mi nyag 'gar bzhug zhag gsum bzhugs/ der hong ba'i tshe'i na'i ra thu pheng chang(519)gis na bza' khyer byung / sha yang hur tho gon dben sri'i chibs pa khyer nas slebs byung /

119zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i bcu dgu la ta'i tur phebs ching sang sogs mi dpon tshos bsu/ mchod rten sngon por bzhugs sa byas nyer gsum la gong ma yab sras dang 'jal/ nyer drug la hong tha'i tshe'i sras 'khrung / sang de hong tha'i tshe gdan drangs nas gser bre gcig phyag phyi'i dge bshes rgan pa brgyad la gos yug re/ phyi'i mi mang la dar yug sum cu gnang / mi brgya dang bdun cu la rgyag gnang / gan che ba'i shang len gser bre gnyis dngul bre gsum/ gan chung dro'i gser bre gcig gos phyi nang dgu tshan gcig phul/ gan chung pa'i pho brang du bzhi bcu rtsa bzhugs nas/ rgyal bu chen pos byams chos(520)dang skyes rabs(521)zhus/ de'i ring la paṇḍi ta dang / bla ma rgyal rin sog gu shrī kun gyis gong du bkur nas gnam mchod pa(522)kun gyis gtso bo mdzad do/chos rje pa nyid la/ thu lu sri skya'o ta'o dben gu shrī yi shel gyi dam kha gnang /nyes pa can spyi thar ba'i shel 'ja' chen po zhus nas bod du sgrog pa la sde dpon dkon mchog rgyal mtshan btang / bstan pa shed bskyed pa'i 'ja' sa khyad par du rgyal bu chen po'i ling ji na/ bande rnams kyis gong ma la phyag 'tshal mi dgos par bkur ba la/ gyis rgyal brgyad mi dpon sogs la phyag 'tshal dgos byung 'dug pa'i dus ma bde ba des la// da phyis de bzhin ma byed zer ba dang / sde lha khang zhig rnams gan pa'i chos zer ba tshud pa/ chos rje ba nyid kyi bka' shog dang bcas pa sgrogs pa la nye gnas dpon 'go gsum btang 'dug mkhan chen don grub dpal ba'i che ba'i yon tan rnams dpal ldan dmi pa las thos zhes pa'i hong tha'i tshe'i spel kha dang / ta hung gi phya ru bskar 'dug glang lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bdun la ju jur byon nas dbyar sa mthed/ rgod ma brgya thams pa dang / bzhon ma lnga bcu/ dbyar gyi dgos cha ci yin bskur nas zhabs tog mi dpon gsum btang / dgun ta'i tur byon/

120gong ma pho brang rgyab mar bzhugs nas yab sras gnyis gas khrid gsan/ yon gser bsil ma bre gnyis/ ling ma bre gcig phul/ skabs der tshal pa'i ha ju'i sde la 'ong / ta ha'i spun zla'i pha mes kyi dur sa yin zer nas khyer ba/stochos rje bas gong ma yaḥ sras la dngos su byon pa'i de ma thag lon/ skabs der chu cung zad ma 'phrod pa la bsnyad nas/ bod du 'byon pa'i zhu ba mdzad pas/ gong ma yab sras ma gsan/ khyad par du hong tha'i tshes spyan chab bton nas zhus pas/ chu stom pa la lo gsum byang ngos/ mi nyag 'ga'/ shing kun sogs su byon/ de nas phyir 'byon pa'i chad mdzad/ gong ma yab sras kyis dbang zhus/ yon du gser bre gsum/ gos dar dgu tshan phul/ stag lo zla ba dang po'i bcu gsum la hong tha'i tshe skyel gdung kur sder byon/ bcu bzhi la btegs/ ching sang sogs kyis brag sgo bar bskyal/ yar lam dung cing du/bla chen bsod blo ba dang mjal/ byang ngos mchod rten brgya brtsar rgyal bu ratna byon nas dbang zhus/ byang ngos sngar kurma pa sa btab pa'i ga ra dgon pa zhes par gan pas gzim khang bskor mang po gsar du phub nas/ zla ba bzhi pa la der phebs/ gsor zer ba'i sa btsan la zhen pa'i ngo log mang pos chos rje ba la ngo ltas nas dgos kyi mi sde byas/ gong na yod pa'i rgyag rnams yar 'then zhing / skyel thung la tho gon dben sri/ na ga ju/ jim thurā / zung dbon gyi bsod nams 'bum thong ji sogs yong / phyis de rnams log nas byang ngos rgyal po'i go sa thams cad rgyal bu chen po la sgos su gtogs par byas(523)nas/ nying jim bu dben bslangs yod pa'i mi dpon tshos zhabs tog byas/chos zhu mi dpag med 'dus shing gdul bya che la thugs dam 'phel/ chos rje ba'i bka' drin la/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs pa la si du/ dar rgyal la skyar si tu/sgol rin la gu'i gung(524)gi tham kha/ mtshur phur nang pa'i la gu'i gung gi

122'grogs nas sgam por byon te/ rje mnyam med dwags po lha rje dang mjal/rtogs pa 'khrungs/ lo ngo gsum bsten/ yar byon nas tsha rong btsad pos yon bdag byas te/ phag mo grur ljag spyil dang / chos khrims mdzad nas dgon pa btab/ dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa lnga nas 'gro don bskyangs/ dgung lo drug cu rtsa gcig gi rta lo ston zla tha chung(533)la mya ngan las 'das/ de'i thugs kyi sras bzhi ni/ bsod nams mthar phyin 'bri khung pa(534)/ mos gus mthar phyin stag lung pa(635)shes rab mthar phyin par phu ba/ rtogs pa mthar phyin sna phu(536)ba/ /nye ba'i sras bzhi ni/ skal ldan ye shes seng ge(537)kun ldan gtsang pa ras chung pa(538)/ rtogs ldan mi nyag sgom rin(639)grub thob nyag re se bo'o(640)/ gzhan yang mkhan po zhang sum thog pa dang / khro phu'i rgyal tsha rin chen(641)/ chos rje gtum/ glang seng gi rgyal mtshan/ smo ston chos blo/ seng ge sdings pa/ seng ston ldings pa/nyang shan grong pa/ zhang ston mkhan po rtsibs ri ba/ te bo dge ba dpal/dge bshes ston 'jam/ rgyal cha/ me sgom sogs te/ sku 'da' ba'i lo la grwa pa brgyad brgya byung / bde gshegs rin po che(542)'das rting / 'bri khung chos rje(543)rang gi lo mang rab gdan sa bskyangs/ rting la khong rang gi gsol ja ba(544)spyan snga rin po che(545)phag gru'i gdan sar bskos/khong gi gdung rus lha gzigs yin/ phag rgya'i lha khang bzhengs/ phyis 'bri khung gi gdan sa mdzad dus khong rang gi dbon po rgyal ba thog rdags pa phag grur(546)bskos/ de'i sku tshe'i smad rgyal po ha la ha'i(577)'bul mo che blangs nas zhag bcu bdun na rgyal ba rin po che sgrongs the/ /de'i dpon po rin po che bcu gnyis pas(548)gdan sa mdzad nas rgyal ba rin po che'i rten sgo mangs po bzhengs/ de'i slob ma la spu rtogs zer/ de grongs nas spu

123rtogs tshos sgo mangs gcig bzhengs/ bcu gnyis pa'i dbon po gcen grags pa ye shes(549)bskos/ de'i slob ma la sdol bu zer bas/ spu ldol gyi chags sdang de nas byang / rin po che grags pa ye shes/ bla ma 'phags pa rme rgyud gdams ngag zhurā/ bla ma shar pa ye rin pa la khong rang gi dbon po snag tsha brag blo ba phul/ de la sa skya pas gdan sa bsko rtsis byas pas/ gcung rgya bos(550)bkrongs/ de rting rin po che grags pa ye shes grongs nas/ rin po che gcung rgya bo grags rin gyis gdan sa mdzad/ sa skya pas brag tshe ba'i khams mchu(551)rtsod rtsis byas pas/ gcung rgya'i rting 'bri khung pas mnan pas/ sa 'bri 'khrugs pa'i(552)mgo tshugs/ phag gru pa rang la skyon cher ma byang zhing / phyis gcung rgya pos bla dpon sbrel nas mdzad/ de grongs nas/de'i༄ slob dpon rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan(663)sa pho khyi la gdan sar bskos/ spyo dpon rabs ni/ spyan snga'i dus su 'bri gung nas sgom pa shag rin(554)gyis spyi'i kha ta byed/ spyan snga'i nye gnas sgom brtson gyis rkang dang /lhar la ngo lta byas rting la dpon rdo rje dpal mdo khams nas mi gzhon gcig byang / lha gzigs yin byas pas gsol ja ba bcol/ rting du rgya yul du thengs/ phag rgya khri bskor(565)dang stag mgo(566)blangs/ khri dpon(657)yun rings byas/ sne gdong(558)brtsigs/ de 'das nas de'i nu bo gzhon nu rgyal mtshan gyis byas/ de 'das rting khong gi dbon skya yar 'brog pa byang gzhon gyis khri dpon byas/ skabs der sa 'bri 'khrugs pa la/ byang gzhon gyis sa skya pa gang gsung byas/ dpon chen a glen gyis phag gru bsreg par byung pa byang gzhon gyis zhus pas tshengs/ byang gzhon shi nas gzhon nu rgyal mtshan gyi tsha bo gzhon nu yon tan gyis khri dpon byas/ rgyal bu thi mur sbo kha(559)bod du bzhugs pa'i dmag gi phyags gyi dang / zhabs tog cung ma

124grub/ phyi go ma chod kyang / nang du zhing pa ya gsum la sogs la gzan pa byas pas/ rin po che gcung rgya ma mnyes par rgyal bu yab yum la rgyas pas gzhon nu yon tan phab nas gong du zhu ba btang / de ma 'khor bar du/ rgyal bu'i ma go cha/ sa skya pa'i khrims gcod pa rin chen bkra shis/ rin po che'i nye gnas brtson 'grus dpal/ gzhon nu yon tan gyi dpon 'og ma grags pa 'od zer/ sngar ha la has bskos pa'i yul bsrungs go go chu'i bu rdo rje seng ge/ jo bo grags jon rnams 'dzem gyin bya ba sgrubs/ gong du bla ma grags 'od pas(660)bdag mdzad nas/ rin po che gcung rgya la khri dpon gyi 'ja' sa grub nas bla dpon sbrags/ gzhon nu yon tan la rten por 'chos mon mkhar byin/ gcung rgya grong rting/ rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan(561)gyi gcen po rgyal mtshan dpal gyis gong du byon/ lha rje phag mo gru pas zhus nas/lung gis rgyal mtshan dpal bskos/ de'i lag nas khong rang gi nu bo grags bzangs sa skya pa la zhus nas bskos/ de'i lag nas gzhon nu rgyal mtshan gyi bu rgyal mtshan skyabs kyis 'ja' sa blangs/ rin po che grags rgyal pa'i gcung po byang chub rgyal mtshan(662)sa skyar bla ma bdag nyid chen po'i drung du sdad/mnyam med pa la slob gnyer mdzad/ bla chen kun blo(563)bod du byon dus/rgyal mtshan skyabs phab nas khri dpon la bskos/ rting la tsing dbang rgyal po'i(564)'ja' sa thob/ rgyal mtshan skyabs kyi tsha bo bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis lung gis brtsad cing / khyon gyi bsko bzhag dang / mtho dma' mang du byung yang sus kyang ma thub par rgyal khams dbang du bskyar mi 'di yin no//sta lha sa'i thog ma kha rag gi gnyos lo tsā ba yon tan lhags pa rgya gar du byon nas/ slob dpon chen po bha lim ta a tsar la chos don du 'gril ba kha zin che ba gcig zhu byas pas/ gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs(666)kyi skor gnang /

125las kha tshar(566)mang po gcig zhu byas pas/ gshin rje dgra nag(667)gnang / la chung gcig gi tsa na yod pas bka' bsrungs(568)gcig kyang zhu byas pas/ 'jig byed(669)la rtug shad sbrel nas gnang nas/ rgyud skor gsum du grags te/ dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ lo tsā ba'i gcung po gnyos 'byung gnas shes rab kyis(670)'bri mtsho'i mkhan po yang mdzad 'dug bla ma lo tsā ba'i sras po slob dpon rdo rje bla ma/ pha rgyud skor gsum(671)/bde mchog(572)sogs mkhas shing bod kyi mi chen bzhir grags pa'i gcig yin skad/ khong gi sras slob dpon dpal le dang / dpal seng / dpal seng gi sras slob dpon gnyos nag grags pa dpal chos rgyal mya ngan med kyi ska'i skye ba yin par zhang rin po ches lung bstan/ khong gi sras 'gro ba'i mngagon po ras chen gnyos lha nang pa(573)zhes bya ba de/ rgya gar gyi nag po spyod pa chung ba yin par zhang rin po che nas lung bstan 'dug cing / rtsa rir byon dus mkha' 'gro mas lung bstan par bzhed/ sangs rgyas ras chen(574)gyi yab gnyos nag grags pa dpal gyis gson gshed(575)byas pa'i gral dpon la 'bri khung chos rje gdan drangs pas ma byon par/ khong gi zhal tas zhang rin po che gdan drangs/ khong gis rgyad skor gsum la sogs pa yab kyi chos ma lus pa mkhyen cing / thag ma ka che/ dang / thag ma rdor gzhon/ sbal ti jo sras gsum la rab tu byung / bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ 'bri khung du chos rje rin po che'i drung du nā ro ba'i gdams ngag(676)skor rnams gsan cing / sgrab pa la nan tan du mdzad/ rtsa ri dang / te se la byon nas gzigs snang khyardo par can byung / chos rjes tshogs pa skyong(577)ba'i zhal ta mdzad nas gnas gang dgongs su tshogs pa skyong ba thogs re(678)mdzad/ mon gyi dpal gro cal khar tshogs pa thogs re bskyangs/ byang du lha nang btab nas/ lha pa nyis stong

126brgyad brgyar grags pa de dus byung / de nyid la skal ldan gyi slob ma bcu drug dang / bka' babs brgyad du grags pa byung / khong gi dbon po lha rin chen rgyal po de nyid lha sras mu tig btsan po'i skye ba yin skad/ dang por skyor mo lung(579)du rab tu byung nas/ thog mar 'dul ba la blo sbyong mdzad cing mkhas par mkhyen/ pha rgyud skor gsum la sogs pa'i chos skor khu bo la gsan cing ma lus par mkhyen/ sbyal kha sa g.yos kyis 'gyel ba'i tshab tu phag ri rin chen sgang brtsigs shing / khu bo'i gdan sar lha nang du bzhugs pas rgyal khrims 'chal ba'i(680)dmag sna'i gnod pa byung bas skyi smad(681)kyi sa char byon nas/ rab grong brtsigs/ lha nang du khu bo'i slob ma grub thob 'dam seng gdan sa la rdzangs gda'/ gdam pa ri pas nye gnas mdzad nas gye re dgon pa(582)btab cing / gye re lha khang gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/༈de'i dbon po'i brgyud pa ni/ bla ma dar ma rgyal po dang / de'i slob ma dbon po gzi brjod rgyal po/ chos kyi brgyud pa ni/ lha rin chen rgyal po khu dbon gnyis la mkhas pa dge brag pa tshul khrims gzhon nus thug/ de'i slob ma mkhas pa byang dar/ de'i slob ma 'jam dbyangs gzi brjid rgyal po'o/ /nyer lnga pa/ tshal pa bka' brgyud byung tshul/zhang 'gro ba'i mgon po rin po che(583)ni/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud(684)dang / gnyis med rnam rgyal/ sprin chen mo'i mdo(685)la sogs du ma nas lung bstan/ gdul bya'i don du sku 'khrungs pa'i yul skyi shod tsha ba gru

127(386)/ gdung rus sna nam zhang / yab rdo rje sems dpa' dgung snying chu mo yos/ dang po'i mtshan dar ma grags dgung lo bcu nas sam byung lo tsā sogs la sgra tshad sogs mtshan nyid gsan/ stod lung rtsa brgyad kyi rngog ston sogs la sngags kyi dbang dang lung gdams pa thob/ ska gzhon nu la yi dam gzigs/ mthu che bar yang grags/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa༄ gsum la dge bsnyen mdzad/ rtsa drug la mdo khams su mkhan po mkhar 'go pa/ las slob grab mkhar ba/ gsang ston gzu ljang mdo pa sogs la rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ brtson 'grus grags par mtshan gsol/ spyir chos kyi 'brel ba'i bla ma bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi bsten/ khyad par du rtsa ba'i bla ma(687)drug ste/ rtsa mi sangs rgyas grags pa(588)dang / a bha ya ka ri yi slob ma dpal chen rgu los(589)gdams pa bstan/ gling kha ba'i slob ma mal yer pa bas(590)gegs bsal(691)/ ba ri lo tsā'i slob ma byang chub sems dpa' 'ol kha bas kun rdzob byang chub sems(692)la bog ston/ dwags po lha rje'i dbon po dwags po sgom pa(693)las don dam byang chub sems(594)kyi rtogs pa 'khrung / su ra pā la'i slob ma grub thob bai ro tsa na(595)dang / sa skya pa chen po'i(696)slob ma ngam shod gshen pa las lung mtha' dag brnyes pa'o//bla ma de thams cad kyis dbang bkur byin gyis brlabs/ yon tan bum pa gang 'byor thob/ bskyed rim(597)la grub pa thob/ rdzogs rim(598)la dus pa thon/ nges don(599)la nyams rtogs mthar phyin/ rdzu 'phrul dang mngon shes yi dam lha zhal gzigs tshul/ ngo mtshar gyi rnam thar dpag tu med/ jo shag rnam gnyis sogs kyis bstan pa gtad cing / dwags po sgom pa'i gsung la bsten nas/ lha sa rnam gnyis(600)kyi zhabs tog tu/ shing mo lug gi lo la tshal(601)btab/ me mo lug gi lo la gung thang btab/ lha chen dpal

128'bar(602)bzhings/ gnya' dang rgyal khrims(603)mdzad/ gdul bya dpag tu med pa smin grol la bkod/ ska 'bum chen mo(604)bzhengs 'phro la/ dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa gcig(rtson gcig)bzhes pa chu mo glang gi lo gdub bu zla ba'i yar tshes bcu la mya ngan las 'das pa'i rjes su'ang ska'i bkod pa du ma bstan// cubla ma de'i thugs kyi sras po bu slob dpag tu med kyang / bu chen phyogs na bzhugs shing nyid dang mdzad pa mnyam pa ni/ grub thob gling chen ras pa(606)/ 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras(606)grub thob ti shrī ras pa(607)/gu shrī rtogs pa yongs su gsal ba/ mdo ras pa(608)/ zhig po bdud rtsi(609)dran ston mtha' bral/ 'brug gi spa ri ba/ gzhan yang gtsang pa jo btsun/ bla ma bse phrang pa/ khams ston rdo rje blo gros/ sum ston rdo rje snying po/ mal dbu dkar ba/ khams pa mgon ston/ dge bshes dwags po/gzhon ras sogs so//gzhis la bzhugs pa'i bu chen ni chos kyi rgyal tshab(610)/ mnyam med shākya ye shes(611)/ mkhan chen bzod pa/ bu chen bzhi la/ kha rag gi grwa pa rin po che 'dul ba 'od(612)/ dpal ldan lha phyug mkhar pa nyi zla 'od(613)/ lha ri ba chen po nam mkha' 'od(614)/ ro skam pa lo sgom nyi ma shes rab(615)/ rtog ldan bya btang gi rnal 'byor pa la rgyal ba lo zhig mar sgom/ ri sgom/ rtog ldan sbra sgom/ gtsang ston blo ldan/ 'ja' sgom byang chub snying po/ shang pa rol pa'i rdo rje/ byang chub shing gdan 'dren mi bya 'dzin//'phrin las grub pa'i bu chen ni/ chos skyongs kyi sprul pa grub thob chen po dpon dar ma gzhon nu(616)bstan pa'i bdag por bskos/ 'phreng po'i lha

1—29btsun dbung seng / bsam yas kyi btsad po khri rtse/ bzang yul gyi gnas brtan dge sing / gru gu sgang gi gnas brtan seng ge grags/ kha rag gi rgyal tsha rdor dbang / sga 'dra'i gnas brtan grub thob/ sgom pa dkon cog seng gemon mtsho sna'i gnas brtan/ 'brug mdo gnas brtan/ gnas brtan mgon po/ dar bsod/ 'gar rgyal ba 'byung gnas/ phyag khri mchog kun dga' ra ba'i nag mo dbon ston/ gzhung gi dam pa srabs sman/ sge mkhar gyi 'bum yag gung bang gi dkon gnyer hril chung / lha bzo dpon pho rog mar pa lha dkar/ shing mkhan phag lha bzo/ lha nyi ma shes rab/ phyag dpe ba na mo rje btsun/ dkon gnyer hral mo/ sgom pa bzod ldan/ gnas brtan mchog lha la sogs so/ de rnams bu chen gyi gtso bo smos pa tsam yin gyi/ bu slob gdul bya ni dpag tu med do//mnyam med rin po che shākya ye shes ni/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyad nas lung bstan/ yul ya 'brog stag lung(617)gi dgon pa dkar po/ zhugadung rus sgrad/ sngags rnying ma ba'i rgyud/ sangs rgyas nam mkha' zhes pa'i grub thob gcig la rta mgrin gyis lung bstan nas/ shang lha phu'i sngags pa gcig gi bu mo 'od ldan la sras che shos slob dpon jo btsun/ bar pa lcam mo sher 'bum/gsum pa mnyam med rin po che ste yos lo la 'khrungs/ skya ming(618)shākya rdo rje lo dgu nas yab la chos bslab/ lo bcu gcig la zhang gi snyan pa gsan zhing / gcen dang lhan du rong gi mtsho mgor mjal ba'i 'dis nga'i gdan sa 'dzin zhes lung bstan zhing / de nas brtsam te thugs kyi sras su gyur/ yon tan bum pa gang byor thob/ mkhan po myang bran chos ye/ slob dpon 'ben thung pa la rab tu byung / bcu dgu la mkhan po brtsib pa gzhon seng / las slob glang pa jo btsun/ gsang ston gtsang gad stod rnams la bsnyen rdzogs

130mdzad/ gcen slob dpon jo btsun/ rngog mdo sde/ grub thob ngom se po/gang pa gnyan/ slob dpon mgon ston/ shang pa'i khu ston grub sing / gtsang rong gi zha rgya mkhar ba/ shang pa ston chung / pazlo ta lung ti pa/ khro phu'i gtsad tsha rdzong rten/ se 'bru rdo rje grags/ nyang sgom rin she/ grub thob dbu se(619)/ 'bri gung chos rje(620)/ stag lung thang pa(621)/ bla ma gshen pa rnams la gsang sngags kyi dbang lung gdams pa zhus/ dge bshes rgyal padol po bsher bla/ slob dpon ston seng / la stod dkon mchog mkhar/dpal bsam yas pa/ dge bshes ston dar/ dge bshes 'o ma thang pa/ lum chung pa/ gangs pa gnyen/ slob dpon mgo ston/ myang sgom rin she/ rgya ma'i sangs rgyas dbon ston rnams la mtshan nyid dang bka' gdams gsan/ zhang gi drung du/ las kyi slob dpon khrid gnyer(622)/ slob ma skyong ba(623)thams cad kyi ma la mdzad/ dgung lo bzhi bcu pa la gdan sar bskos/ zhang rin po che zhal bzhugs ring mnyes pa gsum gyi zhabs tog mdzad cing / lo drug na zhang mya ngan las 'das/ sku 'dab dang / sku 'bum chen mo'i 'phro gdung khang bkris 'od 'bar/ mgon khang / lha khang gi khyam smad/ thig khang /rgya phub gser 'bru dang bcas pa/ lcags ri nang ma sogs bzhengs/ rgya pho ba lung pa dang / gtsang pa dung khur(624)ba/ gtsang pa blo ldan/ dge bshes mang pa sogs bu chen mang po byung / yi dam zhal gzigs shing mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ bla ma gshegs rting yang lo bco lnga gdan sa bskyangs te/dgung lo drug cu rtsa gcig yos lo rgyal zla ba'i tshes gsum la gshegs/ mnyam med rin po che'i gcung po slob dpon tshul khrims 'od kyi sras rin po che sangs rgyas snying po/ sangs rgyas gzhon nu/ slob dpon shag rin/ grub thob rin grub/ slob dpon bsod nams snying po/ slob dpon shākya 'od de drug go

131slob dpon shag rin byams/ sras rin chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan no/ slob dpon bsod snying gi sras slob dpon sher byang ngo / slob dpon shākya 'od kyi sras rin po che sangs rgyas rin chen/ slom dpon yon rgyal lo/ yang gdung brgyud 'di yi pha spun nye shos slob dpon shes rab ye shes lho brag nas yong nas slob dpon nam mkha' la bsten te bzhags/ de'i sras slob dpon byang yes/ de'i sras slob dpon ye shes sku ma~Xd bzhi/ ye shes sras rin po che shākya 'bum/ de'i gcung dbon she'o/ rin po che sangs rin gyi lcam mo rin chen 'bum gyi sras rin po che byang chub dpal bzang po'o/ 'brug lo la slob dpon byang yes gdan sar bskos nas lo ngo gsum gdan sa mdzad pa'i bslab pa ma thub(626)par/ rta lo la rin po che lha phyug mkhar pa la gdan sa gtad/ khong gis lo lnga bskyangs nas khyi lo gdan sar sang 'bum(626)bskos/ khong gi dus su yang dgon dar cha chen mo byung na'ang / lha phyug mkhar ba'i lo gsum gyi bka' rgya yod pa la lo lnga bzhugs pa'i/ yos lo la gdan sa 'khrugs(627)nas khong bu'i skabs der ti sri ras bas gral dpon mdzad/lo de rang la rin po che nga rsā rgyas snying po(628)bskos/ gdan sa lo bdun mdzad nas gshegs/ khyi lo la rin po che sangs rgyas gzhon nu bskos/ sangs rgyas ras par grags/ nyang stod kyi glang lung dgon pa(629)btab/ gdan sa lo nyi shu rtsa gsum mdzad nas spre'u lo la gshegs/ rin po che kun dga' rgyal mtshan bskos/ lha gdengs btab/ yang dgon ka dgu ma'i steng dang /gser khang steng skor mdzad pas gser khang steng par grags/ gdan sa lo sum cu so gsum mdzad 'brug lo gshegs/ rin po che sang rin bskos par grags/ gdan sa lo bcu mdzad/ glang lo la 'das/ rin po che shākya 'bum bskos/ sprul skur grags/ gdan sa lo dgu mdzad nas khyi lo la gshegs//

132de lo la rang rin po che byang chub dpal bzang por gdan sar mnga' gsol lo// bla ma rin po che 'di yi gdung ni 'bre ste/ 'bre chen po shes rab 'bar(630)dang / gtsang pa 'bre sgar la sogs dge bshes chen po da ma byang ba'i brgyud do// ༄ ༄ ༄yab slob dpon yon tan rgya mtsho sngags rnying ma ba yin/ yum yang dgon pa'i dbon mo rin chen 'bum dgung snying sa pho khyi lo pa/ gzhon nu mtshan shākya mtha' yas/ dgung lo bcu pa la/ mkhan po lha de pa shes rin pa ngang / slob dpon snar thang gi mkhan po grags she ba las dge tshul mdzad/mtshan byang chub dpal bzang por gsol/ mkhan po la thugs bskyed(631)dang blo sbyong(632)sogs lung du ma zhus/ shārkan gyi bla ma grags 'byor pa la dbang dang me lugs(633)/ tshal lugs(634)kyi bshad lugs/ gdams pa thams cad zhus/ dgung lo bcu gsum pa lcags pho khyi lo la chen po dga' bde yab sras(635)kyis dbus su gdan drangs nas/ zla ba lnga pa'i tshes gsum la 'gro mgon rin po che'i gdan sar mnga' gsol/ de'i phyi lo brtag gnyis gsung / dgung lo nyi shu 'gro ba la/ tshogs pa chen po'i mkhan po seng pa/ las slob mkhan po bsod nams dpal ba/ gsang ston bla ma shar rkan pa sogs las bsnyen par rdzogs/ mkhan po la 'dul ba mdo rtsa(636)dang spyod 'jugs(637)gsan/ 'dul skor gyi lung dang phyag len(638)zhus/ bsam sding pa'i bla ma mkhas grub chos rje gzhon nu la gru ma ri gongs pa'i chos skor(639)zhus/ rje btsun ri bo pa rin po che bzang po la rngog pa'i chos skor(640)mtha' dag zhus/ rtog ldan don yes la zhang gi bka' rgya ma sogs zhus/ brtag gnyis me lugs(641)dang zhang 'gro ba'i mgon po rin po che'i bka' 'bum(642)sogs bshad pa dang lung man ngag khrid rim gyi 'gro don

133ma dzad/ yer pa dga' ldan gyi ri khrod(643)btab/ yang chos khri lha khang dang bla bre phyi nang mdzad bka' rgya ma'i lung bstan dang bcas cha mthun par/spyi skungs nas zhang rin po che'i zhabs rjes bsnyed/ de sogs ngo mtshar gyi rnam thar logs su gsal/ /sgom bde'i sprul ska sangs rgyas 'bum ni dgra'i sto srongs su/ gdung rus rje/ yab sto rad rme'i sras su 'khrungs/ mtshan rdo rje 'bum/ dgung lo lnga pa la zhang rin po che'i gra phur byon dus/ yab kyi khrid nas sems bskyed chen mo thob phyir sgrags mdar dbang chen mo thob/ gung thang du slob dpon zhang rin po che'i mkhan po bzod pa gnyis la rab tu byung / sangs rgyas 'bum du btags/ khrid zhus pa'i rtog pa 'khrungs zhes zer ba gda'/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gsum la bsnyen rdzogs kyi mkhan slob sngon ma dang cig pa 'dra sku gzhon dus slob dpon dgon zhe la sogs pa bla ma mang du bsten skad/ phyis dpal lha phyag mkhar pa'i thugs kyi sras su gyur zhing chos mtha' dag gnang / zhabs rtog mdzad/ shing pho khyi lo la tshal ⑫ za da rgan du gdan sar bskos nas lo lnga mdzad/ chu pho stag lo la gung thang du dgon sde btab/ bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas dbu rtser phul/ lha sa'i rag gsos 'bri stag gi 'dum la byon pa sogs phyag rjes du ma mdzad/ de'i zhal slob bla ma ba lam pa/ spyan snga ba phyugs pa'i rtogs ldan 'dag char ba/ jo btsun sras pa/ lha rje dge 'bum lcam sring / grwa pa dge slong / slob dpon ngar phug pa 'bri ra ba/rtogs ldan byang phyi ba/ spos kha ba/ lha spyil pa zhang sgom/ bla ma do pa/stod tshal ci rigs pa dang / sgang rigs pa la sogs bu slob mang po byon/dgung lo bdun cu rtsa lnga la gshegs/ dbon rin po che lo lnga brag du bsgrab pa la byon pa de dus 'khor nas bsgom der bskos te/ gdan sa lo nyi shug rtsa

134bzhi mdzad/ de 'das nas dbon po shākya rgyal mtshan gzhon pa'i sprul ska sang 'bum gyi zhal slob pha rgan sang 'bum gyis gdan sa lo gnyis/ zlo ma rshazhung pas lo gnyis/ bla ma shākya rgyal mtshan pa dgung lo bcu gsum pa la gdan sar bskos nas lo ngo nyi shu rtsa lnga mdzad de rgyal sras par btags/ de rjes dbon rin po che'i lcam mo'i sras bla ma tshul khrims gzhon nus gdan sa lo ngo bzhi bcu mdzad/ drin chen por btags/ rgyal sras pa'i dbon po bla ma shākya yon tan gyis gdan sa lo ngo bcu mdzad/ de'i dbon po bla ma yon tan 'od zer gyis gdan sa lo/ /dpal ldan lha phyug mkhar pa ni/ 'khrungs yul dol gyi zhur na lung gdung rus gzi sngags rnying ma'i brgyad/ yab jo bo sangs rgyas skyabs/ sras lcam sring bzhi yis chung shos skya bojo dus rngog mdo sde/ gan pa dar re/ lo re ras pa rnams bsten/ zhang rin po che dang mjal nas lo gsum la khong rang la las slob zhus/ sha mi 'dul 'dzin la mkhan slob zhus nas lha sar bsnyen par rdzogs/ nyi zla 'od du mtshan gsol/ zhang lo nyi shu rtsa gcig bsten/chos ma lus pa thob/ byin brlab zhugs nas rtogs pa 'khrungs/ ba lam mtha' brag na bzhugs yod pa phrad tsam gyis gdan drangs nas/ lug lo la 'ju phu btab/ der lo gsum bzhugs nas mtha' brag tu byon/ glang lo la lha phyug btab nas bco brgyad song ba'i dus su/ rta lo la yang dgon gyi gdan sa slob dpon byang mas gtad nas lha phyug dang sbrel ba lo lnga tsam mdzad/ khyi lo la kho rang gi nye gnas sangs rgyas 'bum yang dgon du bskos/ phag lo la dgung lo bdun cu rtsa gcig pa la lha phyug tu gshegs so/ /lha phyug mkhar pa'i zhal slob/ ci smras nyan pa'i bsam tan shes rab yod ces pa ni bla ma spyan snga ba yin/ mkhas pa gzhag gzu ston nam yod ces

136pa rin po che ston nam mo/ kun tshang rnal 'byor ye shes yod ces pa ni bla ma ba lam pa yin/ mngon shes can gyi sher byang yod ces pa ni rtogs ldan brag po che pa la zer/ rtogs ldan zhig po ston bde yod ces pa ni ru thog pa yin te/ dbu stod du ru thog bskor ba rnams dang za lung ba sogs de las 'phel/rta sga ba snang sgom zhig po nas stod tshal thams cad 'phel ba dang / rin po che sang 'bum yang dgon gyi gdan sa mdzad cing sgom sde btab pa sogs byung ngo / lha phyug mkhar pa zhi bar gshegs nas/ bla ma spyan snga bas gdan sa lo bdun mdzad/ rin po che ston nam gyis lo gsum/ de nas lo sbrel du gdan sa stong pa'i skabs su/ bla ma ba lam pa'i mi nyag yul 'khor nas gdan sa mdzad/ de nas sangs rgyas jo sras kyis gdan sa mdzad/ de nas sangs rgyas ston pas gdan sa mdzad/ de nas bla ma za lung pa bsod nams dbang phyugade nas za lung pa bla ma mjos pa bzang po/ de nas ru thog pa shākya rgyal mtshan/ de nas bla ma 'ju phu ba shes rab 'phel te/ gdung brgyud min te gang bzang gi brgyud pa'o/ /lha ri pa chen po 'khrungs yul grwa yi mdzad/ yab gru gu tsa la/ yum thang gro ma/ zhang rin po ches btags pa'i mtshan nam mkha' 'od/ bsnyen ming sangs rgyas ras chen kyang zer/ de'i slob ma sangs rgyas lha dges gdan sa mdzad/ de'i dbon po dpon rin po che/ de'i gdan sar stod lung spang 'dab pas nyis 'dzin byas/ de'i gdan sar khya dkar mo pa'i chos kyi mgon po/ de lha ri ba'i phud nas dol yal mo ba bla ma rdo rje mgon po de'i gdan sar stod lung pa bsod nams mgon po'i sras/ bla ma nam mkha' rgyal mtshan da lta bzhugs shing / bla ma rdo rje mgon gyi dbon pos byas par 'dug /ro skam chen po ni glags kyi phur lung myang khang ni gdung rus lo mi/

136phyug po bkris seng ge'i sras gnyis kyi chung ba/ dgung lo bcu gsum la mkhan po lcags phu ba dang slob dpon mkhar la rab tu byung mtshan la nyi ma shes rab bo/ zhang rin po che'i grwa'i 'gyer du dmag la byon pa dang ngar phug tu phyag phyi la phyin/ tshal du mkhan po sha mi 'dul 'dzin/ slob dpon zhang rin po che/ mkhan po bzod pa sogs kyi spyan sngar bsnyen par rdzogs/ dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu bar du zhang rin po che bsten/ yon tan bum pa gang byor thob/zhang mda' khar lo sgom rang pha yul du sgoms gsungs pas/ ro skam du 'jag spyil mdzad nas sgom/ de nas 'bri khung chos rje dang mjal/ chos thob smom zhwa(644)g.yogs/ tshogs dung gnang / ro skam du tshogs pa lnga brgya 'du ba'i dgon pa thob gsungs/ yos lo la ro skam btab/ gdan sa tshal gung thang du zhabs tog chen po mdzad/ lo nyi shu rtsa lnga tshogs pa skyongs nas dgung lo bdun cu pa sa 'brug lo 'das//de'i gcen po yon bdag 'bum mo'i sras rin po che sang rdor ni/ khu bo dang / 'bri khung chos rje/ spyan snga rin po che rnams kyi slob ma yin/ 'brug lo la dpon sangs rgyas kyis ro skam gyi skam du bskos nas/ khyi lo'i bar lo nyi shu gdan sa byas/ dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa brgyad la 'das//de'i lcam mo skyid 'bum dang / glags phu'i sho mi dgos pa 'bum gnyis kyi sras bla ma gzhon nu rin chen tshe dpag tu med pa grags pa khu bo dang /spyan snga rin po che la chos thob/ khyi lo la dpon rin rgyal gyis ro skam du bskos/ rta lo'i bar lo sum cu so gsum gdan sa mdzad nas/ drug cu rtsa bdun la 'das//de'i pha spun rgyal tsha rin po che 'bum gyi bu bdun gyi che ba rin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs par grags/ lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis rta lo la dpon dga' bdes

137gdan sar bskos/ phyi lo khu bo'i rten gyi rab gnas la/ yang dgon nas rin po che sang rin pa gdan drangs nas bsnyen rdzogs zhus/ yos lo'i bar du lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis gdan sa byas nas bzhi bcu zhe bzhi la 'das so//de'i gcung po lnga tshig bla ma yon tan rin chen bsnyen rdzogs tshogs chen pa'i mkhan po bsod nams dpal la zhus/ gcen po dang / bla ma rngog pa rin chen bzang po/ dga' ldan bla ma kun bsod/ yang dgon pa rin po che byang chub dpal bzang po rnacha/sa la/ 'bri rngog sa tshal gyi chos thob/ yos lo la dpon chen po smon lam(645)pas gdan sa bskos/ rta lo yi bar lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad gdan sa mdzad nas gtad/ 'di gcen po'i bu'i bu nam mkha' seng ge dpal ldan bla ma dge sbyong chen po pa/ blon po grags pa bshes gnyen pa/ ro skam gyi mkhan slob gnyis sogs la chos thob/ lo bcu dgu pa rta lo la/dpo kun dga' rdo rje'i bsko bzhag mdzad//kha rag pa chen po ni 'khrung yul grwa yi kyi pa sa/ gdung rus kyi/sngags rnying ma'i rgyad rnying ma'i chos skor yang mang du mkhyen zhing / mched ya gcig yod pa mersha bsad pas skyo ba skyes nas/ bya lo la 'gro ba'i mgon po zhang rin po che'i spyan sngar tshal dgon khru mor byon/ chos skor nams zhus shing yung bu gad par 'dag char lo gsum byas(646)gdams ngag rnams rdzogs par thob/ ri'u chung gi rtser slob dpon zhang rin po che dang / mkhan po 'ban thang pa/ dad pa'i dge 'dun(647)bcu gsum gyi sar rab tu byung nas mtshan dge slong dngos grub bla mar btags/ phyis zhang rin po che nyid kyis 'dul ba 'od du btags shing / rtogs ldan nyag po seng ge yang grags/khong gi gcung po bsod nams bla ma dang / bzo ldan bla ma gnyis kyis zhang gi dpe gnyer dang / nang gi nye gnas byas/ kho rang gi rten skya bo'i dus kyi sras

138slob dpon jo sras grongs nas glo bur lhor rten gtso chen mo bzhengs/ glang lo la zhang rin po che'i lung bstan gyis kha rag gi ri dgon btab/ rting la dro bo rir rtogs pa 'khrung nas kho rang gi dbon po seng ge brtson 'grus zhang rin po che'i drung du rab tu byung zhing 'bul ba chen po bskyal ba'i dus na lta sgom spyod gsum kha rag gi nyag po seng gis khyer te gangs dkar stong su bros zer ba'i brdungs mdzad/ bar skabs su gung thang gi sto sgo dang / lcags ri sto phyogs btang / sku 'bum chen mo bar rim gsum gyi sding yan chad tshar bar bzhengs grogs mdzad/ zhang rin po che dang mtha' bzhi dol du 'khrug pa chen po byas pa'i dus su/ kha rag nyag pos 'khrug pa la byon zhing bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs par byas/ kha rag du ri khrod btab shar du bkris kun dga'/nub tu gsal steng / rig pa/ phu stod do bo ri/ byang kha lung rnams btab/kha rag nyag po des bkra shis kun dgar bzhugs dus bde mchog drug cu rtsa gnyis gzigs/ sog po dgon par bzhugs dus/ khong rang gi slob ma rnal 'byor ye shes kyis spyan gsum 'dug pa mthong / do bor rir bzhugs dus thog bab byung ba chos gos kyi mthu bar bcug nas brag khar skur/ nags la me chen po mched pa sdig mdzub mdzad pas rang bzhin gyis zhi/ kha rag tu char pa 'beb dus zhang rin po che la gsol ba btab pas/ zhang rin po che yang dgon ka dgu mar mthong kha la bskor ba mdzad gin kha rag nyag po'i char pa 'bebs grogs byed dgos gsungs pas/ kha rag tu char chen po babs gda'/cha'o lung du zhang rin po che la dbang zhus dus/ bde mchog gi gtso bo de zhang rin po ches dngos su gzigs 'dug kha rag pa sku gshegs dus thugs kyi dpal be'u dang / chos gos ma tshig par byon 'dug skre khyams stod kyi phyag stong spyan stong gi nang na bzhugs/ ljags ma tshig par phags kyi sgra dang bcas pa

139rna la 'byor jo yes kyi pang du byon pa kha rag gi ska 'bum nang na bzhugs/ ring bsrel las grub pa'i rgyal mtshan gcig dang / nacang gi yi dam lhan cig skyes pa cig byon pa kha rag gi gdan sa bla ma sgang kha ba'i phyag na bzhugs/ khong sku gshegs nas kho rang gi nang rten gser sku ni da lta kha rag na bzhugs/ kha rag nyag po'i spur sbyongs byed dus gnam la nyi ma gsum shar gshegs pa'i dus nas kho bo zhang rin po che'i thugs khar 'pho ba yin gsung zer/ grwa pa nyag po sku gshegs rting kha rag dpon pos thugs rje chen po'i bcu gcig zhal bal po padmas bzhengs su bcug nas khyams stod du gdan drang ste rab gnas zhus rtsa na lha sa gung thang gnyis 'ja' tshon gyis 'brel ba byung 'dug gung thang du sde 'khrugs byung dus/ chos skyong gi lung bstan byung nas sde 'khrugs zhi bar byas/sgom bde yul bud nas/ grib mda' gnas gsar dang / lha sa rtse mor bros dgos byung dus/ sgom sde nub gling kha rag pa'i sgom bde ba la phul/ dbang gdams pa zhus/ kha rag dbon pos dgon btab pa la/ bon 'brug 'ol/brag tshe/ do lung phu stod/ spong po mkhar/ dbyang / spang po mkhar/ gong bu/ gam po dgon pa rnams btab/ gdan sa rirā pa ni/ kha rag nyag po'i rting la/ dpon po seng ge brtson 'grus/ chos rje rgyal gzhon/ mkhas pa grags rgyal/ bla ma sgang kha ba blo gros bzang po/ dbu rtse ba grags pa rdo rje/'jam dbyangs shes rab bzang po/ dge bshes kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'od zer lha tho ba/ skabs der mkhan brgyud bla ma dbon ston pas gdan sa bskyangs/de nas bla ma gzhon nu rgyal mtshan//lha phyug pa'i slob ma ru thog pa chen po ni/ 'khrungs yul grwa zur phu gdung mdzo ro/ ska tshe stod la gra'i lde'u sgang du sna ro chos kyi slob mar gda'/sku tshe'i sgang la lha theg pa bsten/ phyag rgya chen pos sgom khrid zhus/ rtog pa

140shin tu mtho skad/ mal gro ru thog dang / sgang bu dgon pa btab/ lhan lung yang phyag tu byung / khong la slob ma rtogs ldan gsum/ rtag chen du rtogs ldan tshal pa/ za lung da rtogs ldan mdzes pa/ rta lha ru rtogs ldan dar bsod do// curtogs ldan tshal pa ba lam ri khyi dba'i bon brgyad yin/ grwa byi rtag can dgon pa btab/ ru thog pa'i dbon po bsod namadro gzhon nu/ de la dbon po lha phyug pa dang / slob ma grub thob/ bla ma seng ge la sogs byon//rtogs ldan mdzes pa'i 'khrungs yul mnga' ris ma pham g.yu mtsho'i 'gram za 'og gle g.yang chung kha rur/ mal dgos pa mgon gyi bu 'bring po g.yu rung byin brlabs kyi sras su 'khrungs/ khyi ra ras pa'i skye bar grags shing la stod rta sgar mkhan po sprug gcer ba la sogs la bsnyen par rdzogs nas mdzes pa snying por btags/ des rta sga ba'i 'bul ba skyel ba'i zla la/glo 'bur shar gyi gañdzir(648)de 'khur nas dbus su chos 'tshol du 'ong /mal gro sgang bu dgon gsar du rtogs ldan ru thog pa la phyag tu chen mo zhus nas bsgrub pa lo gsum byas pas/ nub cig gi rmi lam na/ bud med sma ra khyu ge ba cig byung nas/ zhang rin po che la gsol ba thob/ spyil skung su bsgrub pa gyis zer ba rmis/ glo 'bur nub tu sku 'dra la maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba btab pa'i sngar gyi nyams de kun las lhag pas nyams skyes/ de nas byang gi phyi 'brong bu spyil khung du ri mi 'babs par(649)lo bcu gsum byas/ shing mo phag lo la za lung btab/ slob ma rtogs ldan grwa pa mang du byung / lo sum cur tshogs pa bskyangs bdun cu don dgu 'brug gi lo la gshegs so/ slob ma rtogs ldan nam mkha' dbang phyug gis g.yul gangs ra btab/ rtogs ldan nam mkha' seng ge kong por sna phu gangs ra btab pas/ gangs ra ba gsum zer/

gzhanaya nga rtobatagaldan dar ma dang / sangs rgyasalasogasapabacu gsum1spras rkang por dgon pa bcu gsum btab/ rtog ldan ge 'tsho bas stod lung ko ba brag btab/ chos gos nyi zer la bkal/ rtogs ldan tsa ri bas lhan grub sdings btab/ rtogs ldan nyi zla la sogs pa lngas g.yor phyogs su gadros khrod la sogs rnams btab bo//rtogs ldan mdzes pa'i nu bo g.yu rung byin rlab brtan gyi bu gnyis las stod nas spyan drangs pa'i gcen po de/ rtogs ldan pa dang mkhan po shākya bkras ba la rab tu byung / bsod nams dbang phyug tu btags/ 'brug lo la za lung gi gdan sar byon te/ lo bcu bzhir za lung gi gdan sa byas/ de nas lha phyug gi gdan sa byas/ de'i gcung po mtshan gzhon rdor sbrul lo la gdan sar byon lo bcu dgu tshogs pa bskyangs/ yos lo pa lnga bcu nga brgyad/phag lo la 'das so//de'i lcam mo sangs rgyas skyid kyi bu slob dpon rnam rgyal mdzes kyis phag lo nas glang lo'i bar gdan sa lo bco lnga bas/ sbral lo pa bzhi bcu zhe bzhi glang lo la 'das/ de'i gcung po slob dpon sgozhon nu mdzes glang lo nas gdan sar byon no//ru thog pa/ rta sga'i snang sgom ras pa zhes grags pa des/ dpal lha phyug pa'i drung du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung mtshan yang sangs rgyas 'od ces btags/ khrid bsgrab skor gdams pa thams cad tshar bar mdzad nas/ byang mkhar/ spyil skudros mtha' brag rnams su bsgrab pa mthar phyin pa mdzad dpal gdan sa pa'i drung du khrid bsgrab skor gyi zhun ther bcad nas gdul bya'i 'phen pa la brten nas ti se darā rdzong drug la bsgrab pa la byon/brag skya rdo rje rdzong du thugs dam gyi rtsal sbyangs/ rta sga'i rshagon pa btab nas

142sku nub ris la gdul bya'i mthil mdzad/ grwa pa yang mang du 'dus pa'i dus su/rin po che gdan sa yi drung du/ nged kyi dgon chung gcig btab yod pa'i nged kyi tsha bo jo sras kyi mgo byas btsun pa gsum bzhi pa cig rdzong pa zhu zer ba'i zhu ba byang ba'i jo sras dang / tshang 'dur ba chen po/ bsam gtan rdzong pa/rtogs dosdon dar bsod rnams brdzongs ya gir sleb nas zla ba gnyis lon pa dang / jo sras grongs/ khong rang bgres nas/ rtogs ldan dar bsod la khyod kyis dgon pa 'dir sdod dang / sems can la phan thoṭa par yong gis gsungs nas/ khong gis gdan sar bzhugs nas nub ris dang / men zhang spu rang dol po/ glo bo rnams su 'gro don 'phrin las rgyas/ rta sga'i dgon pa yang dar/ khong sku gshegs pa'i rjes la/ bla ma gzhon nu ba'i 'dab dang phyi rten nang rten rnams legs par bsgrubs shing sngar gyi bu slob tsho dang / go la kun rdzob rnams su byon nas 'gro don skyongs/ gdan sa'ang dar rgyas mdzad/ bla ma gcung po bas khong gshegs pa'i rjes kyi 'dab dang phyi rten nang rten bzhengs pa dang / sngar gyi bu slob yon bdag rnams kyis bskyangs bran mdzad/ khong gshegs pa'i rjes la slob dpon sangs rgyas bla mas gdan sa mdzad nas/'dab dang phyi rten nang rten dang / grwa pa bu slob rnams bskyangs/ gdan sa yang dar rgyas su mdzad/ khong gshegs pa'i rjes la bla ma shes rab bla mas 'dab dang phyi rten nang rten grwa pa bu slob rnams bskyangs/ gshegs rjes grwa pa bu slob rnams kyis 'dab dang phyi rten nang rten bzhengs/ gdan sar bla ma dkon mchog gzhon nus bskyangs/ bla ma bzang za ra rtsegs thams cad kyis 'gro mgon rin po che'i 'phrin las la tshal gung thang / lha phyug mkhar rnams su gsungs rab dang / gañdzir/ nor zang zing 'bul ba mang po skyal gda'/tshang 'dur ba chen po de yab kyis dpal ldan pa'i drung du spang thog cig phul

143'dug cher song ba dang / bla ma ba lam pa'i drung du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung / mtshan yang tshul khrims seng ge zhes bya bar btags/ khrid sgrub skor gdams pa thams cad kyis rgyud smin par mdzad cing / de nas rin po che gdan sa pa'i drung du byon nas gzim g.yog mdzad gin khrid sgrab skor gdams pa thams cad gnang nas/ rta sgar byon nas sangs rgyas 〉la pa dang / mkhan po sprug gcer ba gnyis las dge slong mdzad/ rdzong drug dang spang rgyan gangs kyi ra ba dang / dbang po'i brag rnams su bsgrab pa mthar phyin pa mdzad cing / snang sgom ras pas gdung khang mtho brgyad rmo cig tshong 'dus 'gur mor(660)bzhengs/ phyi rten ska 'bum bzhengs nas thugs dam gyi rtsal dben gnas brag dkar la sbyong gin ba gas dus/ khal glang mi/ g.yog mgon po/ ston pa be chung / khong yon bdag gsum gyis tshang 'dur gyi lung pa de phul/ dgon pa btab/ dgon pa'i ming yang lha sdings su btags nas/spyan ras gzigs dngos yin pa'i lung bstan la brten nas snang sgom zhig po zhes par grags/ sto nub gung gsum/ jo bo sku rgyal gyi sa cha yan chad gdul bya'i mthil du gyur/ 'gro don dang 'phrin las dpag tu med pa la brten nas/kyi rong du jo bo'i drung du byon dus btsun pa rnams wa 'di yi 'gram la gro 'debs/ ngan long snying rje ba/ zar med gos med rnams la snying rje skyes nas jo bo pa'i dpon rgyud la/ nga jo bo pa'i drung 'dir tshug na thug tshul cig 'dzugs/ ma tshug na phye khal bcu drug yod pa 'dis dzam drug cig gi thug pa(651)cig btang ba'i khyed kyi sa cha cig g.yar btang bar zhu zhus pas/khong gi thug tshul gyi sa cha rnams phul nas/ dus de nas bzung ji srid 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du thug tshul(652)dang / ma ṇi'i rgyan(663)tshugs/ jo bo'i dkon gnyer la btsun pa re re bzhag de na / byamarā sprin rlung gi kha gnon

144(664)du byon nas/ byams sprin gnyer ba'i gzhig phul nas/ maṇi'i thun btsugs/ de nas yang / spang zhing bcu dpon gyi 'go byas pa'i spang zhing pa rnams dang / yon bdag sgar pa rnams kyis zhog phug gi dgon sa gzhis phul nas dgon pa btab/ 'jam dpal dang ma ṇi'i thun(655)btsugs/ bal sding gi bla ma rgyal ba shes rab kyis chos kyang mang du zhus/ khong rang gi lto skal gyis sgang du ma ṇi'i thun btsugs/ lar na yon bdag rgun pa shag mun rnams kyis dgos gzhis/ lung pa rtsa shing rnams phul/ dgon pa dmun pa/yon bdag cig gi ma ṇi'i thun btsugs/ gsang ma nas gzhis phul nas dgon par ma ṇi'i thun btsugs/ sngags sding nas yon bdag gcig gis gzhis phul nas ma ṇi'i thun btsugs/ dgun bzhug gi ring la thug tshul nar mar btsugs/dgun bzhug thon pa'i rjes la grwa pa thams cad kun mchod du 'dus nas/ rgyal 'bring rnam gsum(656)/ skyabs 'gro sems skyes(657)/ yi ge brgya pa(658)/ 'jam dpal/ rnam 'joms/ sgrol ma/ ma ṇi'i mthun(659)kha mang po btsugs nas zhag nyi shu tsam re thun mo che(660)byed/ rgyun mdar ka ṇi'i mchod rten(661)chen po bzhengs/ gung thang du yon bdag rin chen mgon gyis gdan drangs nas/ srad thang gi gtsug lag khang phul/ gzhis kyi ma ṇi'i thun btsug snyams yon bdag bsam grub kyis gdan drangs/ brag shug gseb phul nas dgon pa btab ma ṇi'i thun btsugs/ gtsang du yon bdag blo gros kyis gdan drangs nas sbo khung gi gzhis phul/ ma ṇi'i thun btsugs/ phyi yul du mang dkar ba rnams kyis gdan drangs nas yon bdag gis mthil byas/khyu ri dgon pa btab/ ma ṇi'i mthun btsugs rta sgar tshes bcu bla brang brtsig sangs rgyas tshal pa'i mchod pa zla ba byung ngo cog dang / tshes bcu nar mar btsugs/ rta sga'i kun mchod ka ba bzhi rtsigs/ dkar phig(662)phub/

145rta sga bla yer chos khri brtsigs/ sku 'dra bzhengs/ zhabs tog dpag tu med pa byas/ sprug cer du mkhan po'i phyi rten ma grub par 'dug pa'i phyi rten gyi 'bum pa bzhengs nas phul/ dros pa'i yon bdag rnams kyis gdan drangs nas byang chub gling gi dgon pa btab/ chos khri thang la chos gsungs/ yon bdag rnams kyis dgon gzhis phul nas 'jam dpal dang ma ṇi'i thun btsugs/ yon mchod rnams kyi tsha tsha(663)nyi ma lnga re 'debs pa'i dge srol btsugs/ sku thang du yon bdag rgyal gyis gdan drangs nas sprog tu dgon pa btab/ ma ṇi'i rgyan btsugs sa ga la ka ṇi chen po bzhengs/ sum rje rtsom gling du ban nag lhas gdan drangs nas dpag rkyen gyis dgon gzhis phul/ dgon pa btab/ma ṇi'i rgyan btsugs/ dgon pa dang brag dkar rta so dbu rṣa/ rdzong / sman khang / ༄go bo tsha rnams su bsgrub pa mdzad cing / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam thar gyis sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa mdzad/ dgung lo bdun cu'i steng du ska gshegs/ bur sbyang dus phyag gi rkang nang du lhan skyes phyi la spyan ras gzirshas/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi sku zhun zhu las grub pa sor phyed dang do pa gcig rtsig ma sor gcig gi steng na khong rang gi sku 'dra zhun thig las grub pa dbu so rtsig gi ba gcig thams cad la rgyan dang ring bsrel kha dog sna tshogs pa dang / gzhan yang dung g.yas su 'khyil ba dang / chos skyong gi sku la sogs pa gdung ring bsrel dpag tu med pa rnams phyi rten nang gi thugs khar bzhugs nas/ gser ska'i drung du mi ma yin gyis mar me phul ba'i mar me mtshan thub rnams nyin zhag carshasum gsum 'bar de nya stong brgyad gsum dang / khong gshegs dus kyi chos nyi shu byung res la 'bar/ bla ma dpon gyi 'dab phyi rten dang nang rten bzhengs pa dang / mchod pa 'dzugs pa grwa pa bu slob rnams kyi skyong bran mdzad/ dge legs rnams mdzad/ rtogs ldan brag dkar ba rin

116seng gis gyis can gyi dgon pa btab/ 'gro mgon gyi sku 'dra bzhengs nas de'i thugs kur ye shes mgon po'i ska bzhugs bla ma rin po che'i mchod pa bzungs/ rab gnas zhus nas dgyen pa'i ming yang phyes can du btags/ de nas thugs dam dang 'gro don dpag tu med pa mdzad nas sku gshegs/ lha sku ring bsrel dang / sku chos kyi pur gtums pas ma tshig par byon pa la sogs pa'i rtags ya mtshan can mang po byon 'dug grwa pa bu slob rnams kyi 'dab dang phyi rten nang rten bzhengs/ cha/chod pa btsugs/ bla ma bsod nams dang bar gdan drangs nas/ khong gi dgon pa dang grwa pa bu slob kyis bskyangs bran/dge las kyi srol thams cad ma chag par bskyangs/ khong sku gshegs te pur sbyangs grwa pa bu slob rnams kyis 'dab dang phyi rten bzhengs pa mchod pa 'dzugs pa byas/ de nas bla ma bsod nams shes rab kyi gdan sa bzung nas dgon pa dang grwa pa bu slob rnams kyi skyong bran dge legs byas/ khong sku gshegs nas grwa pa bu slob rnams kyis 'dab dang phyi rten nang rten bzhengs/ mchod pa btsugs/ bla ma zang za ra brtsegs rnams kyis tshal gung thang gi gtsug lag khang dang / sgom sde lha phyug rnams su gsung rab rin po che/ gser gduṭa/gasnar/ gur mo che la sogs pa'i zang zing 'bul ba bsam gyis mi khyab/mnga' bdag pa rnams yum rje blon dang bcas pa rnams dang sde pa chen po zur bzang gi dpon brgyud rnams kyis dge legs thams cad kyi zhabs tog bskyangs bran du 'gro ba mdzad nas thugs la btags(664)/ rin po che gdan sa ba'i slob ma jo btsun spras pas stod phyogs la byon/ dpal ba me rtse'i dgon pa btab/ blo smad gtad bla shod kyi dgon pa btab nas dbu ma'i bshad sgra btsugs/ sgom bsgrab kyis rgyud smin par mdzad nas bal yul(666)du byon/bal por 'gro don sman po byung nas 'phags pa shing kun(666)gyi srog shing tsho
