147'phags pa klu sgrab kyi btsugs pa'i srog shing brje ba la sing ga nags na srog shing gsum yong pas gcig breg pa'i shing kun gyi srog shing brjes/ gdags bkal/ sku dkar gsol/ rdo ring btsurshas/ 'gro don dang 'phrin༄ las dpag tu med pa grub 'dug bal po'i rgyal po dang / 'ba' ro rnams kyis bkra shis sgo mang phul/ ras la sogs pa'i 'bul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa nas yar byon pas ra sha ma se ru ska gshegs/ tshong 'dus pa'i bla ma dpon gyis bur sbyangs/ pur sbyangs sa pachod rten bzhengs/ dbu rtse chen mo 'jam dbyangs kyi gser sku phul/ sgom sder bkra shis sgo mang phul nas/be tse dang khyung rten gnyis ka nas sgom sder phul ba na rim bzhin bskyal/ zhang nyag 'bri ra ba'i slob mas zhol phug gi dgon pa btab/ 'or ma ron gung thang rnams yon bdag tu gyur nas gdul bya dang 'phrin las rgya che byung zhing / skyid rong du 'jam dpal gling / rin chen spungs pa dang gnyis kyi dgon pa btab nas 'or ma'i sa 'gag la ka ṇi'i mchod rten bzhengs/ tshal gung thang / sgom sde 'bri ra rnams su bla ma na rim gsum tsam du zang zing gi 'bul ba skyal nas zhabs tog cher byas gda'/ bsam gtan rdzong pa chen po'i glo 'or/ bsam gtan rdzong gi dgon pa de btab nas bshad nyan dang sgom bsgrab kyi gdul bya bskyangs/ lha phyug sgom sde gnyis su 'bul ba rim bzhin ba la gda'/ gdan sa'i zhen pa mos gus chen po'i 'gro don dang 'phrin las mdzad 'dug rin po che'i slob ma rtog ldan g.yung sa ba'i mi la'i rdzong drug dang ti se la byon/ mi la rdo rje phug bzhugs nas thams cad kyi rtsal sbyangs/ 'gro don dang phyis dpag tu med pa byung nas/ spu rang rgyal po'i(667)thad sor bzhugs nas/ rgyal po yab yum gyi nang gi bla mchod(668)mdzad/ dad gus dpag tu med pa la brten nas sgom sder yang gser gyi 'bul ba skyel 'dug rgyal po yab yum

140pa dar rgyas su mdzad cing / rta sgar yang gsung rab kyi mgo byas nor zang zing gi 'bul ba bskyal/ tshal gung dang lha phyag tu'ang gsung rab dang / nor zang zing gi 'bul ba yang bskyal nas/ rnyed tshal zhes su grags nas zhen pa dang mos gus dpag tu med pa yod lags//ha lan deb gter 'di/ gzhon nu blo gsal ba rnams kyis bltas na gtam 'od mang du shes pas mkhas par 'gyar/ sngon ye'u ti zer ba'i rgyal po'i dus su/ rgyal khams kyi ming thang zer༄ bar 'dug /thang zer ba'i don/rgyal khams dga' ba dang bskyed pa zer ba yin/ de'i rting g.yu dbang rgyal po'i das/ rgyal khams kyi ming ho'i zer/ de'i don rgyal khams klong nus pa'i yon rton chen po zer bar 'dag thang dbang rgyal po'i das/ rgyal khams kyi ming yin zer bar 'dag ༄ de'i don bya ba gang dang rshang gi dkyil drang po zer/ de'i rting rgyal (bas kha yar gyi ming ma btags/ jing gi rgyal pos rgyal khams kyi ming ta'i dben zer bar btags/ de'i don ci yin na/ ji bu yi zer ba'i yi ge nang na yod pa/ khen dben zer ba'i yig 'brus/ yangs pa dang chen po rgyas pa 'di yin par song na/ bden pa brtan pa'i gdan sa yin zer bar 'dug /nyer drug pa/ yon rgyal rabs kyi gong ma yol ja thu'i dus bod kyi grwa pa rnams la sprad pa'i bande shed skyed kyi 'ja' sa/sol ja thu rgyal po'i dus/ lha tshe rings gnam gyi she mong las bsod

150nams chen po'i dpar la bsten nas/ rgyal po nged kyi lung / byung shu zhing gi mi dpon(670)rnams la/ chu mi dben gyi mi dpon(671)/ g.yu shri tha'i mi dpon(672)la/ gying dzu shri zhing / gying g.yu'i shri tha'i mi dpon/ gle stong si'i mi dpon mkhar dpon dang yul bsrungs rnams la/ dmag dpon/dmag mi rnams la/ tshan pa tshan pa'i rgan pa rnams la/ mi sde mang po la go bar byed pa'i lung / jing gis rgyal po dang / o go ta rgyal pos/ shākya mu rna'i chos lugs bzhin du/ bsne(673)ji 'dra yin kyang / khrul dmag las gsum(674)ma len du chug gnam mchod cing smon lam 'debs pa'i don la nged kyis bdag byed pa yin byas 'dug se chen rgyal pos dkon mchog gsum(676)la mos gus byas pa'i don la/ sangs rgyas shākya mu de'i chos 'jig rten du kun gyi thog tu 'grim du bcug 'dug pa bzhin/ nged la smon lam 'debs pa dang cho ga byed du chug bzlas pa yin na'ang(676)/ zur du mkhar mig la bskos pa'i mi dpon dang mi sde rnams kyis ma go ba'i don la/ lha khang / dgon sde la she mong btsongs pa(677)dang / bande la she mong btsong pa yod de yong / da yin na/ mi sde shes pa'i mi dpon(678)dang /mi sde mang pos/ da phyin chad/ shākya mu de'i chos kyi lugs bzhin 'grim du chug bande la she mong ma btsong du chug lha khang dang dgon sde la she mong ma btsong bar zhabs tog byed du chug bod kyi bande rnams la zhabs tog byed pa'i don la/ se chen rgyal po'i dus su/ nyes pa sdod pa'i mkhar la yod pa'i ma ming zer ba gcig gis dge slong gcig gi gong rtsa nas bzung ba'i don la/mi de nyes pa las btugs pa yin/ da phyin chad bod kyi bsna rnams la mi skyas lag gi slebs na(679)lag pa bregs/ khas slebs na lce thon/ 'ja' sa 'di ltar sgrags phyin chad/ bande la bskur cha mi byed pa dang / lha khang

du dang dgon pa la she mong 'tshong ba'i mi de phyogs phyogs su bskos pa'i mi dpon(680)dang / bande rgan pas(681)zung la/ nged can khyer shog(682)ji ltar byed nged kyis go bar byed pa yin/ nged kyi 'ja' sa 'di bya lo dpyid zla tha chungs kyi nyer brgyad la shang to na yod dus bris/ gri dben lo nyi shu rtsa gsum la(683)/ rgya gar rgya nag kha che la sogs dang / bal bod la sogs mang po'i phyogs rnams su/ /mkhas grub bla ma rnams kyi byon tshul dang / /mi yi dbang po rgyal blon chen po rnams/ /ska tshe'i tshad dang mdzad pa rnam thar 'di/ /dkar chag 'dir ni gsal bar bsnad pa bzhin/ /'jig rten bya ba 'di la ma rmongs shing / /mang po'i dbus su mi 'jigs spobs pa yis/ /smra ba'i skyes bu nyid du 'gyur bar shog /'di la 'khrul dang nongs pa'i tshogs mchis na/ /shes ldan skye bo rnams kyis bzod par mdzod/ /tshe 'di yun thung shes bya'i rnam pa mang / /tshe yi tshad kyang ji tsam mi shes pas/ /ngang pas mtsho la 'o ma len pa ltar/ /rang gi 'dod pa dang du blang bar rigs/ /phyoṭa dang dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du bkra shis dang bde legs kyis khyab par gyur ci ka /

153la drug cha'i khrul zer ba khrul gyi dang po yin cing / de nas zhing dpon la yang bran g.yog byung nas dpon dang g.yog gi khyad par byung thog rim bzhin 'bangs dang / dmag dpung / sa cha bcas yod pa'i rgyal po byang / rgyal po'i dang po ni 'khor los brgyar ba'i rgyal po yin/ de la rshasod nams che chung gi dbang gis gser dang sto/ dngul dang / bangs dang / lcags bcas las grub pa'i 'khor lo zhig yod pa de btang nas 'khor lo des gang du slebs tshad kyi sa cha tshang ma mnga' 'og tu bsdu thub zer/ zhib cha mngon pa mdzod〉kyi le'u gsum par gzigs/(2) rgyal po mang pos bkur ba'i gdung rabs/ 'di gong du rgyal po zhes pa'i skabs su bshad pa ltar 'jig rten thog gi rgyal po'i dang po mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal po de nas rgyal brgyad ma chad par shākya'i rgyal po zas gtsang ma(sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i yab)rshar byung ba dang / de nas shākya'i rgyal po'i rgyal brgyud rgyal bu gzhon nu don grub ni rab tu byung nas sangs rgyas pa'i mtshan la sangs rgyas shākya mu de'am shākya thub pa zhes btags shing de nas shākya'i rgyal brgyud chad pa yin zhes bshad srol yod/(3) stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gyi khams/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gzhung mngon pa mdzod〉nas bshad srol la gling bzhi gling phran/ nyi zla/rgya skar bcas cha yongs su tshang ba'i 'jig rten khams stong phrag gcig la stong sdong po'i 'jig rten zhes zer zhing / stong dang po de 'dra ba stong phrag gcig la stong gnyis pa bar ma'i 'jig rten gyi khams dang / stong gnyis pa de 'dra ba stong phrag gcig la stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams zhes bshad srol yod/(4) ston thog gi drug cha/sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gzhung mngon

154pa mdzod〉nas bshad srol la/ bskal pa ya thog gi mjug tu sger la dbang ba'i dpal 'byor lam lugs byang ba'i rjes su spyi tshogs bde 'jags yong ched dmangs kyi rang mos thog 'desdus bsko byas pa'i dpon zhig byang ba de la zhing dpon zer ba dang / zhing pa dmangs kyis rang nyid la dbarā ba'i sa zhing thog nas ston 'bab khal re'i thog nas bre gsum dang phul gnyis(khal rer bre nyi shu tham pa dang bre rer phul drug re rtsis pa'i dbang du byas)re ste/ khal gcig gi drug cha gcig zin pa'i dpya khrul sprod pa de la drug cha'i khrul zer zhing /dpon po'i lam lugs byung ba dang dpya khral lam lugs byung ba dus mnyam zer/'di deng sang gi mar le ring lugs kyi lo rgyas dngos gtso smra ba'i spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi bshad tshul dang mi mthun/ cu(6) gling bzhi/ (1)sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gzhung mngon pa mdzod〉nas bshad srol la/ 'jig rten khams la mtha' dang mu med pa'i nang nas rang cag 'tsho gnas byed pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di la gling bzhi gling phran brgyad nyi zla rgyu skar bcas cha tshang yod cing / de'i nang gi gling bzhi ni/shar lus 'phags po'i gling / stor 'dzam bu gling / nub tu ba lang spyod kyi gling / byang du sgra mi snyan gyi gling bcas gling gtso bo bzhi dang / de re re la gling phran chung ba gnyis gnyis bcas gling phran brgyad/ gling phran de dag gi nang du nang gi mtsho bdun/ phyi'i khor yug tu phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po/ steng gi nam mkha' la gnam gyi go la phub kyi bang rim ltar gnas pa'i steng du nyi zla rgyu skar gyi 'gro lam dang / nyi ma'i khyim bcu gnyis bcas yod zer/ zhib par〈mngon pa mdzod kyi le'u gsum pa〉'jig rten khams bshad pa'i thad du gzigs/ (2)sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi dus 'khor rtsa rgyad dang / 'grel pa nas bshad tshul gong dang mi 'dra ba yod pas/ gzirgol par 'dod na sa

155rnying bka' brgyad dge lugs sogs grub mtha' ris med kyi mkhas pa mang pos brtsams pa'i byes 'khor gyi 'grel pa ha cang mang po yod pa de rnams su gziṭa par zhu/(6) rgyal chen bzhi'i rigs kyi lha/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gzhung mngon pa mdzod〉nas bshad srol la gong du bshad pa'i gling bzhi po de'i dbus su ri yi rgyal po lhan po zhes bya ba/ ngos bzhi dang bang rim bzhi yod pa/ bang rim bzhi po sdo'i shar phyogs su rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung /(mdog dkar po/ pi wam 'dzin pa) lho phyogs su rgyal po 'phags skyes po /(mdog sngon po/ ral gri 'dzin pa) nub phyogs su rgyal po spyan mi bzang /(mdog dmar po/ sbral zhags dang mchod rten 'dzin pa) byang phyogs su rgyal po rnam thos sras/cu (mdog ser po/ rgyal mtshan dang de'u le 'dzin pa)bzhi po de dag rang rang gi 'khor mang po dang bcas pas 'jig rten khams 'di'i phyogs bzhir sangs rgyas chos lugs srung skyob byed pa yin zer srol dang / zhib cha mngon pa mdzod〉kyi le'u gsum pa 'jig rten gyi khams bshad pa'i thad du gzigs/(7) sum cu rtsa gsum/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gzhung mngon pa mdzod〉nas bshad srol la/ gong du bshad pa'i ri rgyal lhan po de'i steng du sa steng dang 'brel ba'i 'dod khams kyi lha gnas sum cu rtsa rshasum ste/ drag po bcu gcig nyi ma bcu gnyis/ tha skar gyi bu gzhon nu gnyis te/ sum cu rtsa gsum gnas pa yin pas/ yongs grags su lha gnas sum cu rtsa gsum zer/ gong gi drag po bcu gcig dang nyi ma bcu gnyis tha skar gyi bu gnyis bcas ni mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa mngon pa'i rgyan〉ste/ yongs grags su 〈mchims mdzod〉zer ba de'i le'u gsum pa'i skabs su gsal/

156(8) barmig65 pa/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bshad srol la 'jig rten khams la grangs med pa dang mtha' med cing 'jig rten 'di nyid ma chags gong 'jig rten snga ma med par gyar nas lo dung phyar khri phrag mang po sdod pa'i bar stong de ni 'jig rten snga ma lhangs pa'i bskalag pa dang / de nas 'jig rternga gsar pa chags 'go btsugs pa nas 'jig rten thog mi dang po byung ba'i bar ni chags pa'i bskal pa yin/ de la yang lo grangs dung phyur mang po yod/ mi dang po byung ba nas 'jig rten med pa chags 'go ma btsugs bar ni gnas pa'i bskal pa yin/ de'i dus tshod nang mi'i tshe lo khri phrag thub pa nas tshe lo bcu pa bar mar 'grib dang / de nas slar yang tshe lo khri phrag bar yar 'phel gnyis res mos byed pa'i gnas bskal la bar bskal nyi shu yod/ bar bskal nyi shu rdzogs rjes rang byung gi gnod 'tshes 'jig rten stongs pa'i 'go tshugs te mthar 'jig rten gcig rtsa med du song nas/ 'jig rten gsar pa ma chaṭa bar gyi dus yun ha cang ring ba de la yang bar bskal nyi shu yod/ 'jig rten gcig gsar du chags pa dang / gnas pa/ 'jig pa/ stongs pa bcas kyi bskal pa bzhi bsdoms pa'i dus yun bar bskal brgyad cu yod pa la bskal pa chen po gcig zer gyi yod nga/ red/(9) bskal pa rdzogs ldan/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gzhung〈mngon pa mdzod〉nas bshad srol la/ 'jig rten gyi khams su dang por mi'i 'gro ba byung nas dus tshod ha cang ring po'i nang rgya nor sger la dbang ba'i lam lugs med pa ma zad/ mi rnams rang bzhin gyizlo kun spyod bzang po dang ldan pas/ gzhan gyi rgya norari —brkas pa dang / gzhan gyi srog gcod pa/ phan tshun 'thab rtsod byed pa༄/ de'i cherdo du rdzun shod pa btson du 'jug pa sogs med pas/ mi rnams rang bzhin gyis dge ba bcu cha tshang bar ldan pa'i cha nas

157bskal pa rdzogs ldan zhes btags pa yin zer/ ('di la mi lo sa ya gcig dang / bdun 'bum/ nyis khri brgyad stong yod zer)(10)bskal pa gsum ldan/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gzhung nas bshad tshul la/ gong du bshad pa'i bskal pa rdzogs ldan gyi dus de rim gyis nyams nas mi rnams la dge ba bcu'i nang sna gsum ldan zhing / gzhan dag ma tshang bas bskal pa gsum ldan zhes btags pa yin zer/ ( 'di la mi lo sa ya gcig dang / nyis 'bum/ dgu khri/ drug stong yod zer)(11) bskal pa gnyis ldan/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bshad srol la/ gong du bshad pa'i bskal pa gsum ldan dus skabs de yang rim gyis nyams te dge ba bcu'i nang nas gnyis tsam ma gtogs ma lus pa der zer/('di la mi lo brgyad 'bum/ drug khri/ bzhi stong yod zer)(12) chu bee skal ldan shing rta/ 'di mngon brjod kyi gzhung du chu bo gang ga'i ming yin par bshad/ de yang mu stegs pa'i rig byed kyi gtam rgyad du/ lha dbang phyug chen po la btsun mo gnyis yod pa ste/lha mo u ma dang /ṅgāganyis so/ lha mo gaṅgā chu klung chen po'i gzugs su sprul nas mi yul du thog mar babs skabs gangs ri chen po ti se'i steng du babs pa de nyid cha shas bdun du gyur nas/ ri kha ba can brtol te/ shugs drag chen po'i sgra dang bcas te rgya mtsho chen por 'bab pa na/ ri kha ba can gyi khrod na ting nge 'dzin sgom bzhin du bsdad pa'i drang srong dza ha nu zhes bya ba de chu'i sgras ting nge 'dzin sgom pa la gnod pa'i dbang gis khros nas/ chu bo gaṅgā hab gcig gis 'thungs so/ / nam zhig rgyal po dug can pa zhes bya ba'i bu drug rnye shi nas dmyal bar skyes pa na/ de'i rgyal rabs lnga pa rgyal po skal ldan shing rtas rang gi mes po dug can pa'i bu rnams dmyal bar skyes pa las thar ba'i ched du chu

168bo gaṅgā 'bab par 'dod nas dka' thub drag po spyad de lha tshangs pa mnyes par byas te tshangs pa la gsol ba btab pas/ lha tshangs pas chu bo gaṅgā la khyod mi yul du babs par gyis shig ces smras kyang gaṅgā 'bab tu ma 'dod pa la/ lha tshangs pas khyod mes po'i bka' ma nyan pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhes smras nas gaṅgā blangs te rang gi ral pa'i nang du bzhag go /gaṅgā phyir 'byung bar 'dod nas lha yi lo stong phrag gi bar du 'khor zhing babs kyang ral pa de'i mtha' ma rnyed/ slar yang rgyal po skal ldan shing rtas lha chen po tshangs pa la gsol ba btab pas lha chen pos rang gi ral pa btsir ba dang / chu bo gaṅgā'i thigs pa gcig gangs ri ti se'i steng du babs pa yud tsam zhig la rgya mtsho chen po gcig tu gyur/ de yang chu bo chen po bdun du gyur te/ gangs ri ti se'i shar phyogs kyi brag glang po che'i kha 'dra ba nas chu bo gaṅgā/ lho phyogs su brag rma bya'i kha 'dra ba nas chu bo sin dhu/ nub phyogs kyi brag rta yi kha 'dra ba nas chu bo pa kṣu/ byang phyogs kyi brag seng ge'i kha 'dra ba nas chu bo si tā bcas 'bab cing / gzhan yang chu bo rgal dang / tshim pa dang / na li nā bcas chu bo chen po bdun 'bab pa'i nang nas/ chu bo gaṅgā ri kha ba can brgyud sa 'og tu song ste/ dmyal ba'i gnas su rgyal po dug can pa'i bu drug khri'i las kyi lhag ma rnams bkrus shing de rnams dmyal ba nas shi 'phos te mtho ris su skyes pas na/ chu bo gaṅgā'i ming la chu bo skal ldan shing rta dang /tshangs pa'i ral klung zhes btags pa yin zer/(13) drang srong ser skya'i gnas/ rgya gar byang phyogs sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i 'khrungs yul gyi ming / deng sang bal yul dang thag nye sa zhig tu de'i shul yod 'dug thang san dzang gi lam yig bod yig tu bskyar ba zhig gi nang gsal don/ skabs der grong khyer ser skya'i pho brang gi shuzlo tsam

159las med pa dang / mtha' skor du le dbar bco lnga tsam dang / grong tsho stong phrag bcu tsam/ lha khang gog po mang po yod par bshad/(14) mas dpon gyi sring mo/ 'di'i mas dben gyi sring mo zhes pa yig nor yin 'dra ste/ mas dben gyi sring mo zhes ma mi gcig pa'i sring mo la go dgos/(16) byang chub kyi mchog rtu thugs brgyud/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi theg pa chen po'i lam gyi bshad srol la/ rang nyid gcig bu'i don du zhi bde don gnyer gyi bsam pa spangs nas nam mkha' khyab pa'i 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i bsam pa thog mar skyes pa'i zhe sa'i tshig(16) bskal pa grangs med pa/ gong du bshad pa'i bskal pa de 'dra ba grangs med pa'i bar du zhes pa'i don te/ 'di'i grangs med pa zhes pa ni grangs gtan nas med pa'i grangs med la go rgya min par/ grangs gnas la gcig nas grangs med pa'i bar drug cu tham pa sdud pa/ ('di'i 'grel bshad(mi dbang rtogs brjod〉kyi tshig 'grel nang gsal bas der stos) de 'dra ba'i bskal pa gcig gi yun tshad la bskal pa grangs med pa gcig zer/(17) sgrib gnyis/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang / shes bya'i sgrib pa gnyis te/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa ni rtsa ba'i nyon mongs drug lta bu dang /shes bya'i sgrib pa ni/ mi shes pa'i rgyu bzhi lta bu/ zhib cha phar phyin〉dang〈dbu ma'i gzhung〉rnams su gsal bas 'dir ma bris/(18) tshogs gnyis/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gzhung spyi'i bshad srol la/ bsod nams kyi tshogs dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis la zer zhing /bsod nams kyi tshogs ni/ sbyin pa btang ba dang / tshul khrims srung ba lta bu

160dang / ye shes kyi tshogs ni ting nge 'dzin sgom pa dang / stong pa nyid kyi lta ba rtogs pa lta bu yin/(19) dga' ldan lha'i gnas/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gzhung(mngon pa mdzod〉nas bshad tshul la khams gsum gyi nang nas 'dod khams la 'gro ba ris drug dang de'i nang gses lha la 'dod lha ris drug tu phye ba(1 rgyal chen ris bzhi/ 2 sum cu rtsa gsum/ 3 'thab bral/ 4 dga' ldan/6 'phrul dga'/ 6 gzhan 'phrul dbang byed bcas)las/ bzhi pa dga' ldan lha'i gnas ni sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' skye ba gcig gis thogs pa rnams bzhugs pa'i dag pa'i zhing khams shig yin par bshad/(20) phar phyin/ skabs 'di'i phar phyin ni phar phyin drug dang bcu sogs la go rgyu min par phar phyin gyi gzhung la go dgos/ phar phyin gyi gzhung ni byang chub sems dpa' byams pas mdzad pa'i byams chos sde lnga〉(1 mngon rtogs rgyan〉 lha mdo sde rgyan〉 3 rgyud bla ma〉 4 dbus mtha' rnam 'byed〉 6 chos nyid rnam 'byed〉 bcas yin)bka' 'gyur pod phi/ pa'i nang yod cing / slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med kyis brtsams pa'i sa sde lnga〉 (1 (sa'i dngos gzhi〉 lha gtan la dbab pa bsda ba〉 3 gzhi bsda ba〉 rnam grangs bsda ba〉 ca rnam par bshad pas sgo bsda ba〉bcas yido)bstan 'gar gyi pod/ cu (dzi)(khri)(zhi)(zi)('i)(7)bar pod drug yod cing cu/ de rnams las mang che ba ni rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi dus/lo tsā ba zhang ye shes sdes bod skad du basbyar ba yin la/ 'ga' zhig dus sdu/sa bcu gcig pa'i mjug tu rngog lo dhī ba blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur ba phar phyin gyi gzhung gi nang don gtso bo ni/ 〈yum rgyas 'bring bsdus

161gsum〉gyi brjod don du sbas pa'i dgongs pa rnams/ dngos po brgyad(mkhyen pa gsum/ sbyor ba bzhi/ 'bras bu chos kyi ska) dang don bdun cu(rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos bcu/ lam shes mtshon༄ byed kyi chos bcu gcig gzhi shes mtshon byed kyi chos dgu rnam rdzogs sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gcigartse mo'i sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos brgyad/ mthar gyis sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gsum/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos bzhi/ chos sku mtshon byed kyi chos bzhi bcas)bcas su bsdas nas bshad pa yin zhing gong du bshad pa'i phar phyin gyi gzhung de rnams kyi seng don dbye tshul dang / go rim bshad tshul bcas rgyas bsdas 'dra min sna tshogs yod kyang / nang don gtso bo ni de dag yin/ gzhan rnong bod kyi chos lugs ris med kyi mkhas pa mang pos brtsams pa'i phar phyin gyi gzhung gi 'grel pa ni mtha' yas so/(21) (mdo lde rgyan gyi ṭi bar〉/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pas/ mdzad pa'i mdo sde rgyan/〉la rgya gar gyi mkhas pa dang / bod kyi mkhas pa mang pos brtsams pa'i 'grel bshad yod cing / rgya gar gyi skad nas bod kyi skad du bskyar ba'i mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel bshad〉la/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis rādzad pa'i mdo sde rgyan gyi bshad pa〉 (bstan 'gyur pod/(li)pa'i nang yod)slob dpon btsun pa ngo bo nyid med pas mdzad pa'i(mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel bshad〉(bstan 'gyur pod(ba)pa'i nang yod)slob dpon blo gros brtan pas mdzad pa'i mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel bshad〉(bstan 'gyar pod(mi)(tse)gnyis la yod)sogs kha shas dang / de min bod kyi chozlo lugs ris med kyi mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis kyang 'grel bshad mdzad pa yod/ gong gsal rgya gar nas bod du basbyar ba rnams ni rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi dus lo tsā ba ska ba dpal brtsegs stol sogs pas bsgyur ba yin/

162(22) rtsod ldan gyi dus/ sangs rgyas chos lugs/ kyi gzhung nas bshad tshul la/ gong gsal gnyis ldan gyi dus skabs de yang rim gyis nyams nas mi rnams mi dge ba bcu ka cha tshang bar bag med du spyod pa dang / dmag 'khrug rgyun mi chad pa byung ba'i 'go tshugs pa nas rtsod ldan gyi dus yin zer/('di la mi lo bzhi 'bum/ sum khri/ nyis stong yod zer)(23) dpyid bla ba chung / rgya gar lugs kyi lo gcig la dus drug dang / dus bzhi brtsi tshul gnyis yod pa'i nang nas dus bzhi rtsi tshul gyi dbang du byas na/ lo gcig la dbyar dgun ston dpyid bzhi dang de bzhi po re re la/ ra ba/ 'bring po/ tha chung gsum re rtsis pa'i/ dpyid zla tha chung ni/bod lugs kyi sa ga zla ba/(24) rjo bo rje'i lugs/ sangs rgyas shākya mu nee ska 'das nas da bar lo ji song gi 'das lo rtsi tshul la lugs mi 'dra ba nyi shu sgrog tsam yod pa('di rnams so so'i 'dod pa mi 'dra ba'i re'u mig zur du bkod pa zhig yod pa der stos)las/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha'i lugs/(25) chos rje sa skya pa/ 'di sa skya paṇa chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan la zer/ 'di'i lo rgyus 'og gi mchan rtags ang 88 par gsal/(26) gnyan yod/ (mnyan yod)de sngon rgya gar yul dbus kyi sa char yod pa'i grong khyer zhig gi ming / rdo rje gdan dang thag mi ring ba zhig tu yod par bshad/ rgya gar skad du ko sā la zhes zer/(27) rgyal po'i khab/ de sngon rgya gar du sangs rgyas shākya mu ni sku bzhugs skabs kyi rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i pho brang yod pa'i grong khyer gyi ming ste/ (thang san dzang gi lam yig〉mdor bsdas bod skad du basbyar ba las/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan nas shar phyogs su le dpar nyis brgya dang byeg cu

lhab tsam na yod pa dang / skabs der grong khyeragishulatsamalasamedaru/63lcags ri'i mtha' bskor la le dbar brgya dang lnga bcu tsam/ mkhar grong nang ma'i rgya khyon le dbar sum cu tsam yod par bshad/ sa gnas der rgyal po'i khab zer ba'i rgya mtshan/ rgyal po gzugs can snying pos rgyal po byed skabs kyi ca/khar grong sngorno ma de grong khyer nang du yod skabs 'bangs kyi khang khyim nas me zhor ba rgyal po'i pho brang du mched pa thengs kha shas byung ba'i rkyen byas/ sus khyim nang me shor ba byung na de'i khang khyim nang mi dang bcas pa dur khrod nang du phyir 'bud byed dgos rgya'i khrims bcas/ yun ring ma song bar rgyal po rang gi khyim nas me shor bshā / rgyal pos rang gis gtan 'bebs bzos pa'i khrims rang gis bshig mi rung zer nas pho brang dur khrod du spos nas bsdad par rgyal po'i khab zer ba'i ming thogs/ de rgyal po gzhan dag gis shes te gsang ba'i rkan dmag btang ba'i gros byas pa rgyal pos go thos byung bas/ lcags ri rshaskongs te khang khyim mang po btab nas grong khyer du bskyar ba zhig yin kyang ming bskyar ma byas par sngon ming rnying pa rang 'jagarno su 'jog pa yin zhes〈'dulag ba'i gleng 'bum〉du gsal/(28) ko'u shasmyu/ de sngon sangs rgyas shākya mu de ska bzhugs skabs kyi rgya gar nub phyogs kyi grong khyer chen po zhig gi ming yin pare 'dul ba'i gleng 'bum〉las bshad/(29) 'phags thre5spu/ 'di sngar sangs rgyas shākya mu ni sku bzhugs skabs kyi rgya gar shar phyogs kyi grong khyer zhig gi ming yin par 'dul ba'i gleng 'bum〉las bshad/zhe sa'i (sdu/) khab tu bzhugs/ rang gi pha ma'i khyim du 'tsho ba skyel ba'i

164(31)mngon par byung / rang gi pha ma'i khyim spangs te rab tu byungab ste/ deng sang chos sgor zhugs zer ba dang go don gcig(32) dka' ba lo drug spyad/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gzhung nas bshad tshul la/ sangs rgyas shākya mu de rang gi khyim spangs nas rab tu byung ba'i rjes su skabs der rgya gar du dar rgyas che ba'i mu stegs pa'i chos lugs la/ zas spangs pa dang me lnga bsten pa/ khab brtsegs mthon po'i steng nas mdud rtse yi steng du mchongs pa sogs dka' ba ha cang mang po spyad nas 'khor ba las thar bar khas len gyi yod pa ltar/ khong gis kyang zas gcod pa'i dka' thub lo drug ring spyad nas lus kyi sha rnams zad de rus gong skam po pags pas g.yogs pa ltar gyur kyang mthar rang nyid kyis 'dod pa'i 'bras bu gang yang ma thob par brten/ zas za ba spangs nas dka' ba spyad pa'i chos des 'khor ba las thar mi thub pa'i dpe mtshon zhig ston pa gnang ba yin zhes bshad srol yod/(33) zang chub kyi snying por gshegs/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bshad srol la/ sangs rgyas rishākya mu des lo drug ring dka' ba spyad pa'i rjes su rdo rje gdan gyi byang chub kyi shing gi 'og tu ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs te/bdud bzhi btul nas sangs rgyas pa'i go 'phang brnyes pa yin zer/ 'di skor zhib cha bris kyang chos lugs kyi rmang gzhi'i shes yon med pa'i mi rnams kyis go bde lon dka' bar bsams nas ma bris so/(34) sa gas sdon ba/ skar rtsis pa rnams kyis bshad srol la lo gcig la zla ba bcu gnyis yod pa zla ba so so'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin zla ba dang mnyam du 'grogs pa'i skar ma gang khel bar gzhir bzung nas zla ba de la ming de ltar btags pa yin cing / hor zla bzhi pa ste bod lugs kyi zla ba bzhi

165pa'i tshes 15nyin zla ba dang mnyam du 'grogs pa'i skar ma ni sa ga yin pas/('di rags rtsis kyi dbang du byas shing / zhib rtsis la nyin re zung gis bar khyad yod)bod zla bzhi pa la sa gas nya ba'i zla ba zer/(35) bdud brtul/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gzhung nas bshad tshul la/ chos lugs kyi go rtogs mthar phyin nas sangs rgyas pa na/ bdud bzhi las rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob pa yin cing / de yang nyon mongs pa'i bdud bcom nas de'i bag chags dang bcas pa rtsa ba nas spangs pa/ phung po'i bdud bcom nas lus sha rus bsdos bcas kyi gzugs phung gnas 'gyur nas 'ja' lus mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i skur 'gyur ba/ lha'i bu'i bdud bcom nas mnyam rjes gcig tu 'dres pa/ 'chi bdag gi bdud bcom nas skye 'chi spangs pa'i rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa bcas la bdud btul ba zer/ 'di mdo lugs kyi dbang du byas shing / gsang sngags kyi gzhung nas bshad tshul de las gting zab cing go dka' bas 'dir ma smos so/(36) ma0nam par bzhag sems dmigs pa gcig la dmigs te bying ba dang rgod pa'i skyon gnyis dang bral ba'i sgo nas rtse gcig tu 'jog pa/(37) mi mjed kyi bdag po/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gzhung nas bshad tshul la/ gong du bshad pa'i stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams la mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams zer zhing / de'i bdag po lha chen po tshangs pa gdong bzhi pa yin zhes zer srol yod/(38) ba ra na se/ rgya gar gyi byang phyogs su yod pa'i chu bo wa ra dang / ṇa si gnyis kyi bar du yod pa'i yul de'i spyi ming ste/ nirya pā la'i lho nub kyi mtshams chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram du yod pa'i grong khyer gyi ming zhig yin par〈thang san dzang gi lam yig〉las bshad/

166(39) drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi gnas/ gong du bshad pa'i chu bo wa ra dang ṇa si brgal nas byang shar mtshams su le dbar bcus chod pa'i sa na yod pa'i nags tshal zhig yin cing thang san dzang gi lam yig〉las skabs der dgon pa chen po shin tu brjid chags pa zhig gi nang / dge 'dun sum stong tsam yod pa dang / de rnams rtsa ba'i sde bzhi'i nang nas mang pos bkur ba'i sde pa yin pa/ dgon pa de'i rten gyi gtso bo thub pa chos 'khor ma zhig dang rang sangs rgyas kyi mchod rten lnga brgya bcas yod par ba'ad/(40) 'khor lnga lde/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bshad srol la sangs rgyas shākya mu nee sangs rgyas nas zhag bzhi bcu zhe dgu'i ring chos nyan pa po'i sdod brtag pa'i ched du chos mi gsung bar bzhugs pa dang / de nas lha tshangs pa dang / brgya sbyin gnyis kyis gser gyi 'khor lo dang / dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil ba phul te chos gsung bar gsol ba btab pa ltar chos thog mar gsungs shing / de skabs chos nyan pa'i slob ma'i dang po lnga yod pa de la 'khor lnga sde zer/ 1 kun shes skru :nu/ 2 rta thul/ 3 rlangs pa/4 ming chen/ 5 bzang ldan bcas lnga po de rnams chos nyan pa dang dus mnyam du dgra bcom pa'i rtogs pa thob pa yin zhes bshad srol yod/(41) dman pa'i gdul za/ chos la dad pa yod kyang theg pa chen po'i chos byang chub kyi sems dang / phar phyin drug sogs blo la ma chud pa'i mi rnams/(42) bden pa bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gzhung nas bshad tshul la/ sangs rgyas shākya mu zhes dang por gsungs pa'i chos la bden bzhi'i chos 'khor zer zhing de la bzlas pa gsum

167dang rnam grangs bcu gnyis yod/ sdag bsngal bden pa/ kun 'byang bden pa/ 'gog pa'i bden pa/ lam gyi droden pa/ bcas bden pa bzhi the der/ngo bo la bzlas pa bzhi/ bya ba la bzlas pa bzhi/ bya ba'i 'bras bu la bzlas pa bzhi ste/ rnam grangs bcu gnyis yod/ 'di rnams phar phyin gyi gzhung dang bu ston chos 'byung〉las gsal 'dul ba lung sde bzhi〉yang bden bzhi'i chos 'khor gyi khongs su gtogs pa yin/(43) dran rgod tha:thab cas/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bshad srol la/sangs rgyas shākya mu zhes theg pa chen po'i chos gsung ba'i gnas ri zhig gi ming yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' mang po zhig rang lus bya rgod du sprul nas chos nyan pa'i gnas yin pas ming de ltar thogs pa yin zer/ 〈thang san dzang gi lam yig〉las/ ri 'di ni gong du bshad pa'i rgyal po'i khab kyi byang shar mtshams su yod pa dang / sa gnas gzhan dag las mtho zhing / rdo'i skas lam zheng la gom pa bcu dang / srid la le dbar drug tsam yod ces bshad/(44) theg pa thun mong ma yin pa/ theg pa chung ngu ba'i nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis blo yul du ma zhong ba'i chos/(46) mtshan nyid med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo/ chos thams cad rgyu dang rkyen la brten nas 'byung zhing / rang gi mtshan nyid kyis ma grub par ston nga 'i chos yum rgyas 'bring bsdas gsum〉lta bu ste/ bka' 'gyur gyi nang yum rgyas 'bring bsdas gsum bsdormos pa'i pod nyi shu tham pa yod de/yum rgyas pa sher phyin 〉bum pa〉 (ka) (kha) (ga) (nga) (ca) (cha)(ja) (nya) (1) (tha) (da) (na) bar pod bcu gnyis la/ bam po sum brgya/ le'u don gnyis/ sgro ka chig 'bum yod/ yum 'bring po sher

168phyin stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa'am〉yongs grags su nyi khri〉zhes 'bod pa pod/(ka) (kha) (ga) bar pod gsum la/ bam po brgyad cu/ le'u bdun cu don gnyis/ shlau ka nyis khri lnga stong / 'bring gi 'bring po khri brgyad stong pa〉pod(ka) (kha) (ga) bar pod gsum la/ bam po drug cu/ le'u brgyad cu rtsa bzhi/ 'bring gi bsdas pa khri brgyad stong pa〉pod gcig la/bam po sum cu rtsa bzhi le'u so gsurmi/ blo ka brgya pa/ yum bsdas pa〈brgyad stong pa〉pod gcig la bam po nyer bzhi le'u so gnyis/ blo ka )rgyad stong / sher phyin rgyas bsdas sna tshogs phyogs gcig ta bsdas pa/ sher phyin sna tshogs pod gcig bcarā/ gong gsal rnams zlong sdu ba rgyal po khri srong lde sdusan gyi dus lo tsā ba zhang ye shes sde dang / dzī na mi tra sogs kyis bsgyur ba —na/(46) ri ma la ya/ rgya gar sto phyogs kyi mtha' sner yod pa'i ri zhig gi ming / 〈thang sen dzang gi lam yig〉las/ rgya gar gyi sa dbyibs zla gam gzugs su med pa'i rtse mo rno shos na ma ru ku bste yongs grags su ra me shā ri zer ba der/ tsan dan dang / ga bur gyi rigs ha cang mang po skyes pa'i ri zhig yod pa de'i ming la ma la ya/ zhes 'bod pa dang ri de'i rtse mor spyan ras gzigs kyi lha khang legs po zhig yod la/ ri de'i logs shig nas brdol ba'i chu mig ri de la lan nyi shus bskor nas 'bab pa'i lho phyogs rgya mtsho chen por thug pa zhig yod pa dngos su gzigs par bshad/(47) yangs pa can/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bshad srol la sangs rgyas shākya mu zhes theg pa chen po'i chos mang po gsungs pa'i gnas yin zer srol dang thang gan dzang gi lam yig〉las/ gong gsal gyi chu bo wa ra cha brgyud nas shar phyogs su le dbar stong phrag gcig gi sa na yangs pa can gyi

170bo'i phar 'gram na sku gdung me la bzhus pa'i gnas khor yug tu le dbar gnyis tsam yod pa dang thog mar stegs bu yin pa la skabs der gting zab tshad 'dom drug lhag tsam yod pa'i shong chen por song ba ni sangs rgyas kyi sku gdung me la bzhus pa'i gnas de'i sa rdol rnams nad rigs gang la'ang phan nas che ba'i dbang gis len mkhan rgyan༄ mi chad pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin par /shad/ cu(51) ston zla ba chung / 'di rgya gar gyi skar rtsis pa'i lugs sdu/ra bzhag pa'i ston zla tha chung ste/ bod dang hor lugs kyi zla ba bcu pa (62) bka' bci ba dang po/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bshad srol la/ sangs rgyas shākya mu nee mya ngan las 'das pa'i phyi lo der/ sangs rgyas kyi nye gnas kun dga' bo dgra bcom pa thob te/ grong khyer rgyal po'i khab kyi bde can ma'i phug tu/ rgyal po ma skyes dgras sbyin bdag byas nas/sangs rgyas rang nyid dngos su bzhugs ring zhal nas gsungs pa'i bka' rnams mi brjed pa'i gzungs thob pa'i dgra bcom pa rnams kyi blor bzung nas yod pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdas rjes/ slob ma dgra bcom pa rnams dpang por bzhag te tshig dang don la sdud lhag nor 'khrul lta ba'i ched du sdad pa po so sos blo las bton pa rnams nyan nas gtan la phab pa yin cing / ༄ de yang thog mar skabs der yod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi slob ma dgra bcom pa yod tshad bsdus pa'i tshogs chen 'tshogs thog nyan thos 'od srung chen po sogs dgra bcom pa rnams kyis ming bton nas/ kun dga' bo mdo sde'i sde sdod sdad pa po dang / 'phags pa nye bar 'khor 'dul ba'i sde sdod bsdas pa po /nga /'od srung chen po mngon pa'i sde sdod sdud pa por gcig gyur gyes bsko bzhag

171mdzad/ de nas dgra bcom pa lnga brgya tham pa'i snam sbyar brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du kun dga' po bzhag nas des rang nyid kyi blo la yod pa'i mdo sde rnams bton nas mdo sde'i sde snad bsdas/ de rjes 'phags pa nye bar 'khor gyis rang nyid kyi blo la yod pa'i 'dul༄ ba'i sde sdod rnams bton nas bsdus/de rjes nyan thos 'od srung chen pos rang nyid kyi blo la yod pa'i mngon pa'i sde // rnams bton nas bsdus/ de rnams la bka' bsdu ba dang po zer srol (53)kun dga' bo/ sangs rgyas shākya mu de'i sku tshe gcig ring gi nye gnas dang / sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das rjes nyan thos 'od srung chen pos nyes skyon chen po brgyad bgrangs nas re zhig chad pa bcad/ ring po ma lon par khong dgra bcom par gyur nas 'od srung chen po sogs dgra bcom pa lnga brgyas mgrin gcig tu mdo sde'i sde sdod sdad pa por bskos/ 'od srung chen po mya ngan las 'da' khar sangs rgyas drong nyid kyi bka' ltar bstan pa'i bdag por bskos/ 'di'i lo rgyus zhib tsam 'dul ba lung〉du gsal/(54)mdo sde'i lde snod/ lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa brjod bya'i gtso bor byas nas ston pa'i sde sdod/ 'di la bka' 'gyur gyi nang mdo mang〉(ka)(a)bar/ pod sum cu skor/ gsang sngags kyi gzhung rnams kyangam sde sdod gsum du phye ba'i skabs su mdo sde'i sde sdod kyi khongs su gtogs pa —na/(55)'phags pa nye bar 'khor/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bshad srol la 'di sangs rgyas shākya mu de dngos kyi slob ma/ skra gzhar mkhan gyi rigs las rab tu byung zhing dgra bcom pa'i rtogs pa thob pa dang / 'dul ba'i bslab khrims kyi gnad don mang por dogs pa yod pa rnams sangs rgyas

172rang nyid la dngos su dri ba zhus nas dogs pa gcod par mdzad pas 'dul ba la shin tu mkhas pa dang / sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das rjes nyan thos 'od srung chen po sogs slob ma dgra bcom pa lnga brgyas mgrin gcig tu 'dul ba'i sde sdod sdad pa por bskos thog rang nyid kyi blo la yod pa'i 'dul ba'i sde sgod rnamarā bton nas phyogs bsdas byas/ 'di'i lo rgyus zhib pa/ bka' 'gyur gyi 'dul ba lung〉du gsal/(56)'dul ba/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa(chos sgor zhugs pa'i dge bsnyen dang / rab byang dge tshul/ dge slong rnams kyi bslab khrims)brjod bya'i gtso bor byas nas༄ ston pa'i sde sdod la zer zhing bka' 'gyur gyi nang 'dul ba lung sde bzhi〉la pod bcu gsum yod/ de yang 'dul ba lung gzhi〉pod(ka) (kha) (ga) (nga)bar pod bzhi dang / bam po brgya dang dgu ka sum khri nyis stong bdun brgya/ lung rnam 'byed las/ (dge slong pha'i rnam 'byed〉(ca) (cha) (ja) (nya)bar pod bzhi dang / bam po gya gsum bloka nyis khri bzhi stong dgu brgya/ dge slong ma'i rnam 'byed pod(1)pa pod gcig dang / bam po nyer brgyad/ bloka brgyad stong bzhi brgya/ (dge slong pha'i so thar gyi mdo〉dang / (ma'i so thar gyi mdo〉so sor bam po gnyis re bcas yod/ (lung phran tshegs〉pod(tha) (da)bcas pod gnyis dang /bam po lnga bcu nga dgu saka chig khri bdun stong brgyad brgya/ 〈gzhung dam pa'am gzhung bla ma〉la pod/ (na) (pa)pod gnyis bcas khyon bcu gsum yod/ 'dir bstan 'gyur khongs su yod pa rnams bka' bsda ba'i khongs su ma gtogs pas rtsis med/ dku(57)'phags pa 'od srungs chen po/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bshad srol la/ 'di sangs rgyas shākya mu nee dngos kyi slob ma/ bram ze'i

173rigs las rab tu byung zhing dgra bcom pa'i rtogs pa thob pa dang / sangs rgyas rang nyid mya ngan las 'da' khar rang nyid kyi ska tshab tu bskos shing / mya ngan las 'das rjes slob ma dgra bcom pa lnga brgyas mgrin gcig tu mngon pa'i sde snod sdad pa por bskos te/ rang nyid kyi blo la yod pa'i mngon pa'i sde snod rnams༄ bton nas phyogs bsdas mdzad/ mthar ri bo bya rkang can du phebs nas 'gog pa'i ting nge 'dzi la mnyam par bzhag te sangs rgyas byams pa 'dzam bu'i gling du ma byon bar du sku gson por bzhugs pa yin zer/'di'i lo rgyus zhib pa bka' 'gyur gyi 'dul ba lung〉gi nang gsal/(68)ma24na pa/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bshad srol la/ lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa brjod bya'i gtso bor byas nas ston pa'i sde sdod/ yum rgyas 'bring brdzas gsum lta bu/(59)zes rgyal zu ngan med/ 'di rgya gar yul dbus kyi rgyal po stobs chen zhig ste/ rgya gar skad du dharma rā dza a zho ka/ zer zhing bod skad du basbyar na chos rgyal mya ngan med zer/ yul tsam pa nar nyi ma'i rigs kyi rgyal sku nee mi ta yi bu bdun yod pa'i nang gi chung ba yin/ rgyal po 'di dus tshod ji tsam la byung ba bod kyi lo rgyus tshor shod stangs 'dra min yod kyang /bod kyi lo rgyus mkhas can bu ston rin chen grub kyis/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgya dang bcu na chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis sbyin bdag byas nas bka' bsda ba gnyis pa byas par gsungs shing / a mdo dge 'dun chos 'phel gyizlo brtsams pa'i deb nyer dkar po〉las/ siṅgala'i gnas bstan ming chen gyis brtsams pa'i ma hā bsar〉sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis brgya re gcig par mya ngan med khri la 'khod de/ lo bzhi bcu srid bskyangs nas grongs zhes bris pa de dang / 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal gyis brtsams pa'i

174〈dab ther sngon po〉nang du bstan pa'i gtad rabs shog 'khyar zhig bod skad du bsgyur nas bris pa las/ bar skabs der sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das lo sum brgya lon te/ mya ngan med ces bya ba'i rgyal po de shi nas/ zhes 'khod pa gnyis lo gcig gis kyang chad lhag med par mthun pas na ji tsam 'phyis kyang sangs rgyas 'das nas lo nyis brgya lnga bcu'i nang rol du/ rgyal po mya ngan med 'khrungs nas yod nges pas so/ zhes bshad pa rjes su dpyad dgos/rgyal po 'di thog mar mu stegs dbang phyug pa'i lta ba bzung nas mi dang sems can mang po dmar gsod btang ba'i dmar mchod phul mkhan zhig yin kyang /rjes su dgra bcom pa grags pas chos bshad de sangs rgyas chos lugs su bsgyur nas lha khang dgon pa mang po bzhengs pa dang / 'dzam bu gling gi sa gnas khag mang por sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel bzhugs pa'i mchod rten bye ba gcig bzhengs pa sogs bshad srol yod/ 'di'i lo rgyas bod yig thog 'khod pa ni/ jo nang tā ra nā bas brtsams pa'i rgya gar chos༄ 'byung〉tsam ma gtogs gzhan dag da phan ma mthong lags/(60)bka' bci ba gnyis pa/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bshad srol la/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgya dang bcu song ba(slob dpon legs ldan 'byed kyis brtsams pa'i rtog ge 'bar ba〉dang slob dpon dbyig bshes kyis brtsams pa'i sde pa tha dad du 'byed pa〉las/sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgya dang drug cu na yin zhes bshad)yul yangs pa can du gnas pa'i dge slong rnams kyis/ hu lu lu yi rung ba dang /a la la yi rung ba sogs rung ba bcu byas na/ sangs rgyas kyis nyes pa yod par gsungs pa rnams kyang nyes med du 'gyur thub zer nas rung ba ma yin pa'i gzhi bcu zer ba'i srol gsar du bstod/ rgyu nor dang bza' btung mang

175po gsog 'jog byas te chos/ khrims bag yangs su spyod bzhin yod pa las/rgyal po mya ngan med kyis srid dbang bzung nas lo bcu drug la slebs pa'i lo der yul yangs pa can du rgyal po mya ngan med kyis sbyin bdag byas te dgra bcom pa grags pa sogs dgra bcom pa bdun brgya gdan drangs nas/ yangs pa can pa'i dge slong rnams kyis srol btod pa'i lam lugs gsar pa der skyon brjod dang dgag pa mdzad thog gso sbyong gnang ste bka' bsdu ba gnyis pa mdzad/ 'di'i lo rgyus zhib pa/ bu ston rin chen grub kyis mdzad pa'i chos 'byung gsung rab rin po che'i mdzod〉nang gsal/(61) kha che'i yul/ 'di yongs grags su /smir zer ba'i rgyal khab de yin cing / shar phyogs ni rang rgyal gyi bod ljongs mnga' ris dang sa 'brel/ lho phyogs ni nyin rdo dang sa 'brel/ nub dang byang ni pa ci si than gyi sa dang 'brel ba yin/ ༄ mi grangs mang che ba kha che'i rigs dang chos lugs ni sangs rgyas shākya mu ni mya ngan las ma 'das phan chad kha che'i chos lugs yin kyang / sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas yun ring ma song bar dgra bcom pa nyi ma gung pas yul der byon nas sangs rgyas chos lugs dar spel btang ba de nas bzung sangs rgyas chos lugs gtso bo byas pa dper na〈thang san jong gi lam yig〉las/ skabs der yul de na theg pa chung ngu'i dge 'dun lnga stong tsam yod pa'i dgon pa chen po gcig dang / sangs rgyas shākya mu de'i tshems yin zer ba sogs yod pa dang / yul de'i slob dpon dge 'dun grags pa sogs las rig gnas dang / theg pa chen po'i chos mang po nyan par bshad cing / bod du sangs rgyas chos lugs thog mar dar ba nas/ dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i mjug tu ru rkaḥyi dmag dpung gis rgya gar sgo phyogs phud pa'i dbus dang nub gnyis dbang bsgyur ma byas bar du sangs

0 76rgyas chos lugs gtso bor byed pa dang / bod du skad grags yod pa'i bod rigs lo tsā ba chen po mang po yang kha che'i yul du sangs rgyas chos lugs slob sbyong byas pa'i gnas tshul lo tsā ba so so'i rnam thar dang lo rgyas tshor 'khod yod/ gzhan yang bod du skad grags yod pa'i kha che sha kha zlo zer ba'i me tog gur kum gyi 'dab lo bod sman thog med du mi rung ba de yang yul de nas thon cing / sangs rgyas shākya mu ni sku bzhugs skabs nas bzung 'jom gling thog skad grags yod pa'i ka shi ga'i ras dang du ku la zer ba'i skad grags can de yang yul de nas thon par bshad/(62) ka ji ba 'di ni sangs rgyas shākya mu ni sku mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgya phrag kha shas 'das pa na kha che'i yul du byung ba'i rgyal po stobs chen zhig yin par jo nang tā ra nā thal brtsams pa'i rgya gar chos 'byung〉las bshad/(63) bka' bci ba gsum pa/ 'di la bshad srol mi 'dra ba sna tshogs zhig yod pa/ (bu ston chos 'byung〉nang gsal zhing / jo nang tā ra nā thal brtsams pa'i rgya gar chos 'byung〉gi nang bshad pa de rang khungs btsan par bsam nas 'dir de bzhin du 'god na/ rgya gar yul dbus kyi rgyal po mya ngan med gyi bu'i yang tsha(mya ngan med la bu bcu gcig yod pa'i nang gi gtso bo ku na la yin cing / de rab tu ma byung gong gi bu mya ngan bral dang de'i bu dpa' bo'i sde yin)rgyal po dpa' po'i sde'i dus su/ yul ma ru tshe'i phyogs na/ tshong dpon zhig gi bu lha chen po zer ba/ pha dang / ma dang /dgra bcom pa gsum bsad myong ba zhig yod pa des rang gi sdig nyes la skrag nas kha che'i yul du yong ste/ rang gi sdig nyes gsang nas dge slong byas/rig pa shin tu no bas sangs rgyas chos lugs la mkhas par gyur/ rang gi

178tshogs byung ba bsdoms na lo brgya ma zin tsam byung / de nas kha che'i yul gyi rgyal po /ṇi kās srid dbang bzung nas yun ring song ba'i dus su rtsod pa de dag zhi bar byed 'dod nas dza landhara'i dgon par/ dge slong dgra bcom pa thob pa dang / 'bras bu thob pa yan chad bsdoms pa'i lnga brgya dang / byang chub sems dpa' lnga brgya dang / 'bras bu ma thob pa'i so so skye bo'i sde sgod 'dzin pa ha cang mang po dang bcas gdan drangs nas/ sangs rgyas chos lugs lta ba mi 'dra ba bco brgyad du gyes pa tshang ma sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa dang mthun pa yin par khas len gnang nas rtsod pa zhi bar byas shing / de sngon yi ge'i thog bkod ma zin pa'i 'dul ba dang / mdo sde/ mngon pa bcas yi ge'i thog tu thog mar bkod/ sngar yi ger 'khod zin pa rnams la'ang zhus dag byas te sangs rgyas kyi bka' phyogs gcig tu bsdas pa der/ lo rgyus thog bka' bsda ba gsum pa zer/ 'dir gnad bsdang tsam go rim bsgrigs nas bkod pa can pa las/ zhib par/ jo nang ṭwāṃ ra nā bas brtsams pa'i rgya gar chos 'byung〉le'u bcu gcig pa dang / bcu gnyis pa gnyis su gsal bas der gzigs/(64) bstan pa gtad/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bshad srol la chos lugs gang dang gang yin kyang chos lugs de gsar gtod byed mkhan gyis rang nyid 'da' khar rang gi slob ma'i nang nas yon tan 'dzom shing yid ches ldan pa zhig rang nyid kyi shul rgyan 'dzin mkhan du bskos pa der bstan pa gtad pa zer zhing / skabs 'di ni sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'da' khar nyan thos 'od srung chen po la bstan pa gtad/ des kun dga' bo la gtad/ des shā na'i gos can la/ des nyer sbas la/ des lhar trī ka la/ des nag po pa la/des legs mthong chen po la gtad pa la bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun zer/

179(65)klu sgrub(mgon po klu sgrab)/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi lo rgyus thog mtshan snyan grags shin tu che༄ ba'i rgya gar gyi slob dpon/ shing rta'i srol 'byed gnyis kyi nang tshan zhig slob dpon 'di dus skabs gang 'dra zhig la byung ba ni/ bod kyi lo rgyus mkhas pa mang po zhig gis gsungs pa ltar na/sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo bzhi brgya tsam song ba'i dus su byung bar bshad cing / jo nang tā ra nā thas brtsams pa'i rgya gar chos 'byung〉gi nang mgon po klu sgrab kyi lo rgyas thang du bshad par/ slob dpon 'di'i ska tshe'i smad du rgya gang lho phyogazlo kyi rgyad du byon nas sangs rgyas chos lugs dar ༄ spel mdzad pa'i dus skabs su/ ༄tho gar gyi yul gyi rgyab shu li ka zhes bya ba'i yul('di thur chis dang thag nye ba'i zhus li ya zer ba de yin nam brtag)du song nas kla klo'i chos lugs thog mar brtsams nas/ rjes su de'i slob ma be khams pa zhes bya bas kho la slob sbyong byas rjes ma kha'i yul du song('di dbyi tā li'i rgyal sa lo ma'i ming rnying pa yin nam snyam)nas kla klo stag gzig gi chos lugs dar spel gtong 'go tshugs zhes bshad pa dang / slob dpon 'di nyid sku che'i smad du rgya gar lho phyogs su byon pa'i dus spyi lo'i dus rabs dang po'i 'go tshugs pa yin tshod 'dug kyang / de las gsal ba'i lo rgyas zhib cha da phan kho bos ma mthong / slob dpon 'di nyid rgya gar lho phyogs sdu dar bha zhes bya ba'i yul du bram ze 'byor ldan zhig gi khyim du 'khrungs shing / mtshan mkhan la bstan pas tshe ring shos la lo bdun las mi thub zer bas/ pha ma gnyis kyis bu shi ba'i ro mig gis mthong ma bzod par g.yog dang bcas yul gzhan du 'khyam du btang / rim gyis rgya gar yul dbus kyi dgon pa che shos nā len drar phebs te slob dpon bram ze sa ra ha dang mjal te tshe dbang zhus/ gzhan gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa'i gsang sngags kyi chos mang po gsan/ dgon

180pa'i mkhan po sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po'i drung du dge slong gi sdom pa zhus te/mtshan dge slong dpal ldan zhes btags/ dgon pa'i zhal ta pa(grwa pa rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i gnyer pa)gnang ring mu ge chen po byang ste/ gling phran zhig nas gser 'gyur gyi rtsi blangs nas gser btsong pa'i ༄rin gyi thog nas dge 'dun la 'tsho ba sbyar/ de'i gnas tshul dge 'dun tshos dris pa na lan drang por gsungs pas/ dge 'dun la gnang ba ma zhus par tshong byas nas 'tsho ba sbyar ba chos khrims dang 'gal ba yin zer te gnas nas phyung(sgrigs btsugs nas phud pa)/de nas yul gzhan du byon nas lha khang dang mchod rten mang po bzhing shing /rdo rje gdan gyi byang chub kyi shing gi mtha' bskor du rdo'i dra mig gi rwa bas bskor/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs('di rgya gar shar lho'i phyogs su 'bar ma dang thag nye bar yod pa'i gling phran grong khyer gyi dkyil du mchod rten chen po yod pa zhig)kyi mchod rten la lcags ris bskor zhing lcags ri'i nang du lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad yod pa bzhings/ ska tshe'i smad la rgya gar lho phyogs kyi yul mtha' gri sta ra zer ba'i yul gyi rgyal porā pho brang dang thag nye ba'i dpal gyi rir gtso bor rgyun bzhugs gnang ste sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi dbu ma'i lta ba dar spel mdzad/ slob dpon 'di dgung lo drug brgya bzhugs zer ba dang /sum brgya bzhugs zer ba'i bshad srol gnyis yod kyang de gnyis ka lo phyed la lo gcig tu brtsis pa'i lugs yin zhes jo nang tā ra nā thas brtsams pa'i rgya gar chos 'byung〉las bshad pas gang ltar ska tshe ring po zhig bzhugs pa 'dra/slob dpon 'dis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos zlo dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab〉 rigs pa drug cu pa〉 〈stong nyid bdun cu pa〉 (rtsod bzlog〉 zhib mo rnam 'thag〉(mdo kun las btus pa〉〈rmi lam yid bzhin nor bu'i gtam〉chos byed khyim pa la gdam pa bshes springs〉 〈rgyal po bde spyod bzang po la gtam du bya ba

181rin po che'i phreng ba〉chos byed rab byung la gdams pa byang chub kyi tshogs〉gsang sngags kyi lta spyod mdor bsdas te bshad pa rgyad kun las btus pa〉dbu ma'i lta ba gtan la 'bebs pa byeng chub sems 'asgrol〉gsang sngags kyi bskyed rim ston pa mdor byas〉 mdor bsre〉〈dkyil chog nyi shu pa〉gsang sngags kyi rdzogs rim ston pa rim pa lnga pa〉 gso ba rig pa'i bstan bcos sbyor ba brgya pa〉skye bo spyi la gdams pa lugs kyi bstan bcos skye bo gso thigs〉rgyal po'i blon po rnams la gdams pa shes rab brgya pa〉 spos sbyor gyi bstan bcos mig mangs ris kyi sbyor ba〉rtsis kyi bstan bcos sten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i gtsug lag gi de kho na nyid〉bcas/ cha tshang ba bod skad du 'gyur zhing re gnyis tsam ma gtogs mang che ba rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi dus bod skad da bskyar ba/ bstan 'gyar gyi nang da yod/ slob dpon 'di nyid kyi lo rgyus thed dreg thog bkod pa ces shos ni༄/ jo nang tā ra nā thas brtsams pa'i(bka' babs bdun ldan gyi brgyud pa'i rnam thar rin po che'i 'byung gnas〉su gsal bas der gzigs/(66) arya de ba/ (slob dpon arya de ba)bod skad du slob dpon 'phags pa lha zer)'di slob dpon klu sgrab kyi sku tshe'i smad kyi slob ma/sangs rgyas chos lugs pa rnams kyis slob dpo klu sgrab dngos dang khyad med pa'i rtsi ba cu/ra dang dad gus zhu yul dang / sadros rgyas chos lugs tsam ma zad mu stegs pa'i grub mtha' la yang ha cang mkhas pa zhig yin/ bod kyi lo rgyas 'ga' zhig nang bshad srol la slob dpon 'di siṅgala'i gling gi(deng sang ṅge sri lan)rgyal po'i skyed tshal nang gi me tog padma'i nang brdzus te 'khrungs zhes gsal yang / rgya gar gyi lo rgyus khungs ma ltar na/ siṅgal gling gi rgyal po pañtsa sri gam zhes pa'i sras yin par bshad yod tshul tā ra nā thas brtsams pa'i

182〈rgya gar chos 'byung〉gi nang gsal/ mkhan po he ma de wa las rab tu byung zhing dge slong gi sdom pa zhus/ de nas rgya gar gyi skam sa chen po'i thog yod pa'i lha khang dang mchod rten rnams mjal bar phebs/ skabs der slob dpon klu sgrab lho phyogs rgyud du phebs pa dang stabs khel nas mjal te/ slob dpon gyi byeng du mdo sngags kyi chos mthar phyin pa gsan/ slob dpon klu sgrab sku 'das khar bstan pa'i bdag por bskos nas rgya gar sto phyogs kyi rgyad du rmings rgyas chos lugs dar spel gnang ste/ lha khang dang gtsug lag rteng nyi shu rtsa bzhi bzhengs/ de thams cad du chos gzhi(chos lugs slob sbyong byed pa'i rten gzhi)btsugs/ bram ze thub dka' nag po zhes pa rtsod pa la 'gran zla med pa de pham par mdzad nas rang nyid kyi slob mar gyur pa'i mtshan la slob dpon dpa' bo zhes zer zhing / na len dra dgon par yang yun ring du bzhugs/sku tshe'i smad du rgya gar sto phyogs kyi rgyad rang du bzhugs nas der ska 'das/slob dpon 'dis brtsams pa'o bstan bcos la/ dbu mas lta ba rgyas par bshad pa dbu ma bzhi brgya pa〉de mdor bsdas nas bshad pa dbu ma lag pa'i tshad〉de la rtsod pa spong ba 'khrul pa bsdug pa'i gtan tshigs grub pa〉mtshan nyid dang sngags kyi grub mtha'i rnam gzhag ston pa ye shes snying po kun las btus〉gsang sngags kyi lta spyod gtan la 'bebs pa spyod pa bsdas pa'i sgron ma〉de rigs pas sgrab pa sems kyi sgrib sbyong〉smin byed dbang sgo cho ga la rdo rje gdan bzhi'i daskul chog snying po mdor bsags〉bskyed rim ston pa rdo rje gdan bzhi'i sgrab thabs〉la sogs pa mdzad pa rnams/ dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i nang bojo kyi lo tsā ba pa tshab nyi ma grags sogs kyis rim bzhin brgyar ba/ bstan 'gyur snar thang dpar ma'i sngags phyogs pod/ (za)pa dadro / mdo phyogs (tsa) pa'i nang yod/ slob dpon 'di'i lo rgyus rgyas pa/

183bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i bu ston chos 'byung〉dang jo nang tā ra nā tha'i(rgya gar chos 'byung〉le'u bcu bdun par gsal bas der gzigs/(67)bla ba grags pa/ (slob dpon zla ba grags pa)deb ther 'dir slob dpon 'di 'jom gling rgyan drug gi gras su bgrang 'dug kyang / bod kyi lo rgyas yong grags su slob dpon arya de ba bgrangs pa las/ slob dpon 'di bgrangs srol med/ slob dpon 'di slob dpon klu sgrab kyi dngos slob yin min la bshad srol mi 'dra ba sna tshogs 'dug kyang slob da na rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa sgron gsal〉nang slob dpon klu sgrab kyi dngos slob yin par gsungs pa ma zad jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti shas thedzad pa'i byang chub lam sgron〉las kyang / slob dpon 'di slob dpon klu sgrab kyi dngos slob yin par gsungs pas de la nor 'khrul med/ sku 'khrungs pa'i yul rgya gar lho phyogs sa madhar yin cing / chung dus nas rig gnas mtha' dag la mkhas par sbyangs/ sto phyogs kyi rgyud de nyid du rab tu byung /slob dpon klu sgrab dang / slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyangs dang / slob dpon legs ldan 'bresprad kyi slob ma mang po las mdo sngags kyi chos mang po gsan cing / lhag par dbu ma'i gzhung dang gsang sngags kyi gzhung la sbyangs pa mthar phyin pa mdzad/ na len dra yi dgon pa'i mkhan po yun ring du mdzad de/ sku tshe'i smad du rang nyid kyi 'khrungs yul lho phyogs kyi rgyad du byon nas lha khang dang dgon pa mang po btab/ dgung lo sum brgya tsadro bzhugs zer ba bden min ji ltar yang sku tshe ring po bzhugs par mngon te khong gi slob ma rigs pa'i khu byag che ba dang / de'i slob ma rigs pa'i khu byag chung ba/ (bla ma byams pa'i (la 'byor pa)yin la/ de'i slob ma jo bo che po a ti sha yin cing / jo bo chen po ni bod kyi rab byung gong gi chu rta/ spyi lo 982lor sku 'khrungs pa

184dang dgungalodrug cu re gcig pa bod kyi rab byung dang po'i lcags 'brugaspyi lo 1040lo'i lo mjug la rgya gar nas bal yul brgyud mnga' ris su phebs pa yin pas mgon po klu sgrub kyi sku che'i smad dus rabs dang po 'go tshugs pa nas/ jo bo chen po 'khrungs pa'i bar dus rabs dgu la lo dgu brgya lhag tsam yod pa tshang mas mkhyen gsal ltar sangs rgyas chos lugs la lhag bsam rnam dag gis dad mos byed mkhan tshog de la dogs pa rtsa ba nas byed kyi med kyang / lo rgyas dngos gtso smra ba'i lugs ltar byas na sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi lo rgyus brdzu bzo yin pa'i gzhi 'dzin sa lta bur gyur 'dug pa brtag slob dpon 'dis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos la/ (dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab kyi 'grel pa tshig gsal〉〈dbu ma'i bstan bcos chen po dbu ma la 'jug pa〉dang de'i rang 'grel〉〈dbu ma shes rab la 'jug pa〉slob dpon klu sgrab kyis mdzad pa'i dbu ma riṭa pa drug cu pa'i 'grel pa〉 byang chub sems /pa'i rnal 'byor spyod pa bzhi brgya pa'i 'grel pa〉(dbu ma phung po lnga pa〉bcas 'di rnams mang che ba spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i nang / nag tsho lo tsā ba dang / pa tshab lo tsā ba sogs kyis bsgyur ba yin/ bstan 'gyur snar thang dpar ma'i mdo phyogs kyi pod/ ('a)(yasteganyis su yod/ gsang sngags kyi skor la/ 〈gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa sgron gsal〉〈gsang ba 'dus pa'i sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i 'grel pa〉'di gnyis spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu pa'i mjug tu/ mnga' ris lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos bod skad du bsgyur ba bstan 'gyur snar thang dpar ma'i sngags phyogs kyi pod/ (sha)par yod/ 〈sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i 'grel pa〉'di gnyis spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i mgor mnga' ris lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos bod skad du bsgyur ba/ bstan 'gyur snar thang dpar ma'i sngags phyogs kyi pod/ (sha)

186par yod/ slob dpon 'di'i lo rgyas skor bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i bu ston chos 'byung〉dang jo nang tā ra twe thas brtsams pa'i rgya gar chos 'byung〉gnyis su gsal/(68) thogs med/ (slob dpon 'phags pa thobs med)slob dpon 'di sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi grub mtha' smra ba bzhi'i nang nas sems tsam pa'i grub mtha'i srol gsar gtod gnang mkhan yin pas shing rta'i srol 'byed chen po gnyis kyi nang tshan gcig tu bgrangs srol yod/ slob dpon 'di dus skabs gang du byung ba bod yig gi lo rgyus tshor gsal ba ma mthong yang / slob dpon 'di dang slob dpon dbyig gnyen gnyis yum gcig pa'i ska mched yin pa dang slob dpon dbyig gnyen dang bod kyi rgyal po lha tho tho ri rshanyis dus mnyam par/jo nang tā ra nā thas brtsams pa'i rgya gar chos 'byung〉nang gsal zhing / slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi slob ma slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po dang bod kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po gnyis dus mnyam par mdo smad pa dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis brtsams pa'i deb ther dkar por〉bshad/ slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po'i slob ma slob dpon dbang phyag sde yin pa dang de'i slob ma slob dpon chos kyi grags pa yin pa/ slob dathecan chos kyi grags pa dang / bod kyi rgyal po srong bcan sgam po gnyis dus mnyam par/ jo nang tā ra nā thas rgya gar chos 'byung〉las bshad pa bcas gung bsgrigs na slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med ni/ spyi lo'i dus rabs bzhi pa nas lnga pa'i mjug bar byung ba yin tshod 'dugaslob dpon 'di'i yab ni rgyal rigs dang / yum bram ze mo pra kā sa shrī la/(rab gsal ngang tshul ma yin)cher longs pa'i dus su rig gnas lnga la mkhas par sbyangs te yum gyis bslab bya byas pa ltar rab tu byung mkhan slob dang dge 'dun gyi g.yog lo gcig mdzad/ de rjes dge slong gi sdom pa zhus nas lo lnga'i

186ring sangs rgyas chos lugs la slob sbyong dang / lo re tshigs bcad khri bcu re'i tshig dang don thams cad khong du chud pa gnang / de nas lo mang po'i ring gsang sngags kyi chos la sgom sgrab dang theg pa chen po'i chos la slob gnyer gnang sku tshe'i dkyil du rgya gang nub phyogs u rgyan gyi yul(deng sang gi a hphu han)dang / rgya gar sto phyogs kyi rgyad du sangs rgyas chos lugs dar spel dang /lha khang dang mchod rten/ chos garno brgya lhag tsam gsar du btsugs/ rang nyid la slob ma khri phrag mang po yod kyang / rgyun du mnyam du gnas pa'i 'khor dge slong nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam las med pa tshang ma sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gnas tshad nges can re yod pa sha stag yin/ sku tshe'i smad kyi mthar rgya gar yul dbus kyi na len dra dgon par lo bcu gnyis tsam bzhugs shing / dgung lo brgya dang lnga bcu bar bzhugs/ mthar grong khyer rgyal po'i khab tu ska mya ngan las 'das/slob dpon 'dis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos la/ yum rgyas 'bring bsdas gsum dang mngon rtogs rgyan gyi don ston pa de nyid rnam nges〉theg pa chen the'i sde sgod gsum gyi don rgyas par stan pa sa sde lnga/ 1 sa yi dngos gzhi/2 rnam par gtan la dbab pa bsda ba/ 3 gzhi bsda ba/ 4 rnam grangs blda ba/ 6 rnam par bshad parā sgo bsda ba〉bcas༄ theg pa thun mong gi don bajes te ston pa mngon pa gan btas〉 ༄ 'di rnams bstan 'gyar snar thang pathe ma'i mdo phyogs kyi skor༄ pod/dzi) (li) (zhi) (zi) lnga'i) (yi)(li) bcas su yod mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel gyi 'grel pa〉 bstan 'gyur mdo phyogs kyi skor pod(ji)par yod/ 〈theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i 'grel pa〉 bstan 'gyur mdo phyogs skor pod(phi3par yod/ de rnams kyi nang nas theg pa chen po rgyad bla ma'i 'grel pa〉 de dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i mgor bsgyur ba tsam rā gtogs/ de byings tshang ma dus rabs brgyad

/87pa'i dkyil rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi skabs/ lo tsā ba zhang ye shes sdes bsgyur ba yin/ slob dpon 'di'i lo rgyas rgyas pa jo nang tā ra nā thas brtsams pa'i rgya gar chos 'byung〉le'u nyi shu rdzu gnyis par gsal/(69) dbyig gnyen/ (slob dpon dbyig gnyen)'di slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med dang yum gcig pa'i gcung po yin cing yab ni bram ze'i rigs yin/ slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med rab tu byung ba'i phyi lo der 'khrungs/ chung ngu'i dus na len dra dgon par rab tu byung / theg pa chung ngu'i sde snod gsum cha tshang bar slob sbyong gnang / da dung kha che'i yul du byon nas slob dpon dge 'dun bzang po'i drung du theg pa chung ngu'i grub mtha' rigs mi 'dra ba bco brgyad dang / mu stegs kyi lta ba rigs mi 'dra ba drug gi rig pa'i gzhung lugs mtha' dag khong du chud par mdzad de yul dbus ma snya dhar byon/ slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med kyi drung du theg pa chen po'i chos mtha' dag gsan/ skabs der mi yul du yod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' theg pa che chung gi mdo sde kun bsdoms par mdo lnga brgya tsam thugs la bzung nas lo rer thengs re blo thog nas zhal 'don gnang / slob dpon 'di theg pa chen po'i chos la zhugs pa'i shugs 3na la brten nas theg pa chung ngu'i mkhas pa lnga brgya tsam theg pa chen po'i chos la zhugs/ rgyan du sa gnas gzhan dag tu ma byon par ma bha tta rang du bzhugs nas chos 'drod nyan dang / lha khang rnying pa rnams nyams gsos/ theg pa chen po'i chos gzhi brgya dang brgyad gsar du btsugs/ rgya gar shar phyogs o ḍi bai shar theng gcig byon nas zla ba gsum lhag tsam ring chos gsungs shing / chos gzhi brgya rtsa brgyad gsar du btsugs/rgya gar sto phyogs kyi rgyud du ma phebs kyang bka' bsgos te chos mang po btsugs pa bcas bsdoms na chos gzhi drug brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa bzhi tshugs zhes grags/

188 slob dpon 'di bzhugs pa'i dus su rgya gar shar lho dbus sogs su yod pa'i slob ma theg pa chen po'i dge slong gcig pu bsdoms na yang khri drug tsam dang /slob dpon nyid dang mnyam du gnas pa'i dge slong yang stong phrag longs pa yod/ sku tshe'i smad du slob ma mkhas pa stong phrag lnga tsam mnyam du khrid nas/bal po'i yul du byon nas chos gsungs pa dang / chos gzhi btsugs pa sogs mdzad/ mthar dge slong zhig gis rab tu byung ba'i chos gos gyon bzhin du zhing rmo ba gzigs pa'i rkyen byas te bal yul du sku gshegs/ der slob ma rnams kyis mchod rten yang bzhengs/ dgung lo brgya ma zin tsam bzhugs/slob dpon 'dis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos ha cang mang po yod kyang /grags che zhing bod skad du bskyar ba'i gras la 'phags pa sgo drug pa'i gzungs kyi rnam par bshad pa〉〈chos drozhi pa'i mdo'i rnam par bshad pa〉〈ga ya go ri'i mdo'i rnam par bshad pa〉〈sa bcu pa'i mdo'i rnam par bshad pa〉'di gsum bstan 'gyur mdo phyogs pod(nge)par yod/ 〈blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo rnam par bshad pa〉bstan 'gyur mdo phyogs pod(ci)par yod/ 〈bzang spyod smon lam gyi mdo'i 'grel pa〉bstan 'gyur mdo phyogs pod/ (nyi)par yod/ (mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel pa〉bstan 'gyur mdo phyogs/ (2)par yod/〈dbus dang mtha' rnam par 'byed pa'i 'grel pa〉dang chos dang chos nyid rnam 'byed kyi 'grel pa〉'di gnyis bstan 'gyur mdo phyogs skor pod/ (khri)par yod/ (sum cu pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa〉 nyi shu pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa〉(de'i rang 'grel〉 rang bzhin gsum nges par bstan pa〉 phung po lnga'i rab tu byed pa〉〈rnam bshad rigs pa〉 las grub pa'i rab byed〉〈theg pa chen po'i chos brgya gsal ba'i sgo'i bstan bcos〉'di rnams bstan 'gyur mdo phyogs/(shi)par yod/ (chos mngon pa mdzod kyi rtsa ba〉dang de'i rang 'grel〉bstan

189'gyar mdo phyogs pod(gu)(ngu)gnyis la yod/ 'di rnams nas re gnyis ma rshatogs mang che ba rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi dus lo tsā ba zhang ye shes sdes bod skad du basbyar ba yin/ slob dpon 'di'i lo rgyus skor bu stan chos 'byang〉dang jo nang rū ra nā thas brtsams pa'i rgya gar chos 'byang〉le'u nyi shu rtsa zhuganyis par gsal/ cu(70) phyogs glang / (slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po) slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi slob ma/ tshad ma rig pa la shin tu mkhas pa zhig yin/'khrungs yul ni rgya gar sto phyogs siṅga bsta zhes bya ba gnyi'i yul dang thag nye ba zhig tu sku 'khrungs shing / rigs ni bram ze'i rigs yin/ slob dpon 'di nyid dus/ skabs gang du byung ba ni gong du slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi lo rgyus thad bshad pa der dogs gcod yod/ sku chung ngu'i dus su mu stegs kyi grub mtha' la shin tu mkhas par sbyangs/ nyan thos bye brag smra ba'i slob dpon glang po byin zhes bya ba las rab tu byung zhing / mtshan phyogs kyi glang por gsol/nyan thos kyi grub mtha' la mkhas par sbyangs nas/ mthar slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi drung du byon nas theg pa che chung gi chos mang po gsan/ de nas lo mang po'i ring rgya gar shar phyogs kyi yul oḍi khri sha'i brag phug tu sgom sgrab gnang zhing bzhugs/ de nas thengs cig mu stegs kyi grub mtha' smra ba rū dur dza yas nā len dra dgon par yong nas sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi mkhas pa tshor rtsod gleng byed 'dod pa na/ skabs der na len drar yod pa'i mkhas pa sus kyang rtsod par ma nus par rgya gar shar phyogs nas slob dpon 'di nyid gdan drangs/ slob dpon gyis mu stegs pa de 'dul nas rtsod pas pham par mdzad de sangs rgyas chos lugs la bskyar/ slar yang rgya gar shar phyogs oḍi bai sha rang du phyir log phebs te sku sdu ma rdzogs bar du der bzhugs/ skabs skabs

190su chos lugs gsung ba dang mu stegs kyi rtsod pa bzlogs pa/ bstan bcos rtsom pa sogs mdzad/ yul der gtsug lag khang chen po bcu drug dang / dge 'dun gyi sde chen po bcu drug chos gzhi mang po bcas 'dzugs par mdzad/slob ma ni shin tu mang yang mnyam du gnas pa'i 'khor ni gcig kyang med/bslab khrims rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas yul de'i nags tshal dben pa zhig tu sku 'das/ dgung lo ji tsam bzhugs pa da phan mthong ba'i bod yig gi lo rgyus tshor mi gsal/ slob dpon 'dis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos la/ kha 'thor shin tu mang yang / bod du basbyar zhing grags che ba'i gras/ (tshad ma'i mdo kun las btus pa〉dang de'i drong 'grel〉 dmigs pa brtag pa〉dang de'i rang 'grel〉 dus gsum brtag pa〉〈tshad ma'i bstan bcos rigs pa la 'jug pa〉〈phyogs chos dgu'i 'khor lo〉'di rnams bstan 'gyur mdo phyogs skor pod(ce)par yod/ 〈chos mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa gnad kyi sgron me〉bstan 'gyur mdo phyogs pod(tu)(thu)gnyis la yod yon tan mtha' yas par bstod pa'i 'grel pa〉bstan 'gyur mdo phyogs pod(gi)par yod/ 'di dag las re gnyis ma gtogs mang che ba dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i dkyil du lo tsā ba dge ba'i blo gros sogs kyis bod skad du bskyar ba yin/ slob dpon 'di'i lo rgyus rgyas pa/ bu ston rin po ches mdza/ pa'i bu ston chos 'byung〉dang /jo nang tā ra nā thas brtsams pa'i rgya gar chos 'byung〉le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum par gsal bas der gzigs/(71) chos grags/ (slob dpon chos kyi grags pa)slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po'i slob ma slob dpon dbang phyag sde'i dngos slob yin/ slob dpon 'di dang bod kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgazlo po gnyis dus thog gcig yin par jo nang tā ra nā thas brtsams pa'i rgya gar chos 'byung〉las bshad/ rgya gar sto

191phyogs tri ma la ya zer ba'i yul du 'khrungs/ yab bram ze'i rigs kyi mu stegs ro nyanaji zhes zer/ chung dus rig gnas lnga dang mu stegs kyi grub mtha' la shin tu mkhas par sbyangs nas lo bco brgyad son tshe mu stegs kyi lta ba la shin tu mkhas par gyur/ rjes su sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gzhung la gzigs nas mu stegs kyi grub mtha' dor bas/ pha ma zhang po dang bcas pas khyim nas bskrad/ rgya gar yul dbus su byon nas de'i slob dpon chos skyong gi drung du rab tu byung nas/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gsung rab mtha' dag la mkhas par sbyangs/ slob dpon dbang phyug sde'i drung du tshad ma kun btus〉tshar gsum gsan/ na len drar rtsod gleng du 'ong pa'i mu stegs pa'i mkhas pa graṭa can mang po snga rjes su pham par mdzad/ rgya gar shar phyogs dang sto phyogs kyi rgyud du phebs nas mu stegs pa mang po btul zhing sangs rgyas chos lugs dar bar mdzad de/ lha khang dang chos gzhi brgya lhag tsam gsar du btsugs/ slob ma khri phrag mang po yod kyang mnyam du gnas pa ni lnga las lhag pa med/ ska tshe'i mthar rgya gar sto phyogs kyi rgyad du bzhugs nas/ yul ka ling kur ) ngan las 'das/ slob dpon 'chas brtsams pa'i bstan bcos mang po yod kyang /yongs su grags shing bod du bskyar ba'i gras tshad ma rnam 'grel〉〈tshad ma rnam nges〉 rigs pa'i thigs spro 'di gsum dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i mjug tu rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyis brgyar zhing / 〈gtan tshigs thigs pa〉dang 'brel pa brtag pa〉 〈rgyud gzhan sgrarā pa〉〈rtsod pa'i rigs pa〉bcas/dus rabs brgyad pa'i dkyil du lo tsā dro bande nam mkha' sogs kyis bsgyur ba bstan 'gyur mdo phyogs pod(ce)par yod/ slob dpon 'di'i lo rgyus rgyas pa bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i bu ston chos 'byung〉 dang jo nang tā ra nā thas brtsams pa'i rgya gar chos 'byung〉gnyis su gsal bas der gzigs/

192(72)yon tan 'od/ (slob dpon yon tan 'od) 'di slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi slob ma/ 'dul ba la shin tu mkhas pa zhig yin/ yul bcom brlag tu bram ze'i rigs su 'khrungs/ chung dus su mu stegs kyi grub mtha' dang rig gnas la mkhas par sbyangs rjes su yul der rab tu byung zhing dge slong mdzad/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi drung du theg pa che chung gi sde sdod dang / nyan thos sde pa bco brgyad kyi grub mtha' thams cad la mkhas par sbyangs/ slob ma dge slong stong phrag lnga tsam yod cing / de'i nang sde stod sna re gnyis la mkhas pa lnga brgya tsam yod/ dgung lo bzhi brgya tsam bzhugs zer ba bden min dogs pa yod kyang sku tshe ring po zhig ni bzhugs pa yin tshod 'dug mthar rang nyid kyi 'khrungs yul du mya ngan las 'das/ slob dpon 'dis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos mang du yod kyang bod du 'gyur ba'i nang nas grags che ba'i gras byang sa'i sbyin pa'i rim par phye ba dgu pa yan gyi 'grel pa〉〈byang sa'i tshul khrims le'u'i 'grel pa〉'di gnyis nag tsho lo tsā ba dang /zhang ye shes sde gnyis so sos brgyar ba bstan 'gyur mdo phyogs pod(yi)par yod/ ('dul ba mdo rtsa brnyedapa de'i rang 'grel〉 ('dul ba'i lag len las brgya rtsa gcig pa〉bcas dus rabs brgyad pa'i mjug tu rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi dus cog ro lo tsā ba dang / ga rong tshul khrims 'byung gnas gnyis kyis bsgyur ba/ bstan 'gyur mdo phyogs pod/ (thu)('u)(yu)gsum la yod/ slob dpon 'di yi lo rgyus bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i bu ston chos 'byung〉dang jo nang tā ra nā thal brtsams pa'i rgya gar chos 'byung〉le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum par gsal/(73)shākya 'od/ (slob dpon shākya 'od)slob dpon 'di yang 'dul ba la shin tu mkhas pa zhig yin/ dus skabs gang du byung min mi gsal zhing /

193lo rgyas gsal bar 'khod pa zhig da phan ma mthong / khong gis mdzad pa'i〈'byel ba 'od ldan〉las slob dpon bsod nams grags pa dang / zhi ba'i 'od gnyis kyi slob ma yin par gsungs/ slob dpon 'dis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos la/ bod du 'gyur zhing grags che ba ni 'dul ba sum brgya pa〉dang〈de'i rang 'grel 'od ldan〉gnyis dus rabs brgyad pa'i mjug rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su/ lo tsā ba rtsangs de wand+ra ra smu tas bod skad du bsgyur ba/ bstan 'gyur mdo phyogs pod/ (ha)par yod/(74) rgyal po yin dra rgya blo/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bshad srol la/ o rgyan gyi yul(deng sang gi a hpha han)du rgyal po ind+ra bhu ti snga rjes gnyis byung ba'i rjes ma de ni sangs rgyas myathi ngan las 'das nas yun ring ma song ba'i dus su byung ba yin zer/ skabs der yo rgyan gyi yul du grong khyer 'bum tsho lnga dang / rgyal po gnyis yod pa grong khyer sam bha la'i grong 'bum tsho gnyis dang phyed yod pa rgyal po ind+ra bhu ti la dbang zhing / grong khyer man la pu ra na grong 'bum tsho gnyis dang phyed yod pa rgyal po dza lertsa la dbang / rgyal po ind+ra bhu ti sangs rgyas chos lugs la dga' zhing bu mo gcig yod pa ming la legs smin ka ra zer/ rgyal po dza lend+ra mu stegs pa'i chos lugs la dga' zhing / de la bu gcig yod pa pha mas chung dus nas gnyen sgrigs byed du bcugarjes su bu mo rang nyid khyo bo'i sar mna' mar 'gro skabs khyo bo rgyal po'i sras des bag ma'i ston mo bya ba'i ched du ri dwags ha cang mang po bsad pa mthong nas sems la skyo ba skyes te/ nga'i pha sangs rgyas chos lugs la dad cing /sems can gyi srog gcod pa spang ba'i chos rgyal yin bzhin du/ nga mu stegs kyi rgyal po sdig can 'di 'dra zhig la bag mar gtong phod pa nga la snying rje gtan nas med pa'o snyam nas bag ma'i nor rdzongs su sprad pa'i gser dngul rgyan

kai wa sathegaya tshang ma rang nyid bsu skyel byed mkhan gyi 'khor g.yog kun la bgo bsha' rgyab ste/ nga rgyal sras sdig can de'i mna' mar mi 'gro zer nas smyo brdzu btab/ de'i gnas tshul phyogs gnyis gas shes nas bu mo rang gang 'dod byed du bcug pa las bdag sprod ma byas/ rjes su bu mos nyin mo smyo brdzu btab/mtshan mo chos byas te grub pa thob nas/ thengs cig rgyal po dza lend+ra ri dwags rngon par phyin pa'i dus su lam nor te/ bu mo yod sa'i brag phug tu slebs nas blta skabs grub pa thob par shes nas chos nyan/ rang nyid kyi rgyal srid bu la gtad nas/ bu mo'i drung du chos byas/ bu mo'i pha ma la yang de'i gnas tshul yi ge btang bas/ bu mo'i pha rgyal po ind+ra bhu ti yang rgyal srid bu la gtad nas chos byas te lo bcu gnyis song ba na grub pa thob/ de nas rgyal po dza lend+ra yang yun ring ma song bar grub pa thob nas rang nyid kyi mnga' 'bangs thams cad sangs rgyas chos lugs la basbyar nas/ rang yul du gtsug lag khang bdun brgya tsam bzhings zhes bshad sro/ yod/rgyal po 'dis brtsams pa'i bstan bcos bod skad du brgyar zhing grags che ba ni/ grub pa sde bdun gyi nang tshan ye shes grub pa〉dang/lhan cig skyes grub〉gnyis yin/ dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i mgor/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po dang / 'bro lo tsā ba shes rab grags kyis bod skad du bsgyur ba/bstan 'gyur sngags phyogs pod(mi)(tsisteganyis su yod/ 'di'i lo rgyus cung zad zhib pa/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon a bhu ka ra/ bod skad du 'jigs med 'byang gnas kyis mdzad pa'i grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i rnam thar dang lo rgyarsha〉pa tshab lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba de'i nang gsal/zlodi sde dger shing dpar yod/(76) sa ra ha/ (slob dpon sa ra ha) slob dpon sgra gcan 'dzin

yangaza—ra slobadapona'adi slob dpon kla sgrabakyirtsaba'iblamayinapas rdzus rabs dang po'i gong tsam du byang ba yin /dra༄/ slob dpon 'di'i 'khrungs )la ni/ lo rgyas 'ga' zhig na/༄ rgya gar lho phyogs be dabha yin zer ba dang /'ga' zhigaca gis rgya gar shar phyogs kyi grong khyer ra dhe zhes bya ba yin zer gang ltar pha ma gnyis ka bram ze'i chos lugs pa yin kyang / rang nyid sangs rgyas chos lugs la dad pa skyes nas nyin mo bram ze'i chos lugs dang / mtshan mo sangs rgyas chos lugs byas/ skabs rer chang yang 'thung bas bram ze rnams chos lugs dang 'gal bar brtsis nas rgyal po la zhus pas rgyal pos gnas nas bskrad/ de nas sangs rgyas chos lugs la rab tu byung nas nā len dra dgon par byon/ slob dpon sgra gcan 'dzin 'od bya ba sogs slob dpon mkhas pa mang po bsten nas theg pa che chung gi chos dang / gtso bor gsang sngags kyi chos gsan de nas gsang sngags kyi lam la bsten nas rtol/sa pa mthon por song ste mda' mkhan gyi bu mo phyag rgyar bsten te spyod pa la gshegs/ ska tshe'i smad du lho phyogs dpal gyi rir byon nas/ der gsangasngags kyi chos mang the gsungs nas slob dpon klu sgrab sogs slob ma 'ga' zhig byung / dgung lo ji tsam bzhugs min lo rgyu/ gsal ba zhig da phan ma mthong zhing / slob dpon des mdzad pa'i bstan bcos la/ bod du 'gyur zhing grags che ba ni do ha mdzod〉(sku'i mdzod 'chi med rdo rje'i glu〉〈gsung gi mdzod 'jam dbyangs rdo rje'i glu〉〈thuṭa kyi mdzod skye med rdo rje'i glu〉 sku gsung thugs yid la mi byed pa'i phyag rgya chen po〉 man ngag tshigs su bcad pa bcu gnyis pa〉 rang byin gyis brla bas pa'i rim pa〉bcas/ lo tsā ba skra bai ro tsa na dang / rma ban chos 'bar gyis bsgyur ba/ bstan 'gyur sngags phyogs pod(mi)par yod/ slob dpon 'di'e lo rgyus rgyas pa jo nang tā ra nā bas brtsams pa'i bka' babs bdun

106ldan gyi brgyud pa'i rnam thar rin po che'i 'byung gnas〉su gsal/(76) khrir la pa/ (grub chen yir wa pa)'di rgya gar du grags che ba'i grub thob cig yin/ dus skabs gang du byung min gsal bar bshad pa'i lo rgyas ma mthong / rigs ni rgyal rigs yin kyang rgyal srid spangs nas na lend+ra dgorsha par rab tu byung / mkhan po dharma mi tras sri dharma pā la zhes(bod skad du dpal ldan chos skyong du grags)btags/ mkhan po de nyid slob dpon du bsten nas mdo sngags kyi chos mtha' dag la sbyangs te mkhas par gyur/ mkhan po de sku 'das rjes na lend+ra dgon pa'i mkhan po mdzad/ de nas yun ring ma song bar grub pa thob pa'i rtags sna tshogs mis mthong nas rang nyid la dma' 'bebs byed pa gsan te dgon pa'i sgrigs 'dzugs nas kha bral te spyod pa la gshegs/ slob dpon 'di'i lo rgyus gzhan dag skor gangs rgyas chos lugs la dad pa yod pa tshor ma gtogs dgos pa med stabs 'dir ma bris/ gzigs par 'dod na/ lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar〉pod gsum sde dge dpar khang du shing dpar yod pa der gzigs/ (77) gyub chen brgyad cu/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bshad srol la/ gsang sngags kyi lam la brten nas thun mong gi dngos grub brgyad dam/ska tshe de la sangs rgyas pa 'am/ mchog gi dngos grub gang rung thob pa la grub chab dang grub chen zer/ grub chen 'di rnams dus skabs gang du byung ba na/jo nang tā ra nā bas brtsams pa'i rgya gar chos 'byung〉las/ nang pa'i slob dpon grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhir grags pa phyed lhag tsam slob dpon chos grags kyi dus man chad nas rgyal po tsa na gas srid dbang bzung ba yan chad du byon pa dang / rgyal po go pā la nas rā ma pā la'i bar pā la bdun brgyad kyi ring gsang sngags kyi lam la bsten nas grub pa thob pa shin tu mang bar byen

zhes bshadapaltar na/ grab thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'inang mngache ba //7kyi rab byang gong gi shākya'i 'ardos so('di'i nang gi shākya'i 'das lo rnams kha che paṇa sdun shākya skyi'i lugs kyi 'das lo gzhir bzung ba yin) 1166lo bod kyi rab byung gsum pa'i mjug bar dang / (spyi lo'i dus rabs bdun pa nas dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i mjug bar)gyi lo drug brgya tham pa'i ring der byung bar mngon/ 'dir grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i ming tsam smos na/ 1 lu i pa/ nya sto ba/ ཿ dha ri ka pa/ smad 'tshong la g.yog byed pa/ 3 ḍim ke pa/ 4 li lapa/ 6 bar wa pa/ dpal ldan chos skyong / ca sam snyi ba 7 sha wa ri pa/ ri dgas rngon pa/ ci sa ra ha pa/ bram bres ra ha pa/ 9 ka ka li ba/ nyal po la dga' ba/ 10 mi na pa/ nya pa/ 11 go rakṣa pa/ rkang lag med pa/ 12 tsa 'ur kha pa/ ba lang skyong / 13 khri na pa/ rol mo la chags pa/14 rasna a ka ra sharnyi/ rin chen 'byang gnas zhi ba/ 15 tog tse pa/ 'jor thogs mkhan/ 16 ha: ༄pa/ thags mkhan/ 17 tsa ma ri pa/ lham mkhan/ 18 khaṅga pa/ ral gri can/ 19 thu sgrab slob dpon klu sgrab/ 20 kaṇḍa pa/ nag po spyod pa/ 21 ka na ri pha/stoslob dpon adrug de ba/ 22 the ge na pa/ brdzun la dga' ba/ 23 te lo pa/ til brdong mkhan/ lha nā ro pa/ paṇa chen nā ro pa/ 26 sha li pa/spyang gi pa/ 16 tsa ta pa/ chos slong mkhan/ 27 bha ha pa 28 lha khan dhi pa 29 a dzu gi/ le lo can/ 30 sa ka la pa/ smyon pa/ 31 com bai ba/ khrus mkhan/ 32 me ko pa/ dur khrod pa/33 ka ma ri pa/ mgar ba/ 34 dza lan dha ra pa/ 'bar ba 'dzin/36 ra hu la/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ 36 bharma pa/ chos smra ba/ 37

198bho ka ri pa/ sdod 'khur ba/ 38 me dha ni/ zhing pa/ 39 san dza la/ 40 dril bu pa/ 41 a yo gi 42 tsa lo gi/ 48 gu hu ri pa/ bya pa/ 44 lu mi ka/ tsog 'dug skog langs/ 45 rkam ka la/ gdu bu pa/ 46 rkam pa li/ la wa pa/ 47 lha de pa/ 48 ten ta pa/ cho lo pa/ 49 ku ku ri pa/ khyi la dga' ba/ 60 ku dzha li/ ltag lnga can/ 61 dharma pa/ thos shes can/ 52 ma dhi la/ nga rgyal can/ 63 a tsi sta/ shing 'tshong mkhan/ 54 bha la ha/ 66 na li pa/ 'dam gyis ma gos pa'i padma/ 56 2 su ku pa/ 'du shes gsum pa/ 57 nd+ra bo dhi/ byang chub dbang po/ 58 legs smin ka ra/ de'i sku mched(mo) 59 dza lend+ra pa/ 'bar ba'i dbang po/6) ni ra gu na/ yon tan med pa/ 61 tsa ba ri pa/ 'khur pa 'tshong ba/ 62 tsa pa ka 63 snyi kha na/ 64 til brdung pa/ 65 ku ma ri/ 66 du me ba/ 67 ma ṇi bha dra/(mo) 68 rnal 'byor ma me kha la/69 de'i sku mched/(mo) 70 ka na da pa/ mu cor smra ba/ 71 kan tha li pa/ 'tshem bu pa/ 72 sto pu ri pa/ ku sha'i thag pa gcu mkhan/ 73 u dha ri pa/ rdzu 'phrul gyis 'phur mkhan/ 74 ka pā li pa/ thod pa can/75 gi ra pa/ srid dmag la dga' ba/ 76 mtsho skyes rdo rje/ 77 surba bha ga la/ mthong tshad za ba/ 78 na ga bo dhi/ klu'i byang chub/ 79 khur li pa/ bris sku 'chang ba/ 80 pa na ha/ mchil lham can/ 81 ko ka li pa/ bya ko ka li la dka' ba/ 82 a na ka/ lus bzang pa/ 83 samund+ra/tshong byed mkhan/ 84 bya ri pa/ bcud len mkhan bcas yin/ spyir gsang sngags bla med kyi lam la brten nas grub pa thob pa ni slob dpon klu sgrab kyi dus kho nar lnga stong lhag tsam byung bar bshad cing / yongs grags su ༄grub thob

/99brgyad cu rtsa bzhi dang grub thob brgyad cu zhes grags pa ni/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pas tshogs 'khor mdzad pa'i skabs dngos su byon pa'i grub thob gyi grangs la brgyad cu byung bar brten nas ming de ltar grags pa yin zer srol yod/ grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i lo rgyus mdor bsdas zhig rgya gar gyi slob dpon a bhu ka ras mdzad pa'i grub thob brgyad cu mig bzhi'i rnams thar dang lo rgyas〉bod kyi pa tshab lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba zhig sde da khro shing dpar yod/(78) 'bras bya dang sgrub pa'i dus/ 'di'i 'grel bshad gong gi mchan rtags 76par gsal/(79) lung dang mdzon pa'i dus/ 'di'i 'grel bshad gong gi mchan rtags ang 76par gsal ba der ltos/(80) rtags tsam 'dzin pa/ sangs rgyas chos luṭa kyi bshad srol la/ sangs rgyas shākya mu de'i chos lugs 'jig rten 'di ra gnas pa'i gnas tshad la lo lnga stong yod pa'i tha ma'i lo lnga brgya ni/ rab tu byung ba rnams skra bregs pa dang / rab byung gi rtags tsam 'dzin pa ma gtogs lung gi yon tan dang / chos kyi go rtogs lta ci/ tha na rab byung gi sdoms khrims tsam yang med par 'gyur pa'i dus yin pas ming de ltar thogs pa yin zer/(81) can tra bdun/ rgya gar gyi lo rgyus su/ rgya gar shar phyoṭa bam bha la/ (deng sang rgya skad du mong ca la zer)zer bar tsand+ra'i riṭa las byung ba'i rgyal po tsand+ra'i ming can bcu dgu byung ba'i(1 ha ri tsand+ra/ 2 a kṣa tsand+ra/ 3 dza ya tsand+ra/ 4 mi tsand+ra/ 5 pha ni tsand+ra/ 6 bhang sa tsand+ra/lha sa la tsand+ra/ 8 tsand+ra gasbra/ 9 2 tsand+ra/ 10 dharma tsand+ra/ 11 karma tsand+ra/ 12 9 kṣa tsand+ra/ 13 mi ga ma tsand+ra/ 1 kā ma tsand+ra/ 16
