359khrims dngos gzhi ci 'dra yin gyi dpyad gzhi'i yig cha da phan lag tu ma son pas 'dir 'bri ma thub/(298) gon cing dben/ (zhon kreng yon)yon rgyal rabs kyi skabs su sa skya nas rgya bod sa mtshams bar gyi lam brgyad sa tshigs kyi khrul la lta zhib byed mi dpon rigs kyi go gnas shig yin par rwasnang / (299) bstan pa'i gtad rabs/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bshad srol la/ bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa sangs rgyas kyis rang nyid kyi slob ma nyan thos 'od srung chen po la chos kyi bdag por bskos pa nas rgyun ma chad par bla ma snga mas rang nyid kyi slob ma rjes ma'i nang nas phul du byung ba zhig 'dams nas chos kyi bdag por bskos pa'i brgyad rim la zer/(300) mkhan brgyud/ (1) rshage slong gi sdom pa gnang mkhan gyi mkhan po'i brgyud pa sto/ bod du sangs rgyas chos lugs bskyar gso byung rjes kyi brgyad pa snga shos ni bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal nas dbus gtsang gi mkhas pa sdu bcu sogs la brgyad pa ni bla chen brgyad pa zer/ (2) rab byang gsum pa'i shing byi spyi lo 1234lor kha che paṇa sdun shākya shrī bod du phebs༄ rjes dge slong gi sdom pa mang po gnang nas tshogs pa sde bzhir gyes pa'i brgyud pa byang ba rnams la paṇa chen brgyad pa zer/ (3) bod kyi dgon pa khag gi chos srid gnyis mi'i bdag po mdzad mkhan gyi mkhan po rim par byang ba'i brgyud rim la go dgos pa'i skabs yod kyang skabs 'dir snga ma garnyes la zer/(301) bshad rgyud/ spyir btang la rtsa rgyad dang bshad rgyud gnyis su phye ba'i bshad rgyud la go dgos kyang / skabs 'char de min par/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gzhung chen po lnga'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i slob khrid kyi brgyud pa la go dgos/

sdi 60 ——————wa wa wa wawa wa (302) 〈lang bar gshegs pa'i mdo'i 'grel pa〉 (lang kur gshegs pa'i mdo〉ni spyi lo'i dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang bod kyi lo tsā ba 'gos chos grub kyis rgya nag gi yi ge dang rgya gar gyi yi ge las bod kyi skad du bsgyur ba yin zhing / de'i 'grel pa la rgya gar gyi slob dpon bzang pos mdzad pa/ bstan 'gyur mdo(ni)pa'i nang du yod/ 〈lang gar gshegs pa'i mdo'i 'grel pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i rgyan〉bod kyi lo tsā ba 'gos chos grub kyis bskyar ba bstan 'gyur mdo(pi)pa'i nang du yod/skabs 'dir bshad pa ni rāgrel pa phyi ma de yin par mngon/(303) 'dul ba stod dar/ dus rabs bcu pa'i mjug tu mnga' ris gu ge'i rgyal po lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis rgya gar shar phyogs kyi pazlo ta dharma pā la gdan drangs te stod mnga' ris su rab byung gi sde dang / 'dul ba'i bshad pa btsugs/ de nas slob ma pā ra rnam po/sum sogs nas dar spel byung ba nga stod 'dul lugs ze ra/(304) 'dul ba'i bshad rgyud/ dus rabs bcu pa'i dkyil du bod sa gnas su sangs rgyas chos lugs bskyar dar byung skabs bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyi slob brgyud klu mes tshul khrims shes rab dang / sum pa ye shes blo gros sogs nas bod du rab byung gi sde ha cang mang po 'phel zhing / 'dul ba'i bshad pa dang lag len dar rgyas chen po byung ba'i skor deb ther sngon po〉le tshan(kha)pa'i mgo nas mjug bar dang / 〈chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉gyi le tshan(nya)pa'i mgo nas mjug bar gsal (305) bya 'dul nas brgyud/ dge bshes bya 'dul ba 'dzin pa brtson 'grus 'bar nas brgyud pa'i 'dul ba'i bshad pa deb ther sngon po〉le tshan(kha)pa'i grangs 8 ba 5—9 ba skyabar dang / chos 'byung mkhas

361pa'i dga' ston〉le tshan(nya)pa'i grangs 12ba 7—13 ba6bar gsal/(306) paṇa chen shākya shrī/ (kha che paṇa chen)(rab byung gnyis pa'i me lug spyi lo 1127 rab byung bzhi pa'i shing bya spyi lo 1225bar)dgung lo dgu bcu go dgu bzhugs/ 'khrungs yul ni rgya gar nub phyogs kha che'i yul(deng sang gi /smir)du grong khyer khra wa su ra/ yab tshong dpon chen po sa ma dza ya'i sras su 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu nas bzung rig pa'i gnas lnga la sbyangs pa mthar phyin/ dgung lo nyer gsum la rab tu byung / de nas rgya gar shar phyogs su phebs te dgung lo sum cu bar sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa la slob gnyer gnang / de nas dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes nas gsang sngags kyi chos la slob gnyer gnang ste 'jom gling yongs su grags pa'i paṇḍi ta chen por gyur/ rab byung dang po'i mjug dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i lo 'gor nub phyogs du ru spu'i dmag drangs nas rgya gar lha phyogs dang shar phyogs ma gtogs pa nub dang byang dbus bcas yongs rdzogs du ru ku'i mnga' 'og tu tshud de/ pazlo ta dang / mkhas pa/ rab byung mang che ba rgya gar shar phyogs 'bar ma dang / tha'i go can hphu kre sogs su bros phebs shing / kha che paṇa chen sogs nyung shas shig rgya gar byang phyogs bod kyi mtha' mtshams gro mo'i sa khul dang nye ba'i baiḍārya'i tshong 'dus su bros phebs/ der lo ngo gcig tsam bzhugs mtshams/ theb byang gsum pa'i shing byi spyi lo 1204lor/ bod kyi khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i /pal gyis gro mo brgyad nas bod du gdan drangs/ skabs der kha che paṇa chen dgung lo bdun zlo don brgyad la phebs shing / khro phu lo tsā ba dgung lo sum cu las slebs med pa'i sku gzhon nu zhig yin stabs/ khong la chos 'ga' shas gsungs nas rang nyid rgya gar du phyir phebs dgongs pa byung rjes su khong gi slob ma paṇḍi ta 'ga' zhig yod

362pa rnams dang / chos kyi gsung gleng gnang ba de paṇa chen gyis zhor la gsan pas ha cang thugs mnyes te/ bod la lo tsā mkhas pa chen po gzhon nu 'di 'dra yod pa ngo mtshar che gsungs nas khong gis chos nam gsungs kyang lo tsā ba la skad basbyar gnang du bcug phyag tu 'bal ba'i dngos po gang yod lo tsā ba la gnang /༄ lo bcu'i ring bod du bzhugs te sangs rgyal chos lugs dar spel gnang / dgung lo brgyad cu gya brgyad pa rab byung bzhi pa'i shing khyi spyi lo 1214lor bod nas kha che'i yul du phyir phebs gnang / bod du bzhugs ring mang tshogs dang / dad ldan phyug po rnams kyis dngos po 'bul ba rnams sa gnas so so'i dgon pa dang / rten bzhengs sogs la gnang ba las rang nyid kyis sne gcig kyang sger 'dzin mi mdzad/ kha cher yang lo bcu gnyis ring sangs rgyas chos lugs dar spel mdzad de dgung lo go dgu la sku gshegs/paṇa chen 'di'i lo rgyas rgyas pa deb ther sngon po〉le tshan(ba)pa'i mgo nas shog grangs 5ba par dang chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉le tshan(nya)pa'i grangs 13ba 6—20ba 6bar gsal/(307) chu thal sprog ma dgon pa/ sngar lha sa gtsang po'i smad sdu/spya chu shul sa khul du yod pa'i dgon pa zhig 'di'i lo rgyus da phan ma (308) tshogs chen pa/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī bod du phebs rjes dge slong gi sdom rgyun mang du spel ba gnang ba las tshogs pa sde bzhi ste/1 tshogs chen pa/ lha tshogs pa bye rdzing pa/ 3 tshogs dge 'dun sgang pa/4 tshogs chos lung pa bcas byung ba'i nang nas/ tshogs chen pa ni paṇa chen gyi slob ma gtsang pa rdo rje dpal nas brgyad pa'i tshogs pa yin/(309) bye rdzing pa'i tsho'es pa/ gong du bshad pa ltar tshogs sde

36 bstu9re nang gses tshogs pa chen po'i mkhan po sangs rgyas dpal/ (mkhan rabs dang po rdo rje dpal gyi slob ma)gyis snye mo gzhu'i bye rdzing du bzhugs nas sdom rgyan spel ba de nas brgyad pa la tshogs pa bye rdzing pa zer/ (310) bka' gdajes nga / ston pa sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i bka' las yig 'bru gcig kyang ma lus par rang gis nyams su blang bya'i gdams ngag tu khas len pa/ rab byang dang po'i lcags 'brug spyi lo 1040lor jo bo rje a ti sha bod du phebs na lo ngo bcu bdun ring mnga' ris dang / lha sa snye thang / 'phan po bcas su sangs rgyas chos lugs dar spel gtong ba gnang zhing rab byang dang po'i me bya spyi lo 1067lor khong gi slob ma 'brom ston rgyal po'i 'byarngon gnas kyis rwa sgreng dgon pa btab nas gnas gzhi bzung / de nas dathe spel byung ba'i chos brgyud la bka' gdams pa zer/rjes su dus rabs bco lnga pa'i mgor rje tsong kha pas sangs rgyas chos lugs la dag ther gnang ste bka' gdams pa'i chos lugs bskyar du dar spel gtong ba gnang ba nas bka' gdams pa dang dge lugs pa'i chos brgyud gcig tu 'dres nas/ bka' gdams pa'i chos lugs zur du med par gyur/(311) za stong gyi rgyal po/ (lha ga la'i rgyal po)sngar gyi bod yig lo rgyas thog skabs re za hor gyi rgyal po dang / skabs re lha ga la'i rgyal po zhes sdung 'dogs tshul mi 'dra ba gnyis byang / don da deng sang gi meng tsā la'i rgyal khab kyi rgyal po la zer/ ༄ ༄(312) dge 'dun phal chen lde/ phal chen sde pa/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi 'dul ba'i lag len dang / dge slong gi sdom rgyun gyi 'byang khungs mkhan po mi 'asdu ba bzhi las gyes pa'i sde pa bzhi yod pa'i nang nas cu phal chen pa'i sde pa ste/ mkhan po ni nyan thos 'od srungs chen po rnam sbyar gyi

364rnam phran nyi shu rtsa gsum nas bdun bar grwa rtags pa ni dung dkar/ so thar gyi mdo 'don skabs bra khri ta'i skad du 'don pa/ zas snad kyi nang du zas blugs te rang gi mdun du bzhag pa tsam gyis byin len chags pa/ dge slong dang dge tshul khang pa gcig gnas khang gcig gi nang nyal dgos tshe bar du yol bas bcad na nub lhag bsrung ba'i go chod pa bcas su khas len/ de la yang nang gses kyi sde pa mi 'dra ba lnga ste/ 1 shar gyi ri bo pa/ 2 nub kyi ri bo pa/ 3 gangs kyi ri bo pa/ 4 'jig rten 'das par smra ba'i sde/ 6 rtag par smra ba'i sde bcas lnga yod/ de dag so so'i lta ba'i khyad par phran bu yod pa rnams zhib par slob dpon dbyig bshes kyis mdzad pa'i gzhung lugs kyi bye brag bkod pa'i 'khor lo〉dang / slob dpon dul ba'i lhas mdzad pa'i sde pa tha dad pa bstan pa bsdas pa〉bstan 'gyur mdo phyogs le tshan(u)par yod cing / 'jam dbyengs bzhad pa sku phreng dang po ngag dbang brtson 'grus kyis mdzad pa'i grub mtha'i rnam bshad kun bzang zhing gi nyi ma〉le tshan (kha)pa bcas su gsal/ (313) jo bo dzā paṃ ka ra/ (jo bo rje a ti sha)gong gi mchan rtags ang 250par gsal/(314) 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ (dge bshes ston pa)rab byung dang po'i gong gi lo skor tha ma'i shing 'brug spyi lo 1004lo —rab byung dang po'i shing 'brug spyi lo 1064lo bar/ dgung lo drug cu re gcig bzhugs/ 'dir 'brom ston pa'i 'khrungs lo dang dgung grangs 'das lo bcas la mi mthun pa khag bzhi tsam 'dug pa 'dir ma bris/ 'dir ni las chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i bka' gdams chos 'byung mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog〉ltar bris pa yin/ 'khrungs yul ni byang gi gnyan chen

36'i thang lha'i 'og rtsa skye mo/ rus yang gnyer/ yab rta gsum sku gshen dang yum khu 'od bza' lan gcig gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/ chung ngu nas yum gshegs rjes yab kyis ma yar gcig blangs pas rgyan du sdang po byas pa'i rkyen gyis khams su bros phebs bla ma se btsun gyi sar zlozhugs nas nyin mo nang g.yog rta phyags gso ba/ phye 'thag pa sogs mdzad pa'i zhor la slob sbyong dang ma bral stobar gnang / mtshan mor bla ma'i zhing srung sogs mdzad de bla ma'i zhabs 'degs dang rang nyid kyi slob gnyer 'thus sher med pa mdzad/ zhor la pazlo ta smri ti las sgra rig pa dang sang sgri ta'i skad bslabs/ de nas mnga' ris su jo bo rje a ti sha phebs pa gsan ste khams nas mnga' ris su zhabs thang gis mgyogs por phebs pas/ jo bo rje nyin gnyis gsum nas ma 'gyangs par rgya gar du phyir phebs gnang nye ba'i dus su pu hreng rgya zhing zer ba'i grong gi nang du mjal/ de nas dbus gtsang gi dge bshes mkhas pa tshor jo bo rje lta bu'i paṇḍi ta rgya gar nas bod du phebs pa thengs gcig yin pas nges par du bod dbus gtsang du gdan 'dren zhu dgos zhes phyag bris gnang ba ltar dbus gtsang gi mkhas pa rnams kyis jo bo bod dbus gtsang du gdan drangs/de nas jo bo rje khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung gi sar zla ba gsum tsam bzhugs yun ma gtogs sku tshe gcig gi ring nang g.yog gtso bor mdzad de/zhar la go skabs byung tshe chos zhu bar mdzad/ jo bo rje sku mya ngan las 'das nas sku gdung dang phyag dpe sogs slob ma tshor gnang dgos rigs gnang nas sku gdung thugs dam rten bcas dang / jo bos gso skyong gnang ba'i slob ma tshogs pa khag rnams khrid de rwa sgreng du phebs/ rab byang dang po'i me bya spyi lo 1057lor rwa sgreng dgon pa btab/ dngul gyi mchod༄ rten zhig gi nang jo po'i sku gdung rnams bzhugs/ de nas jo po'i slob ma rnams 'brom gyis chos dang

366'tsho ba gnyis mi'i sgo nas bskyangs tshe gcig gi zang rten dge bsnyen du bzhugs pa las rab byung ma mdzad kyang bcaslab khrims bsrung ba la dge slong las kyang lhag pa mdzad/ mthar dgung lo re gcig pa la rwa sgreng du sku gsheṭa/rnam thar lo rgyus rgyas pa las chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i(bka' gdams chos 'byung mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog〉dang / ri bo che dpon tshang tshe dbang rgyal gyis brtsams pa'i sto rong chos 'byung thub bstan gsal byed〉kyi grangs 14 na 5 shog grangs bcu lhag tsam dang chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉le tshan(da)pa'i grangs 14 na —30na bar gsal/(316) dge bsnyen/ rang nyid sangs rgyas chos lugs la dad pa yod kyang rab byang byed pa'i cha rkyen med pa'am/ rab byang gi tshal khrims ring ring ring khas len byed ma nus pa'i mig spang bya lnga spong ba'i dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa slang na chog spang bya lnga ni/ 1 srog gcod pa/ dzi ma byin par len pa/ 3 mi chos bla ma'i brdzun smra ba/ 4 log g.yem byed pa bcas rtsa ba bzhi'i steng du/༵ chang 'thung ba bsnan pa'i spang bya yan lag lnga spong bar khas len pa'i khyim (316) ra sgreng dgon pa/ rab byung dang po'i me bya spyi lo 1057lor jo bo rje a ti sha'i slob ma 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis thog mar btab pa'i dgon pa zhig (deng sang bod rang skyong ljongs lhan grub zhan phod mdo chus kyi khongs)dgon pa der 'brom ston pas gnas gzhi zlotsugs nas dar spel gtong ba gnang ba'i chos brgyud la bka' gdams zer/ de sngon bod la sa gnas srid gzhung btsugs pa nas gzhung skyong dgon pa'i khongs su gtoṭa pa las dge ldan khri thog lnga bcu nga bzhi pa ngag dbang mchog ldan gyis yun ring bar tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i yongs 'dzin

wa wa — ——— wa wa 367gnang ste/ sku ma 'das gong tsam du rwa sgreng dgon pa sger 'dzin du gsol ras zhus pa ltar/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa lug spyi lo 1739lor tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pas rwa theng dgon pa de bzhin khong la sger 'dzin du 'bul ba gnang zhing / khong sku gshegs rjes sprul sku khri chen bstan pa rab rgyas la/ching rgyal rabs kyi gong ma tsā ching khri lo nyi sha pa/ rab byang bcu bzhi pa'i shing phag spyi lo 1865lor gong ma tsā ching lhas slar yang rwa snang dgon pa de rwa sgreng ho thog thu ska phreng rim byon la sger 'dzin du gnang / de nas bzung khri chen gyi ska phreng jom byon la rwa sgreng sprul sku zhes pa'i mtshan thogs pa yin/dgon pa 'char a ti sha rang nyid ska 'tsho bzhugs skabs bris pa'i 'dra thang /dge bshes nag tsho lo tsā bas brtsams pa'i jo bo'i rnam thar bkod pa brgyad cu pa bris pa/ yongs grags su 'dra thang dbu yon ma zer ba de dang / jo bo rje'i thugs dam rten jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje sogs rin thang bral ba'i gna' shul dngos rdzas mang po yod/ sngar rwa sgreng du grwa khang stong / rten lugs ma ngo mtshar che ba lnga bcu skor dang / thang ka sum stong drug brgya lhag tsam/gsung rten po ti sa ya bcu lhag tsam/ gdung rten bdun brgya dang bdun cu don lnga yod ces rwa sgreng gi lo rgyas las bshad/(317) phu chung ba sgozhon nu rgyal mtshan/ (dge bshes phu chung ba)rab byang dang po'i lcags lug spyi lo 1031 —rab byang gnyis pa'i me khyi spyi lo 1176bar lo rgyus zhib pa/ deb ther sngon the le tshan(ca)pa'i grangs 13na3—14na3bar dang / las chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i〈bka' gdams chos 'byang mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog〉bcas su gsal/ sto(318) po to ba rin chen gsal/ (dge bshes po to ba)rab

368 byang dang po'i me yos spyi lo 1027 rab byang gnyis pa'i shing bya spyi lo 1105zlo bar/ bka' gdams pa'i dge bshebaca slob ma la chos 'chad pa la mkhas pa'i mchog ta gar pa zhig yin zhing / lo rgyas zhib pa las chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan sgros༄ mdzad pa'i bka' gdams chos 'byung mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog〉gi nang du gsal/(319) spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar/ (dge bshes spyan snga ba)rab byung dang po'i sa stag spyi lo 1038 rab byung gnyis pa'i chu lug spyi lo 1103bar/ dgung lo don drug bzhugs/ dgung lo nga brgyad pa rab byung gnyis pa'i shing phag spyi lo 1096lor lo dgon pa btab/ lo rgyus zhib pa las chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i bka' gdams chos 'byung〉95ra ba/ra slob/ (320ka) kham pa lung pa/ (dge bshes kham lung pa sgang pa shākya yon tan)(rab byung dang po'i shing glang spyi lo 1086 rab byung gnyis pa'i shing lug spyi lo 1116bar)lo rgyas rgyas pa las chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis brtsams pa'i bka' gdamathe chos 'byung mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog〉gi nang du gsal/(320kha) gtum ston blo gros grags/ rab byung gnyis pa'i me khyi spyi lo 1106 rab byung gsum pa'i me khyi spyi lo 1166bar/ dgung lo re gcig bzhugs/ dge bshes sha ra ba'i slob ma yin/ dgung lo zhe brgyad pa/rab byung gsum pa'i chu bya spyi lo 1153lor snar thang gi dgon pa btab/lo bcu bzhi bar gdan sa bskyangs/ de nas rang nyid kyi slob ma rdo ston shes rab grags bskos nas stod du phebs/ lo rgyas rgyas pa las chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i bka' gdams snacus 'byung mkhas pa'i yid

369'phrog〉na nga gsal/(321) snar thang / snar thang dgon pa/ bod kyi lo rgyas thog snyan grags che ba'i bka' gdams kyi dgon pa zhig yig (deng sang thed rang skyong ljongs gzhis ka rtse shan chu mig chus khongs su yod)rab byang gsum pa'i chu bya spyi lo 1163lor dge bshes sha ra ba'i slob ma gtum storno blo gros grags pas btab/ dgon pa 'di nas mchims nam mkha' grags pa sogs mkhas pa chen po mang du byon/ sngar dus rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i mgor/ bcom ldan rig pa'i ral gri dang / dbus pa blo gsal sangs rgyas 'byam sogs kyis bod sa gnas su yod pa'i bka' 'gyur dang / bstan 'gyur gyi ma dpe yod tshad bsdas nas phyogs bsgrigs gnang ba'i bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur cha tshang dang /rathe byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags phag spyi lo 1731lor pho lha bsod nams stobs rgyas kyis sbyin bdag byas te bzhengs pa'i bka' 'gyur pod brgya tham pa'i par shing dang / de'i rjes su mu mthud nas bzhengs pa'i bstan 'gyur pod nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga'i par shing / ston pa sangs rgyas kyi 'khrungs rabs dpag bsam 'khri shing gi thang ka nyi shu rtsa lnga'i par shing / rje tshong kha pa'i rnam thar cha tshang gi thang ka bco lnga'i par shing sogs par shing shin tu mang ba dang / gzhan yang gna' rabs kyi shul rdzas ha cang mang po yod/(322) dpal ldan gro bdag nyid du/ (gro ston bdud rtsi graṭa)gtum ston blo gros grags kyi slob ma yin lo rgyas zhib cha da phan ma rnyed lags/(323) gnas brtan bcu drugazhusangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bshad srol la/ ston pa sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das khar sgra gcan 'dzin la sogs pa'i dgra bcom pa bcu drug la/ 'dzam bu'i gling du nga'i bstan pa ma nub kyi bar du khyed rnams kyang mya ngan las mi 'da' bar nga'i bstan pa skyong dgos

370zhes bka' phabs pa ltar/ khong rnams kyang 'dzam bu'i gling gi gnas mi 'dra ba bcu drug la bzhugs nas bstan pa dar spel mdzad pa yin zhes bshad srol dang / gnas brtan gyi grag su yod pa'i ha shang de ni thang rgyal rabs kyi gong ma thang tha'i tsung gis rgyal sa khrung an du gnas brtan bcu drug dngos su gdan drangs skabs gnas brtan rnams la sne len zhu mkhan dang / rgyun du gong ma'i mchod gnas dang / gong ma'i sras brgyad kyi dge rgan du bzhugs pa de yin pa dang / gnas brtan gyi gras su yod pa'i dge brnyen dharma tā la ni/ dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i mgor jo bo rje a ti sha bod du phebs nas brag yer par bzhugs skabs nyin gcig gnas brtan bcu drug dngos su phebs te 'brom ston pas gnas brtan rnams la gsol ston gyi byin len zhu mkhan mdzad pa de yin zhes bshad srol/ bod kyi gnas brtan bcu drug gi ska brnyan bris thang dang / 'jim ska ni/ thog mar dus rabs bcu pa'i mjug ṭwāṃ bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal sgro slob ma klu mes 'brom chung gis khrung an rgyal sar phebs nas/ gong ma thang tha'i tsung gis gnas brtan dngos su spyan drangs skabs bzhengs pa'i 'dra 'bag la dpe bshus mdzad de lha sar phebs/ de la ma dpe byas te brag yer pa'i gnas bcu lha khang gi nang du bzhugs pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug gi 'dra 'bag bzhengs par mdzad pa nas/ bod sa gnas kyi gtsug lag khang mang por 'phel rgyas byung zhing / gnas brtan bcu drug po tshang ma rgya gar gyi dgra bcom pa sha stag yin kyang / bod kyi ri mo'i lag rgyan du tshang ma rgya nag gi hā shang dang 'dra bar na bza' phyo thung can sha stag bris ༄grol yod pa'i rgya mtshan yang de yin/ gnas brtan bcu drug po so so'i lo rgyus zhib pa tshe chorsha gling bla ma yongs 'dzin rin po che ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i〈gnas brtan bcu drug gi rtogs brjod〉gsung 'bumadzub)pa'i nang yod/

———— 37(324) grub thob nyang ri khrod pa/ mnga' bdag myang nyi ma 'od zer gsang sngags rnying ma'i bla chen mtshan snyan shin tu che ba zhig rab byung gnyis pa'i shing 'brug spyi lo 1124 rab byung gsum pa'i shing byi spyi lo 1204bar/ dgung lo brgyad cu gya gcig bzhugs/ lo rgyus zhib pa/ rin chen gter mdzod pod dang po'i gter ston brgya rtsa'i rnam thar〉nang gsal/(325) mtshan nyid kyi grwa sa/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i gzhung chen po lnga la slob sbyong gtso bor byed mkhan gyi dgon pa che ba rnams la mtshan nyid kyi grwa sa zer/ de sngon se 'bras dge gsum ma byung gong du/ bod kyi mtshan nyid grwa sa chen po ni dbus kyi gdan sa chen po drug ste/mi gsang phu/ 2 bde ba can rwa ba stod/ 3 tshal gung thang / 4 dga' gdong / nga skyor mo lung / ga zul phu bcas la yongs grags su gsang bde gung gsum dga' skyor zul gsum zer/ rjes su/ dge lugs kyi gdan sa chen po gsum/ dga' ldan/ 'bras spungs/ se ra/ bcas kyi steng /bkra shis lhan po/ ska 'bum/ bkra shis 'khyil bcas kyang mtshan nyid kyi grwa sa chen po〉 gras su /dren srol yod/ 'on kyang dge lugs kyi grwa sa chen po rnams gtso bor mtshan nyid rig pa la slob gnyer byed kyi yod cing / grwa sa'i nang gsang sngags kyi gzhung la slob gnyer byed mkhan grwa tshang zur du yod/(326) bcom ldan ral gri/ (bcom ldan rig pa'i ral gri)dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i mgor byung ba'i bod kyi dge bshes mkhas pa chen po zhig chung dus su snar thang dgon par sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig par slob gnyer mdzad skabs dka' spyad 'bad brtson blo yul las 'das pa gnang / dbus pa blo gsal sangs rgyas 'bum dang mnyam du snar thang gi bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur la zhus dag gnang nas bka' bstan gnyis kyi

372 dkar chag nyi ma'i 'od zer〉zhes bya ba yang brtsams par mdzad/ gzhan yangang tshad ma rig pa'i 'grepa/ pa/ gso ba rig pa'i bstan bcos sogs gsung rtsom pod bcu drug tsam yod/ lo rgyus nyung bsdas deb ther sngon po〉le tshan(cha)pa'i grangs can 7—6 na bar gsal/ cu(327) 'chims nam mkha' grags/ (mchims 'jam dpal dbyangs)bcom ldan ral gri'i slob ma yin kyang thengs shig bla mas mtshan mo 'phyi por dpe gzigs gnang ste bzhugs pa la gdon 'dre yin khul gyis 'jiṭa snang bskul bas rkyen byas bla mas slob ma'i gras nas phud/ de nas sa skyar bzhugs skabs yon rgyal rabs kyi gong ma bu yin thus mchod gnas su gdan drangs/ pho brang shang dor(hrang tu'u)bzhugs skabs mngon pa mdzod kyi 'gre ra bshad mngon pa'i rgyan〉zhes pa/ yongs grags su mchims mdzod〉ces 'bod pa de brtsams pa gnang zhing / 'dis mdzad pa'i tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi 'grel pa zhig kyang yod ces/ deb ther sngon por bshad/ lo rgyas rgyas pa deb ther sngon po〉le tshan(cha)pa'i grangs 5ba 4—6 pa bar gsazlo/(328) chu mig chos 'khor chen mo/ rab byung lnga pa'i me glang spyi lo 127lor 'gro mgon 'phags pa bod du thengs gnyis pa phebs skabs/gtsang gi chu mig ring mor dge 'dun khri bdun 'tshogs pa'i chos 'khor zhig gnang ba de la bod kyi lo rgyas thog chu mig chos 'khor zer/ (329) gral dastuban/ dge 'dun mang po 'tshogs pa'i dus ston skabs gral mgor bzhugs te/ bsngo ba yon bshad sogs mdzad mkhan gyi bla ma/(330) chos khrims/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyis dge slong dang dge tshul/ rab byung bcas la so so'i bsam blo'i chu tshad dang mthun pa'i khrims

373gtan 'bebs gnang ba de la chos khrimasazer khotshosakhrimasade lasa'ag ba byung na/ sang gi nam ma langs tshun chad rang gi khrims grogs dang / yang ca rang dang sdom pa rigs mtshungs yin pa'i sdom ldan zhig la rang gi nyes pa ngos len zhus/ tshe zla ba kha shas ring dman pa'i bya spyod lnga dang len zhus te/nyes chad bcad pa tsam gyis 'thus pa las/ sgrigs 'dzugs nas phud pa'i nyes chad gcod mi dgos/ gal te khrims 'gal byed pos khrims las 'gal nas ngos len ma zhus par sang nyin gyi nam langs na khrims las 'gal nas zhag gcig song zin pas tshogs pa'i sgrigs 'dzugs nang nas phud pa'i chad las thob pa sogs nyes chad lci yang gi rim pa mi 'dra ba yod pa ma gtogs/ lus kyi thog nyes brdang dang / 'dzin bzung byas pa/ btson du 'jug pa sogs kyi khrims gcod sgrod mi chog pa yin/ 'on kyang / bod du chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs dar rjes gong du bshad pa'i chos khrims des dgon pa'i nang du yod pa'i gra pa'i chos khrims legs po yong ba'i 'gan srung byed mi thub par gyur pa dang chabs cig dgon pa khag la bran g.yog dang mi ser mchod gzhis bcas yod pa'i dbang gis kho tshor bkas bkod brgyad 'dzin gyi khrims lugs lag bstar byed pa dang 'dra bar dgon pa'i nang gi cems 'gal grwa pa tshor yang nyes brdung dang / btson 'jug sogs khrims lugs lag bstar byed stangs thad bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi srid gzhung dang khyad par med pa de 'dra byung ba red/(331) bka' gdams gzhung pa/ 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byang gnas kyi dngos slob dge bshes po to ba chen po nas dge bshes sha ra ba rwasags nas gnyal gra skor mkhan chen chos skyabs bzang po'i bar rim bzhin brgyud pa'i khrid srol la bka' gdams gzhung pa zer/ de la bka' gdams

374gzhung pa zhes zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ni bka' gdams gzhung drug( skyes rabs so bzhi pa〉 ched du brjod pa'i tshoms〉〈bslab btus〉〈spyod 'jug〉〈byang sa〉 mdo sde rgyan〉bcas)ste/ skyes tshoms gnyis/ bslab spyod gnyis/ sa rgyan gnyis bcas gzhung drug dang sbyar nas slob khrid gnang srol yod pas ming de ltar btags pa yin/(332) khroms zheng chen po/ dge bshes khroms gzhir ba rin chen seng ge/ (rab byung gsum pa'i chu lug spyi lo 1163—rab byung bzhi pa'i lcags 'brug spyi lo 1220bar)lo rgyas zhib cha da phan ma mthong /(333) skam skam/ lha sa'i nye༄ 'dabs klang shod rgyud da yod pa'i dgon pa zhig ༄ ༄(334) dum bya ri/ lha sa'i nye 'dabs rgya ma khri sgang gi sa khul du yod pa'i bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa zhig(336) rong pa phyag sor pa 'brom ston pa dang / nag tsho lo smo ba'i slob ma yin/ lo rgyas cung zad deb ther sngon po〉le tshan(ca)pa'i grangs 35 ba7—36 na 64ra gsal/(336) 'khrug zlums/ nang 'khrug la bar 'dums byas pa/(337) zur chos pa/ rtsa ba'i slob khrid gnang mkhan min kyang zur du dogs gcod dang bskyar khrid rogs ram gnang mkhan/(338) bstan rim〉rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyi slob ma gro lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i bstan rim chen mo〉'di ni bka' gdams kyi gzhung ha cang legs po zhig yin pas/ rje tsong kha pas(bstan rim chen mo〉'di g.yar po bzhes te gdan drangs skabs spros rings bsnams te rgyang ring po nas bsu ba mdzad pa'i 'o rgyus yod/ ci

375(339) gsang phu ge'u thog rab byung dang po'i chu glang spyi lo 1073lor/ jo bo rje a ti sha'i dngos slob rngog lo tsā ba legs pa'i shes rab kyis thog mar btab/ de yang dgon pa 'debs pa'i sa gnas 'di jo bo rje a ti shas bstan pa gnang zhing / dgon pa ma 'debs bar du gsang ba mdzad par zhu zhes zhus par brten nas gsang phu zhes ming thogs par bshad/thog mar gra pa lnga brgya tsam 'dus pa la rngog gis 'chad nyan mdzad/ rjes su/grwa tshang bcu gcig tu gyes/ mi spel ser/ 2 nyi ma thang / rgyu dgas po grwa tshang / 4 rnam rgyal gser khang / 5 khu spe/ bcas gling stod grwa tshang lnga dang / cu sgrob snying ba/ tshi gzhi ba/ 2 nyang rong / gnas sgo ba/ mi sgros gsar ba/ mimi ra ba stod smad bcas gling smad gra tshang drug ste bcu gcig yod la zhib par gling stod blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sprul ska nyi thang ngag dbang gzhon nu bstan pa'i nyi mas mdzad pa'i gsang phu'i gdon rabs dang skyes chen dam pa'i rnam thar brjod pa pad dkar chun po〉zhes pa der gzigs/(340) gsang sngags rnying ma/ bod du sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gsang sngags chos lugs thog mar dar ba ni rnying ma'i chos lugs yin/dus rabs brgyad pa'i dkyil du rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis srid dbang bzung skabs slob dpon pad ma 'byung / gnas bod du gdan drangs te/ rgyal po dang / blon po/ 'bangs bcas nyung shas la gsang sngags kyi chos mang po gsungs pas slob ma grub thob rje 'bangs nyer lnga zer ba byung / ('di'i skor〈gna' rabs lo rgyas yig cha'i tshig 'grel〉nang du gzigs) gzhan yang rgyal po khri srong lde btsang gyi dus sngags 'chang dharma gi) dang / paṇa chen khri ma la mi tra/ sogs rgya gar gyi paṇḍita mang po bod du byon nas gsang sngags kyi chos

376mang po bod skad du bskyar/ de rjes bod sil bu'i dus mgor rab byung gi sde med par gyur kyang / zhu gsang sngags kyi chos ni slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes kyis lo brgya dang bcu gsum ring bzhugs nas gsang sngags dgongs 'dus kyi skor dar spel mdzad/ de rjes zur chen zur chung sogs kyis gsang sngags kyi bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i skor la brgyad pa mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas phye na gsum yod/ 1 ring brgyud bka' ma/ sto2 nya brgyud gter ma/ 3 zab mo dag snang gi brgyad pa bcas yod/1 ring brgyud bka' ma ni/ rāṇa chen bai ma la mi tra(snga ma)zhes rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su bod du byon pa des rma rin chen mchog dang /gnyags tsā na ku ma ra gnyis la sbya 'phrul gsang ba snying po'i skor gsungs shing de nas brgyud pa'i slob ma mang dusto byung nas gtsang stod mang mgar dang / la stod lho byang / 'bri chu 'bab yul gyi brgyad/ spo 'bor sgang gi sa cha rnams su dar spel byung / yang slob dpon dha༄ na rakṣa tas bal po dharma bo dhi la rtsa rgyad dang / bshad rgyad sogs gsungs/ bru sha'i yul du phrom ru che btsan ces la gsungs nas nyabod skad du basbyar ba las dar spel byung / yang gnyags rnya na ku ma ras lo tsā ba bai ro 1 sna dang g.yu sgra snying po gnyis la rdzogs pa chen po sems phyogs su grags pa zhus/ de nas rim par 'phel ba la sems phyogs zer/ yang lo tsā ba bai ro tsā nas dbang mi pham mgon po la dpal nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud la sogs pa rdo rje zam pa'i man ngag gi skor gsungs shing / de las brgyud pa'i chos brgyud la klong sde zer/ yang slob dpon khri ma la mi tra sngon mas rgyal po khri srong lde btsan dang myang ting 'dzin bzang po gnyis la rdzogs pa chen po snying tig〉gi skor gsungs pa las rjes su kun mkhyen klong chen gyis dar spel gnang ba'i chos brgyud la klong chen snyinge tig

377zer 4/nga slob dpon dga' rab rdo rjes rig 'dzin sri sing hā la mkha' 'gro snying tig〉gi skor gsungs pa las/ snying tig rigs mi 'dra ba gzhan zhig byung bar bshad/2 nye brgyad gter ma/ slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas la soṭa pa'i tshad ldan gyi ces bu dam pa 'ag na zhig gis chos dpe khag gcig ri dang brag sogs la gter du sbas te gter de dus nam gyi tshe 'don dgos pa dang /'don ran pa'i dus rtags/ gter de 'don pa po'i ming rus skye yul/ lo rtags/ lus kyi sha rtags sogs gsal bar 'khod pa'i gter gyi kha byang btab/ rjes su gter de 'don pa'i gnas dus gang zag sogs cha rkyen thams cad 'dzoms pa na gter de bton nas slob ma mang por spel ba la gter chos zer zhing / gter de 'don pa po'i bla ma de la gter ston zer/ gter ston la yang ngo ma dang brdzus ma gnyis yod cing slob dpon padma'i lung gis dngos su zin pa dang ma zin pa bsdoms pa'i gter ston brgya lhag tsam(tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pas mdzad pa'i byang bdag rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar〉las gter ston brgya dang bcu bdun gyi mtshan tho tsam gsal zhing / gter ston so so'i rnam thar zhib pa rin chen gter mdzod kyi pod dang po'i nang yod/3 zab mo dag snang gi brgyud pa/ bla ma 'ga' zhig la dag pa'i snang bar rang nyid kyi bla ma dang yi dam dngos su mjal nas des gsungs pa'i chos rnams gsang ba'i sgo nas slob ma nyung shas la dar spel ga na nga ba der zer/rnying ma'i chos lugs shor zhib par thub bstan 'od gsal bstan pa'i nyi mas mdzad pa'i gsal chen snga 'gyur nges don zab mo'i chos 'byung〉dang / 〈thu'u bkun grub mtha'〉le tshan gnyis pa bcas su gzigs/(341) dge bshes rdo rje gzhon nu/ 'di'i lo rgyus da lta ma

378rnyed/(342) bstan pa'i khur bskur/ sangs rgyas chos lugs dar spel mdzad mkhan gyi rgyun 'dzin par bskos pa/(343) lung / sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab dang / mkhas pa snga ma tshos mdzad pa'i bstan bcos kyi tshig gcig kyang chad lhag med par bla mas bklags shing slob mas legs par nyan pa/(344) rigs pa/ tshad ma'i gzhung nas bshad pa ltar dngos stobs kyi rigs pa dang / yid ches pa'i rgyu mtshan yang dag pa la brten nas gzhung don la dogs pa gcod pa/(345) bka' mdo rgyud/ sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i bka' mdo phyogs dang / sngags phyogs kyi rgyud/(346) 'grel pa/ (1)tshig 'grel/ gzhung gi tshig re re bzhin du go ba skye ba'i 'grel bshad byas pa/ (2)don 'grel/ thog mar nang don bsdas pa'i sa bcad bstan pa rjes su dka' gnad la dogs pa chod nges kyi garshal bshad/ tha mar bshad zin pa'i don gyi snying po go bde bar 'chad pa/(3) mchan 'grel/ gzhung gi brjod don dka' gnad yod pa'i rigs la gsal bshad byas pa/(347) man ngag gzhung don lag len du bstar skabs kyi gal che'i nyams myong /(348) zhang tshe spong chos kyi bla ma/ rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyi slob ma/ 'dis tshad ma rig pa'i 'grel pa 'ga' zhig mdzad yod/(349) zhang kro lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas/ rngog lo kro ba chen po blo ldan shes rab kyi slob ma yin/ 'dis mdzad pa'i lam rim〉

379(bstan rim〉〈tshad ma'i 'grel pa chung ba〉sogs yod/ lo rgyas rgyas pa las chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i bka' gdams chos 'byung mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog〉gi nang du gsal/(350) cha pa chos kyi seng ge gsang phu'i dge bshes gyi nang nas dbu ma dang tshad ma la shin tu mkhas pa zhig yin/ 'di'i 'khrungs lo dang 'das lo da lta ma nges kyang phal cher rab byung gsum pa'i mgo nas mjug bar yin tshod/ khong gis tshad ma rig pa'i gzhung rnams bsdas tshan du bgos nas slob sbyong byed tshul bsdas grwa〉zhes pa'i srol dang / mashān nyid kyi slob gnyer byed mkhan rnams 'dzin grwar bgos nas 'dzin grwa'i nang du slob gnyer ba rnams nyi ma re mos kyis dam bca' bar bsdad nas khas len bzung lugs dang / dri lan 'debs tshul/ rtsod gleng gtong mkhan gyis 'dzin grwa'i dbus su yar langs te thog mar khas len bzung mkhan la gus 'dud gyi rnam 'gyur dang bcas te/ gzan skyor 'bebs nas skad gsang mthon pos bgro gleng 'go tshuṭa pa'i dhi skad gtong ba dang / de nas gzan sked par dkris te skabs su babs pa'i gzhung las 'phros pa'i khas len dri ba dang / thal 'gyur 'phen pa dang chabs cig lag pas thal mo rdeb pa/ khyab mtha' 'god pa/ rgyu mtshan 'dri ba/ 'khor gsum bskor ba sogs kyi srol gsar gtod gnang bas skabs de'i grwa sa chen po rnams su mtshan nyid rig pa'i slob gnyer 'phel rgyas la skul lcag chen po thebs pa ma zad/ slob ma yang rigs pa'i dbang phyag seng chen brgyad/1 gtsang nag pa brtson 'grus seng gi 2 dan 'bag smra rngu'i seng ge mi bru sha bsod nams seng gi rma bya rtsod pa'i seng gi 5 rtsigs dbang phyag seng gi nyang bran chos kyi seng ge skya 'dan ma dkon mchog seng rshaci gnyal pa yon tan seng ge ste rigs pa'i gzhung lugs smra ba la mkhas pa'i

380 phul du phyin pa brgyad sogs byung / bye brag smrabadangamadosdeba'ilugasadonal gyis bzhes cing / slob dpon zla ba grags pa'i lugs la skyon brjod mang du mdzad mkhan zhig yin/ gsung rtsom yang byams chos sde lnga'i 'grel pa dang /tshad ma ma rnam nges〉 dbu ma bden gnyis〉〈dbu ma rgyan〉 dbu ma snang brnya〈spyod 'jug〉bcas kyi 'grel pa dang tshad ma yid kyi mun sel〉rgyas bsdas gnyis sogs mang po yod pa deb ther sngon po〉le tshan(cha)pa'i grang༄sa 3ba6—4na3bar dang / cha pa'i dngos slob gtsang nag pa brtson 'grus seng ges mdzad pa'i rnam thar dad pa'i 'od zer phyogs brgyar 'gyed pa〉zhes bya ba yang yod/(351) 19sa pa bcad/ chos kyi bya ba kho na ma gtogs bya ba gzhan dag mtshams 'jog byas pa/(352) bangapo che/ dbus gtsang gi mkhas pa mi bcu'i nang tshan gru mer tshul khrims 'byung gnas kyis rab byung gong gi lo skor drug cu tha ma'i ma sbral spyi lo 1017lor btab/ rjes su khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung gisang dar rgyas su mdzad pa'i dgon pa zhig(353) ar byang ye shes/ (ar byang chub ye shes dbus pa blo gsal byang chub ye shes) snar thang gi bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur thog mar gsar sgrigs byed skabs bcom ldan ral gri dang / rgyang ro sangs rgyas 'bum bcas dang mnyam du zhus dag mdzad mkhan de yin/(364) gnam rtsed ldeng / dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i mjug tu dge bshes ar chen po byang chub ye shes kyis btab pa'i dgon pa zhig de sngon lha sa'i nye 'dabs stod lung phur yod/(365) gzhu kun dga' ra ba/ dus rabs bcu pa'i mjug tu

381rngog byang chub 'byung gnas kyi snye mo gzhu nang du btab pa'i dgon pa zhig(356) ja sig chen/ ja sngag chen ste/ sbag chung bzhi/(357) las kyi me 'o nga〉las 'bras kyi rnam bzhag ston pa'i gzhung zhig(368) chos blo bshad byed/ dpe deb sogs blta mi dgos par blo thog nas bshad pa/(369) g.yonal pa zhig po/ cha pa chos kyi seng ge'i slob ma gnyal zhig 'jam dpal rdo rje/ 'di'i lo rgyas da phan ma mthong /(360) tshal gung bang /༄ tshal dgon pa dang / gung thang dgon pa gnyis gcig tu bsdoms pa'i spyi ming yin/ sngar rab byung gsum pa'i shing lug spyi lo 1175lor/ gung thang bla ma zhang brtson 'grus grags pas thog mar tshal gyi dgon pa btab/ de nas lo bcu gsum song ba'i me lug spyi lo 1187lor gung thang dgon pa btab/ bla ma zhang ska gshegs nye gnas dar ma gzhon nus sde mi ser dang dgon pa'i bdag po byas rū dgon pa'i mjug skyong byas/ de nas dpon rabs kha shas song rjes dpon rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis gong ma ha pi li se chen han gyi mdun du song / gong mas tshal pa khri skor gyi mi ser rnoms dgon pa dang lha khang zhig gsos kyi mthun rkyen du gnang nas tshal pa khri dpon byas/ de'i bu dpon dga' bde dpal bas gra tshang chos 'khor gling btab nas mtshan nyid rig pa'i slob gnyer btsugs shing dbus gling du sngags pa gra tshang btsugs/ tshal pa khri dpon kun dga' rdo rje'i dus bu ston rin po che gdan drangs nas tshal pa bka' 'gyur zhes bod kyi mkhas pa yongs kyis tshad ldan gyi dper byed pa de bzhengs pa sogs zhib par 'jog ri ngag dbang bstan 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i tshal gung thang gi dkar chag 'gro mgon

382zhal lung〉zhes pa'i nang gsal/(361) bshad grwa/ mtshan nyid rig pa'i gzhung chen po lnga la slob gnyer gtso bor byed pa'i dgon pa/(362) mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum/ mkhas pa zhig yin phyin 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum ka la mkhas pa byung na rab dang / de min kyang 'chad rtsod gnyis ma tha'ang 'chad pa la mkhas pa dgos/ 'chad pa las rtsod pa dka' zhing / de gnyis las rtsom pa dka'/ 'chad pa dang rtsod pa la nor 'khrul yong srid pas rang nyid kyi lta ba ngo ma 'chad pa'i nges pa med/ rtsom pa ni tshig sbyor dang / brjod don/ rigs pa'i gzhung lugs bcas gang ci'i thad nas tshad mtho tsam zhig dgos pas 'chad rtsod gnyis la mkhas pa cung zad mang zhing / rtsom pa la mkhas pa ni snga ma gnyis dang bsdar na dkon pa yin zhes bshad srol yod/ cu (363) khro phu/ rab byung gsum pa'i lcags yos/ spyi lo 1171lor 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa'i slob ma rgyal tsha rin chen mgon gyis khro phu dgon pa btab nas gnas gzhi bzung ba de nas khro phu bka' brgyad byang /dgon pa 'dir khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis gser zangathe kyithe bzhengs pa'i sangs rgyas byams pa'i ska/ mi'i gzhu 'dom nyi shu(khru brgyad cu)tham pa'i tshad tsam yod/ khro phu bkarā brgyad kyi lo rgyas zhib pa ri bo che dpon tshang tshe dbang rgyal gyis brtsams pa'i sto ༄rong chos zlobyung〉dang chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉le tshan(na)pa'i grangs 64na6—65na bar gsal/(364) bya ston kha che/ (bu ston rin po che rin chen grub)rab byung lnga pa'i lcags stag spyi lo 1290 rab byung drug pa'i shing 'brug spyi lo 1364bar/ dgung lo bdun cu don lnga bzhugs/ rgya gar du phebs ma myong

383yang thar lo nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi drung du sgra rig pa la sbyangs pa mdzad de/ sngar bod du ma 'gyur ba'i rgya dpe 'ga' zhig kyang bong skad du bsgyur bar mdzad/mdo sngags rig gnas mtha' dag la mkhas pa'i phul du phyin par gyur te/thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che zhes bong kyi mkhas pa kun gyis mgrin gcig du bsngags/ rje tsong kha pas kyang bu ston rin po ches zhus dag mdzad myong ba'i 'gyur dang bka' dang bstan bcos rnams la tshad mar 'dzin pa gnang / gsung rtsom kyang lo rgyas/ 'dul ba/ mngon ba/ phar phyin/ dbu ma/tshad ma/ sgra rig pa/ skar cings/ sngags phyogs bcas khyon bsdoms pod chen nyi shu rtsa drug tsam rtse po tā la'i zhol dpar khang du dpar yod/ lo rgyas rgyas pa khro phu ba bsod nams seng gis mdzad pa'i bu ston gyi rtogs brjod༄ ngo mtshar gtam gyi rol mo nyer gcig pa〉bla ma mgon po dpal bas mdzad pa'i(bu ston rin po che'i rnam thar rin chen phreng ba〉tshe chog gling yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i bu ston rin po che'i gsung 'bum gyi dkar chag bstan pa rin po che'i mdzes rgyan〉bcas su gsal/(366) la ba pa/rgya gar gyi grub chen brgyad cu'i nang gi slob dpon kum pa li zhu ba de yin/ lo rgyas cung zad tsam rgya gar gyi paṇa chen maḥ ka ras mdzad pa'i grub chen brgyad ༄cu rtsa bzhi'i rnam thar〉pa tshab tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis bod skad du bsgyur ba/ sde dge dpar khang du dpar yod/ (366) nag po spyod pa/ rgya gar gyi grub chen brgyad cu'i nang na slob dpon mihā pa zhu ba de yin/ de'i lo rgyas gong gsal grub chen brgyad cu'i rnam thar〉der gsal/ dku(367) bka' babs bzhi/ grub chen te lo pa la bka' babs bzhi'i gdams ngag yod de/ 1 pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa'i bka' babs/

3842 ma rgyad 'khor lo bde mchog gi bka' babs/ 3 mi lam dang bar do'i gdamabazhu ngag gi bka' babs/ 4 'pho ba dang grong 'jug gi bka' babs bcas so/(368) pha rgyud/ 'di la gsung srol 'dra min yod kyang rje tsong kha pa'i dgongs pa ltar 'chad na/ gsang sngags bla na med pa'i rgyad kyi nang rgya lus gtso bor ston pa zhig la zer/ dper na/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyardo lta bu/ cu(369) ma rgyud/ 'di la gsungs tshul 'dra min yod kyang rje tshong kha pa'i dgongs pa ltar 'chad na/ gsang sngags bla med kyi rgyad gyi nang nas 'od gsal gtso bor ston pa'i rgyad phyogs gtogs dang bcas dro/ dper na bde mchog rtsa rgyud lta bu/ dku(370) te lo shes rab bzang po/ phal cher spyi lo'i dus rabs dgu pa'i dkyil tsam du byung ba 'dra/ lo rgyas rgyas pa chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉gyi le tshan(na)pa'i grangs 9bsta5—12na bar gsal/(371) dka' ba bcu gnyis/ paṇa chen nā ro pas rang gi bla ma'i bka' ltar srog la thug pa'i dka' ba chen po bcu gnyis spyad pa/ 1 thog brtsegs bcu gsum yod pa'i khang pa'i steng nas mchongs pa/ ཿ smyug ma'i thur ma zing zing ba mang pos lus kyi mkhal khung phan tshun nas phug pa/ 3 srin bu pad bas gang ba'i 'dam la rang lus kyis zam pa 'dzugs su 'jug pa soṭa zhib par chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉gyi le tshan(na)pa'i grangs 15ba — 17naḥbar gsal/(372) mchog dang thun mong dngos grub/ gsang sngags bla med kyi lam la zhugs nas rab la mchog gi dngos grub ste sangs rgyas pa/

386'bring la gong du mchan rtags ang 446 par bshad pa ltar gyi thun mong gi dngos grub brgyad gang yang rung ba zhig thob pa yod zer/(373)jo bee na ro ta pa ye shes dngos grub/ (paṇa chen nā ro pa)phal cher dus rabs bcu pa'i ring byung ba 'dra ste lo tsā ba rgya brtson 'grus seng gis rgya gar du jo bo gdan 'dren par song skabs paṇa chen nā ro pa da dung bai kra ma shi la'i dgon par bzhugs mus yin par bshad pas so/ lo rgyas rgyas pa chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉le tshan(na)pa'i grangs 12(7—18ba3bar gsal/(374) mar pa lo tsā chos kyi blo gros/ (rab byung gong gi lo skor drug cu tha ma'i chu byi spyi lo 1012 rab byung gnyis pa'i me glang spyi lo 1097bar)'dir deb ther sngon po〉ltar bris/ dgung lo gya drug bzhuṭa/bod kyi lo rgyas thog mtshan snyan shin tu che ba'i lo tsā ba zhig yin/ 'khrungs yul lho bsgo chus khyir phu/ yab mar pa dbang phyag 'od zer/ yum rgyal mo 'od zer gnyis kyi sras ming sring bzhi'i gnyis dro yin/ dgung lo bco lnga nas 'brog mi lo tsā ba shākya ye shes kyi drung du sam sgri ta'i skad dang sgra rig pa la slob sbyong gnang / de nas rang yul du byon nas gser srang bco lnga tsam bsnams te bal por byon/ de nas kha rag gnyos lo tsā ba dang mnyam du byung yang khong rgya gar du thegs/ mar pa rang nyid sa chu'i 'phrod bsten gyi ched du bal por lo gsum ring bzhugs te de'i ring bal po spyi ther ba'i drung du gsang sngags kyi chos mang po gsan/ de nas paṇa chen nā ro pa'i drung du byon/ de nas rgya gar nub phyogs su byon nas slob depon ye shes snying po'i drung du gsang ba 'dus pa gsan/ de nas slar yang bal yul du paṇa chen nā ro pa'i drung du gsang ba 'dus pa dang / ma hā mā ya gsan nas gser 'tshol ba'i ched du

386bod du tshur phebs/ gser mang po bsgrabs nas rgya gar du phebs skabs/ nā ro pa spyod pa la gshegs zin yang dkadro ba mang po spyod nas btsal bas nags gseb zhig tu mjal/ dgung lo zhe gnyis pa la bod du phyir phebs te/ bdag med ma khab tu bzhes/ lo shas nas slar yang gser bsnams te rgya gad du phebs nas bla ma me ci pa dang mjal nas gsang sngags kyi chos mang po gsan/snga phyir rgya gar dang bal po bcas su phar tshur 'byon skabs khres po bsgoms nas zhabs thang du phebs te/ dug sbral gyi gling dang / bye thang / dug chu bcas brgal nas dka' spyad tshad merdo pa mdzad de bod du tshur phebs skabs gsang sngags kyi chos dpe mang po bsnams te de dag bod skad du basbyar ba gnang / dgung lo gya drug pa la ska gshegs/ lo rgyas zhib pa bod༄ kyi lo rgyus chos 'byang phal che ba'i nang ma 'khod pa med cing / ༄ rgyas shos ni rgod tshang pa sna tshogarsha rang grol gyis mdzad pa'i mar pa'i rnam thar mthong ba don ldan〉zhes par gzigs/(375) 'thog mi shākya ye shes/ ('brog mi lo tsā ba) rab byang dang po'i gong gi lo skor dang po'i chu sbrul spyi lo 990 rab byang dang po'i snang stag spyi lo 1074bar/ dgung lo brgyad cu gya gnyis bzlogs/ lo rgyas cung zad deb ther sngon po〉le tshan(nga)pa'i grangs lhan1—3na dror gsal/ (376) mgos lo tsā ba/ 'gos lo tsā ba khug pa lhas btsas/bod kyi lo tsā ba mtshan snyan grags ha cang che ba zhig yin/ 'di'i 'khrungs lo dang gshegs lo lo rgyas yig cha rnams su gsal bar 'khod pa ma mthong yang /jo bo rje a ti sha'i zlob ma yin pas dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i nang byon pa ni de las gsal bar shes/ 'khrungs yul gtsang rta nag phu'i khug pa zhes bya ba'i

387sa char 'gos kyi rigs su 'khrungs/ chung dus bal po brgyad rgya gar du byon nas paṇḍi ta yi mtshan yod pa'i bla ma bdun cu tsam bsten narā chos gsan pas/mdo sngags gang gi thad nas khong gis gsan ma myong ba'i chos med pa lta bu yin/ bod du phebs nas gsang sngags gsar ma'i chos mang po dang / lhag par gsang ba 'dus pa'i skor la gzhung mang po basbyar zhing bshad pa mdzad/lo rgyus zhib cha yod pa'i yig cha bdag gis ma mjol lags/(377) rgyal sras me khyi pa/ (mnga' bdag me tri pa)phyi nang gnyis ku'i grub mtha' la mkhas pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po zhig de nas bla ma mar pa la brgyad pa'i lta ba bod du dar ba la phyag rgya chen po'i lta ba zhes/ bka' rgyad chosgo lugs kyi phyag rgya chen po'i lta ba'i khungs khong la thug pa yin zhes rgosung / (378) ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa/ rgya gar gyi dgon pa chen po dpal na lend+ra'i nub sgo srung ba po yin la pazlo ta chen po zhig kyang yin/ nyi ma re re la tshigs bcad stong phrag re'i brjod don mkhyen thub pa dang / mkhyen pa rnams nam yang brjod rgya med pas ngag gi dbang phyug zhes mtshan thogs/lo rgyas zhib cha jo nang tā cur nā bas mdzad pa'i rgya gar chos 'byung〉grangs 99)ba6—117ba 1 bar gsal/(379) ri ri ba/ rgya gar gyi grub chen zhig yin/ 'di'i lo rgyus zhib pa da phan bdag gis ma mthong /(380) ka so ri ba/ 'di yang rgya gar gyi grub chen zhig yin/lo rgyas zhib pa bdag gis ma mthong / —0 (381) a ba rgya ti pa/ jo bo rje a ti sha'i bla ma byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhes grags pa de yin/ 'di'i lo rgyus tshe chog gling yongs 'dzin rgyal

38 mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i lam rim tha mabargyad pa'i rnam thar〉nang gsal(382) chos kyi 'brel nga 'i zlo ma/ rang gis dngos su chos zhu myong ba'i bla ma/ chos lugs kyi dbang du byas na/ rang gi pha ma spun mched lta bur rang nyid kyis dngos su chos zhu myong ba yin na/ de chos kyi 'brel pa'i bla mar rtsi dgos pa yin/(383) gnyis med rnam rgyal/ 'di ni bod kyi mkhas pa khag gcig gis rgyad yang dag yin par bzhed/ 'ga' zhig gis brdzun ma yin par bzhed/ theganyis med rnam rgyal gyi rgyad〉che ba le'u bdun cu don bdun/'gyur byang med pa/ 〈gnyis med rnam rgyal gyi rgyud chung ba〉bu ston rin po ches brgyar ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis yod/ bka' 'gyur snar thang dpar ma'i rgyad kyi rā tshan(ca)par yod/cu (384) sku mkhar dgu thog mar pa lo tsā bas rang gi slob ma mi la ras pa la bzhings su bcug pa'i sras dar ma mdo sde'i sku mkhar thog brtseṭa dgu yod pa/(385) mkhakhur 11da sdom/ gsang sngags kyi gzhung las dag pa mkha' spyod zhes pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams zhig yod pa de ni/ sngags kyi lam la brten nas tshe gcig la sangs rgyas pa'i gang zag rnams lus ma spangs par zhing der skye thub ces bshad/(386) grod 'jug gsang sngags bla med kyi gzhung nas bshad srol la/ sngags med kyi lam la zhugs te gnas tshad nges can zhig tu slebs pa na/ rang nyid kyi rlung sems la rang dbang thob pa zhig 'ong / skabs der rang nyid kyi da yod lus rten des gzhan don rgya chen po bsgrab mi nus pa'i skabs su rang nyid ma shi gong du rang gi lus rten dang bral ༄te/ gzhon nu lang

389tsho ldan pa shi ba'i ro 'am/ de ma rnyed na sems can gzhan gyi ro rma med pa'i gtsang ma zhig btsal nas de la rang gi rnam shes rlung stobs kyis 'phos te/slar yang rang nyid sngar bzhin gson por gnas thub pa byed pa'i thabs shes shig ste/ dper na/ sngar bla ma mar pa lo tsā ba'i sras dar ma mdo sde chibs rtas g.yugs nas sku gzugs la mas skyon chen po byung ste 'tsho thabs med par gyur pa'i skabs su/ gzhon nu lang tsho ldan pa shi ba'i ro btsal yang phug ron shi ba'i ro zhig las ma rnyed par brten/ de la rnam shes 'phos te rgya gar gyi dur khrod du song nas bu lo bcu drug lon pa zhig shi ba'i ro dur khrod du skyel ba'i steng du babs/ de la rnam shes 'phos te mkhas pa chen por gyur pa la ti phu gsang sngags sdong po zhes mtshan du chags shing / de la bla ma ras chung pas mjal nas chos gsan pa'i lo rgyus yod pa dang / de dang mtshungs par stong 'khor rin po che bsod nams rgya mtsho yang pha ma gnyis mi dgos par sku phreng lnga ma mdo rgyud rgya mtsho sku gshegs rjes byis pa lo brgyad lon pa zhig shi ba'i ro la grong 'jug mdzad pa yin zer srol 'dug(387) thugs kyi sras/ bla ma de'i slob ma mang po yod pa'i nang nas rang nyid kyi shul rgyun 'dzin thub nges kyi slob ma zhig la bla ma des rang nyid la mnga' ba'i mdo sngags kyi chos yongs rdzogs sbas gsang med par gnang nas rang nyid kyi sras dang 'dra bar thugs rtsis che shos su mdzad pa'i slob ma zhig(388) dol gyi 'tshur ston dbang je / 〈deb ther dmar po〉dpe mi 'dra ba bcu lhag tsam bdag gis mthong ba tshang ma'i nang bla ma 'di'i lo rgyas rtsa chad song 'dug pas nga tshos dpe 'di dpar bskrun byed skabs ma yigazhu ltar dpar bskrun byas pa las kha sdon byas med kyang / 'dir de'i kha sgon gyi tshul du gzigs na/ (deb ther sngon po〉le tshan(nya)pa'i grangs skyab5—8

391gsum pa'i me sbral spyi lo 1197—rab byung bzhi pa'i shing byi spyi lo 1264bar)dgung lo drug zlo re brgyad bzhugs/ 'di'i lo rgyas cung zad deb ther sngon po〉le tshan(pha)pa'i grangs 23na 6—24ba 1bar༄ gsal/(394) ba ri lo tsā ba/ ba ri lo kro ba rin chen grags/ (rab byang dang po'i lcags 'brug spyi lo 1040 rab byung gnyis pa'i lcags yos spyi shlau 1111lo bar)dgung lo don gnyis bzhugs lo rgyas rgyas pa da phan ma mthong /(395) zangs dkar lo tsā ba/ pangs dkar lo tsā ba 'phags pa shes rab/ mar pa lo tsā ba dang dus mtshungs/ 'dis lha sa gtsug lag khang la nyams gsos legs par mdzad/ lha sa'i grong khyer nang sdod pa'i sprang po tshor sprang tshang zer ba'i khang pa zur du rtsigs pa gnang / lo rgyus rgyas pa ri bo che dpon tshang tshe dbang rgyal gyis brtsams pa'i sto rong chos 'byung〉grangs 11na 11ba bar/(396) rma lo tsā ba/ rma lo tsā ba dge ba'i blo gros(rab byung dang po'i shing sprel spyi lo 1044 rab byung dang po'i sa sbrul spyi lo 1089bar)dgung lo zhe drug la gzhan gyis dug btang ste bkrongs/ lo rgyas zhib pa deb ther sngon po)le tshan(na)pa'i grangs 3ba1—4ba2bar gsarā/(397) 'arnya cas kyu)zin/ 'di mar pa lo tsā ba bzhugs yul lho brags chus 'khyer phu dang ha cang thag mi ring ba'i sa char yod nges kyang / deng sang sa gnas gang du yod med ma shes/(398) carngogs ze na/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i chos kyi snying po man ngag rdzogs pa chen po/ de la nang gses kyis dbye na/ 1 sems sde/ 2 klong sde/ 3 man ngag gi sde bcas gsum yod/(1)sems sde/ 'di la ma bu bsdoms pa'i bco brgyad yod cing / lnga

ni /2chen ༷ ra tsā na dang / bcu gsum ni pan chen khri ma la las brgyad bye yin la/ rdzogs pa chen po sems phyogs su grags pa ni lo chen be rosto tsā na dang / g.yu sgra snying po gnyis la/ gnyags rnya na ku ma ras zhus/ khong la bka' yi chu bo chen po bzhi 'dus shing / slob ma'i mchog bcu la sogs pa byung ba nas/ sog po sangs rgyas ye shes sogs la brgyad nas byung ba yin/yang / lo chen bee ro tsā na'i slob ma spangs sangs rgyas rshagon pos rba ra kṣi ta la gsungs/ des ya zi dar ma shes rab sogs nas brgyad pa dang / yang /bee ro tsā nas jo mo sgre mo la gsungs pa sogs brgyad pa ༄mi 'dra ba yod/(2) klong sde/ rdzogs pa chen po klokya sde ni pan chen khri ma la las byung / des dpal nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyad〉kyi don klong dgus bstan pa dang / (ye shes gsang ba〉la sogs pa'i rgyad stol brten nas rdo rje zam pa'i man ngag rnams bai ro tsā nas dpang mi pham margon po la gsungs pa rnams rim gyis 'dzeng rma bo dhi sogs nas rim gyis brgyad pa las 'phel rgyas byang /yang de las zab pa'i rdzogs pa chen the snying tig ni pan chen ddhi ma la mi tra(snga ma)bod du byon skabs rgyal po khri srong sde btsan dang myang ting 'dzin bzang po gnyis la gsungs shing / myang gis dbu ru 'bri gung zhwa yi lha khang du gter du sbas nas/ chig brgyad kyi man ngag rnams 'brom rin chen 'bar la gsungs pa las rim par brgyad hūṃ btsun seng ge dbang phyug bar byung / des gdams ngag rnams gter kha༄ gsum du sbar pa las/ rong snang mda'i lce sgom nag po dang mal dro 'chad pa stag sku shangs pa ras pa/ yar 'brog g.yu mtsho'i 'gram du 'khrungs pa'i zhang bkris rdo rje rnams kyis gterwa nas bton te/man ngag rnams rim bzhin kun mkhye da klong chen pa'i bar tu byung / ku na mkhyen klong chen pas rdzogs pa chen po snying tig gi chos skor rnams gzhung dang man

wa wa —wa wa ——— 393ngag gang ci'i thad nas dar rgyas su mdzad pas bod yongs su klong chen snying tig ces grags pa 'di byung /yang mkha' 'gro snying tig ni/ slob dpon dga' rab rdo rje nas rig 'dzin sri sing ha la gnang / de la slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyis gsan nas bod du mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal la gnang / des gter du sbas pa rnams gter ston padma las 'brel rtsal gyis gter nas bton te rgyal sras legs pa rgyal mtshan sogs nas rim par brgyad de dar rgyas su byung ba yin/ lo rgyas zhib pa thub bstan 'od gsal༄ bstan pa'i nyi mas mdzad pa'i(gsang chen snga༄ 'gyur nges don zab mo'i chos 'byang〉dang / nam pa mkha' spyod kyis mdzad pa'i gter ma'i lo rgyas gter stongan chos 'byang〉 kong sprul yon tan rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gter ston stobargya rtsa'i rnam thar〉b.rās su gsal/(399) rgya gar du phyi res byon/ bla ma mar pa lo tsā ba rgya gar du thengs gsum phebs pa'i gnyis pa rab byung dang po'i chu rta spyi lo 1042lor jo bo rje a ti sha mnga' ris nas bod du phebs pa'i lam bar du mjal ba'i lo rgyas 'dugacu (400) yinajig rten spangs/ 'jig rten khyim pa'i bya gzhag rnams rtsa ba nas mtshams 'jog byas pa/(401) rdzong drug rje btsun mi la ras pas sgrab pa mdzad pa'i gnas phyi nang gsang ba'i rdzong drug 'di rnams mi la'i rnam thang chen mo〉nang ba/ra mi /(402) la phyi'i gangs/ la phyi'i gangs ri/ deng sang jo mo glang ma zhes 'bod cing / bod yig gi lo rgyus thog gangs rgyal mo mthon mthing zhes 'khod pa'i gangs ri rtse lnga pa/

394(403) chu bar/ stod kyi la phyi chu dbar/ gangs rgyal mo mthon mthing dang thag nye sar yod par mi la'i rnam thar mgur 'bum〉las bshad/(404) rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor/ bka' brgyad chos lugs kyi phyag rgya chen po'i lam bgrod tshul la gnas tshad mi 'dra ba'i spel 'byor bzhi gsungs pa'i(1 rtse gcig 2 spros bral/ 3 ro gcig blo 'das sam sgom med bcas)nang gses dang po rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi sems la rtse gcig tu ma yengs par dmigs pa('di ni sems la dmigs pa'i zhi gnas sgom pa dang khyad par yod med brtag)pa ste/ rje rgod tshang pas 'di mdo lugs kyi tshogs lam dang sbyor lam gyi dod yin par gsungs/(405) spros bral/ gong du bshad pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi'i nang gi gnyis pa spros bral gyi rnal 'byor ni rang sems skye 'gag gnas gsum gyi spros pa dang bral bar rtogs pa ste/ rje rgod tshang pas 'di mdo lugs kyi mthong lam dang sa bcu'i dang po rab tu dga' ba'i dod yin par gsungs/(406) ro gcig gong du bshad pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi'i nang gses gsum pa ro gcig gi rnal 'byor ni phyi rol yul gyi snang ba dang rang gi sems kyi ngo bo ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i nyams 'char ba ste/ rje rgod tshang pas 'di mdo lugs kyi sa gnyis pa dri ma med pa nas sa bdun pa ring du song ba'i bar gyi dod thub par gsungs/(407) tshe rings ma spun lnga/ jo mo tshe ring mched lnga/ (1)jo mo bkris tshe ring ma/ (2) mthing gi zhal bzang ma/ (3) mi g.yo blo bzang ma/ (4) cod pan mgrin bzang ma/ (5)gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma bcas lnga ni bka' brgyad chos lugs kyi srung ma'i gtso bo'i gras shig yin/(408)sto dam la 2rgogs/ gzugs med kyi lha 'dre la chos bshad nas

wa wa — —— wa 395rang nyid kyi bka' la nyan du bcug pa/(409) sgom med kyi rnal 'byor/ gong du bshad pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi'i nang gi bzhi pa sgom med kyi rnal 'byor ni/ yul la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i 'du shes dang bral nas rang sems ting nge 'dzin dang 'dres pa ste/ rje rgod tshang pas 'di mdo lugs kyi sa brgyad pa nas bcu pa'i bar gyi dod thub par gsungs/(410) dam pa thre5 gar/ pha dam pa sangs rgyas/ bod kyi lo rgyus thog shod srol la dgung lo lnga brgya tsam bzhugs zer ba yang snang / zhi byed kyi chos lugs bod du thog mar dar bar mdzad pa po yin/lo rgyus cung zad tsam deb ther sngon po〉le tshan(na)pa'i grangs 1na 3ba3bar gsal/(411) bya chen/ slob ma'i nang nas brgyud pa 'dzin thub nges kyi gras/ (412) mnyam med dwags po lha rje/ (dwags po rin po che)rab byung dang po'i sa lug spyi lo 1079rtserab byung gsum pa'i chu bya spyi lo 1163bar/ dgung lo bdun cu don lnga bzhugs/ dgung lo chung dus nas sman dang sngags la mkhas par gyur te sman pa rgyan ring tsam mdzad/ rjes su sras dang sras mo gnyis byung ba yang 'das shijo / lcam yang 'das pas thugs skyo ste dgang lo nyer drag par rab byang dang / bsnyen rdzogs das gcig ta ra ri ri ri ri bsgrab pa gnang nas mtshan bsod nams rin chen du gsol/ de nas bka' gasdoms pa'i dge bshes mang po'i sar nas bka' gdams kyi chos rnams cha tshang ba gsan/ dgung lo so gcig pa sa glang la rje btsun mi la ras pa dang mjal nas gsang sngags kyi chos gsan te lo ngo drug tsam bzhugs/ dgung lo

/yo6zhe gsum pa rab byung gnyis pa'i lcags glang spyi lo 1121 lor dwags lha sgam pa'i dgon pa btab ste/ gnas gzhi bzung ba gnang / de nas dar spel byung ba'i chos brgyad la dwags po bka' brgyad zer zhing / shangs pa bka' brgyud phud pa'i de can gyi bka' brgyad chos zlogs tshang ma dngos dang brgyad pa'i sgo nas 'di las gyes pa sha stag ༄yin/ rnam thar rgyas pa dpon po mi 'od rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa yod la/ gzhan yang bka' brgyad chos lugs kyi chos 'byung mang che ba'i mgor dwags po rin po che'i rnam thar༄ ma 'khod pa med pa lta bu yin/(413) lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor dgu/ rgya gar gyi grub chen te lo pa shes rab bzang po la ye shes kyi mkha' 'gros gzugs med pa'i skad kyi thog nas bstan pa ltar/ 1 smin grol sems kyi rgya mdud/lha spyod pa chu la ral gri/ 3 dam tshig rang sems me long / 4 dam rdzas rtogs pa'i nyi ma/ 6 ro stoms spyi yi me long / 6 bde chen gsung gi rin chen/ 7 rtsa rlang dra mig 'khor lo/ 8 rang grol phyag rgya chen po/9 rig pa ye shes snan me bcas so/(414) dam mig nyams/ rang gis bla ma de la gsang sngags kyi chos zhus rjes dad pa log nas kha gtong ba dang bka' dang 'gal ba'i bya ba byas pa/(416) lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du gshegs pa/sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gsang sngags kyi gzhung nas bshad srol la/ rang gi lus kyi rtsa rlung thig le sogs la gnad du bsnun nas bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis rlung sems gnyis la rang dbang thob rjes/ rang lus sha rus gdos bcas kyi phung bu 'di yang spangs ma dgos par sangs rgyas pa/

397(416) 〈ting je 'dzin rgyal po〉 'di la bam po bco lnga dang /le'u dgu yod/ rgyal po khri lde srong btsan gyi das su pazlo ta sri lend+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba chos nyid tshul khrims kyis bskyar ba/ 〈snar thang bka' 'gyur〉mdo mang gi pod(da)par yo/da/ cu(417) 〈snyi nga rje chen po pad dkar〉 'di la bam po drug pa dang bam po bco lnga pa gnyis yod/ dang po ni paṇḍi ta dzi na li tra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde gnyis kyis bskyar zhing / rjes ma ni paṇḍi ta dzi na mi tra/su rend+ra/ pu dzha warma/ bod kyi lomi tsā ba zhang ye shes sde bcas kyis bskyar ba(bka' 'gyur snar thang dpar ma'i〉mdo mang(cha)par yod/ dku(418) chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin gyi spros pa dang bral ba'i ting je 'dzin/ chos thams cad kyi stong pa nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa ste/ stong pa nyid pa'i spros pa'i mtha' brgyad dang bral ba yin zhing /de yang / 1 skye ba med pa/ 2 'gag pa med pa/ 3 rtag pa'i mtha' dang bral ba/ 4 chad pa'i mtha' dang bral ba/ 6 gang du 'gro ba med pa/6 gang nas 'ong ba med pa/ lha rang bzhin gyis gcig dang du ma gang rung dang bral ba/ 8 mtshan mar 'dzica/ pa'i spros pa dang bral ba bcas kyi khyad chos dang ldan pa/ 'di'i skor slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i(dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab〉dang / slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa'i 〈'grel pa tshig gsal〉rje tsong kha pas mdzad pa'i dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab kyi 'grel pa rigs pa'i rgya mtsho〉bcas la gzigs/(419) gnas pa bzang po/ rang gi lus la gnas pa'i rlung la rang dbang thob na rang gi sems kyang rang gi dbang du 'dus thub ces gsang sngags bla na med pa'i gzhung gi bshad srol la yod/

393 (420) sa bcu non pa'i snga ltas/ sa bcu pa thob pa'i snga ltas su rang gzhan gyi skye ba snga ma brgya dang / phyi ma brgya tham pa shes pa dang /sangs rgyas brgya tham pa'i zhal mthong ba/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya tham par 'gro ba sogs kyi rtags 'byung bar dbu ma 'jug pa〉sems bskyed bcu pa'i nang gsal/(421) thabs lam/ lus kyi nang du gnas pa'i rlung thams cad lte ba'i rtsa dbu ma'i nang du sdud pa'i ched du lte ba'i rtsa mdud grol ba'i thabs shig zhib phra gsang sngags kyi gzhung las gsal/(422) rtags snang dang nyams thong / gong du bshad pa ltar rang gi lus kyi rlung thams cad rtsa dbu ma'i nang du zhugs gnas thim gsum rim bzhin 'byung zhing zhugs pa dang / gnas pa dang / thim pa bcas so/ so sor phyi rtags brgyad dang / nang rtags brgyad yod/ zhib phra gsang sngags kyi gzhung las gsal/(423) longs sku/ khyad chos lnga dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas/ (1)ska nges pa/ mtshan bzang po so gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus ces pa/ (2)'khor nges pa/ byang sems 'phags pa sha stag gi dbus su bzhugs pa/ (3)gnas nges pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'og min kho nar bzhuṭa pa/ (4)chos nges pa/ theg pa chen po'i chos kho na gsungs pa/ (5)dus nges pa/ 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du sems can gyi 'gro don mdzad pa bcas zhib par slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa'i dbu ma 'jug pa〉sems bskyed bcu pa dang / de'i 'grel pa rgya gar dang bod kyi mkhas pas mdzad pa mang po yod pas de rnams su gzigs/(424) stsosnol skrag/ 'di ni sku gsum gyi nang gi sprul skuste sangs rgyas

399rnams rang nying sangs rgyas zin pa'i rjes su sems can gyi don du gang la gang 'tshams pa'i spral pa sna tshogs bstan nas don mdzad pa/(425) bden pa mngon du rtogs/ stong pa nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa/ stong pa nyid ni chos thams cad kyi bden don dngos de yin pas de rtogs pa na bden pa'i don mngon sum du mthong ba yin zer/(426) zad par zil gnon gyi ting nge 'dzin/ gsang sngaṭa kyi gzhung nas bshad tshul la/ rang gi lus la gnas pa'i 'byung ba bzhi la rang dbang thob na/ phyi'i 'byung ba bzhi yis gnod mi nus par ma zad/ rang nyid kyi lus kyang 'byung ba bzhi so sor sprul thub zhes bshad srol yod/(427) snang sems 'dres/ phyi rol gyi yul snang dang / rang sems logs su med par gcig tu 'dres pa'i 'char snang /(428) dwags po rin po che sku mched gsum mnyam med dwags po lha rje/ de'i gcen po'i sras dgas sgom tshul khrims snying po/ de'i gcung po dwags po sgom chung /(429) gdan sa 21ga gdan sa 'dzin mkhan du bskos pa/(430) bkra shis sgo mang / sangs rgyas sku 'khrungs pa nas mya ngan las ma 'das bar sku tshe gcig gi mdzad pa'i gtso bo brgyad la dran gso zhu ched dus skabs so sor mchod rten re bzhengs pa la bde bshegs mchod rten brgyad zer zhing / de'i nang gses sangs rgyas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas chos thog mar gsungs pa'i gnas wa ra nā sir bzhings pa'i dran gso'i mchod rten zhig la bkra shis sgo mang zer/ 'di'i bzo dbyibs ni sa 'dzin nas bang chen bar dang / bum stan pad ma nas tog gi bar du byang chub mchod rten dang 'dra ba la bang chen dang bum gdan pad ma'i bar du bang

40ri ma bzhi yod pa/ dbyibs gru bzhi/ bang rim bzhi bo so so'i phyogs bzhi ri glo 'bur dang bcas pa rgyas par sgo brgya dang brgyad/ 'bring la sgo lnga bcu nga drug bsdas par bcu drug bcas byed srol yod/(༵༵1) gabebar nam/ zhig gso nyams gso/(432) za 'bring gi lde 'khrug (rba 'bring gi sde 'khrug)bod du sangs rgyas chos lugs thog mar bskyar gso gnang mab/na dbus gtsang gi mkhas pa mi bcu'i gras dbus pa mi lnga'i nang gi rba tshul khrims blo gros kyis 'phan por lan pa spyil bu'i dgon pa btab nas gnas gzhi bzung / de nas dar spel byung ba'i tshogs pa la rba tsho zer zhing / dbus pa mi lnga'i nang gi 'bring ye shes yon tan gyis 'phan por ngan lam spyi mo'i dgon pa btab nas gnas gzhi bzung / de nas dar spel byung ba'i tshogs pa la 'bring tsho zer/tshogs pa sde gnyis po rjes su 'phel rgyas chen po byung nas dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i dkyil dang / dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i 'gor phan tshun bar lha khang dang dgon pa 'phrog res kyi dmag 'khrug yang yang byung ba ma zad/ bod kyi rab byung gsum pa'i lcags 'brug spyi lo 1160lor lha sa khul du yod pa'i rba rag tsho pa gnyis kyi bar dmag 'khrug yun ring byung ba dang / dmag 'khrug gi ring lha sa gtsug lag khang dang / ra mo che gnyis la gtor skyon tshabs che tsam byung skabs dwags sgom tshul khrims snying po phebs nas phan tshun gnyis kur rgyu dngos 'bor chen gnang ste bar 'dums mdzad rjes/ dmag 'khrug ring gtor skyon byung ba'i lha sa gtsug lag khang la nyams gso legs par mdzad nas skabs der lha sa dang / sto kha khul du dpal 'byor dang dmag don gnyis spu'i thad nas stobs shugs che shos yin pa'i gung thang bla ma zhang rin po cher rtsis 'bul gnang ba bcas chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉gyi

401le tshan(jo)pa dang(na)pa gnyis dang / ri bo che dpon tshang tshe dbang rgyal gyis brtsam/sa/ pa'i lho rong chos 'byung〉gnyis su gsal/(433) zhang rin po che/ gung thang bla ma zhang brtson /brgyas grags pa/ 'og gi mchan rtags ang 583par gzigs/gnyis/(434) gnas kha gnyis/ lha sa gtsug lag khang dang ra mo che (435) mnyam med dwags po rin dzo che'i bya chen/ dwags po bka' brgyud thog mar gsar gtod mdzad po/ mnyam med dwags po lha rje'i slob ma'i gtso bo yin pas bu chen zer/(436) rje dus gsu ma mkhyen pa/ (karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa)mtshur phu kurma pa'i sku phreng dang po yin/ (rab byung gnyis pa'i lcags stag spyi lo 1110rtserab byung gsum pa'i chu glang spyi lo 1193bar)'khrungs yul mdo khams kre shod/ yab sgom pa rdo rje mgon po dang yu / lha thog bza' spang lcam ming 'dren gyi sras su 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu drug la chos 'khor ka brag zhes pa'i dgon par slob dpon chag seng ge grags kyi drung du rab tu byung ba'i mtshan chos kyi grags par gsol/ dgung lo nyi shu la dbus su phebs te sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i gzhung chen po lnga la mkhas par sbyangs/mkhan po mal 'dul 'dzin gyi drung nas dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te slar yang 'dul ba'i gzhung la sbyangs pa mdzad/ gzhan yang bla ma mkhas pa mang du bsten nas mdo sngags kyi chos mang po gsan/ dgung lo sum cu pa la mnyam med dgas po lha rje dang mjal nas lo gsum ring chos gsan/ de nas dbus mon lho khams sogs gnas nges med du byon nas sgom sgrab nyams bzhes mdzad/dgung lo brgyad cu pa rab byung gsum pa'i sa bya spyi lo ༄1189lor/ stod

402lung du mtshur phu'i dgon pa btab ste gnas gzhi bzung bar mdzad/ de nas dar spel byung ba'i chos brgyad la mtshur phu bka' brgyad dang / kurma bka' brgyad zer/ dgung lo ba da cu gya bzhi pa la sku 'jos/ de nas sku phreng rim pa( byon pa ni/ (2)karma pa chos kyi bla ma/ (rab byung gsum pa'i shing byi spyi lo 1204 rab byung lnga pa'i chu lug spyi lo 1283bar)dgung lo don bzhi bzhugs/ (3)karma pa rang byung rdo rje(rab byung lnga pa'i shing sprel spyi lo 1284dzarab byung drug pa'i sa yos spyi lo 1339bar)dgung lo nga drug bzhugs/(4)karma pa rol pa'i rdo rje(rab byung drug pa'i lcags 'brug spyi lo 1340 rab byung drug pa'i chu phag spyi lo 1383bar)dgung lo zhe bzhi bzhugs/ (6)garma pa de bzhin gshegs pa(rab byung drug pa'i shing byi spyi lo 1384rtserab byung bdun pa'i shing lug spyi lo 1415bar)dgung lo so gnyis bzhugs/ (6)kurma pa mthong ba don ldan/ (rab byung bdun pa'i me sprel spyi lo 1416 rab byung brgyad pa'i chu bya spyi lo 1453bar)dgung lo so brgyad bzhugs/ (7)kurma pa chos grags rgya mtsho(rab byung brgyad pa'i shing khyi spyi lo 1454 rab byung brgyad pa'i me stag spyi lo 1506bar)dgung lo nga gsum bzhugs/ (8)kurma pa mi bskyod rdo rje/ (rab byung dgu pa'i me yos spyi lo 1607—rab byung dgu pa'i shing stag spyi lo 1664bar)dgung lo zhe brgyad bzhunas/ (9)karma pa dbang phyug rdo rje/ (rab byung dgu pa'i me 'brug spyi lo 1556—rab byung bcu pa'i chu yos spyi lo 1603bar)dgung lo zhe brgyad bzhugs/ (10)karma pa chos dbyings rdo rje/ (rab byung bcu pa'i shing 'brug spyi lo 1604 rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing stag spyi lo 1674bar)dgung lo don gcig bzhugs/(11)karma pa ye shes rdo rje/ (rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me sbrul spyi lo 1677rtserab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags sbrul spyi lo 1701bar)dgung lo nyer lnga

404mgo bo bcad/ mi'i mgo bo gson po ma rnyed par ma he bsad ma thag pa'i mgo bo drod ma yal ba zhig dbu'i steng du sbyar nas 'byar ba'i rkyen gyis ba/son por bzhugs pa yin zer/ lo rgyas zhib cha jo nang tā ra nā thas mdzad pa'i〈'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi chorsha 'byang〉nang gsal/(439) dpal rga lo/ bod skyo lo tsā ba mkhas pa zhig 'di'i lo rgyus rgyas pa jo nang tā ra nā thas mdzad pa'i 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi chos 'byung〉nang gsal/ (440) karma pakshi/ rkarma pa sku phreng gnyis pa(rab byung gsum pa'i shing byi spyi lo 1204 rab byung lnga pa'i chu lug spyi lo 1283bar) 'khrungs yul mdo khams/ yab rgya dbang tshur tsha dang yum seng bza' mang skyid gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/ dgung lo lnga nas bcu bar 'bri klog sogs byang chub par mkhyen/ dgung lo bcu gcig pa la rab tu byung ba'i mtshan chos kyi bla mar gsol zhing / dgung grangs tshang ba dang bsnyen rdzogs bzhes/ dgung lo nga gnyis pa rab byung bzhi pa'i shing yos spyi lo 1266lor/ yon rgyal rabs kyi gong ma hu pi li se chen han gyis gdan drangs pa ltar byon te/ lo de rang du rong yul gser stod zhes par rgyal sras dang mjal te chos gsungs/ rgyal po'i pho brang du yang phebs/ lo ngo brgyad tsam bzhugs narme bod du phebs/rab byung bzhi pa'i shing byi spyi lo 1264lor mtshur phu'i lha khang chen mor gser zangs kyi lha chen gzhu 'doms bcu gsum yod pa bzhengs/ de'i mtha' bskor du byams pa dang / spyan ras gzigs/ rgyal ba rigs lnga bcas kyi ldem ska dang / gzhan yang gser dngul las grub pa'i bka' 'gyur sogs rten rshasum mang du bzhengs/ dgung lo don bzhi par ska gshegs/ lo rgyas rgyas pa〈chos 'byung sga /khas pa'i dga' ston〉le tshan(pa)rsha'i grangs 12bcu 7—30

405balhabar gsal zhing / 'be lo tsā ba tshe dbang kun khyab kyis brtsams pa'i/ kā/ /ma tshang gi chos 'byung rab 'byams nor bu'i zla shel〉las kyang rgyas (441) grub thob mi tya dzo yi rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta bod du yang phebs myong ba zhig yin/ 'khrungs yul wa ra ṇa si/ rgyal po'i sras su 'khrungs/mtshan la dza ga tra ā nadha zhes bod skad du basbyar na/ skye 'gro kun dga' zer/chung dus yab yum gnyis la chos byed chog pa: gnang ba nan gyis zhus te bros/rdo rje gdan du slob dpon rgyal ba'i lha'i drung du rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs zhus rjes su mkhas pa chen por gyur te o rgyan gyi yul(deng sang gi a phe'u han)du lo mang po'i ring sgom sgrub mdzad cing bzhugs/ bod kyi khro bye lo 1 ba byams pa'i dpal dgung lo nyer drug bzhes pa/ rab byung gsum pa sa rta spyi lo 1198lor bal yul du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ bod zla drug pa'i nang bla ma 'di dang mjal nas bod du gdan drangs te khro phur zla ba drug tsam bzhugs ring skye bo dmangs la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sogs theg pa thun mong gi chos gsungs shing / slob ma nyung shas la gsang sngags kyi chos gsang ba chen po mdzad de gsungs/ gzhan gyis dngos po gang 'bul mkhan byung yang / rten bzhengs dang / mchod 'bul/ dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur/ dbul phongs la sbyin gtong / dmag 'khrug bzlums pa sogs la 'phral 'phral du gtong ba las rang nyid kyis cung zad tsam yang bdag bzung mi mdzad pa sogs ngo mtshar che/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bshad srol la/ slob dpon 'di sku tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes nas sangs rgyas chos lugs 'dzam gling thog med par ma gyur bar du ska lus ma spangs par rgya gar sto phyogs dpal gyi ri la dngos rgyu/ bzhugs pa dang༄ / bod du lo re la thengs re phebs pa'i zhal bzhes yod ces bshad srol

406'dug 'di'i lo rgyus zhib pa chos 'byang mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉gyi le tshan(1)pa'i grangs 4na lha lhan 4bar shesal/(442) sems bskyed du bcug sems bskyed kyi sdom pa len du bcug pa/ de la smon sems cho gas bzung tshul dang / 'jug sdom len tshul gnyis yod pas spyir btang chos lugs kyi go rtogs dma' ba rnams la dang po ma gtogs gnyis pa de sbyin pa'i srol med/(443) phrir sol ba/ rang nyid kyis brtsams pa'i gzhung la gzhan gyis dgag pa byed pa'am/ rtsod gleng byed par 'ong ba'i mi/(444) lithab khuraja5/ 'dan chos 'khor dgon/ klong thang sgrol ma lha khang yod pa'i sa khul yin par paṇḍi ta smri ti'i rnam thar nang bshad pa de yin nam snyam/(445) gnyan chen bang lha/ sngar bod kyi rim pas mgur blangs pa'i skabs bstod bsngags zhu ba'i yul bod kyi yul lha bcu gsum gyi nang tshan yin par bshad/(446) mthu mong ge grub rtags/ (thun mong)sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gsang sngags kyi gzhung nas bshad tshul la/ gsang sngags bla med kyi lam bsgoms nas bskyed rim mthar phyin pa na phyi'i rtags mtshan du thun mong gi dngos grub brgyad thob pa 'byung ste/ (1)ri lu'i dngos grub/ (2)mig sman gyi dngos grub/ (3)sa 'og gi dngos grub/ (4)ral gri'i dngos grub/ (5)rkang mgyogs kyi dngos grub/ (6)mi snang ba'i dngos grub/ (7)'chi med kyi dngos grub/ (8)nad 'joms pa'i dngos grub bcas brgyad ka thob pa'am/gang yang rung ba thob pa 'byung / yang na/ lta stongs kyi dngos grub brgyad de/(1)shing tog 'bras bu ma smin pa la lta stangs byas nas sa la 'bebs nus pa/

la —— 4(/77(2)mkhregs shing gyen du skyes pa'i shing la lta stangs byas pa tsam gyis thur du 'gug nus pa/ (3)rgyang ring du yod pa'i shing tog dang me tog sogs la lta stangs byas pa tsam gyis rang gi mdun du dgug nus pa/ (4)gcan gzan gdug pa can la lta stangs byas pa tsam gyis rang gi dbang du bya ba/ (5)sngar rang nyid kyis lta stangs byas nas sa la phabs pa'i shing tog rnams la slar yang lta stangs byas pas rang sar 'byor nus pa/ (6)sngar rang nyid kyis lta stangs byas nas thur du bkugs pa'i shing la slar yang lta stangs byas pas sngar bzhin du bsgyur nus pa/ (7)sngar rang nyid kyis lta stongs byas nas mdun du bkugs pa'i shing dang me tog rnams la slar yang lta stangs byas pas rang rang so so'i gnas su bskyal nus pa/ (8)sngar rang nyid kyi lta stangs byas nas bsad pa'i gcan gzan gdug pa can la slar yang lta stangs byas pas gson por gso nus pa/ bcas brgyad po de ni gsang sngags bla na med pa'i gnas tshad rim pa jug gi nang nas rim pa dang po mthar phyin pa'i tshad gzhi yin zhes bshad srol cad/ (447) er ka than gyi chos lugs/ sog po'i yul du sangs rgyas chos lugs ma dar gong bon po'i chos lugs dar zhing / de yang bod kyi bon nag po'i chos lugs dang 'dra bar mi la na tsha byung ba dang / 'chi ba soṭa kyi skabs su ra lug dang / 'bri g.yag rta sogs stong phrag nas bcu phrag gi bar bsad nas sha khrug gis dmar mchod 'bul ba'i lugs zhig yod cing /sog yul du chos lugs de thog mar gang nas byung ba dang kho tsho'i lta tshul gang yin pa sogs kyi dpyad gzhi'i yig cha da phan ma mthong /(448) khro bcu/ gsang sngags kyi gzhung nas bshad pa'i sgo srung khro bo bcu ste/ (1)gshin rje gshed/ (2)gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ (3)rta

408mgrin/ (4)bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/ (6)mi g.yo ba/ (6)'dod pa'i rgyal po/(7)dbyag sngon can/ (8)stobs po che/ (9)gtsug tor 'khor los bskyar ba/ (10)gnod mdzes rgyal po ste/ phyogs bzhi/ mtshams bzhi/ steng gleg gnyis dang bcas pa'i gnod 'tshe srung ba'i khro bo bcu yod/ 'di gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi bzhed srol ltar bris pa las/ yi dam rdo rje 'jiṭa byed kyi khro bo bcu 'di dang phran bu mi 'dra ba yod pa 'dir ma bris/(449) dbang bskur sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gsang sngags kyi gzhung nas bshad srol la/ rang gis dad pa byed pa'i yi dam gyi lha gang dang gang yin pa de'i sku bsgom pa dang / sngags zlo ba/ phyag mtshan la lta ba dang /reg pa sogs kyi dbang cha sbyin pa la zer/ 'di yang rga don stabs bde'i dbang du byas pa yin/(460) bla ba 'byung dzo cog gi dus bzang bzhi/ zla ba re re bzhin gyis tshes brgyad ni sman gyi bla ma'i dus chen/ tshes bcu ni mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus chen/ tshes bco lnga ni sangs rgyas kyi dus chen/ gnam gang ni sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi dus chen bcas yin/(451) dngul bre stong / bod lugs kyi gser gyi ljid tshad tshad ldan ni/ tshong 'dus mgur mo'i tshad gzhi ste nas 'bru che ba gnyis/ 'bring ba gnyis/ chung ba gnyis bcas drug gi zhid tshad dang mnyam pa'i gser la se ba gang / se ba brgyad la zho gang / zho brgyad la srang gang / srang bzhi la dngul bre gang ste/ gser srang bcu drug la gser bre gang / dngul bre gang la dngul srang sum cu so gnyis yod par/ 'dul ba'i 'grel pa mang che ba'i ma byin len gyi pham pa'i skabs su gsal/(462) btsun thams cad dong sprug btson pa rnams gcig

cho 409kyang ma lus par slod grol gtong ba la zer/(453) lha chen po gco 'khor dgu/ mtshur phu'i lha khang chen mo'i nang du bzhugs pa'i thub pa chen po gtso 'khor dgu ste/ dbus su thub pa chen po/ g.yas g.yon du byams pa/ 'jam dbyangs/ spyan ras gzigs/ rgyal ba rigs lnga bcas yod/(464) skad rigs mi gcig pa sum brgya drug cu/ sngar rgya gar du sangs rgyas chos lugs thog mar dar skabs 'jom bu'i gling du skad rigs mi 'dra ba sum brgya drug cu yod ces rgya gar gyi skad nas bod skad du bskyar ba'i mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa〉rnams su bshad kyang / de dag gi ngozlo 'dzin bshad pa mi snang /(455) rgyal po de gnam du song / rgyal po shi ba la gnam du song zer ba dang / rgyal po la gnam gyis bskos pa'i lha sras zer ba sogs ni rgya nag gi bon po'i chos lugs kyi bshad srol yin zhing / bod du yang gna' rabs kyi yi ge rnying pa'i nang / gnam lha babs kyi bdag po zhes 'khod pa'ang bod kyi bon po'i chos lugs kyi bshad srol rgyun 'jags su gnas pa zhig yin/(466) rgyal bya mong kha ldan sku mched/ jing ger han gyi btsun mo che ba la bu bzhi byang ba'i bzhi pa tho los la/ bu bzhi ste/ mong gol nyan/ ha pi li/ ha dīga'i ha/ a ri sto ga bcas yin/ ha khri li phyogs gcig bye gzhan gsam phyogarsha gcig byas te srid dbang 'phrolhas pa'i 'jib rtsod byung ba'i skor chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉gyi le tshan(pa)pa'i kurma pakshi'i rnam thar gyi thad du gsal/(467) snang sri da thams cad/ phyi rol yul du yod pa'i dngos po thams cad/

410(458) gnas nyer bzhi/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gsang sngags kyi gzhung mang po nas ming tsam byung zhing / bu ston rin po che'i gsung bde mchog chos 'byung〉dang / paṇa chen er te ni dpal ldan ye shes kyi gsung(sham bha la'i rnam bshad〉nas rgyas par bshad pa gnyis gung bsgrigs nas don bsdas te bkod par(1)snyu li ra ma la ya(rgya gar shar phyogs bhang snya la yi lho bothe ma la ya'i chu klung 'bab pa'i gnas) (2)jo 'ji ra(chu bo gang ga mtsho mo pham nas mnga' ris kyi yul brgyud nyin 'ga' zhig lho nub phyogs su kha gtad nas 'bab cing / ṭi li'am dhi li'i byang phyogs ha ri dā war nas shar phyogs su 'khyogs nas 'bab pa'i byang ngos/ dza la mug gam/ dza la mu khi ste rdo la me 'bar ba'i gnas) (3)ma snyi ya na('di gong du o rgyan gyi yul zhes bshad pa de yin)(4)a rbu ta(rgya gar sto phyogs kyi ri dbus mtho la mtha' dma' ba 'brang rgyas sam snying gi gzugs can zhig gi ming) (6)gi da wa ri(bal po'i yul gyi byang ngos rang rgyal gyi gnya' nang zhan gyi nye 'dabs la phyi gangs ra zhes gangs ri chen po zhig yod par bshad pa ltar na/ deng sang gi sa bkra'i thog tu sgo sa yin than ri bo zhes sam/ yongs grangs su shi sha sbang ma'i ri bo zhes pa de yin nam snyam ste brtag 'di rje btsun mi la'i rnam thar du/ stod gnya' nang du yod pa'i la phyi gangs ra zhes gsal zhing / la phyi gangs ra zhes pa gyi ma la ya'i ri yi rgyud gcig yin pas/ sa bkra'i nang sgo sa yin than zhes gsal zhing / deng sang yongs grags rgya skad du shi sha sbang ma zhes pa de yin nam/ de min la phyi gangs ra zhes pa logs su yod med brtag dgos) (6)rwa me sha ri(rgya gar gyi sa dbyibs gru gsum du chags pa'i rtse mo rno zhos sto phyogs su gtad pa'i rgya mtsho'i 'gram gyi sne der yod/ 'di nas shar lho phyogs su gru btang nas song na lang spu'i grong khyer ram lam ga'i gling
