wa wa— ——— —— — —4 —phran zhes rgyal po ra rmā nas srin yul du dmag drangs par bshad pa'i yul de yin pas/ deng sang sing ga la'ang / sri lana'am si li laskozer) (7)de blu ko tri/ 'di bod skad du lha mo'i mkhar zhes zer zhing 'di la ngos 'dzin tshul mi 'dra ba gnyis te/ (kong po'i yul dang dwags po)klo yul gsum gyi 'tshams su yod pa'i rtsa ri la ngos 'dzin pa gcig dang / rgya ga a sam gyi shar phyogs/gang tsha rab zhes pa'i nang tshan ti ra phur zhes pa'i ri bo der ngos 'dzin pa gcig yod/ (8)mā la wa/ (rgya gar nub phyogs rgya mtsho'i gling phran zhig yin par bshad) (9)ka ma ru pa (bal yul dang thag nye ba'i gangs rgyal mo mthon mthing gi 'gram nas(rgya gar skad du chu bo lo nyi ta rgya skad du mā mtshon 〉) bod skad du rta mchog kha 'bab tu grags pa de nyid gzhis ka rtse nas nyang chu dang 'dres/ lha sa'i sto nub chu shul nas skyid chu dang 'dres nas yar lung brgyad du 'bab pa la yar lung gtsang po zer/ de nyid kong po yul nas kha lhore bltas nas rgya gar shar phyogs su thon pa'i sa der ngos 'dzin/ de nas rgya gar shar phyogs ya sam gyi yul brgyud nas shar pa gi si than gyi byang nas kha sto bltas nas rgya mtsho chen por 'bab pas gong gsal chu bo'i de'i dum bu la rgya gar ba rnams kyis bha ram purdo zer)(10)o khyi(rgya gar lho phyogs rgyal po shing rta bcu pa'i yul la ngos 'dzin par bshad kyang sa gnas ngos ma zin) (11)byi sha ku na(rgya gar nub phyogs chu bo gaṅga dang / gan ti su ru pa gsum gyi 'dus mdo der yod) (12)ko sa la(rgya gar yul dbus gnyan yod ces pa de yin)(13) ka liṅka rgya gar sto phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram gyi yul la ju liṅka la sogs pa'i liṅga'i ming can brgyad tsam yod par bshad pa'i nang nas gcig yin)(14)lam pa ku(o rgyan gyi yul gyi shar phyogs su yod par bshad) (15)kañtsi(rgya gar lho phyogs kyi dkyil tri ling ka zhes pa de yin par bshad) (16)gyi ma

412la ya/ bod skad du ri bo gangs can zhes rgya gar gyi byang phyog su yod pa'i ri rgyad shin tu ring ba zhig gi ming / (17)pre ta(mnga' ris gu tre/'i yul du zlod) (18)gri ha de wa ta(li yul lcang ra smug po'am/ deng sang shin cang du 'bod pa'i gnas kyi nub ngos su yod par bshad) (19)so ra :/('di bod skad du bzang po can zer zhing rgya gar nub phyogs kyi yul zhig yin par bshad pa ltar rang rgyal nas par bskran byas pa'i sa bkra'i nang du rgya gar nub phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram gyi yul zhig ༄la su la ba'o zhes 'khod pa de yin snyam) (20)su warna dī pa('di bod skad du gser gling zer zhing / deng sang en rda nyi shi ya'i rgyal sa ya sne tā yi nub byang ngos kyi gling phran che ba su man ta la sbyor ba de yin zhes rgya rigs kyi mkhas pa'i dbang po 'ga' zhig gis gsungs pa thos) (21)nā ka ra(rgya gar byang phyogs bal yul dang khyad nye bar chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram du grong khyer pa pa tra li bu rtu 'am(bod skad du skya bo'i bu zer)pa baṇa zhes nā ga ra'i yi ge 'byung ba'i yul de yin par bshad)(22)sin ju/ gangs ri ti se'i byang ngos nas 'bab pa'i chu bo min dhu zhes pa/bod skad du seṅge kha 'bab zer/ de mnga' ris kyi yul brgyud dang por byang dang / de nas pa li ca siri lho ngos nas re zhig bar nub drang po dang de nas kusmira'am/ kha hri smir gyi shar ngos nas nub byang bar 'khyog nas 'bab cing / mthar nub pa gi si than gyi byang shar nas dkyil drang po brgyud rgyal sa kha ra ci'am snga dus kha ra khyar 'bod pa'i nye 'dabs nas a ra ba'i rgya mtshor 'bab pas/ rgyal sa'i nye 'dabs su gong gi gnas de yod par bshad/ (23)ma ru/ kusmir gyi byang phyogs dza landha ra'i nye 'dabs su yod par bshad/(24)ku lu ta/ kusmir gyi byang phyogs kyi mtha' mtshams mnga' ris kyi yul dang thag nye bar yod pa dang / mnga' ris pa rnams kyis nyung rda'i yul zhes

413'bod pa'i nang tshan zhig yin par bshad/(459) then ma khar/ 'di sa gnas gang du yod min ma shes/(460) shin kun/ (shing kun sde chen)'di ska 'bum dgon pa dang thag nye ba zhig tu yod par brag sgom pa dge bshes bstan ༄pa rab rgyas kyi mdzad pa'i mdo smad chos 'byung deb ther rgya mtsho〉las bshad/(461) spang po la tshul bcugs/ sprang po rnams la nyin ltar zhogs pa thug pa thengs re ster ba'i ma dngul 'dzugs pa/(462) chos rje rin po che rang byung rdo rje/ (karma pa rang byung rdo rje)karma pa'i sku phreng gsum pa yin/ (rab byung lnga pa'i shing spel spyi lo 1284 rab byung drug pa'i sa yos spyi lo 1339bar)/ 'khrungs yul mnga' ris mang yul gung thang gangs zhur mo'i 'gram/ rtsa phu rlung shod zer bar yab gsang sngags rnying ma'i sngags 'chang chos dpal zhes pa'i sras su 'khrungs/ dgung lo lngar phebs pa rab byung lnga pa'i sa byi spyi lo 1288lor grab thob o rgyan pa rin chen dpal gyis kurma pa rang byang rdo rje kurma pakshi'i drong srid du ngos 'dzin zhus pa ni bod du bla ma sprul skurā yang srid ngos 'dzin byas pa'i thog ma yin/ dgung lo bdun pa mkhan po kun ldan shes rab kyi drung du rab tu byung / mtshan rang byung rdo rje zhes gsol/ dgung lo bco brgyad la mkhan po gzhon nu byang chub dang / las kyi slob dpon dge 'dun rin chen gnyis kyi drung du dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes/ snye mdo kun dga' don grub soṭa bla ma dang dge bshes mkhas pa mang po bsten nas/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa dang / gsang sngags kyi chos ha cang mang po gsan/ rab byang drug pa'i lcags lug spyi lo 1331 lor yon rgyal rabs kyi gong ma thug pa'i mur gyis gdan drangs pa ltar phebs kyang mi ring bar gong ma 'das pas/

414slar yang phyi ro gong ma ri/rten dpalagyis gdan drangs pa ltar pe cing pho brang du phebs nas rgyal por chos gnang / ring min rgyal po de yang 'das nas rgyal po tho ken the'i mur gyis srid dbang bzung zhing / des kyang sngar bzhin ti shrīr bkur nas lo gcig tsam bzhugs/ rab byung drug pa'i shing khyi spyi lo 1334lor bod du phebs khar/ gong mas chos kun de nyid gzigs pa'i /mi pa zhes pa'i mtshan gyi 'ja' sa dang / gu shrī'i tham kha/ gser yig bcas phu ge nas lo der bod du phebs/ de nas lo ngo gnyis song mtshams slar yang gong mas gdan drangs pa ltar phebs/ rgyal blon rnams la chos mang du gnang /pe cing pho brang du rkarma pa'i dgon sde zhig kyang gzhengs/ lo ngo gsum tsam bzhugs nas dgung lo nga drug pa la pho brang shang dor(hrang tu'u)ska gshegs/gsung rtsom skor la/ 〈rtsis kyi bstan bcos kun btus〉dang/chos dbyings bstod pa'i rnam bshad〉sogs mang po yod tshod kyang bdag gis ma mjal/ lo rgyus rgyas pa chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉gyi le tshan(pa)grangs 36 na 2—47 ba 4bar dang 'be lo tsā ba tshe dbang kun khyab kyis brtsams pa'i sgrab ba/da kurma spum tshang gi chos 'byung rab 'byams nor bu'i zla shel〉bcas rtso ga gas(/463) snyoms chung pa'i rdza bdugs/ khyim tshang 'tsho ba rang 'go thon tsam dang rdza chas bzo mkhan/(464) glang 'khor sbi mchod/ la stod deng ri na yod pa'i glang 'khor dkon pa'i mchod 'bul dus chen/(465) dam pa'i sku/ rje btsun mi la ras pa stod du bzhugs skabs rgya gar nas bod du phebs pa'i grub thob pha dam pa sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan/

ཿ16mgrin pa/ snying kha/ lte ba rnams la ro rkyang gnyis kyis dbu ma la 'khyud nas bsdams pa'i mdud pa steng 'og gcis re dang / snying khar ro rkyang gnyis kyis g.yas g.yon nas res mos su 'khyud pa'i mdud pa gsum re bsdams pa'i mdud pa drug yod par bshad/(471) mngal dang 31la za rtsis pa'i nyi shu/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi 'dul ba'i gzhung nas bshad srol la/ byis pa lo bdun nas chos sgor zhugs te thog mar rab byang dang / dge tshul gyi sdom pa zhus/ de nas rang lo nyi shur ma slebs na /gi slong gi sdom pa zhus mi chog rang lo bcu dgur slebs rjes rang nyid ma'i mngal du zla dgu ngo bcur sdod pa dang / rang lo bdun nas rang lo bcu dgu'i bar lo ngo bcu gnyis la zla bshol gsum 'ong ba bsnan na lo gcig lhag tsam yod pas/ don la lo nyi shur slebs zin pa dang khyad par med pa der zer/(472) 'dul ba'i skor gsan/ 'dul ba'i gzhung gi bshad pa dang / lag len gyi slob khrid gsan pa/(473) mtshan rsha)da/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i gzhung chen po lnga ste/ (1)tshad ma/ (2)phar phyin/ (3)dbu ma/ (4)mdzod/ (5)'dul ba bcas/(474) snye mdo pa chen po kun dga' don grub/ (rab byung lnga pa'i sa 'brag spyi lo 1286 rab byang lnga pa'i me 'brag spyi lo 1316bar)'di'i lo rgyu/ da lta ma rnyed/ thi ga(476) rgod tshang pa/ (rgod tshang pa mgon po rdo rje)rab byung gsum pa'i sa bya spyi lo 1189rtserab byung bzhi pa'i sa rta spyi lo 1268bar)dgung lo bdun cu bzhugs/ 'brug pa bka' rgyud kyi bla ma 'gro mgon gtsang

417pa rgya ras pa'i slob ma'i gtso bo/ tha mar che ba lo rgod gnyis zhes grags pa'i nang gses rgod zhes pa ni rgod tshang pa rshagon po rdo rje la zer/ 'di'i rnam thar lo rgyas cung zad rgyas pa deb ther sngon po〉le tshan(nya)pa'i shog grangs 122sna 6—126na 4bar dang chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉le tshan(na)pa'i grangs 58na/ 59pa 1bar gsal/ (476) yi dam gyi lha/ rang nyid kyis dad gus dang yid ches bya yul gyi lha ste/ skyabs su bzung 'os kyi lha/ ('gro ba rigs drug nang gi lha rnams mi gtogs)ni sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa'i yi dam zhi ba dang khro bo sna tshogs yod cing / bod du chos lugs khag tshang mas thun mong du khas len pa'i yi dam gyi lha yod la/ chos lugs so so'i thun mong ma yin pa'i yi dam gyi lha yang yod/(477) gong du 'byon/ gong ma'i drung du byon pa/(478) rtsa rlung thig le/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gsang sngags kyi gzhung nas bshad rna75/ mi'i lus khams ni gnas pa rtsa/ g.yo ba rlung /bkod pa byang chub kyi sems bcas gsum tshogs pa la brten nas chags pa dang / de yang rtsa yi gtso bo gsum/ 'khor lo bzhi/ rtsa 'dab bdun khri nyis stong bcas yod la/ rlung la yang rtsa ba'i rlung lnga/ yan lag gi rlung lnga sogs/ rlung nyi khri chig stong drug brgya/ thig le rigs bzhi sogs de dag so so'i 'grel bshad rgyas pa ni gsang sngags kyi gzhung las rgyas par bshad pas 'dir zur tsam las ma smos so/ (479) phyi'i gza' skar dus phyor/ gnya' dgu dang rgyu skar nyer bdun mnyam du 'grogs pa'i dus yun gyi chu tshod dang chu srang gi grangs rtsis pa'i dus sbyor ste/ nyin mtshan gcig la dus sbyor nyer bzhi yod pa dang /

418 ——— wa —————de re re la gza' bdun dang dgu'i dus sbyor rtsis tshul/gi (480) tshe/ga phrachod / sngar kong po zho kha rdzong khul gyi sa gnas zhig sung (/481) shar phyogs las kyi gshin rje'i gnas/ kong po smad khul du yod pa'i rgya la seng gtam zhes pa'i sa gnas/ deng sang kong po me tog shan gyi khongs su yod pa'i ri zhig sa gnas der 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje dngos su gnas pa yin zhes shod srol/(482) zasabaka tho / sog la skya bo yod pa'i sa khul du 'bab pa'i chu/deng sang sog shan gyi sa khul du yod/(483) shar rgyal po thog thi skur/ yon rgyal rabs kyi gong ca mi rabs bcu pa/ rab byung drug pa'i sa 'brug spyi lo 1328 rab byung drug pa'i lcags 'brug spyi lo 1331lo bar lo ngo lnga ring srid dbang bzung /(484) nyi ma gzas bzung / sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bshad srol la/ nyi ma gzas bzung ba zer ba ni/ gza' chen po dgu'i nang nas dus me zere bas g.yas bskor du 'khor ba dang / nyi mas g.yon bskor du 'khor ba gnyis thad kur 'khel ba'i skabs su dus me'i mgo mjug gang rung gis nyi ma sgrib pa la zer/ 'di'i skor gyi 'grel bshad gzhan du gsal/(485) :sgrornga sbyachobab 25 ba/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi chos lugs byed sgo zhig ste/ mi shi ba'i rjes su gshin po'i rnam shes la sgrib sbyong khrus gsol dang skye ba phyi ma'i 'gro lam ston pa sogs byed srol yod pa/ (486) rgyal sge ratā shris/ rgyal po rin chen dpal/ yon rgyal rabs kyi gong ma mi rabs bcu gcig pa yin/ rab byung drug pa'i chu sprel spyi lo 1332lor zla ba gsum ring srid dbang bzung nas 'das/

419(487) gong ma'i sbri cu rgyal brgyud/ gong ma'i btsun mo'i rus brgyad gcig pa yin pa'i rgyal brgyad/cu (488) yin bang / zhu skabs de'i gnas tshul ngo ma zin bris byas pa'i ri mo tshon khru can/(489) bstan 'gyur/tsho ston pa sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i gsung rnams kyi dgongs pa 'grel pa'i ched du rgya gar gyi mkhas pas brtsams pa'i gzhung gang yin pa la bstan bcos zer zhing / de dag gi nang nas rgya gar dang rgya nag gi mkhas pas brtsams pa'i bstan bcos kyi nang nas bod skad du bsgyur zin pa la bstan 'gyur zer/ 'on kyang bstan 'gyur gyi mjug tu bong kyi mkhas pa tshos mdzad pa'i bstan bcos mi nyung ba zhis yo da kyang / sangs rgyas chos lugs snga dar gyi dus su byung ba'i bod kyi mkhas pas mdzad pa khag gcig tsam ma gtogs mi 'jug pa ni/ bod kyi mi 'ga' zhig gis brtsams pa'i bstan bcos rdzun ma rnams bstan 'gyur gyi nang du lhad 'dres mi 'byung ba'i ched du sngon byon bod kyi lo tsā ba mkhas pa rnams kyis bkas bcad mdzad pa yin/ rgya gar du bstan 'gyur zer ba'i tha snyad med la/ rgya nag dang bod du tha snyad de byung ba yin/ 'on kyang bod du bka' 'gyur phyogs bsgrigs kyi dkar chag brtsams pa dang / bstan 'gyur phyogs bsgrigs kyi dkar chag brtsams pa'i lo rgyas phal che ba gong gi mchan rtags ang 264par gsal ba dang phal cher 'jo zhing / 'on kyang bod yig gi bstan 'gyur cha tshang ba thog mar bsgrigs pa ni gong gsal snar thang bka' 'gyur dang chabs cig phyogs bsgrigs byas pa yin la/ rab byung drug pa'i shing khyi spyi lo 1334lor zha lu ska zhang kun dga' don grub kyis sbyin bdag byas te/ bu ston rin po che rgyas rdog gnang mkhan du gdan drangs nas bstan 'gyur cha tshang zhig bzhengs pa zhwa

420lu'i gser khang gtsug lag khang du bzhugs shing / de'i dkar chag kyang bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa bstan 'gyur gyi dkar chag yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po'i phreng ba〉bu ston rin po che'i gsung 'bum(pa)pa'i nang du yod/ de rjes su bstan 'gyur cha tshang ba'i dpe rgyun mang che ba snar thang dang / zha lu'i bstan 'gyar la ma dpe byas te bzhings srol 'dug tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa sku 'byes rjes sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos dbus gtsang gi yig 'bri mkhas pa yod tshad bsdas te bzhengs pa'i bstan 'gyur gser bris cha tshang gcig da lta rtse po tā la'i jo brang dmar po'i tshoms chen nub ma'i sbyags kyi lha khang du yod mus/ de rjes rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me sprul spyi lo 1737sde dge rgyal po bstan pa tshe ring gis bstan 'gyur cha tshang par bskos byas te sde dge par khang du bzhag pa la sde dge bstan 'gyur zer/ de rjes rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags bya spyi lo 1741 lor pho lha ba bsod nams stobs rgyas kyis bstan 'gyur cha tshang zhig par bskos byas te snar thang du bzhag pa la snar thang bstan 'gyur zer/ de dang dus mtshungs gong ma chen lung gis bka' phabs pa ltar pe cing du rgya sog bod gsum gyi lo 1 ba mkhas pa mang po tshogs te bstan 'gyur cha tshang man ju'i skad du bskyar 'go tshugs/ de rjes rab byung bcu gsum pa'i mgo spyi lo dus rabs droco brgyad pa'i dkyi'/ du co nee dponamoskoskogyis bstan 'gyur cha tshang zhig par du bskos te co ni dgon par bzhag pa la co ne bstan 'gyur zer/ de'i dkar chag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng gnyis pa 'jig med dbang pos mdzad pa bka' yi dgongs pa 'grel ba'i bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog gi dkar chag yid bzhin nor bu'i phreng ba〉gsung 'bum pod(ca)pa'i nang du yod/ zhib par gong gsal bstan 'gyur so so'i pod grangs dang / nang don/ shog grangs bcas so so'i dkar chag nang gsal bas 'dir ma bris so//

421(490) dus 'khor dbang cho che/ gsang sngags bla na med pa'i rgyad kyi nang nas dus 'khor gyi dbang la/ byis pa ltar 'jug pa'i dbang zlodun/ dbang gong ma gsum/ gong ma'i gong ma'i dbang bzhi/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen po'i dbang bcas so sor phye bas bcu drug dang / so sor ma phye na/ gong gi byis pa ltar 'jug pa'i dbang bdun gyi steng du/ gong ma'i bum dbang gsum dang gong ma'i bum dbang gnyis gcig tu bgrang / de bzhin du gsang dbang gnyis gcig dang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gnyis gcig tu bgrang pa bcas gsum byung ba bsnan pas bcu/ gong ma'i dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang dang bcu gcig tu bsdas kyang rung ngo / /(491) rigs 'di mkha' 'gro/ rgyal ba rigs lnga dang(1 rnam par snang mdzad/ 2 rin chen 'byung ldan/ 3 'od dpag med/ 4 don yod grub pa/ 5 mi bskyod pa)mkha' 'gro sde lnga(1 sto rje mkha' 'gro ཿ rin chen mkha' 'gro ཿ padma mkha' 'gro las kyi mkha' 'gro ca sangs rgyas mkhasa' 'asbyo/)/ (492) pho zang gi 'u mon gtong / (pho brang gi 'u mon gdong)'dir pho brang bang gi khrims dpon khang yin par chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉grangs 46ba 2par gsal/(493) mnar sde/ kurma pa'i chos brgyad 'dzin pa'i dgon sde/(494) blosas bcigathabs/ sangs sgros chos lugs kyi gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi'i yi dam rnams kyi dkyil 'khor la/ ri mor bris pa'i rdal tshon dang / ras bris/ blos bslangs bcas gsum yod pa'i nang gses shesum pa blos bslangs te/ phyi gzhal yas khang pho brang gi rnam pa lta bu la/ nang du yi dam gyi lha rnams bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor 'bur du yod pa zhig ste/ de la

422'jim pas bzos pa dang / shing las bzos pa/ gser dngul sogs rin po che las bzos pa bcas sna tshogs yod/ da lta nyams chag med par gnas pa ni rtse po tā la'i pho brang dmar po'i dbu rtse'i shar lho'i ngos su yod pa'i blos bslangs khang du/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i me byi spyi lo 1756lor/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pa mchog nas dngos su ljags bkod gnang ba ltar gser zangs la rin po che sna tshogs kyi bras btab nas bzhengs pa'i gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs lha sum cu so gnyis/ bde mchog ci i pa lha drug cu re gnyis/ rdo rje 'jig byed lha bcu gsum ma bcas kyi blos bslangs chen po bzo —bkod tshad dang ldan pa dang / yang tā la'i bla ma ska phreng lnga pa sku mya ngan las 'das rjes/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos byang drom ring chos sde dang jo nang rtag brtan phun tshogs gling du bzhugs pa'i dus 'khor gyi blos bslangs la dpe byas te gser zangs las bzos pa'i dus 'khor gyi blos bslangs chen po tshad ldan zhig bzhengs pa da lta rtse po ta la'i pho brang dmar po'i shar ngos thog brtsiṭa gnyis pa'i dus 'khor lha khang du bzhugs pa dang / gzhan yang se ra dgon pa'i sngags pa grwa tshang dang / 'bras spungs dgon pa'i sngags pa grwa tshang so sor 'jim pa las bzos pa'i gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi blos bslangs bcas la gzigs thub na/ blos bslangs zer ba'i bzo dbyibs kyi rnam pa lam tsam mkhyen thub/(495) chos rje sprul sku bzhi pa/ /rma sku phreng bzhi pa rol pa'i rdo rje/ (rab byung drug pa'i lcags 'brug spyi lo 1340 rab byung drug pa'i chu phag spyi lo 1383bar)'khrungs yul stod a la ring gi brag ra gnam rdzong du yab bsod nams don grub dang yum brtson 'grus rgyan gnyis kyi gas su 'khrungs/ chung dus su rtogs ldan mgon rgyal ba sogs mkhas pa mang po

wa —bston nas mdo sngags kyi gzhung dang man ngag mang po gsan/ dgung lo bdun pa la tshogs dge 'dun sgang pa'i mkhan chen don grub dpal pa dang / slob dpon bsod nams 'bum gnyis kyi drung nas rab rgyung gi sdom pa bzhes/mtshan chos kyi grags par gsol/ de nas bzung lo mang ring sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa dang gsang sngags kyi chos la sbyangs pa gnang / dgung lo bco brgyad pa la sngar gyi mkhan slob la brten nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ de nas yon rgyal rabs kyi gong ma tho ken zhi'i mur gyis gdan drangs pa ltar/ rab byung drug pa'i sa khyi spyi lo 1368lor byang lam brgyud de phebs pa'i lam bar du dpon rigs nang 'thab kyi dmag 'khrug mang po 'dum 'grig gnang ba sogs yun ring 'a ra te/ lo ngo gnyis song ba'i rab byung drug pa'i lcags byi spyi lo 1360lo'i dgun mjug tu gong ma'i pho brang du phebs te rgyal blon la chos gsungs/ lo gcig ring bzhugs te chu stag spyi lo 1362lor byang lam brgyud nas bod dbus gtsang du phyir phebs/ dgung lo zhe bzhi pa la sku mya ngan las 'das/ lo rgyus zhib pa chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉le tshan(pa )pa'i grangs 49ba 4—61na 5bar dang / be lo tsā ba tshe dbang kun khyab kyis brtsams pa'i karma kum tshang gi chos 'byung rab 'byams nor bu'i zla shel〉gyi nang gsal/(496) lo rgyan gyi bsnyen grub/ grub thob o rgyan pa nas brgyud pa'i rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub/(497) chos 'byung / skabs 'dir gsang sngags bla med kyi gzhung rnams las bshad pa'i gru gsum dbyibs can gyi ri mo'am 'bur gzugs te/'di'i gru gsum po des rnam thar sgo gsum mtshon pa yin zhes bshad srol yod/(498) chos 'khor gling / tshal gung thang gi grwa tshang zhig yin

425'byung gnas bod du gdan drangs te gsang sngags kyi chos mang po gsungs nas dar spel gtong ba gnang ba ni bod du gsang sngags kyi chos byung ba'i thog ma yin/ de nas dus rabs dgu pa'i dkyil du rgyal po glang dar mas sangs rgyas chos lugs bsnabs nas dus rabs bcu'i mjug tu slebs skabs mnga' ris lo tsā ba rin sdun bzang pos de sngon bod du basbyar ma myong ba'i gsang sngags kyi chos gsar pa mang po bsgyur ba gnang nas/ bskyare du gsang sngags kyi chos dar spel byung / de nas bzung sangs rgyas chos lugs snga dar gyi dus skabs su byung ba'i gsang sngags kyi chos la gsang sngags rnying ma dang / lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po byon pa tshun chad kyi gsang sngags kyi chos la gsang sngags gsar ma zhes pa'i tha snyad btags pa yin/(606) skyor mo lung pa la 'bri nang gi dmag btegs/〈degadamar〉'dir garma pa rol pa'i rdo rje'i dgung lo bcu gnyis pa rab byung drug pa'i chu sbrul spyi lo 1353 lo la byung bar bshad/ (chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉gyi le tshan(pa)pa'i grangs 62 na 7 pa dgung lo bco brgyad pa rab byung drug pa'i me bya spyi lo 1357 lor byung bar bshad/ gang ltar 'bri gang pa'i dmag gis nang so skyor mo lung pa la dmag drangs pa'i lo rgyus yod the de yin/(506) ngam snand/ lha so'i nye 'dabs 'bri gung rgyud kyi sa cha la ngam skad zer gyi yod pa/ bka' gdamang pa'i dge bshes lha 'gro ba'i mgon po'i lo rgyus su gsal/(507) phyag rtse sprod/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gus lugs lam srol la/ mkhas pa chen po phan tshun bar bla ma dang slob ma'i 'brel ba yod pa yin na mjal phrad gnang dus phan tshun mnyam phyag gnang ba la zer/

426(508) tshal pa si rtu/ tshal pa si tu snga rjes kha shas byung ba'i skabs 'dir ni si tu kun dga' rdo rje yin par mngon/ lo rgyas zhib cha deb ther dmar po〉rtsom pa po'i lo rgyus zur du gsal ba der gzinas/(609) gser bre/ gong gi mchan rtags ang(461)par gsal/(610) dngul bre/ gong gi mchan rtags ang(451)par gesal/(511) gad skyar/ sa gnas zhig gi ming / (612) mal stobs dang sku rim/ dgong mo'i srung 'khor dang zhabs brtan rim gro/ ri (513) lha steng / bar khams pa sa khul du yod pa'i rkarma lha steng gi dgon pa/(514) ldan klong bang / bar khams ldan ma'i sa khul du yod pa'i thang zhig gi ming /(515) 'bri chu/ rang re'i rgyal khab kyi nang khul du 'bab pa'i chu bo chen po ang dang po yin la/ 'dzam bu gling du grags che ba'i chu bo chen po zhig kyang yin/ chu bo 'di'i chu mabo nas chu gzhug shar rgya mtsho chen por 'bab pa'i ring tshad la spyi yi le dbar lnga stong lnga brgya lhag tsam yod/ chu bo chen po 'di ni byang phyogs nas sto phyogs su 'bab ste mtsho sngon dang si khron nub brgyud du ma slebs bar sa mtho'i ri brgyad nas 'bab pa'i dbang gis chu shugs che la 'bab tshad kyang mgyogs/ 'bri༄ chu si khron gyi shar brgyud du slebs tshe a sran ri bos 'gro lam bkag pas brag ri brtol te/ ha'u pa'e dang ha'u nan/ cang shis/ an ha'i bcas zhing chen mang po'i sgang gasnang mi stoms pa'i sa cha brgyud de cung zad rshal po'i sgo nas gtsang lag mang po'i chu dang mnyam du shar phyogs rgya mtsho chen por 'bab pa zhig yin/

wa wa —— 427(516) ga chu/ (rka chu)'di da lta'i kun su'u zhing chen khongs nying zha hu'e rigs rang skyong khul yin/(617) rtsaraja98 rgyas/ 'grim 'grul gzhung lam khel yul gyi sa tshigs gtan khel byas pa'i khrul de la rigs gnyis/ 1 che ba la rdzong skyel zer zhing /de ni rdzong gcig gi sa khul nas rdzong gzhan gyi sa tshigs bar skyel ba/ lha sa tshigs ni rdzong skyel ma dgos par sa tshigs de nas sa tshigs gzhan dag bar skyel ba/ (618) ti shrī'i gdung ngo log gis rgyab pa/ ti shrī'i kun dga' rgyal mtshan pe cing du sku gshegs pa'i ska gdung bod du gdan drangs pa'i lam bar zhing pa'i gyen log gi dmag dpung rshang thug phrad byung ste phrogs pa/(619) stong ba'i tshe'i na'i ra thu thang chang / hong tha'i tshe ni rgyal po'i btsun mo zer ba'i don dang / na'i ra thu thang chang zer ba btsun mo'i ming ngo ma yin nam snyam ste brtag(620) dranams zlo:sa/ byams chos sde lnga(1)rje btsun byams pa mgon pos mdzad pa'i bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan〉skabs brgyad yod pa/dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i dkyil du bod kyi lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyis rgya gar skad nas bod skad du bsgyur ba/ bstan 'gyur snar thang par ma'i mdo phyogs le tshan(ka)par yod/ (2)rje btsun byams pa mgon pos mdzad pa'i〈mdo sde rgyan〉bam po gsum yod pa/ dus rabs brgyad pa'i mjug tu bod kyi lo tsā ba ska ba dpal brtsegs kyis rgya gar skad nas bod skad du brgyar ba/bstan 'gyur snar thang par ma'i mdo phyogs kyi le tshan(yi)par yod/cu(3)rje btsun byams pa mgon pos mdzad pa'i dbus mtha' rnam 'byed〉dus rabs brgyad pa'i mjug ñtsa bod kyi lo tsā ba zhang ye shes sdes rgya gar skad nas bod

ska/lha/bskyarab (4)rje btsun byams pa mgonaposamadzadapa'i chos /nyid rnam drobyed)dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i mgor/ nag tsho lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal bas bskyar ba zhig dang / yang lo tsā ba zha ma seng rgyal gyis bsgyur ba bcas mi 'jo ba gnyis/ (5)rje btsun byams pa mgon pos mdzad pa'i rgyad bla ma〉dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i dkyil du/ bod kyi lo kro ba blo ldan shes rab kyis rgya gar skad nas bod skad du basbyar ba bcas gong gsal bstan bcos phyi ma bzhi po bstan 'gyur snar thang par pa'i mdo phyogs kyi le tshan(pha)par yod cing / bstan bcos khag lnga po de'i 'grel pa la rgya gar mkhas pas brtsams pa rigs mi 'dra ba sum cu lhag tsam bstan 'gyur gyi nang du bzhugs/(621) skyes rabs/ slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas kyi skyes rabs so bzhi pa〉'di la bam po bcu gnyis yod/ rgyal po khri lde srong btsan gyi dus su lo tsā ba mardzi sri wa mas basbyar ba de'i 'grel pa〉rgya gar gyi slob dpon dharma gi rtis marād pa/ dus thebs bcu gcig pa'i mgor bod kyi lo tsā ba shākya blo gros kyis bsgyur ba/ de gnyis ka bstan 'gyur snar bang par ma'i le tshan(ka)pa dang bstan 'gyur sde dge par ma'i le tshan(ge)pa gnyis su yod/(622) gnam mchod pa/ sog po'i skad du lha mchod pa la gnam mchod pa'am/ gnam lha mchod pa zer zhing / de ni bon po'i chos lugs nas bshad srol yod la/ yang bshad sro la gcig la/ rgyal po ni gnam gyi lhas 'jig rten gyi bdag por bskos pa yin pas/ rgyal pos nges par du gnam gyi lha mchod dgos pa yin zer/(623) dgos su rtogs par byas/ sgos su gtogs par zhes pa ste/ sger gyi khongs su gtogs par byed chog pa'i gnang ba thob pa/

429(624) 4)'on sde)ngado / sog po'i rgyal rabs kyi lugs srol la/ rgyal po'i rigs su gtogs pa'i dpon rigs rnams la ga'i gang gi go gnas sprod srol yod/ ༄ ༄(526) zam du dben sha/ gong gi mchan rtags ang(291)la gsal bas der gzigs/(526) chu da ru ga che/ gong gi mchan rtags ang grangs(291)la gsal bas der gzigs/(527) cha'o da'o/ 'di yang sog po'i skad yin/ rim pa dma' ba'i dpon rigs khag la gnang ba'i go gnas shig gi ming yin/(528) bde gshegs/ lam bde ba nas 'bras bu bde bar gshegs pa ste sangs rgyas zin pa/(529) phag mo gru ji/ 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa/ rab byung gnyis pa'i lcags stag spyi lo 1110 rab byung gsum pa'i lcags stag spyi lo 1170bar/ dgung lo drug cu re gcig bzhugs/ 'khrungs yul khams 'bri chu'i rgyud rmi shod kyi stag ngos sab khang / gdung rus dbas/ yab snye na a thar/ yum btsun nee/ chung ngu nas yab yum gnyis ka grongs/ dgung lo dgu la bya khyi lha khang du mkhan po snying nge ba tshul khrims 'bar dang 'od zer rgyal mtshan gnyis kyi drung du rab tu byung ba'i mtshan rdo rje rgyal por btags/ khams su lo nyi shu lhag tsam bzhugs ring bla ma bcu drug tsam bsten nas mdo sngags kyi chos mang po gsan/ dgung lo nyer gnyis pa la dbus su byon/ bka' gdams kyi dge bshes mang po'i drung nas bka' gdams kyi chos gsan/ dgung lo nyer lnga la bya 'dul ba 'dzin pas mkhan po dang / dge bshes rgya dmar bas las slob mdzad de bsnyen rdzogs bzhes/ gzhan yang bla

430ma mang po'i drung nas gsang sngags kyi chos gsan/ de nas dgung lo zhe gcig pa lcags lug la bla ma zhang dang mnyam du mnyam med dgas po lha rje mjal bar phebs/ chos mang po gsan te slob mar gyur nas lo gsum bzhugs/dgung lo zhe dgu pa rab byung gsum pa'i sa stag spyi lo 1168lor phag mo gru'i dgon pa btab ste gnas gzhi bzung ba gnang / de nas dar spel byung ba la phag gru bka' brgyud zer/ bka' brgyud chos lugs la che bzhi dang chung brgyad zer ba'i tshogs pa mang por gyes pa'i nang gi chung brgyad ni/ (1)'bri gung bka' brgyad/ (2)stag lung bka' brgyad/ (3)khro phu bka' brgyud/(4)'brug pa rāka' brgyud/ (5)smar ba barsha' brgyud/ (6)yel pa bka' brgyad/ (7)g.ya' bzang bka' brgyad/ (8)shug gseb bka' brgyad bcas tsham ma phag gru'i bka' brgyud nas gyersha pa sha stag yin/ 'di skor lha ngo sprod gnad bsdas tsam zhig gna' rabs lo rgyas yig cha'i tshig 'grel〉du gsal bas 'dire ma bris/ phag mo gru pajo gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs kyi gsung 'bum pod bzhi yod/ lo rgyas cung zad rgyas pa ri bo che dpon tshang tshe dbang rgyal gyis brtsams pa'i sto rostong chos 'byung〉grangs 241ba3 shog grangs 'ga' shas dang / (chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉le tshan(na)pa'i grangs 38ba —42ba2bar gsal/(630) bya 'dul ba/ (bya 'dul ba 'dzin pa brtson 'grus 'bar)rab byung dang po'i sa lug spyi lo 1079 rab byung gnyis pa'i shing khyi spyi lo 1154lo bar/ dgung lo don drug bzhugs/ lo rgyas cung zad tsam deb ther sngon po〉le tshan(kha)pa'i grangs 8ba5—9najidror gsal/(631) byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan/ bka' gdams pa'i dge bshes shig lo rgyus cung zad tsam tshe chog gling yongs 'dzin

431ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i smyung gnas bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar〉nang gsal/(532) dge bshes zhang sum thog pa/ bka' gdams pa'i dge ngabazhis shig (533) ston bla ba chung / bod zla bcu pa/(534) 'bri khung pa/ skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po/ rab byung gnyis pa'i chu phag spyi lo 1143 rab byung bzhi pa'i me glang spyi lo 1217bar/ dgung lo don lnga bzhugs/ 'khrungs yul mdo khams 'bri klung dam pa chos phyug gi yul tsa ra stod g.yon lung gi grong / yab sngags 'chang rdo rje/yum btsun ma gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/ mtshan btsun pa skyabs su thogs/dgung lo drug nas bzung yi ge 'bri klog mkhas par mkhyen/ dgung lo nyer lnga pa me phag gi lo la phag mo gru pa dang mjal nas chos mang po gsan/ dgung lo so lnga pa la gung thang bla ma zhang gis mkhan po dang / slob dpon rtsi lung bas las slob mdzad de bsnyen rdzogs gnang / dgung lo so bdun pa rab byung gsum pa'i sa phag spyi lo 1179lor/ 'bri gung mthil gyi dgon pa btab ste gnas gzhi bzung / de nas dar spel byung ba'i chos brgyad la 'bri gung bka' brgyad zer/ gsung rtsom gang yod phyogs bsgrigs kyi gseng 'bum pod lnga yod/lo ༄rgyus zhib par ri bo che dpon tshang tshe dbang rgyal gyis brtsams pa'i sto rong chos 'byung〉grangs 282ba2 grangs kha shas dang / (chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉le tshan(pha)pa'i grangs 4na5—7ba bar gsal/(535) stag lung pa/ stag lung thang pa rin po che bkra shis dpal/rab byung gnyis pa'i chu phag spyi lo 1143—rab byung bzhi pa'i sa sbrul spyi lo 1209bar/ dgung lo drug cu re bdun bzhugs/ 'khrungs yul mdo khams

432g.yang shod bong ra stengs/ yab ban blon 'bar po dang / yum grab shi bza' dge sum khro mo'i sras su 'khrungs/ dgung lo bco brgyad lon pa'i tshe/ thang skya lha khang du bros nas mkhan po bla sgang pa shes rab rdo rje dang / slob dpon tshar ston pa gnyis kyi drung du rab byung mdzad/ de nas yang bros phebs te dbus su byon/ 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa dang mjal te chos mang du gsan nas lo drug tsam ring bzhugs/ phag gru ska gshegs nas mi ring bar zhang sho ma ra pas mkhan po dang / mar pa tsom theng pas las slob mdzad de bsnyen rdzogs bzhes/ de nas gnas nges med du sgom sgrab la bzhugs/ dgung lo so dgu pa rab byung gsum pa'i lcags byi spyi lo 1110lor/ dar spras rong gsum dang phod mdo bas stag lung du gdan drangs te bla brang nag po bya ba dang / yang dgon gyi sa der phyag phebs nas gnas gzhi bzung ste dgon pa btab/ de nas dar spel byung ba'i chos brgyud la stag lung bka' brgyud zer/ gsung rtsom gang yod phyogs bsgrigs kyi gsung 'bum pod gcig yod/ lo rgyus rgyas pa gong gsal gyi lho rong chos 'byung〉grangs 368ba2 shog grangs 'ga' shas dang / deb ther sngon po〉le tshan(nya)pa'i grangs 91 na5—96na2bar dang / stag lung zhabs drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i stag lung chos 'byung ngo mtshar rgya mtsho〉bcas su gsal bas de rnams su gzigs/(536) sna phu ba/ (grub chen gling ras pa padma rdo rje)rab byang gnyis pa'i sa sprel spyi lo 1128—rab byung gsum pa'i sa sprel spyi lo 1188bar/ dgung lo drug cu re gcig bzhugs/ 'khrungs yul myang stod rig pa'i 'byung gnas(deng sang gi rgyal rtse)kyi glang po sna'i gling smad/ yab rgyal po skyabs/ yum gzus mo dar chung gi sras su 'khrungs/ chung dus 'bri klog mkhas par mkhyen/ sman pa mkhas pa zhig bsten nas gso ba rig pa la yang

———— 13 3sbyangs/ dgung lo bcu gsum pa la yab gshegs/ dgung lo bcu bdun la slob dpon gling gi drung du bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ de nas lo mang po'i bar bla ma bsten nas gsang sngags kyi chos gsan/ dgung lo so brgyad pa la phag mo gru pa dang mjal nas chos mang po gsan/ dgung lo mthon por song rjes sna phur dgon pa btab nas bzhugs pas grub chen sna phu ba zhes mtshan thogs/ lo rgyas rgyas pa bka' brgyad kyi chos 'byang mang che ba'i nang gsal/cu (537) marlo ldan ye 'the seng ge (za ra ba skal ldan ye shes seng gi)'di'i 'khrungs lo gsal bar 'khod pa ma mthong yang / g.ya' bzang pa'i dgung lo so brgyad pa me stag la g.ya' bzang dgon pa btab pa'i phyi lo(rab byung bzhi pa'i me yos spyi lo 1207)za ra ba skal ldan ye shes seng ge sku gshegs par deb ther sngon po〉las bshad/ khong ni phag gru'i slob ma yin zhing za ra dgon pa yang btab/ lo rgyus cung zad deb ther sngon po〉le tshan(nya)pa'i grangs 110ba1—111 na1bar gsal/ (638) kun ldan gtsang pa ras chung pa/ (kun ldan ras pa)rab byung gsum pa'i sa 'brug spyi lo 1148—rab byung bzhi pa'i me glang spyi lo 1217bar/ dgung lo bdun cu bzhugs/ lo rgyus rgyas pa ri bo che dpon tshang tshe dbang rgyal gyis brtsams pa'i sto rong chos 'byung〉grangs 260ba 6 shog grangs 'ga' shas yod/ (539) rtogs ldan mi nyag sgom rin/ 'gro ma tre na phag mo gru pa'i slob ma/ yi ge mi mkhyen kyang phan sems che zhing slob khrid kyi thabs la mkhas pa zhig yin par grags/ lo rgyus zhib cha ma mthong /(540) grub thob nyag re se bo/ grub thob nyag re se bo 'gro mgon phag rgya'i slob ma yin/ lo rgyus zhib cha ma mthong /

434 (641) rgyal tsha rin chen/ (rgyal tsha rin chen mgon)rab byung gnyis pa'i sa khyi spyi lo 1118—rab byung gsum pa'i shing yos spyi lo 1195bar/ dgung lo don brgyad bzhugs/ 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa'i dngos slob yin/ dgung lo lnga bcu nga bzhi pa rab byung gsum pa'i lcags yos spyi lo 1171lor/ zhang btsun dbon chung zer ba'i sa cha khro phu la rin sprad nas nyos pa gnang / dge 'dun nyi shu lhag tsam 'dus pa'i dgon pa btab nas gnas gzhi bzung / de nas dar spel byung ba la khro phu bka' brgyud byung / lo rgyus rgyas pa gong gsal gyi lho rong chos 'byung〉grangs 133ba2—134ba2bar gsal/(542) bde gshegs rin po che/ 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa/gong gi mchan rtags ang 629par gsal/(543) 'bri khung chos rje/ skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po/ gong 34 mchan rtags ang 534par gsal/(644) bkabebachub jordo nga / gsol ja zhu mkhan/ gsol dpon/(645) spyan snga rin po che/ spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas/rab byung gsum pa'i shing lug spyi lo 1176 rab byung bzhi pa'i shing yos spyi lo 1255bar/ dgung lo brgyad cu gya gcig bzhugs/ 'bri gung skyob pa rin po che'i nye gnas yun ring mdzad pas spyan snga zhes mtshan thogs/ lo rgyas rgyas pa gong gsal sto rong chos 'byang〉grangs 296na6 shog grangs 'baca' zhig dang / (deb ther sngon༄ po〉le tshan(nya)pa'i grangs 74na6—77ba2bar gsal/(646) sbru1la ba 2rgog jugs pa/ (rgyal ba rin po che grags pa brtson 'grus) rab byung gsum pa'i chu phag spyi lo 1203—rab byung lnga pa'i me yos spyi lo 1267bar/ dgung lo drug cu re lnga bzhugs/ lo rgyus rgyas pa

436gong gsal sto rong chos 'byung〉dang deb ther sngon po〉le tshan(nya)pa'i grangs 77ba6—78na bar gsal/(647) 〈sna la 〈sna'on/ jing ger han gyi bu bzhi ba tho los la blo bzhi yod pa'i(mung khe han/ hu spa li/ hu la'i hu/ rnam ri sto ga)nang gi gsum pa/ 'bri gung pa'i sbyin bdag sa skya la dmag drangs mkhan de yin/(648) rin po che bcu gnyis pa/ bcu gnyis rnying ma rin chen rdo rje/ rab byung bzhi pa'i sa stag spyi lo 1218—rab byung lnga pa'i lcags 'brug spyi lo 1280bar/ dgung lo re gsum bzhugs/ lo rgyas rgyas pa gong gsal sto rong chos 'byung〉dang / (deb ther sngon po〉le tshan(nya)pa'i grangs 78na4 bcabar gsal/(649) gcen grags pa ye shes/ rin po che grags pa ye shes/rab byung bzhi ba'i lcags byi spyi lo 1300 rab byung lnga pa'i sa byi spyi lo 1348bar/ dgung lo zhe dgu bzhugs/ lo rgyas rgyas pa gong gsal sto rong chos 'byung〉dang / 〈deb ther sngon po〉le tsha/(nya)pa'i grangs 78ba5—79na2bar gsal/(660) gcung rgya bo/ rin po che gnyis mchod pa grags pa rin chen/ rab byung bzhi ba'i lcags khyi spyi lo 1260 rab byung lnga pa'i lcags khyi spyi lo 1310lo bar/ dgung lo drug cu re gcig bzhugs/ 'di'i lo rgyas rgyas pa gong gsal gyi lho rong chos 'byung〉grangs 306 na shog grangs sto 'ga' shas dang / 〈deb ther sngon po〉le tshan(nya)pa'i grangs 79naḥ mig phreng 'ga' shas yod/(661) zag gle ba'i khams chu/ (kha mchu) rab byung lnga pa'i lcaXs sprul spyi lo 1281lor/ 'bri gung du spyan snga bcu gnyis pa rin chen rdo

436 rje ska gshegs pa'i tshab tu spyan snga rin po che grags pa ye shes khrir bskos/khongacu gis rang nyid kyi dbon po snag tsha brag ble ba sa skya'i bla ma ye shes rin chen la phul/ de la sa skya bas 'bri gung gi gdan sar bsko rtsis byas skabs/spyan snga bcu gnyis pa rin chen rdo rje'i gcung rgya bo gras/sa pa rin chen gyis bkrongs / de'i don du sa skya bas 'bri gung par kha mchu slong rtsis byas kyang /gcung rgya bo grags pa rin checa/ gyi rgyab tu 'bri gung pa yongs rdzogs langs par brten sa skya pa dang 'bri gung pa bar dmag 'khrug byung ba'i 'go tshugs pa yin/gong gsal gyi sto rong chos 'byung〉grangs 306na shog grangs 'ga' shas bar yod pa las gsal/(552) sa 'bri 'azu/ ga pa/ sa skya bdag chen dharma pā la rakṣita sa skya'i gad na sar phebs nas lo lnga la slebs pa rab byung lnga pa'i shing bya spyi lo 1285 lor/ 'bri gung sgom pa kun rdor rin chen gyis stod hor gyi rgyal po ha la'i ha'i sog dmag khri dgu tsam bod du khrid nas sa skyar dmag drangs/sdo nas rlo lnga song ba rab byang lnga pa'i lcags stag spyi lo 1290lor/ (sa skya'i 'jam dbyangs rin cherno rgyal mtshan gyi khri lo bzhi pa)sa skya'i dpon chen ang len gyis yon rgyal rabs kyi gong ma ha mi li se chen han gyi bu the'i mur sto khas sne khrid pa'i dmag dpung dang mnya du gtsang dmag phon chen po dang bcas te 'bri gung du dmag drangs/ 'bri gung mthil gyi lha khang chen mo mer bsregs/ grwa pa dang mi skya bsdoms pa'i mi grangs chig khri lhag tsam bsad/de sngon 'bri gung pa'i mchod gzhis khongs kyi mi sde sa cha mang po sa skya ba ri dzogs/ de la bod kyi lo rgyas thog 'bri gung gling log zer zhing / de nas bzung dbus gtsang gnyis kyi ༄bod rigs nang khul bar 'gal zla chen po chags pa'i 'go tshugs zhes bshad srol yod/

wa wa 437(553) slob dpon rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ tshes bzhi rnying ma grags pa rgyal mtshan/ (rab byung lnga pa'i chu sbral spyi lo 1293—rab byung drug pa'i lcags byi spyi lo 1360bar) dgung lo drursha cu re brgyad bzhugs/ lo rgyus zhib par gong gsal lho rong chos 'byung〉grangs 301ba2shog grangs 'ga' shas dang / (deb ther sngon po〉le tshan(nya)pa'i grangs 79na6 ba5bar gsal/(654) sgom pa shag rin/ sgom pa shākya rin chen/ 'bri gung bka' rgyud kyi dpon chen gyi tshab ni 'bri gang sgom pa yin cing / sgom pa shākya rin chen ni 'bri gung sgom pa mi rabs garnyes pa yin/(655) phag gru khri skor/ thog mar 'bri gung dang phag mo gru pa gnyis sde dgon gcig gi khongs su gtogs pas spyi'i dpon sgom pa shag rin gyis byas/ de rjes nye gnas ldan ma sgom brtson/ spyan snga grags pa 'byang gnas kyi gsol dpon mkhan po rin rgyal bar khri dpon rim par byung / ༄de rjes nye gnas rdo rje dpal ba mdo khams nas bod du slebs te spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas kyi gsol ja ba byas/ bya ba gang la'ang mkhas pas rgya nag tu brdzangs nas/ gong ma'i mdun du zhu thabs mkhas pas phag gru khri skor mi rabs nas mi rabs bar 'bri gung par gtan 'jags su dbang ba'i bka' shog dang dam kha bcas thob/ rab byung bzhi pa'i shing stag spyi lo 1264lo nas lo bcu gsum ring khri dpon byas pa'i ring la/ sne gdong / ha la sgang /sna mo/ zangs ri pho brang sgang / tshong 'dus brag kha/ thang po che gling smad/'phyos gzhis mi mon mkhar bkra shis gdong / rgyal thang / lcags rtse gri khu/mchod rten gling / chad dkar bcas gzhis ka bcu gnyis brtsigs/ de nas de'i nu bo gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ byang gzhon/ gzhon nu rgyal mtshan gyi tsha bo

438gzhon nu yon tan/ de rjes ti shrī grags pa 'od zer gyis gong ma'i drung du zhu grogs byas te rin po che gcung rgya bo la khri dpon gyi 'ja' sa byung / khong gshegs nas rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi gcen po rgyal mtshan dpal gyis khri dpon byas/ de nas grags pa bzang po/ gzhon nu rgyal mtshan gyi bu rgyal mtshan skyabs kyi bar cabyung / de rjes tā si byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis khri dpon gyi go gnas bzung ba yin/ zhib par gong gsal sto rong chos 'byung〉dang / stag tshang pa dpal 'byor bzang pos brtsams pa'i rgya bod yig tshang〉/spyan snga bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i chos 'byung mig 'byed 'od stong〉bcas su gsal/(666) stag mams yon rgyal rabs kyi skabs phag gru khri dpon la sbyin pa'i dam kha/ lag pa 'ju sa'i a long la stag gi mgo bo yod pa/(557) khri dpon/ rab byang lnga pa'i sa 'brug spyi lo 1268lor/yon rgyal rabs kyi gong ma ha spa li se dīn han gyis mngags pa'i gser yig pa a kon dang / me gling ṅgenyis bod du 'byor/ dbus gtsang yongs la dud grangs zhib bsher byas/ de nas lo ngo lnga song ba rab byung lnga pa'i chu sprel spyi lo 1272lor dbus gtsang yongs la gong gsal gyi dud grangs gzhor bzung nas khri skor bcu gsum du phyes nas thu po shon lu'i si tu'u yon lha'i rgyu zer ba'i srid 'dzin do dam sa khul btsugs te bod khri skor so sor khri dman re bskos pa yin/ khri skor bcu gsum ni gna' rabs lo rgyas yig cha'i tshig 'grel〉du gsal/ sto(558) sne gdong / 'di thog mar 'bri gung sgom pa rdo rje dpal gyis khri dpon byas skabs thog mar brtsigs pa'i gzhis ga'i gras yin kyang /rjes su tā si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis khri dpon byas rjes/ sne gdong

—4 gzhis ka rgya bskyed byas shing / rjes su tā sis bod sa gnas yongs kyi srid dbang bzung rjes/ pho brang gi lte ba yin/ deng sang bod rang skyong ljongs lho kha khul khams sne gdong shan yod sa de yin/(669) rgyal bya thi skur sbo kha/ 'di bod yig gi lo rgyus su ha pi li se chen han gyi bu yin par bshad/ cu(560) bla ma grags 'od pa/ ti shrī grags pa 'od zer/ gong gi mchan rtags ang 288par gsal/(661) rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ tshes bzhi rnying ma grags pa rgyal mtshan/ gong gi mchan rtags ang 553par gsal ba ltar yin/(662) byang chub rgyal mtshan/ (tā'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan)phag mo gru pa'i sde srid mi rabs dang po(rab byung lnga ba'i chu stag spyi lo 1302—rab byung drugapa'i shing 'brug spyi lo 1364lo bar)'di sto rong chos 'byung〉ltar bris/ 'bri gung pa'i dpon rin chen skyabs la lcam gnyis yod pa'i chung ba khru smon 'bum skyid kyi bu gsum yod pa'i che ba yin/ lo bdun nas tshes bzhi rnying ma grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi drung nas dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa blangs te ming la byang chub rgyal mtshan du btags/ lo dgu pa la mkhan chen tshul dar ba dang / slob dpon pu thengs pa'i sar rab tu byung / rang lo bcu bzhi pa la sa skyar bdag chen bzang po dpal gyi zhabs phyir bsdad/ rang lo nyi shu pa rab byung lnga pa'i lcags bya spyi lo 1321lor sa skya'i ti shrī kun dga' blo gros kyis phag gru'i khri dpon du bskos shing / yon rgyal rabs kyi gong ma shud trī pha la dbyi tsung ke ken nyan gyis dam kha stag mgo ma nor bu gsum pa dang ta'i si tu'i go gnas sprad/ ci sne gdong rdzong khang gi mkhar las dang /mdun gyi sham chu la zas pa 'dzugs pa/ rang nyid chang dang phyi dro'i kha zas

spo/lo/ sogs rabasnyeng sdom pa bsrangs ra po ma log theng me' bzad pas kha mchu bslangs te g.yang bzang ༄pa dang dmag 'thab thengs kha shas byas kyang thog mar pham/ de nas 'bri gung pa dang g.ya' bzang pa/ tshal pa bcas skog tu kha mthun nas po ya' phab gnyis kyi kha mchu sa skya'i dpon chen gyi mdun du gtugs bsher byas skabs slar yang si tu pham/ 'on kyang si tul khri dpon gyi go gnas dang tham ka rtsis ma sprad pa'i dbang gis dpon chen rgyal pa bzang pos dbus gtsang khri skor bcu gsum gyi dmag yar lung du drangs nas/rjes su si tu bar chings sgrigs byed rgyur kha g.yar te si tu 'dzin bzung thog btson 'jug dang / srog la thug pa'i nyes rdung thengs kha shas btang yang /khri dpon gyi go gnas dang tham ka rtsis ma sprad par re zhig btson 'jug byas/rjes su sa skya'i dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po dang / dpon chen dbang brtson bar 'gal ba cher song zhing / sa skya'i gdung brgyad ngo ma mang che ba dpon chen dbang brtson gyi phyogs su langs te/ dpon cherno dbang brtson la yon rgyal rabs kyi gong mas dpon chen gyi 'ja' sa byang bar brten/ dpon chen rgyal ba bzang pos si tu btson khang nas shor bsdu khul byas te slod bkrol btang /de rjes dpon chen dbang brtson dang / sa skya'i ti shrī kun dga' rgyal mtshan sku mched gnyis kyis/ rab byung drug pa'i chu sprel spyi lo 1332lor lha rtse rdzong du btson 'jug byas thog khri skor bcu gsum gyi dmag yar lung du drangs nas yun ring dmag 'thab byas kyang / glags ma snyed par si tur rgyal kha thob ste/rab byung drug pa'i sa glang spyi lo 1349lor bod sa gnas yongs la dbang bsgyur byas/ de rjes dmag chen khrid de sa skya'i mtha' bskor ba dang sbrags/dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po btson nas bton zhing / dmag 'khrug slong ba'i 'go gtso rnams la khrims gcod byas te sa skya'i srid dbang yongs rdzogs rtsis

441blangs nas phag mo gru pas bod yongs sda dbang bsgyar byed pa'i 'go tshugs pa yin/ de nas rab byung drug pa'i shing 'brug rū lo 1364lo bar lo bcu drug ring srid dbang bzung / rab byung drug pa'i me sprel spyi lo 1367lor/lcags rtse gri gu rdzong dang / 'ol kha stag rtse rdzong / gong dkar rdzong / sne'u rdzong bcas brtsigs shing / de'i phyi lo me bya lor gzhis ka brag dkar rdzong brtsigs/ gzhan yang gzhis ka bsam 'grub rtse'i rdzong dang / rin spungs rdzong pa rnams lhan grub rtse sogs rdzong chen bcu gsum brtsigs nas rdzong so sor rdzong dpon༄ bskos bzhag dang lo gsum re nas rdzong dpon gsar ba gtong rgya/ srid dbang 'dzin mkhan so sos lo res mos su sa gnas so sor ngo /skyod rtog zhib tu 'gro dgos pa bcas kyi lam lugs btsugs/ rang lo nga dgu pa rab byung drug pa'i lcags glang spyi lo 1361lor/ rang nyid kyi lo rgyas bka' chems deb ther〉brtsams/ de yi phyi lor bu ston rin po che'i /ngos slob thugs sras lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal sogs dge bshes mkhas pa mang po zhus dag tu gdan drangs te rtsed thang dgon par gser bris kyi bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur cha tshang bzhengs/ rang lo drug cu re gsum pa rab byung drug pa'i shing 'brug lor rang nyid srid khri'i las 'gan dgongs pa zhus te tshab tu 'jam dbyangs gu shrī shākya rgyal mtshan bskos nas ring po ma song bar 'das/ 'di skor gyi lo rgyas zhib pa ni tā si rang nyid kyis brtsams pa'i〈bka' chems deb ther〉dang / ༄ gong du gsal ba'i sto rong chos 'byang〉gnyis khungs dag par bsam nas de ltar du bris pa yin pas zhib cha de /nyis su gsal/bla ma bdag nyid chen po/ bdag chen bzang po dpal ba/ gong gi mchan rtags ang 439par gsal/

442(663) bla na kun blo/ ti shrī kun dga' blo gros/ gong gi mchan rtags ang (28ka)par gsal/(664) cung dbang rgyal po/ yon rgyal rabs kyi gong ma ha spa li se chen han nas brtsis pa'i gong ma mi rabs drug pa ye sun the'i mur/༄gong gi mchan rtags ang 223par gsal/(565) gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi bzhed srol ltar/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam dpal rdo rje lha bcu dgu ma ste gtso bo yum bcas sku mdog dmar ser zhal gsum phyag drug pa dbus su byas pa'i rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ rdo rje ma drug khro bo bzhi bcas bcu dgu dkyil mchog nor bu'i phreng ba〉las gsal/(566) las kha tshar/ char 'bebs/ sad spung / rkun jag dang gcan gzan sogs kyi gnod pa srung ba/ mi dang mi ma yin dbang du bsdu ba sogs las sbyor sna tshogs kyi ming /(667) gshin rje dgra nag 'di la lha bcu gsum yod pa phal che ba rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma dang 'dra/(568) bka' bsrungs/ chos lugs so sor rang rang gi bka'asrung mi 'dra ba re yod kyang / spyi'i bka' srung mgon po phyag drug pa/ rdo rje gur/ zhal bzhi pa/ lha mo dmag zor ma lta bu/(569) 'jig thed/ yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed/ 'di la lha bcu gsum yod pa ste/ dbus su gtso bo yab yum/ phyogs bzhir gshin rje gshed bzhi/ sgo ba bzhi/ mtshams bzhir yum bzhi bcas yod/(570) gnyos 'byung gnas shes rab/ gnyos lo tsā ba yin nam brtag

——— — wa — 443(671) pha rgyud skor gadraḥm/ slob dpon chen po bha lim ta a tsa ras bod kyi kha rag gnyos lo tsā ba la gnang ba'i pha rgyad skor gsum ste/1 gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs/ tshi gshin rje /gra nag 3 rdo rje 'jigs byed bcas so/(572) bde mchog 'di la 1 bde mchog lu i pa lha drug cu re gnyis/ 2 bde mchog nag po lugs lha drug cu re gnyis/ 3 bde mchog dril bu lus dkyil dang lha lnga/ 4 bde mchog ngam rdzong snyan brgyud sob/sa skyesad/(573ka) gnyos lha nang pa/ gnyos rgyal pa lha nang ba/ 'bri gung skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po'i dngos slob yin/ (rab byang gsum pa'i shing sprel spyi lo 1164 rab byang bzhiri ba'i shing spel spyi lo 1214bar)dgung lo re gcig bzhugs/ lo zlos zhib pa deb ther sngon po〉le tshan(nya)pa'i grangs 87ba2 bskya par gsarā/(6739) nag po spyod pa chung ba/ rgya gar gyi grub chen nag po spyod pa snga rjes gnyis byung ba'i rjes ma yin/(674) sangs 45sa ras chen/ 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa'i slob ma sangs rgyas gnyan ras/ (576) gson gshid/ mi shi ba'i rjes su de'i nye 'brel shul na lus pa rnams kyis dran gso'i mchod 'bul byas pa la zer/(676) na ro pa'i gdams ngag (nā ro chos drug)rtsa ba gsum dang yan lag gsum ste drug dang po rtsa ba gsum ni/ 1 ma rgyud kyi rdor dang / bde mchog nas bshad pa'i gtum mo/ 2 pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa nas bshad pa'i sgyu lus/ 3 de nas bshad pa'i 'od gsal/ bcas dang /

gardo//pa yan lagagasum ni/ 1 ma rgyad gdan bzhi nas bshad pa'i 'pho ba/ci2 de nas bshad pa'i grong 'jug 3 kār do'i gdams ngag bcas yin pas/de rnams la bka' brgyad pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyis ming 'dogs stangs 'di ltar mdzad de/ 1 rshatum mo bde drod rang 'bar/ 2 sbya lus chags sdang rang grol/ 3 mi lam nying 'khrul rang dag 'od gasgol gti mug rang sangs/ 5 'pho ba ma bsgom sangs rgyas/ 6 bar do rgyal ba longs sku bcas drug yin gsung srol 'dug(577) chosags pa 1snyethab / dgon pa'am sgrab sde'i slob dpon gnang ba'i zhe sa/ cu(578) thogs re/ dus yun thung tsam gyi ring /(679) skyor cho lung / sngon dus bka' gdams pa'i dge bshes sbal ti dgra bcom pas thog mar btab cing / rjes su rje tshong kha pa'i dus su dge lugs par gyur pa yin/ (deng sang bod rang skyong ljongs stod lung bde chen shan gyi khongs su yod)sngar bod dbus khul du gdan sa se 'bras dge /sbya/ ༵ nabyung gong du dbus khul du yod pa'i gdan sa chen po drug gi gras (680) thre5la khrims 98chal ba/ khrims lugs med pa'i bya spyod rang snang gang dran/(581) ji zad/ lha sa skyed chu'i smad rgyud/ (682) gye re dgon pa/ thog mar 'bri gung skyob pa rin po che'i dngos slob gnyos rgyal ba lha nang pa'i dbon brgyad lha pa dbang gi rgyal pos gtsug lag khang dang dgon pa btab/ rjes su rākhan po sangs rgyas dbang phyag rje tsong kha pa'i slob mar gyur rjes chos lugs de dge lugs/ par bsgyuX ba

445rten (583) zhang 'gro ba'i mgon po rin po che/ (gung thang bla ma zhang brtson 'grus grags pa) (rab byung gnyis pa'i chu stag spyi lo 1122kherab byung gsum pa'i chu glang spyi lo 1193bar) dgung lo don gnyis bzhugs/ 'khrungs yul ngam skad tsha ba gru/ yab sngags 'chang rdo rje se /sa dpa' dang / yum mang skyid gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/ dgung lo bdun nas yum dang gcen pos yi ge 'bri klog bslabs/ de nas dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi bar slob dpon mang po bsten nas phar phyin dang / mngon pa/ tshad ma/gsang sngags bcas kyi chos la sbyangs pa gnang / dgung lo nyi shu rtsa drug pa la slob dpon grab mkhar ba sogs kyi drung du bsnyen rdzogs bzhes/ mtshan brtson 'grus grags par btags/ rga lo tsā ba sogs gsang sngags kyi bla ma mang po bsten nas chos gsan/ dgung lo so gsum pa la dwags sgom tshul khrims snying po dang mjal nas dwags po bka' brgyad kyi chos gsan/ de nas lo mang ring ri khrod nges med du sgom sgrub mdzad/ ༄ de nas ska tshe'i dkyil nas ska tshe'i smad du ma slebs bar/ lho kha dang / 'bri khung / zhu'ol kha sa khul gyi cu ra btsan dpon rigs mang por dmag drangs te kho tsho'i mi sde rnams dbang 'og tu bsdas par mdzad/ sku tshe'i smad du kurma pa dus gsum mkhyen pas re 'dun zhus pa ltar de nas bzung sku tshe ma rdzogs bar du dmag mtshams 'jog pa gnang /rab byung gsum pa'i shing lug spyi lo 1175lor tshal yang dgon dang / de nas lo bcu gsum song ba rab byung gsum pa'i me lug spyi lo 1187lor gung thang gi dgon pa btab nas lha chen dpal 'bar bzhengs/ de nas dar spel byang ba'i chos lugs la tshal pa bka' brgyad zer zhing / ming gzhan dwags po ཿka' brgyud kyang zer/ gsung rtsom garā yod phyogs bsgrigs byas pa pod lnga

—4geyod/ rnam thar rgyas pa ni deb ther sngon po〉le tshan(nya)pa'i grangs 136na7—138 na bar dang chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉le tshan(na)pa'i grangs 36balha grangs 37 na7 bar gsal/ yang tshal pa kun dga' rdo rjes brtsams pa'i bla ma zhang gi rnam thar rgyas pa〉zhig yod ces dkar chag tu 'khod kyang bdag gis da phan ma mthong lags/(584) 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud/ le'u sum cu so drug yod/ dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i mgor lo tsā ba shākya blo gros kyis rgya gar skad nas bod skad du bsgyur ba/ bka' 'gyur snar thang par ma'i le tshan(da)pa'i nang yod/'di'i nang gi tshig 'ga' zhig la mdo smad pa dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi bshad tshul 'ga' zhig yod kyang 'dir ma bris/(586) sprin chen mo'i mdo/ bam po bcu dang le'u so bdun yod/ sngar rgyal po khri ral pa can gyi dus su lo tsā ba zhang ye shes sdes rgya gar skad nas bod skad du bsgyur ba/ bka' 'gyur snar thang par ma'i le tshan(wa)pa'i nang yod/(686) thi sna da tsha ba gru/ lha sa'i shar rgyud 'ol kha'i sa khul du yod pa'i sa cha zhig gi ming /(687) rtsa ba'i bla ma/ (1) rang la so thar gyi sdom pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa/ gsang sngags kyi sdom pa bcas gsum ka bla ma de'i drung nas thob pa yin sko bla ma de rang nyid kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa/ (2) rang nyid kyis bla ma de la chos mang po zhu myong na bla ma de rang nyid kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa lta bu/ (688) rtsa mi sangs rgyas grags pa/ rtsa mi lo tsā ba sangs rgyas grags pa/ lo tsā ba 'di gung thang bla ma zhang gi rnam thar nang gsal bas khong

447dang dus thog phal cher mtshungs par mngon/ 'khrung yul mdo khams mi nyag gi yul rtsa mi/ lo tsā mkhas par mkhyen cing / mdo sngags gnyis por mkhas pas rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi dgon pa'i mkhan po yang mdzad myong / 'o rgyas zhib cha da phan ma mthong lags/ ༄(589) dpal chen rgu lo/ (rga lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal)gung thang bla ma zhang dang dus mnyam pa khong gi rnam thar las bshad/ 'khrungs yul khams ldan ma nas yin/ lo rgyas rgyas pa/ jo nang pa tā ra nā thas mdzad pa'igashin rje gshed kyi chos 'byujo〉dang chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉le tshan(ta)pa'i grangs 12 ba 1—7 bar gsal/(590) mal ber pa/ gung thang bla ma zhang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma drug gi gras shig yin par bshad pa tsam las lo rgyas zhib cha da phan ma mthong /(591) gegs bsal/ rtsa rlung sgom nas gnas tshad nges can zhig tu slebs pa na/ rtsa gegs dang / rlung gegs mang po 'byung srid pas de la ji ltar byas nas gegs rkyen sel thabs byed dgos min rang nyid kyi gnas tshad la gzhir bzung dgos pa/(592ka) kun thob byang chub kyi sems/ bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i byang chub kyi sems la stong pa nyid kyi lta bas ma zin pa/( 592kha) casab/ ༄stezud/ gsang sngags kyi lam bsgom nas gnas tshad yar rgyas 'gro rgya 'gor po yin na de la myar da yar rgyas 'byang thabs kyi nyams myong ngo spod byas pa/ ༄ ༄ ༄(693) dwags po sgom pa/ (dwags sgom tshul khrims snying po)rab byang gnyis pa'i me spel spyi lo 1116 rab byang gsum pa'i sa glang spyi lo 1169bar/ dgung lo nga gsum bzhugs/ mnyapa med dwags po lha rje'i ga na

po~X ba gser ri'i sras che ba yin/ lo rgyas cung zad zhib pa deb ther sngon po〉le tshan(nya)pa'i grangs 27na2—28na༄6 bar dang chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉le tshan(na)pa'i grangs 33na par ga la/(594) don dam byang chub sems/ bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i byang chub kyi sems de la stong pa nyid kyi lta bas rgyas thebs pa/(595) grub thob bee ro tsa na/ 'di bod kyi rgyal po khri srong lde btsan dang dus mnyam pa'i lo chen be ro tsa na min cing / de dang mtshan 'dra ba'i bka' brgyad chos tshugs kyi bla ma zhig yin/ de'i lo rgyas da phan ma mthong / ༄ ༄(596) sa skya pa chen po/ sa chen kun dga' snying po gong gi mchan rtags ang 264par gsal/(597) bskyed rim/ sbyang bya gzhi dus kyi skye 'chi bar do gsum po sbyong byed ska gsum gyi lam khyer bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis sgo gsum tha mal gyi snang zhen zlos ldog pa'i gsang sngags kyi lam zhig zhib cha gsang sngags bla med kyi gzhung rnams su gsal/ (698) rje(gas rim/ bskyed rim mthar phyin pa'am/ myong ba thon pa'i gang zag gis rang gi lus kyi gnas rnams la gnad du bsnun nas bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum byed pa'i gsang sngags kyi lam zhig zhib cha gsang sngags bla med kyi gzhung rnams su gsal/(699) jes don/ dngos po dang dngos med kyi chos thams cad rang nyid kyi gdags gzhi tshogs pa la brten nas ming gis btags tsam ma gtagazu/ rang gi ngos nas tshugs thub tu grub pa nam yang med pa ni/ ngo bo mthar thug yin cing de la sa gzhan du ngo bo mthar thug pa med pa de gtan

khel ba dang 'gyar ba med pa'i bden don yin zhes bshad srol yod 449(600nye lha sa rnam gnyis/ lha sa gtsug lag khang dang ra mo che rnam gnyis/(601) tshal/ tshal yang dgon/ rab byung gsum pa'i shing lug spyi lo 1175lor gung thang bla ma zhang gis thog mar btab pa'i dgon pa zhigadeng sang bod rang skyong ljongs lha sa grong khyer gyi khongs gtogs tshal gung thang don gcod khang gnas yul/(602) lha chen dpal 'bar/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan chen po/(603) gnya' dang rgyal khrims/ dbang 'og tu ma 'dus pa la dmag drangs nas khrims 'og tu bsdas pa/(604) sku 'byam chen ༷tha/ mchod rten chen mo/(606) grub thob gling chen ras pa/ 'di gong gi mchan rtags ang 636par gsal ba ltar yin/(606) 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras/ gtsang pa rgya ras pa ye shes rdo rje rab byung gsum pa'i lcags sbrul spyi lo 1161—rab byung bzhi pa'i lcags lug spyi lo 1211 bar/ dgung lo nga gcig bzhugs/ 'khrungs yul myang stod khu le/ yab rgya zur pho tshab pe dang / yum mar bza' dari skyid kyi sras bdun gyi nang nas chung shos yin/ dgung lo brgyad pa la yum gshegs/ dgung lo bcu gnyis pa nas nyi shu rtsa gnyis bar du gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos mang po gsan/ de nas grub chen gling ras pa dang mjal nas/ chos mang po gsan/ lo lnga ring bzhugs nas gdams ngag thams cad tshang bar thob/dgung lo so gsum pa la rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs stabs cig tu mdzad/ de

go 3mo nas mi ring bar 'brug tu dgon pa btab/ de nas bzung 'brug pa'i chos lugs kyis bod sa khul yongs la khyab pa lta bur gyur te/ mi phyed 'brug pa/'brug phyed sprang po/ spang phyed grub thob zer ba'i gtam kun gyis gleng ba byung /lo rgyas zhib pa/ 〈deb ther sngon po〉le tshan(nya)pa'i grangs 116ba7—118na stobar dang chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉le tshan(na)pa'i grangs 66na3—67na7bar dang / 'brug pa kun mkhyen padma dkar pos mdzad pa'i〈chos 'byung bstan pa'i padma rgyas pa'i nyin byed〉bcas su gsal/(607) grub thob ti shrī ras pa/ 'di gung thang bla ma zhang gi slob ma yin/ lo rgyas zhib pa bdag gis ma mthong /(608) mdo ras pa/ 'di yang gung thang bla ma zhang gi slob ma grags can zhig yin kyang lo rgyas ma mthong /(609) zhig tres bsdud rtsi/ 'di gsang sngags rnying ma'i bla ma mtshan snyan shin tu che ba zhig yin rab byung gsum pa'i sa sbrul spyi lo 1149wa warab byung gsum pa'i sa lug spyi lo 1199bar/ dgung lo nga gcig bzhugs/ lo rgyas zhib pa gong du gsal ba'i gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi chos 'byung〉dang dedro ther sngon po〉le tshan(ga)pa'i grangs 14ba2—19naḥbar gsal/(610) chos kyi rgyal tshab/ bla mas rang nyid chos rgyan 'dzin pa'i bdag por bskos pa/ cu(611) mnyam med shākya ye shes/ gung thang bla ma zhang gi slob ma/rab byung gsum pa'i me yos spyi lo 1147gorab byung bzhi pa'i me yos spyi lo 1207lo bar/ dgung lo drug cu re gcig bzhugs/ lo rgyus zhib pa〈deb dmar〉'dir gsal/

wa wa 451(612) kha rag gi grwa pa chen po 'dul ba 'od/ kha rag pa 'dul ba 'od/ gung thang bla ma zhang gi slob ma/ 'khrungs yul kha rag nas yin pas mtshan la de ltar thogs/ lo rgyas deb dmar〉'dir gsal ba las zhib cha ma mthong / sto(613) lha phyug mkhar pa nyi za 'od/ gung thang bla ma zhang gi slob ma/ lha phyug mkhar gyi ri khrod btab pas mtshan la lha phyug mkhar bar thogs/ lo rgyas deb dmar〉'dir gsal ba las zhib pa gzhan ma mthong /(614) lha ri ba chen po nam mkha' 'od/ gung thang bla ma zhang gi slob ma/ lha ri kha ba'i dgon pa btab pas mtshan la lha ri bar thogs/lo rgyus deb dmar〉'dir gsal ba las zhib pa gzhan ma mthong /(616) ro skam pa lo sgom nyi ma shes rab gung thang bla ma zhang gi slob ma/ ro sgom gyi dgon pa btab pas mtshan la ro sgom par thogs/lo rgyus zhib pa ma mthong lags/(616) dpon dar ma gzhon nu/ thog mar gung thang bla ma zhang gi nye gnas yin cing / rjes su zhi drag gi las don gang cir 'jon thang che bas sde mi ser gyi dpon du bskos pas dpon dar ma gzhon nur thogs/ lo rgyus zhib cha ma mthong / (617) ya 'arnga ga stag lung / sngar yon rgyal rabs kyi skabs yar 'brog stag lung khongs gtogs su khri skor gcig dang khri dpon yod/ sa skya'i dpon chen ang len ni yar 'brog khri dpon gyi dpon rgyad yin/(618) skya ming / chos sgor zhugs nas drob byung ma byas gong khyim pa'i dus kyi ming /(619) grub thob dbya se/ (karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa)gong gi

453gyis gdan sa ba byed 'dod yod mkhan gyis 'khrugs pa bslangs pa/(628) rin po che sangs rgyas snying po/ 'di'i lo rgyas cung zad deb dmar〉 'di dang gong du gsal ba'i tshal gung thang gi dkarā chag〉'a ra ba/tha slo /(629) nyang stod kyi glang lung dgon pa/ nyang stod rgyal rtse khul gyi bka' gdams kyi dgon pa/(630) 'bre chen po shes rab 'bar/ rngog lo kro ba blo ldan shes rab kyi slob ma'i gtso bo bzhi'i gras yin cing / sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa spyi dang / lhag par du phar phyin la mkhas pa'i mchog tu gyur pa zhig yin/ 'dis mdzad pa'i phar phyin gyi 'grel pa〉dang / 〈nyi khri'i 'grel pa〉/ (mdo sdad pa'i 'grel pa〉bcas yod par dkar chag khag tu bshad/ 'di'i lo rgyas zlos pa ma mthong zhing / mdor bsdas shig deb ther sngon po〉le tshan(chaXpa'i grangs 202 bcabar gsal/ cu(631) thugs brgyud/ byang chub sems bskyed kyi gdams ngag(632) blo phyong/ theg pa chen po'i chos lugs kyi blo sbyong ste/ bla ma gser gling pa nas jo bo rje la brgyad pa'i rgya 'bras man ngag bdun gyi sgo nas byang chub kyi sems la blo sbyong ba sdong / bla nyam byams pa'i rnal 'byor ba nas jo bo rje la brgyud pa'i bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i sgo nas blo sbyong tshul gnyis yod/rje tsong kha pas de gnyis gcig tu sgril nas 'khrid par mdzad pa yin/(633) me lugs/ kye rdo rje'i rgyad 'grel bshad byed stangs 'ga' zhig yod pa'i nang gi mar pa lo tsā ba'i slobacu ma mes ston chen po'i lugs/(634) tshal lugs/ gung thang bla ma zhang gi lugs/(635) chen po dga' bde yab sras/ tshal pa'i dpon chen

da//tram̐ bad dpalab dang / de'i bu che ba dpon rin chen seng ge chung ba spen lam rdo rje bcas la zer/ 'di gsum gyi lo rgyus cung zad gong gsal tshal gung thang gi dkar chag〉las gsal/(636) 'dul ba mdo rtsa〉/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi slob ma 'dul ba la mkhas pa'i mchog tu gyur pa slob dpon yon tan 'od kyis mdzad pa'i 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba〉/ 'di'i nang don ni sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab nang bzhugs pa'i 'dul ba lung sde bzhi'i brjod don rnams go rim du bsgrigs nas gnad tshang bar mdzad pa zhig yin/ 'di la le'u nyi shu dang bam po dgu yod/ rgyal po khri lde srong btsan mu tig btsan po'i dus su rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis rgya gar skad nas bod skad du basbyar ba/ bstan 'gyur snar thang par ma'i mdo phyogs le tshan(za)pa'i nang rnyed/ 'di la slob dpon rang nyid kyis mdzad pa paṇḍi ta a laṅka de ba dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba steng pa tshul khrims 'byung gnas kyis rgya gar skad nas bod skad du bskyar ba/ bstan 'gyur snar thang par ma'i mdo phyogs le tshan('u)(yu)gnyirā su cha tshang yod/ de min bstan 'gyur mdo phyogs le tshan(ru)(luste(shu)(su)bcas la pod bzhi yod cing /dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i dkyil du bka' gdams pa'i dge bshes mtsho sna bas mdzad pa'i 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba'i mchan 'grel nyi ma'i 'od zer〉zhes pa ha cang legs po zhig yod pa bod yongs su khyab che zhing / de sngon lha sar shing par yang yod/ (637) spyod 'jug〉/ 〈byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa〉/ 'di ni rgya gar gyi slob dpon chen po zhi ba lhas mdzad pa zhig yin/mgo nas mjug bar tshigs bcad yin la go bde zhing blo la 'dzin bde ba yod

455pa dang / nang don ni theg pa chen po'i byang chub sems sbyong gi man ngag gtso bor ston pa zhig yin/ 'di la le'u bcu yod cing / thog mar rgyal po khri lde srong btsan gyi dus su lo tsā ba sarba dzña de ba dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba ska ba dpal brtsegs kyis bod skad du basbyar ba las/ snga phyir 'gyur bcos thengs gnyis byas pa/ bstan 'gyar (ra thang dpar ma'i mdo phyogs le tshan(ma)pa'i nang yod cing / de'i 'khrol pa la rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta mang pos mdzad pa'i nang nas khag bcu tsam gong gsal bstan 'gyur snar thang par ma'i mdo phyogs le tshan(sha)pa'i nang yod la/ bod du yang grub mtha' ris med kyi mkhas pa mang pos 'grel pa rgyas bsdas sna tshogs mdzad yod pas 'dir 'bri bar ma langs/ 〈spyod 'jug)ni bod kyi mkhas pa mang pos cha tshang blo 'dzin thog rgyun du ngag skyor gnang mkhan mang po yod pa zhig yin/(638) 'dul skor gyi lung dang phyag len/ 'dul ba'i gzhung rtsa ba dang 'grel pa rnams kyi lung dang bshad khrid/ de'i lag len(sdom pa 'bog chog bslab pa 'bul ba/ gzhi gsum/ yo byad byin rlabs/ spang lhang phyir bcos byin len nub lhag bsrung ba sogs)/cu (639) gru ma ri gongs pa'i chos skor/ shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi chos skor zhig (640) rngog pa'i chos skor/ mar pa lo tsā ba'i slob ma rngog chos sku rdo rje la gsang sngags kyi rgyud mi 'dra ba bdun gyi chos skor man ngag dang bcas pa cha tshang yod cing / de'i nang ses mar pa lo tsā ba rang la gsan pa drug ste/ 1 kye rdo rje lha dgu/ lha bdag med lha mo bco lnga/ 3 rdo rje gdan bzhi lha mang / 4 ma shes dbang 5phyug ma/ ca ma hā mā ya lha lnga/6 gur rigs bsdus bcas dang / 7 khams pa shes rab rdo rje la gsan pa

/yo6'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas bdun la zer/(641) brtag gnyis me lugs/ gong du mchan rtags ang 633par gsal ba ltar yin/(642) bka' 'byam/ bod kyi mkhas pa rang rang so sos mdzad pa'i gsung rtsom gang yod phyogs bsgrigs byas pa la gsung 'bum dang / bka' 'bum zer srol yod mod/ 'on kyang chos lugs mi sna min pa'i rtsom yig phyoṭa bsgrigs la brtsams chos zer ba las/ bka' 'bum dang gsung 'bum zer srol med/(643) yer pa dga' ldan rgya ri khrod/ 'di tshal pa bka' brgyud kyi dgon pa zhig yin pa las/ rgyal rtse sde srid rab brtan kun bzang 'phags pas rgyal rtse dpal chos dgon pa'i nye 'dabs su btab pa'i ri khrod de min/(644) sgom zhwa/ ri khrod du sgom sgrab mdzad pa pos bzhes pa'i dbu zhwa ste/ chos lugs khag gi bla ma tsho'i sgozlo lha'i dbyibs mi 'dra bas/ chos lugs khag gi bla ma tsho'i dgon pa'i nang ska 'dra mjal skabs zhwa stabs mi 'dra ba'i thoge nas chos lugs mi 'dra ba'i dam ba gsal po yod/(646) dpon chen po smon lam/ drung chen smon lam rdo rje/tshal pa'i dpon chen dga' bde dpal ba'i bu chung ba yin/ 'di'i lo rgyus cung zad gong gsal tshal gung thang gi dkar chag〉nang gsal/(646) 'dag 'char lo gsum/ sgo la 'dag sbyar byas te mi dang thug phrad ma byas par sgom sgrub la bsdad pa'i don/(647) dad pa'i dge 'dun/ rang nyid lo nyi shu lon nas dge cislong gi sdom pa zhus skabs/ dpang po zhu yul dang sdom pa zhu yul du rab la

457dge slong bcu tshogs dang / ma mtha' dge slong lnga tshogs dgos/ de la dad pa'i dge 'dun zer zhing / sdom pa 'bogs pa'i cho ga gsung mkhan mkhan po dang las kyi slob dpon yin kyang / sdom pa thob yul dge 'dun las thob pa yin/ ri(648) gañdzi ra/ bod sa gnas su gtsug lag khang dang dgon pa khag gi dbu rtse'i spen bad steng dang rgya phibs kyi steng du gañdzi ra'i tog yod/'di la sangs rgyas rigs lnga mtshon pa'i mtshon rtags lnga yod cing / rgyas par byed na dril gzugs g.ya ra ste/ pad gdan gyi steng du sangs rgyas rnam snang mtshon pa'i 'khor lo/ de'i steng du sangs rgyas don yod grub pa mtshon pa'i dril bu/ de'i steng du sangs rgyas 'od dpag med mtshon pa'i padma 'dab brgyad/de'i steng du sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa mtshon pa'i bum pa/ de'i steng du sangs rgyas rin 'byung mtshon pa'i nor bu'i tog bcas yod/ bsdas pa la dril bu dang 'khor lo mi dgos par byas te/ pad gdan gyi steng dusto sangs rgyas rnam snang mtshon pa'i bum pa/ de'i steng du sangs rgyas 'od dpag med mtshon pa'i padma 'dab brgyad/ de'i steng du sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa mtshon pa'i nor bu'i tog bcas gsum po des rgyal ba rigs gsum mtshon zhing / de la bum gzuṭa gañdzir zer/(649) ri mi 'babs pa/ ri khrod du bsdad nas grong du mi 'bab pa'i mtshams bcad dam po/(650) chong 'dul 'gur mo/ de sngon dus rabs bcu pa'i dkyil du dbus gtsang gi mkhas pa mi bcus mdo smad du phebs nas bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyi slob ma grum ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi drung du dge slong zhus rjes lo shas nas bod du phebs/ de'i nang nas lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug

458gi 'khrungs yul gtsang 'gur mo rab kha nas yin pas khong gis mched grogs gzhan rnams la/ khyed rnams gnas skabs bod dbus gtsang khul du log ma phebs par mdo khams 'dir bzhugs/ ngas sngon la dbus gtsang du 'gro ba'i tshong pa dang mnyam du song nas chos dar nus pa 'dug na log mi yong bar dbus gtsang du bsdad kyis/ de tsa na khyed rnams yar phebs na 'thus/ gal te dbus gtsang du chos dar bar byed ma nus na nga yang tshong pa dang mnyam por mdo smad du log yong rgyu yin gsungs nas tshong pa dang mnyam du bod la phebs/khong rnams sum 'phrang du slebs mtshams tshong pa rnams de gar tshong byas te mdo smad du log rtsis yod skabs/ lo ston gyis khyed rnams 'di nas ma ldog par gtsang la song nas 'gur mo rab khar slebs tshe nga'i pha lo nad gtsug na zer ba zhig yod pa de la nga dbus na 'dug ces lan skyol zhes mngags te gtsang du btang / tshong pa rnams kyis kyang khong gis gsungs pa ltar byas pas tshong legs po byung / de nas bzung gtsang gi 'gur mo rab khar tshong 'dus chags pa'i ming du tshong 'dus 'gur mo zer/ (deng sang bod rang skyong ljongs snye mo zhan khongs mar rkyang chus su yod)de sngon bod kyi gser dngul gyi ljid tshad thang gzhi yang tshong 'dus 'gur mo'i khrom ra'i rin thang gi tshad gzhir bzung nas chos khrims dang / srid gzhung gi khrims yig nang brgas pa 'jal gyi khrims yig skor bshad skabs/ tshong 'dus 'gur mo'i gseng dngul dang 'bru rigs kyi rin thang gzhir bzung bar bshad/ zhib par snga rabs bod kyi mkhas pa tshos mdzad pa'i 'dul ba'i 'grel pa〉khag dang / 〈gtsang ba rgyal po'i khrims yig〉 sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i khrims yig zhal lce bcu gsum〉nang du gsal zhing / gong gsal tshong 'dus 'gur mo'i lo rgyas ni chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉le tshan(nya)pa'i grangs 5 ba7—612

459bar gsal ba nas gnad bsdas byas/(651) dzam drung cig gi thug pa/ rtsam pa la sha rus kyi rdor btab pa'i thug pa/pa/ (662) thug tshul/ rtsam thug rgyun du gtong ba'i ma dngul 'dzugs (653) ma ṇi'i rgyun/ spyan ras gzigs kyi gzung sngags ma ṇi rgyan mi chad par 'don pa'i mthun rkyen sbyor ba/cu (654) byams sprin rlung gi kha gnon/ sngar rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos lha sa gtsug lag khang ma bzhengs gong / mnga' ris mang yul du bzhengs pa'i byams sprin dge rgyas lha khang / de ni 'byang ba rlang gi kha gnon gyi ched du bzhengs pa yin zer/ ga zhu(655) ma ṇi'i thun/ ma ṇi 'don pa'i sgra rgyun mi chad par byed srol yod pa'i thun pa/(656) (rgyas 'bring rnam gsum〉〈yum rgyas 'bring bsdas gsum〉de sngon rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su lo tsā ba rlangs khazlos pa go cha/ bee ro tsa na/ lce khyi 'brug zhang ye shes sde la sogs pas rgya gar skad nas bod skad du basbyar ba'i yum rgyas pa〉bka' 'gyur snar thang par ma'i nang pod(ka)wa (na)bar pod bcu gnyis dang / 〈yum 'bring po〉la nang gses rgyas 'bring bsdas gsum yod pa'i 'bring po'i rgyas pa nyi khri〉 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ /ka' 'gyur snar thang par ma'i nang pod(ka)(kha)(ga)gsum yod/ 'bring po'i 'bring po khri brgyad stong pa〉lo tsā ba zhang ye shes sde sogs kyis bsgyur ba/ bka' 'gyur snar thang par ma'i pod(ka)(kha)(ga)gsum yod/ 'bring po'i bsdus pa shes rab khri pa〉/ lo tsā ba zhang ye shes

460sde sogs kyis basbyar ba/ bka' 'gyur snar thang par ma'i nang pod gcig yod/yum bsdas pa beergyad stong pa〉'gyur mi 'dra ba dang zhus dag thengs mang po song ba/sto bka' 'gyur snar thang par ma'i nang pod gcigayod/ gong gsal yum rgyas pa la pod bcu gnyis/ 'bring po la pod bdun/ bsdas pa la pod gcig bcas pod nyi shu tham pa yongs rdzogs kyi spyi ming la yum sgrol 'bring bsdas gsum〉zer/ zhib par bka' 'gyur so so'i dkar chag tu gzigs/cu (657) skyabs 'gro sems skyes/ skyabs 'gro bzhi skor dang sems bskyed tshad med bzhi ldan/(658) yi ge brgya pa〉/ yig 'bru brgya yod pa'i gzungs sngags/'di la rdor sems yig brgya dang / gshin rje gshed kyi yig brgya sogs yod/(669) maṇi'i thun/ (ma ṇi'i thun)gong gi mchan rtags ang 656par gsal/de yin/(660) thun mo cha/ gong gi mchan rtags ang 655par gsal ba (661) ka ṇḍa'i mchod rten/ mchod rten chen po'i sa 'dzin gyi 'og gam/ yang na khri'i phyogs bzhir 'grim 'gru spru gyi sgo gtod yod pa/(662) dkar thag steng du thog yod pa'i 'gro lam ring po/(663) mnya zu2/ (sa tsha)sa gtsang ma la par btab pa'i mchod rten dang lha sku/(664) thugs la btags/ bka' drin che zhes pa'i zhe sa/ (666) bal yul/ deng sang gi ni pa la'i rgyal khab/(666) 'phags pa shing kun/ bal yul du bzhengs pa'i mchod rten nang du sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel bzhugs pa zhig 'di'i lo rgyus da phan ma

mthong wa wa —wa wa 461(667) spu rang rgyal po/ mnga' ris pu hreng gi sa char dbang bsgyur byas pa'i rgyal po/(668) nang gi bla mchod/ gtso bor chos zhu yul gyi bla ma'am mchod gnas/(669) gu ge rgyal po/ mnga' ris gu ge sa char dbang basbyar byas pa'i rgyal po/ skabs 'dir rgyal po 'di'i ming dngos su ma 'khod cing cu/gu ge mkhan chen ngag dbang grags pas brtsams pa'i mnga' ris chos 'byung〉nang du 'di skor mi gsal bas rjes su zhib 'jug byed dgos/(670) cung shu zhing gi mi dpon/ krung rgya'u zhing gi mi dpon zhing chen gcig gi sa khul la dbang bsgyur byed mkhan dpon rigs shig yin nam brtag(671) chu mi dben gyi mi dpon/ sa sgo'i do dam dpon chen yin nam brtag(672) g.yu shri ba'i mi dpon/ (g.yu si tha'i mi dpon)zhib dpyod mi dpon zer ba yin nam brtag(673) ban nde/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi grwa pa'i rigs la bande zer/(674) khral dmag las gsum/ khrul dang / dmag khrul/ u lag gsum gyi bsdas ming /(675) cudakon mchog gsum/ sangs rgyas chos lugs la skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul dkon mchog gsum ste/ 1 chos gsung ba po sangs rgyas/2 des gsungs pa'i chos/ 3 chos de nyams su len pa'i dge 'dun bcas
